text: mahshuya peʼinaʼpi, kema ituku: thashi teʼnawanke teʼwa mentahterinke iwankepuchin. Aʼma sehtekehsu, yusparin tehke uʼmararnsu nunshinake.

Ihpura iʼwaraya yuntunawe kurihki. ku ya tihkirawe ku nuwanterawehsuke. Tahparawe paʼankamare neʼmehte inaran puʼpian yamura. Nuwantapun aʼnarahchin perahpachinawe. Ku nituhterawe ihkantapunku nimara ku tuminku ihkayantaraʼsuwe.
Kahpashin kankanchihtuwe nuyahsha nunteranku nihpuni.
Ina yuʼin shaʼwichin, nimara tahshiramiachin pakapun wahpuru iʼsha ihkankipachin.
Mniahtun, waʼwa; ihperataweri iraʼ paʼpi a kanuhterinpu, ninanrinpu nihpera wahpurumahshu, nahpatun peʼpeke maniatun maʼshanen.
Ku pahkaturu patekariuwe a waitamare nañantupihsu peike.
Unpuwa, aʼshatu. Ninanuke nimara ichi yaʼweretapu pantaʼpinuwe sami yaniteke, mamanuwe nininpuchin ka waʼwatapu.
Nani uʼnanpachina maninawe aʼsuninawe nuunke yunkirawe kemuinewita ahkeran,nunteku wiʼnamare,inauchi kahpa kankanterawe.
Ku ikirurarewawe uhsharan kankunpate, irahka iraterepuchin.

Kema peike ayanpatan tahshi, nimara yunkiʼihtuwe nahpuru iʼsha pentunterehsu nahpuinahchin. ku nituhterawe inapuchin nahtanawe ushahkern iʼsha nahtansawatu. Naʼwankapunku nimara, kari naʼwanawepuchin, inara ira yah paʼteraisu.
¿Naniteran niwinkusu puʼpian yamura inaran uskuru? Tahshiraya iʼshakeran wentararawe nuya samira kentarawe inaran yaʼi pawereʼinken.
¿Unpuwanta ku yunkirewe nuya paʼtunen? Nani tahshiramiachin samira kechiʼ inke inaran kema yamurake ayantuku, ¿Nuya tenan?
¿Nimara yunkiran nuʼwiterawehsu?

Nimara yusparin iteʼi piyapi yaʼwerawe nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu kaʼtaninku wira awetahpun. Tashi ina nuyahshakeran nuntawatunku winareʼna wenu keterinku uʼurawe. Nimara ku kashu nituhterawe unpuhsu nuhsururinkuhsu. Shaʼwichinke, wiʼnawe, nuyahsha yaʼnuwatan paʼni nuhsurarinen inaran aʼnuke kemanta nuhsuruteransu.
¿Upuinteranta uskuru paʼananawe, yamura inaran nawanuʼsa ihsu paʼnaweke, iʼsha pamaterinsu yaʼkupikapunku nihka kankumakamare ninanuʼpa?
Iʼyara, ku waʼwashanpuwai, nihpiriunwe ni ayateri. Ku nuwiterewe nara tatun anuterinsu. Uʼnan ku tananpiterinpu niʼkamare ira. Iʼwatere ayankamare, ina ahke tananke, yunkirawehsu ku wachi nañatarawe.
Ama kemaraihchin kehparitekesuʼ, weke kareʼku.
Aʼma naʼneinsu, a nuya kankanchin.

Aʼshatu, puʼpian chinuhteri ihsu peiyanake nihpuni, ka kaʼihtuwe samira kehsharawehsu. Ikirurawe naʼkunn iraterawe niʼtun.Inaran wenseintaʼhihtuwe aʼnarahchin pantamare.Manuʼawa nani uʼnan anutarin pawantarinpuwa naʼkun iratakahsu.
¿Ku weʼka teniunwe paʼantenaʼpi kuʼwara paʼterinsu puʼpian nahtanchahtaraʼsuwe?
Ana taweri sehterewa,nihkaunawe taweri kankirin nuya kushatamare nahpuinaʼchin.
Nimara inawa tahpapi puʼpian puʼpian samira paʼanpikeran, tuhpi yuntunkasu tuhpi aʼna taweri sahkaipuchin taweri nihpachin paʼantaimare.
Ni nuʼwire nihpiriunwe, inapihkeran nuyahtantare.
Yusparin ichihtuwe aʼpaniatu nuya winarawekeran.

Nuya tenan amiraʼwa. Naʼwanewa uhshiwarin ahke paʼninsu kirihkatapun, Nimara kanpuari nishihtariwa nanan aʼpakeran aʼpatakamare, ina kahpashinkeran nunchihtunwe. Ka tenawe nihkariuwa nahkaranchin aʼna pantaʼpi senawatewa.

Nimara sanawi naʼwanin kunparin uʼnan weʼsarin paʼninsu. Inahsu ku yaʼkuananen unkuteriunwe aʼnaapita puchin, nimara inaurahchin nihpachin kañuarin. Nimara nuya niʼkapun kuhsharu yuhkamare inaran yunkiruʼsa ninanuke pihta yaʼwerinsu.Ina yusparin ichina nuyahsha maʼsha yuhkatun yaʼwerinmare, ihpura ahke puchini kehkenin kankanenke.
Atarikayuʼtun kepake tahshiramiachin paʼantupiʼpa, aʼchinterinenpuchin, iʼwara iʼwaraya kankiran niʼtun ku interanta paʼanterinkenwe.
Ku ni yaʼweretakahsu kampuwa samira patapimare.

¿Nanpetapun ina paʼtereʼsu kuhtarute kehken peʼperankeran nani tahshi nihpiriunwe? Paʼurunen ikihtapun, wiʼnawe. ¿Nu nuyawe tahshiramiachin nunshinankepa pakamare? Tahshi tananke ahke inaran tanawantahrin. ¿Inta aʼpintapunke ira uʼnanpachina?
Ku nayarayuʼ ina samira yaniteʼ
Ku kema iyawarin kahtawaranwe paʼantamare, ina ihpuranta niwitarin.
Nuyahsha ni yuntunpatewa, yuʼme mentahsha kepararewa inaran aʼma niwike yuʼwawasu; inapuchin uʼmarewa kahpashinkeran yamura kematewa, tuna inaran uskuru peimare.
Ka nahtanawe, paʼaantakasu kuahsu ni awekaaruwe; nimara tuhpinan nunkakahsu kahpashinkeran kahtyaʼpinpu nuya yuki akukaware.
Mañahtun nanpeaʼa, nanpirinuwe, nuyahsha iʼwarin. Yaʼi semanake iratari ninanukeʼpa nunshake inaran nuyarinku iratakahsu kemaruʼku.
Maʼpaku weʼka itereransu, wiʼnawi. Nuyahshakeran muhturu amihke inaran niʼke taʼna, ninanuʼpa pakakahsu nuwantupi nuyahshakeran ni aʼpeikamare.

¿Ina pantaʼpi niwike kechihtunkuwe nunihtaweri paweraranke? Tahpanawe nahtantakahsu, nimantaratun sehtereʼna iratahrawe ku pawere kantirinku niʼtun.Nahpuyanahchin paʼantupiʼpa paʼmawate, aʼnuchihtenkunwe insehkena puʼpian mare paʼanpihsu inaran kurihki a naʼahchihtunwe. Ka nunawehsu nuʼten niʼihtuwe kemaruʼku, ina nuya. ya ninaranku ninantainkumare taweri, iyawe?

Waʼwasha, ¿Unpu yuntun ihteriuta saʼyate tarahpa paʼankamare? Puʼpian naʼkumiachin shapi paʼanpate, yuntun ihteriuwe nuelwanterehsu. ¿Kema kaʼtanku ninanukeʼpa paʼantiʼi? Irahka suʼyawe paʼterin saʼyate tarahpa peike. ¿Unpuanta ku wachi inshateranta paʼteriunwe irahkapuchin.?

Iyahsha nuntewatera, penenawe kankanenkeran nahtankamare. Uhsharan uteke imiparin inaran yusparin iteke nuʼpa wayu ketainkamare. Aʼma aʼnarumiahchin nuʼsitekehsu, nimara kahpashin kankanteke puʼpian yaʼweterinmare. Ka yunkirawe yaʼnupinenpita kahken waʼwaruʼsarehken yaʼnupiransu inaran sehterawe ahkeran niʼtun. Ni aʼpeike iʼsha pamaterinkeran inaran uʼmake ni niantaʼa.
¿Shiʼshi yaʼwerenamen shapun maʼpachihtun?

Nahtanku, wiʼnawe, werate kankanenkeranchachin. Pantaʼpi ninanuʼpa kepawateuwa, aʼma kashin nahchin paʼanwasu.Peike pawanarinsuʼtun paʼanawa: yamura, piʼshi, nawan. Inapuwatewa ku senatu kurihki ayataririuwa aʼnarahchin iʼsha imirarepuchin. Nuya a suʼsuawa wiʼnanpuwa tahpatamare, inawahsu suʼsurapi maʼsha paʼterinsu tahparatuna.
Tahshiraya tahshiramiachin Irataran, pentuntaran kahtu iʼsha inaran kamutechin chinuhtaran. Aʼpeike paʼurunen, nuya puʼmuke sahpatenen pihpikaman.
Paʼa paʼantupike ihpura taweri
Waʼwaruʼsa, nuyahshakeran weʼka ituku aʼchinaʼpi weʼsarinsu nihkanpuwa. Aʼma paʼninsumare sehtakusu,nimara nahkaranchin nihsha nihsha nahsha aʼyakahsu aʼchintarima.
Aʼnan saʼyatemahsu peʼikamare.
Tawehriachin peike paʼmarawe, ama tahshi irake uʼnatakamareweʼ.
Kankirawe naʼnereʼna chiwerawe niʼtun
¡Ama nunsha aʼnantutarakesuwe.

Weʼka, ku shaʼwirawe ya iraterawehsu. Wahpuru iʼsha ku ninarinkuwe nahpuatun taʼarawe iʼsha yunsanke. Nihpiriunwe kahpashin kankanterawe, yaʼi yamuranuwe paʼanawe petete iʼshake. Ku kuʼwanerawe paʼnawehsu mare, nuya taweri ninin paʼantamare.
¿Nimara kuahsu kahpashin kankanterewe nuwarapatera nunshinankeʼpa inaran iyaruʼsa kahpashinkeran nahkawirinawe inaran kusharuke?
¿Mamapaya nañantapun kuʼsharu kuʼwara aʼkayan paʼshahtaraʼsuwe?
Kanpuaʼtun nunshinanke kankunpatewa, Nuyahsha nuya akuaʼawa pantaʼpi nununuʼsa nuyahsha yaʼnukaimare.
Ikiruwinan uʼmarai tahshiwanke.

Nahpuru ku ya paʼaneiwe yuʼme kurihkeran, ya paʼanai uskuru inaran yamura peikemare. Nihpiriunwe puʼpian keterinenpuwa inaran kanpuahsu nuwanteruwa ikiruapiruawe. Kari nani shaʼwiterankema inahsu ku nuyawe kanpianamen nihkakasu. Aʼma tuhpinan yuʼwawasu imirakeran saʼkateruwahsu aʼna maʼsha aʼnuarahchin taʼwaterinsure. Paʼtakasu waʼkirin naʼkun iʼwaraya ina nuya niʼkakasu.
¿Unpuanta yunkirama ku nuyahsha niʼnawe wiʼnawe? Ku nuʼtenwe; ahke sahkataʼpatera winarinsu ku ayaterawe yunkirawekeran
¿mamapaya ku keteʼitun ninunen ana wayumarechinaʼ? ina nuya tenin nihpunin, winapinan, ninusuʼ pahtun wayusuʼ ku pahterinwe. ¿amiwensu nuya kankantuwina kepaʼitun ina iyasha peinenpa?
¿Unpantaihsu ira ku tihkinaun paʼpatura nihkapu aʼna sanawi wairinʼsu iʼshana yunsankeʼpa?
¿Unpu unputa nihka wiʼninpita kechihtuwen?
Uʼnanpachina ku ya paʼnawe, ira tuʼkuiru niʼtun inaran ku nuyarinkuwe iratakahsu ira shipiruke.
Tahshiraya kepake pantaʼpi ninanuʼpa inaran paʼanke nanpiwi miahchin,inaputuwatan piyapiruʼsa aʼnuarahchin paʼantarinenken inaran aʼnuramiahchin peike uʼmararan.
Ama sehtahkesu, ka paʼihtuwe kemaruʼku.

Nimara waʼwasha naʼwanin iyamahshunen paʼninsu aʼna ninanukeʼpa. Nimara ina yunkiapunwe patupi, iyaʼwaini nani tahshi yunkirin. Niʼna aʼshin nuya niʼnin nuntakahsu nuyahshakeran sehtu inkikamare. Waʼwasha tahpaʼin yunki yaʼnupi yaʼnupiyerinsu iʼshake, taweri ayankasu ihkankaware.
Nuya kankunpatan tananke, chiniʼ tawatun chinuhteke, wiʼnawe; Inahke tatamahshunupita kehsha yuʼnin inaran shaʼwinan shaʼwipi.
Nuya niʼku waʼnan ama ni tapiʼnuwe puntuasuwa, ni karikuntranta nanitawarawe wententawakasu paʼawa maitaʼwa kankuntamare iʼwarayateranta ninanuaʼwanenpuaʼpa.
Nuʼseratemare aʼna iyahsharuʼku ni awepatuwi, ku tahshiahtaraʼsuwe nuyahsha nuntarawe, inaputuatu tahshiraya nahkaranchin maike panantarai.
Iʼwata, Imupaya. Nimara kema ya paʼanan kuʼwara kanpiatahsuwe kehsha aʼna pahkanan uskurure, Ku nituhterawe kehpariterinsu.
Unpuwa, iyara, tahshiraya paʼmare nunshake ninanuʼpa. Ka nuya akurarawe peʼpetu inaran kema yunkiraranken ahke irateraweke.
Yunsanken ninachin, nimara aʼshin nanpekawen wahpuru iʼshake.
Nuyahsha ahke irateke, wiʼnawe.
Nimara ina uʼmakawen kara tawerikeran, waʼwini aʼpeichin waʼwishinuʼsa.
Ku nimara ka manurarawe paʼantamare; nuya nimara ninatapu puʼpian paʼterinsu inaran kenansarawe nuʼten paʼterinsu.
Paʼan ihtunwe yamura inaran uskuru uʼpian mare.
Uʼnanpachina, mamapaya uʼnan nihsawatun tananparihchin sehterin. Aʼmipita naʼwanin tenin inaran kankanen inaura nahtanin.
Tewarewa nipirinwe,napunachin ni paʼpuyaterewa ama nanekesuwe
Naʼkun nuwantarawe nuʼpa maʼsha akukamare.
Waʼwahsha nuʼwitewachina,aʼshini ninarin uhshahken tunakamare
Ina ayankintarin iʼwarayaware nani wairin pihkeran.
Nani uʼmaranke peʼirankeran, sami nanpiru keteke iyawarinpita inaran tatamahshunen.

Kepaʼawa weʼehta, inaran neʼmehtemahsu inaran kuhseraʼwa nuya paʼmupinan. Aʼma iʼsha inpi nañantaʼawasu, waʼwaruʼsa. Nani muhturu puʼmurai, nihpiriunwe paʼawa mañahtun wai. iʼwatuwatewa, sanawi kankan yunkiapun inaura tananke. Mañahtun peʼpeawa yaʼi inaran aʼma maʼshateranta pataʼawasu peikeran.
Piʼi chinihken anutewachin tiʼyahtenenke, chinuhteke nunara nukunanke; Inahke naʼkun ninin, mahshuruʼsanta tananpitupi ikituwihsu.

Ku kema ya nunteranku karinken iʼwara nuʼwiranken niʼtun, kari intintirawe. Nimara tachihtunpuchin kemaruʼku ninawe nahpuatun ku nunanwe. Nihpiriunwe nuyahsha ni nutaʼa kuʼwara nunshake paʼshataraʼsuwe. Manuke, wiʼnawe nani piʼi nanperarin samiruʼsa naʼpirawi. Ka kahpashin kankanchihtuwe nahkaranchin tewaranku nihpuni. Ku nuwanterawe kema sehtakesu irateranke. Imiranen ketuku kahtuyaʼpinpu paʼa inapuwate ku inshateranta sehtariunwe ihpura.

Ka mamanuruʼku yunkirai iratakahsu aʼna parihchi nunentun paya niʼkunakahsu. Kahtu iʼsha pentunterai tuʼtuwitenchin. Mamá paʼuru ikihterin niʼtun uhsharan ninarai. Ikirurai itaratawatui, nihpiriunwe nuya kankunai ihpuwinan.

Waʼyanukerachachin weʼka iterawe, uhshipaya. Nimara nani tahshi Kemanta teʼwaran tanawanke. Sehtureʼna yunkirawe mamanuwe nuneninsu peneninkuhsu. Nimara ninararawe kahpaitakahsu ihpura, kankanuwe nituhterin aʼma rupatamarewe naʼkun.
Nuyahshakeran weʼka ichinken, Ahpurimahshu. Nahpuru iʼwaraya kema nuwanteran kanpaitakahsu shiʼshinen samira nanpirure, Yunkirawehsu puʼpian teweterinku nihpiriunwe.
Tahshiraya Kankuanawe waʼwaweruʼku nunshake, nuʼpanema iʼnatuwatu mahshuruʼsaʼtun weʼka itarawe waʼweruapuchin.
¿Tenan nunentunaʼpi nuya nahtanin ninanuke sahkaturuʼsa nuya nanan maʼpatupi niʼtun?
Irataripuchin aʼyaʼa nuwanterawehsu. Nani iʼwaraya maitari ninanukeʼpa winaransu nihkatuwe kahpashin kankanterawe.

¿Ihpura nahtanpatanke ketaunke shapun niwike? Sehterawe kurihke aʼchinawemare ku kantirinkuwe niʼtun inaran kumuiruʼsa ku maʼshateranta yaʼwetepiu neʼmehte peʼsakamare. Pawerearanke paʼantupiʼpa paʼmawatu aʼna sawatuʼpa. ¿Nuwantapun nikaku nahpuware? Ku nahpunin ya ihchi kehpariterankenwen, nihpiriunwe ihsu taweriruʼsa nuya nine yaʼwereke.

Keyahsu yunkirai pentuntakahsu iʼshana peʼnahte peʼikamare. Iraterai keparai saʼyate tarahpa inaran saweni nuya tahpapinan. Paʼpi shihpiru ira, nahpuatun nani nanleraike ni ninarai. Kankunai ikiruwinan nihpiriunwe kahpashin kankankeran iyawe nuhsururawehsu.
Ku peʼpekawewe naʼkun peʼpetu kawera.
¿Ke papun yaʼi paʼanteranu nihka?
¿Unpuanta nani taweri uskuru aʼnanawe?
Sanapi, nahtainke nani tahshi waʼwan naʼnepachin ihpuke. inaputupatan ku ahkete teʼwarariunwe inaran nituhtarin kiwikahsu kanpitake.
Nuya ahpimahshu saʼine yunkirin tahpakaisu kurihke nani yuhkike, Nuwanterehsu yaʼkunkamare aʼchinpeike paʼpi paʼtun niʼtun.
Ku Ku tananpitarau kema pantaʼpinen inauraʼ.
Aʼnankeʼ saweni iyaparin.
Yaʼwere nuhtetenanke piyapiruʼsa yaʼwepihsu inawaʼtun nuntaʼawa, inaran iʼmeke peʼpeawa pantaʼpi, ihsu ira paʼninsu sunuʼpa ahke inaran ikirureʼ.
Ni ichi yaʼwereterai tanawanke, kahpashin kankantereʼna inaran ni ketariuwa kemui kapini aʼma inshateranta tana nahtankamarewe ihsu semanake.
Ihpera ihsu yami nanpiru yuaʼwa?

Nuya Nahtanke, amiaʼwa, penshaa iʼchimasawatu weshirawe. Samira yuʼsawatun yamura maʼpatuatan, nuya niʼke nahpuyanahchin kehkenin. Aʼnasu puʼpian kehkenpachin ama maʼpatekehsu. Nahtanteke charu unpuhsuna paʼterinsu paʼankamare. Manuke, kepake peʼpetunenpita kuʼwara uʼnan anuchahteraʼsewe nimantartun iranta tuʼkuwiru nihsarin.
Unkuchin ina waʼanenterinsu taweriachin inran peike paʼmain kuʼwara tahshiahtaraʼsuwe, nani taweri ninin puchin.
Ina Iyahsha shaʼwirin paweretakahsu niwiterinsu inaran ku pawereteriunwe. Waʼaneni aʼma aʼnaninsuwai, nani nuwiterin nunpininsu.
Ni wentunatuna yunkipi iʼsha wahpuru pihpirarin tahshiramiachin, nimara iratakahsu ahke nimantaratun sahkaturi ichi ikirurin irstspihsu.
Shiaʼwaruʼsa, ama puntuiteruʼ iʼsha anpushamahshu.
¿Tahshi ihpukapun?

Aʼna nuya nanan nahtanterawemare ninarahrawesu imamare Aʼyararawe? Mañahtun imiranen tetuku nani piʼi paʼmararin. Aʼma manurankeran winaransu nañantekehsu irake, ina paʼpi nuya nunenterin pahkaturu nunenan naʼwehterinsu. Ka nunenan nihsarawe kuʼwara iʼshake paʼshataraʼsuwe. ¿Nuwanteran kaʼtainken ihpura u nihpun inapihkeran nuyahshakeran Weʼsaran?
Ku inapuhchahchin kechinke ihsu tanpanate, waʼwa.

Ku nituhterawe kanpiatakahsu nuhsha chinpi aʼna pinshi yanihkene. Ina kanpianamenke ina kemapi nuyahsha nunin kiyari nahterai. Ka, Maʼta nunenʼi pinshike, inahsu ku make paʼteriunwe. Aʼma tananpitaʼawasu nuyahshakeran nunpinchipuahsu. Aʼna maʼsupa tiniaʼawa inara yunkiaʼawa kanpiatakahsu.
Kuʼ paʼananwen Samira niwipina paʼtun nipachin, kuʼ nanitapunwe paweretakasu kemupirusa ayatapi kuʼ tewatapunawe paʼanterusa.
Kiyahsu werun a inpihterai iru nuyahtamare. Nimantaratun ku ya nuyahtuwatera paʼnai nunentu peike.
Paʼpi nahpuruwike paʼnai wahpuruke.
Uʼnan kankipachin, kiyahsu sapumare ni aʼperai iʼsha kurai uʼusawatui. Nuya yaʼi kemuiruʼsa nuya iʼsha uʼuhkaisu aʼma kañukaimarewe.
Paʼantenaʼpi mahshu, nahtainke aʼna kashin paʼantake, mamanuwe nuyahshakeran pawereterin kepawatera.
Nimara chiniruwi ketakahsu, ina naʼwanin amiaʼwain paʼninsu nahpuatun ku kahpashin kankantakahsu yaʼweteriunwe.
Mama kahtawaʼwa paʼanchin.
Ama maniantekesuwe kemuinenpita
Ina kirihkatemareʼ yuʼsareʼ nuya pihshateʼ.
- ¿Unpuruta mamawarin paʼantupikeran uʼmarin? - Ku kankimariunwe. - aʼma paʼyankehsu, ketuku imiraparin inaran kanpu nuyahsha ninataʼa.
Nunsha paʼmapachin, waʼanusa weʼka itarawe inaran shaʼwitarawe weʼnawesu nuyakeran wiʼnaweruʼku.

Tatamahshu, ke waniran nihpuni ka ihseke nara iteke wenseihtuwe. Pinewe pen nahtanawe yuʼme peʼpesawatu. Inaran aʼnarahchin paʼihteriuwe. Ya kankunawe nunshinapa kuʼwara iʼwayataraʼsuwe nunshake napekamare.
Nimara naniteran aʼna parihchi shapun paʼankasu, ihsekesu paʼpi paʼtun.
kemasuʼ nimara, ayaimaranke peike tahshirupu, nawaintun iʼshana nahkun nuhsururuasuʼ. ku nihtuteʼitu kema nahpunin niʼ nahtanansu. nimara yunkiʼitun kuasuʼ ninarinnenpu yunsanken.
ku nihkakaru nihka nuya waʼwashanepu?
¿Tanpanantekeran ni pahtumaterewa?

Ya nahtananke kaʼtanainkumare tananke, niniriu yunihkamare penshune, nahpuinanhchin ira kenane uʼmakamare. Nuyahshakeran nara nukunanke chinuhtamare inaran ninaihteriuwawe piʼi pihpirinsu nuʼten ira aʼnuterinpu niʼtun.
Panka uʼnanpachin iminke, nuyahshakeran peike kehpariteke;yusparin ichihtunwe nuʼpa iʼsha uʼurin niʼtun inaran pantaʼpi suʼsuarin.
Mama kahpashinkeran shaʼwirapirin suʼin nunsha ya paʼanin inaran aʼna nuna pantaʼpi pankamahshu yuʼsawatun maʼpatarin yamura inaran puʼpian shapun.
Inahsu ku ahsu taʼtariunwe inaran yusparin iterin imin aʼpeitupihsu.
Nanun mama shaʼwirin nuyahshakeran kain atarinyuʼsawatun maʼpaterin yamura, iminke ku wachi maʼteranta yaʼweriunwe piʼnikamare.
Aʼma irahka ira nañantiʼinsu.
Ku chinuhtariuwawe wankui irake.
¿nuwanchitunwe ka yuʼnau pishate aresemare? kahtawaranke paʼantaʼsuwen, paʼa nuyahsha ni nuntaʼa, kanpuʼtun ni nahtaʼan, yunkirawe ama ni nunpitarewe inauchin nihapchi sehtupina paʼmare peinepupaʼ.

Iʼwata, yaʼwerewasu ni yaʼyuranesu, waʼwishinaʼwaruʼsa tahshi paʼyapachinara, aʼna tatamashuri kechin chinihken nanan, karisu ninarau kanpitaruʼku unpurusu ina waʼwasha nuyahkeran weʼehkamare. inauchin nuwantanau wamirianipitari.
Nukurawe nunshanuwe nani yapantapateraʼ, ku nuwanteraweʼ winkintakasu tahshiʼ.
Iʼwata paya. Iʼwara kanpiaterai kehsha pantaʼpire, ku nuʼten tuhpirawe ina yunkirehsu kemamarehsu nuʼten.
¿A nuyahtaʼa, nimara ihpuranta yunkiahran ina?
Aʼma yawechinun tewa wishakasu ni wentuneke, wawaruʼsa. Kasu tewaterawe ku nipachinara ku nimirewe yawetuachinawe tuʼpinan
Waʼwasha, aʼshatu shaʼwiteke samiranen kanpiachin yamurake. Nuyahsha nahtanchin inaran aʼma paʼankesu, ina ketarinpu nuya kanakasu.
Yunihke ira iʼsha pirianke.

Iyawe tanankeran uʼmawachin, nuyahshakeran nahkapiarawe. Aʼma tananpitekuhsu inaura pei yaʼkuanake. Nuyahshakeran a nuyakankanchina naʼkun taweri paʼninsu mare. Manuke, nani tatanenpita iʼirate nihsawi ihpukaimare nuyahshakeran.
Ahpurimahsu, ¿Ku kemawe aʼnanankuwe sha yaʼpira paʼantahpu nuya paʼtunke? Nuyakeran nahtan inke kiwiantaku kahtawarankuhsu.
¿Kema paʼanapun nimara pantaʼpi tahshiaya?
Iyahsha,¿Ku kiwirankuwe ketainkusu maʼsha peʼtenehsu nahtanpatankera? Nimara nahkaranchin aʼnanpunku, teʼwarawe niwike maʼpatakasu paʼantupike.
Kayapinuʼsa puʼmuke aʼna panka kuhtaruteke inaran shaʼwike irake ya paʼanansu, aʼma iʼwakasu ninakesu ni yaʼpituwachina.

¿Kema nituhteran unpu nuyahsha nuntereta iyahsha kemahken peʼtawanenpita aʼpeirinsu ke irataʼse? Nunteran nuya nanankeran ayanpu irakeran. ¿keteran puʼpian senateransu nyahsha kankantamare? Inapuchin patarewa nuya yunki kankanuake. ¿Ayanteke yusparin tenansu mahshuruʼsa nuhtetechinachin? aʼchinapi nahtanterin ninanu aʼma nañantamarewe nahpipihsu aʼpeiyatuna yaʼi taweri, ku inshateranta patapunaruawe inaura.
Ama naniantekehsu iʼyara puʼpian mare paʼanan, ihpurasu aʼna paʼtun akuteke inaputupatan ku tuhpinankeran tananke sahkataranwe.
Nimara nani yunahteran nuʼwiterawehsu kawera.
¿Maʼpatapun ihpukasu nuyahsha ihpura?
Tahshi nipachina tewarewa, nipirinwe nipuwatera ku tewarewe
¿Sehterawe wiʼnawemare?
Iwaraya kankuanuwa yaʼwereruawa ninanuke ikiruwinan.
Naʼwanpu sahkatu imiranen nimara.

¿Inta waʼwasha paterin inaura pensha yunsanke? Aʼshin ahke paʼmara peʼiyapun. Kari wensawaratu seʼkunurawe. Nahputerawe niʼtun naʼneinen kahpa ninin. Nahtanawe yaʼwichinku aʼna shaʼwinan tananke nininsu. Niʼmawe ku ahkete sehteriunwe. Nimara kaʼnai pantaʼpi aʼnipinan kahtuyaʼpikui inaran naʼkun winarai.
Nimara wiʼnanpuwa uʼmararin ihsu semanake iʼshaparihchin. Naʼkun naʼwanewa nimara naʼnekariuwa kahpashinkeran peike nahkawiwatewa.
¿Wiʼnin nuwanterinsu ihpuwachin? Penshapirianke ninaʼin aʼma tananpichinsu chiminkahsu kankanenkeran.
Tahshiraya piʼi kankipachin, samira kepararan nunshinanke. Kanpiateke yamurake inaran nanitewatan puʼpian kehsha kehke.
Ku ichi yaʼwerechihtuwe samira yamurake, tahpararawe wiʼnaupitammare inaran paʼankamare aʼnateran ninanukeʼpa.
Paʼawa nuyasha niʼawa nuya pawerinunpuamare.

Kema iʼwaraya uʼmaran nihpuni, aʼpininsu imatun, yunki ihtunwe tatamhshu ira aʼnuterinkehsu. Ku nituhterawe sehtapu aʼna nimara ku nihpun kahpashin kankantapu nimara. Nimara yunki ihtuwe kah puchin,ina tahshi uhsharan iraterehsu yunki ihtuwe.

Wiʼnawi, wanisawatun taʼake nunshinankeʼpa. Uhshiwarin kankipachin aʼna ahketeranparan nuyahshakeran nunteke. Ina winararin nuwitantuken. Manuke, aʼma ichi ninatekehsu. Naʼkun naʼwaninken nahpuru pihkeran senaterankeraware inaran weʼsarin nuyahsha yunkireʼna kehparitamare ihsu taweriruʼsamare.

Nuya nuwanterawe, waʼwaruʼsa, paʼawa tatamahsu yunkiaʼawa kahpa nininsu. Kanpua nimara yunkiaʼawa nanpirinsu pensha pirianke. Nimara ina kahpashin kankanchihtunwe tatamahsu iteruwa nihpuni. Tenawe tahpaʼawa yunkiruahsu nuyahsha, aʼnataweri sehtewatera ninuwi ikihtere nihpiriunwe.
¿Ku nahtanaraun ka kanteranpuchin kaʼaruʼku?

Kiyahsu yah puʼmurai peʼpetu nuyahshakeran ya paʼpatera ahke peike. Peʼpekariuwa weʼehta nimara, pahkatururuʼsa inaran kuhtarute. Inaran puʼpian kepaʼawa pantaʼpi aʼyutupinan. Kuʼwara iʼsha pentuhchahtaraʼsuwe iyahsharuʼsa nuntaʼawa, imin aʼpeichinpuwa. Ku nuya nituhterawe ayanpu nimara, kankanuhsu nani ya ayantarin. Paʼa uhsharan, waʼwashanuwe.
Ayanewa paʼanterawekeran niwanpi ikirupinan, nihpiriunwe yusparin tenewa uhsharan kurihki ni ketamare iyakapini ni awepinankeranwe nimantaratun ku ni apirateraiwe.

Imuya shaʼwiterinku kemui kahtawarehsu nuyahsha niʼninenpu ninanuke. Nahpuatun kari saminen paʼanterawe ina waʼwaruʼsa aʼpeiraʼse. Yaʼwerin aʼnahken yaʼi paʼanpisu, nihpiriunwe kahsu paʼtunen inaranchin tananpiterawe inaran nuwanterawe yuʼsawatu maʼpatakahsu yamura tumare.

Iyaruʼsa, nahtanku ihsu nanan teʼtekeran pihpirinsu.Nuyahshakeran sami paʼanku paʼantupi pankamahshuʼpa. aʼma teʼwasawatuna puʼpian paʼterinsu aʼpatumakuhsu. Kari nuyahsha pawerarawe nuya sahkaterinsu karuʼku, teʼwaterawe tahshiraya kemuiruʼsa tana nahtanpachina iʼshapirianke.
Ninaku, paʼpi kansaterawe.

Ka waʼkikeran ahpiraʼwa kenanpatu iminke, kahpashin kankantawatu naʼneihtuwe. Ninake uhshiwarin yaʼkuanake, aʼma paʼyankesu ikiruwinan kankipachin. Nuya niʼtatun nahkawike inaran kari yahshin kusharu nitapu.

Ahpimahshu, aʼma waʼkikehsu. Nuninke tunputeke peʼpetunen anpu iʼshana pentuntariuwa niʼtun. Mahke nuʼserate kahtawataman nunsha shiʼshitekeran. Maneku mañahtun kankunkamare kuʼwara tahshiyataraʼsu. Paʼantenaʼpi ku naʼkunkeware ninatariunwe.
Kemahsu ku paʼantenaʼpiruʼsa shaʼwiteranwe, Nahpuatun ku mamanen pawerepiuwe.
¿ku naʼwaintunwe kema wiʼnan weʼerin aʼna peike nihpunin? ku ihpura nanichintunwe yaʼi taweri ku niʼnaun nihpurin.
Kemapiruʼsa yunkipi iratakahsu ahke inaran ikirure, nihpiriunwe chinihken kankankeran tanan pentuntarin yaʼkari ninanu niʼkamare.
Kepaʼawa kanpua ashunenpua maʼsha paʼanpiʼpa, ama paweretawarewe, paʼawa ni ketawa kashin kiʼsahamare.
Nimara niʼhkakasu nani taweri, nani taweri inaura yunkirin yuʼin paʼninsu wankana tananke.
Ku teʼwarawe nisha nihsha kaʼnanuʼsa perahpahina tananke, ku kahtaranta, nihpanawe yunkirawe mamanewe ama yunkitekesuwe, nuya nihsarewa.
Nihke, waʼwaruʼsa aʼpeiyawa teʼnakeran naʼkun uʼnanpachin. Ihpuaʼawa inaran iʼsha weyai ketaʼawa tahshi.

¿Tahshiraya sanawiruʼsasu kuahsu kankuanpiuwe yaʼkari ninanuʼpa? Ku, inawahsu ku ahsu pihpiatarapunawe uʼnan ku nunsha a naʼweriunwe niʼtun. Nunentenaʼpimahshuri nuhsuaruatun yaʼwiterin ama nuhsurutaimarewe aʼke pakatuna.

Kema paʼsaran kehchitu iʼshana pentutuate. Nimara iʼsha teʼnai kenankawen, inapuchin nuyahsha iʼnaiteke. Ikiruwatan, itapunku inaran chinuhtare nara nukunanke. Ku nituhterawe unpu iʼshanata pawaninsu, nihpiriunwe pawamaran kara ku nihpun kahtawini.
Ama sehtuwinan pakesuwe kema ninanuʼwake.
Irahpa aʼnanterinsu tanantamare ku maʼpateriunwe pahtumateranta kanapihsu. Ku inshariteranta maʼsha kechinsu ninasawatun ku kankirinsu.
Ku puʼpian mare pantaʼpi yuʼsarawe.
Wiʼnawe, paʼa, kahtawaku nunsha pihtaʼi. samira kehken yah kepare ninanuke, inapuchin kahpashin kehparitaʼa nuya peʼiremare.
¿tata paʼsaran pantaʼpi paʼankapun ihpura? ¿ku ikiruranwen naʼkun pantaʼpi peʼpesawatun? Manuke inaran shaʼwituku paʼsarawe kemaruʼku.
Kema paʼan ihtunwe inaran usharan maʼpachihtunwe.
¿Ku paʼaniunwe atarinen ku inshateranta weʼka itapunawe?
Yuʼawa shiʼshi yamuramare.
Ni kechinan uwaka kurihki.
Aʼma waniahkesu, peʼtenke samira inaran nishirapike unputa. Uhshiwe ya paʼanin yaʼi chachin kuʼwara wenuka nihshataraʼsuwe.
¡Ma kahpashinta paʼantakasu wanku paʼantupike! Kepaihturiuwawe pantaʼpi inaran kehsha, inapuchin naʼkun yuntunihteriwawe yamura paʼankamare.
¿Tatamahshu weʼnin nihpuni kahpashin kankanchihtuwe?

¿Kankuanawe aʼnuarahchin iminke tatanen nuya nanan nahsha shaʼwitamare? Manuke irateransu, inairaruʼsa taʼtapi nani tahshirarin niʼtun. Aʼpeite taʼawatan, inapihkeran naʼwanan nuya nantenen. Ka yuʼme peʼparawe kemah naʼwerinsu yunkiatu winaraʼse. ¿Panka pantapiʼna ninakapunku u nihpun paʼsaran nunshinankeʼpa?
Iyaruʼsa, kahpashin kankantaʼawa kemuinenpuwa niʼtun ni ihpuaʼawa nani tahshiramiachin, teʼwa aʼma peike yaʼkunamarewe.
Ku paʼshatararewa paʼantupisupaʼ pawanin.
Nani iʼwaraya nunshinan weshintarawe, nahpuru tahshi ku iʼsha ahketeʼ kenanaweʼ.

¿Nimara ina sanawi yaʼweran nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu shaʼwirin mukaru weʼehtanen yuʼsawatun ya maʼpaterin nunen pahkaturu ina a waitenaʼpi nunenterisu? ¿Ina nuwantarin aʼnarahchin aʼna ya wairinsu nunenkamare nahpuru iʼwaraya niʼtun? ¿Unkutapun ina yunki aʼnuarahchin kuʼwara panka iʼsha ihkanchahtaraʼsuwe?

Kema shaʼwiteranken kahken aʼshatu ku naniteriun iratakahsu nuyahsha. Nahpuatun ka sami paʼanawe ina yaʼwerenamen yaʼi tahshiramiachin. Nuyahshakeran piyapiruʼsa paʼanterawe inaran aʼpaniterawe nahtaninawehsu unpu yaʼwerinsuna samiruʼsa iʼsha ahkui.
¿Tuhpinan inasu yaʼwerin nunenan pei?
Imaʼwa ira inkankamare aʼnurahchin.
¿iʼwatereʼ waʼwa, ihpuinke nuyasha mehna teʼwa pachinke?
paʼanke yamura.
Naʼkun iratariuwa inaran iʼwaraya chinuhtarewa.

kema nihpera irateran irake tashi ruʼpu, ka nahtanupuchi kemanta nahtanan nihpunin. yunkimaran wiʼna iʼwa, napuʼinnachin tehkeinkeran wentapariwa. nimara nahpunin niʼ nahtaʼintu tashi ku inshateranta tehwarinun.
Wʼinawe, ihpura nani senatakahsu yaʼwerin mañahtun paʼa senarawate kepaʼa paʼankamare. puʼpian tahpake pamaterin iʼsha ku yaʼweriunwe peʼikasu.
Kentaʼin arehse inaran shapun ninanukeran
Senatewatan uʼwinkake puʼpian nahkarachachin nahshakeran shantamare inaran aʼna kapamare peike.
Yaʼi nahpuinahchin kahpashinkeran yunkipi wahpuru iʼsha kemuiruʼsa kepakamare, iratakahsu ahke nihpiriunwe inaran mahshuruʼsa ikirurapi.

Iyahsha shaʼwiterinku aʼshin nimara paʼnin pantaʼpi paʼankapun. Paamara nunshinankeʼpa wahpuru iʼsha chinpirinken. Shaʼwirin kahtunun pantaʼpi kehken peʼperin pinenenke. Ku nituhterawe aʼnuarahchin uʼmamara u kehpariterin nunsahpatun. Ina ya pihpipachina shaʼwiatun paʼnin aʼma sehtekaimarewe. ¡Ma kahpashinta paʼnin ihpura tahshiramiachin! Nimara kachihta kemarin waʼwaruʼsa ketamare ihsu ninanuke.
Uʼnaike iʼsha pamatuachina, mahshu ku naniteriunwe pihpikahsu inaran ku inshariteranta a nuya kankateriunwe.
tashiterewa, iyasharusaʼ. yunkiwatera tashi waʼwayateruasu. teʼware tashinanke. yusparin iʼterewa iyamashurusaʼ kaʼtaninpua tashi yanuʼirewa.
¿Kema nuya niʼnan ihsu irake iʼwapachina tahpare nuyahsha nihkakasu wiʼnapi nihkari inaran inaran paʼantere ninanuruʼsake?

Weʼkama, paʼantunapi. Maneku nuwarateku peʼpetu peʼpepirawehsu. Pentuntariuwa kara tuʼkuiru iʼsha naʼpiraru wewepiru. Nuya mahke peʼpetu naʼwekamare. Kankuaʼawa mañahtun aʼnateranpa, yuhsemare. Nuyahsha ayain kuʼwara tahshiyataraʼsu.

Unpuwa waʼwaruʼsanuwe. Nimara uʼnan anutewachin kahpuara aipiranke kehparitarewa ku yaʼnupinanwe. Sehteruwa ira shihpiruterin niʼtun. Nihpiriunwe nuya kankanterai pei pite yaʼwetawatui inapihkeran weʼka ni itariuwa kahpashinkeran.
Wiʼnasharuʼsa manuaʼawa, nuya wenseaʼawa nunshake. Nani iʼwaraya ninanukeʼpa iratari, inarannnuyarinku iʼshake iʼwarinsu.
Pateke tanan irakeran nuyahshakeran; weʼka iteke nararuʼsa naʼikahsu keterinkenmare inaran aʼma sehtekesu ya paʼnanmare.
Paʼantenaʼpi ku mamapaya tananpitapunwe ku kurihkiwawen, Inantan kaaʼtawaterin peʼpetu peʼpekahsu.

¿Peʼpearan ina kehsha kuhtaruke nininsu kehken tahshiruʼpu? Ikiruaran kuʼwara peike kankumahtaraʼsuwe. ¿Ku weʼsariun iyawarin kahtawaunke irake? Kari ninaranke kuhsharu weyain weyain nihsawatu. ¿Maurata paʼsaran inminke tahshiraya?
Ku kawera ninawe ina nuya nanan yaʼweahpun, nuhsururawehsu; kema karuʼku nihsapiranwe ina ku nañantarauwe.

Kahken wiʼnashanuwe, nahtanke mañahtun: yuʼyuwarin uʼmararin ahke ninanukeran. Manuke, iʼchimike pensha kuʼwara kankimarin. Niʼpatan kahpashin kankantaran inaran winaraʼma nahpuinahchin. Naʼkun yuʼke naʼwanan. Nuyahsha kankanteke, uʼmarinsu ketarima kahpashin kankamtakaʼsu yaʼi kemuiruʼsa.
Nimara kemuiruʼsa tahpaʼina puʼpian nani semanake, uskuru paʼpi paʼtun niʼtun nuwanterawe pensha iʼchimitamare kuhsinake.
Naʼnekawen nimara yusparin ituwatu.

Mahshuya, ku ya pawanawe aʼchinanke. Nahpuru iʼwaraya ku ira kenanawe nahpuatun ku ayanawe. Uʼnan puʼurin ahke tanan yaʼwerinsu imahkamare. Ihpuranta yunkiatuwe sehtarawe chiwerawehsu irake, peikeran ahke paʼnepa wenukake.
Aʼma teʼwakesu, ninake uʼnan naʼweʼin.
Nunsha ninake,yusparin iteke yantirinsu.
Yusparin itaʼawa taweri ninatuwa wiʼnanpuwa nuya niʼtun, inaran kahpashinkeran peike wenu kehshakeran niʼawa.
Nuya aʼpechina uʼnanawachin
Nuya pake, tatamahshu. Ihsu taweriamiahchin iʼsha pentuntariuwa nunshake ninanuʼpa pakamare. Kepataranken taʼna inaran kusharu, inaran naʼkun nanan kentararawe shaʼwitainkemare.

Mamanuwe, ku ichi sehtarankenwe nahpuru taweri mare. Ku kenanawe unpu paʼmakahsu chihtururi muhtupi yaʼkuirin niʼtun. Ku kenanawe iʼsha inaran nararuʼsa. Waʼki iraterawe ku nuwipurawe ahke irake kema aʼnuterinpuahsu.
Nuyahshakeran peʼpeawa nuʼserate inaran yakuirehsu, nimara waʼki iratuwatewa ikiruarewa inaran naʼkun iratakahsu pawananin iʼshaʼpa ihkankamare.
Nahtaintenkewe puʼpianmare nuyahshakeran taʼtamare.
Manuke, wiʼnawe, sami paʼanansu kurihki yuntunke, tahshiraya nimiriu paʼanane yuʼyumare niʼtun.
Uʼnan ihkankipachin, aʼnaurahchin perahku inaran tahpaʼa sehturu iʼshake yaʼwerinsu.
¿Unpuruta wiʼnawe ayananin iʼkeran?

Ku naniterawe nuya nunkakasu, kunupira yaʼkupirinku. Ku nuwanterawe panka nunshake yaʼkunkasu. Ku karuʼku ninanwe uʼnanpachina inaran naʼpire. Naʼnei anuterin, aʼma sehtekehsu, iyahsha, ya yunkiranke.
Kayawin ya paʼanpatan, shaʼwiteke piyapiruʼsa kema nuhtetenake yaʼweweihsu iteke nuyarumiahchin inaran puʼpian parterin, iteke iʼwa paʼananpuchin.
Aʼna winapi ku paʼpina nuntanawe paʼnin nihpuni, ahke iʼshake paʼtapuchin ninuwinwen sehturi maʼihtunwe.
Nuya nanan yaʼwewachin,ama iratekeruwe sehtereʼken kema inahsu.
Tatamahshuruʼku ni nuʼwipirewe, nuyahsha a kahpa kankantarawe inaran kahpashinkeran a yunkirarawe pen yunsanke wensepatera shaʼwiterinkuhsu irahka nanpipihsu.
Ina naʼkun yutunin kurihke yamura paʼankamare.
Ku ka nuwantepuwe shaʼwiterinawehsu paʼtunen; nahtanterawe winareʼna inaran nuya nininsu puʼpian paʼmarin.
Iʼwara pantaʼpi senaransupita kepake, yuʼmeke puʼmuran niʼtun yaʼihpi nuyahpiachin, inaputeran niʼtun piyapiruʼsa aʼnarahchin paʼantarinen.
Sanapi ku naʼtatarinwe samira niwike, nihpirinwe aʼpatupin paʼtun ina suʼin ku keʼsarinwe kurihki iminkeran uhpu nahkukuware yuʼki pihkeran

Kankanenkeran nahtanke, waʼwasha, ka ihkanpatu aʼna nuʼpa ku nuwiraweʼpa, puʼpian nuintuwe inaran niʼchihtuwe naʼtun. Aʼma shura tehkesuwe nimantaratun aʼma taʼakehsu aʼnawita peikeʼpa. Kemahken peʼpetu peʼpeke aʼnawita aʼma kehkentamarewe. Ikirurawe niʼpatankun, nihpiriunwe kahtawapu sanapiruʼsa nunshinanke. Paʼa mañahtun, nani wahpuru iʼshake pantaʼpi puʼmurapi.
Ni aʼpeiran yunkeran tahshi.
Ku paýaterawe niʼniraʼ tahshi nuʼwitakasu, inapuchahchin kanta, iyaʼwa nuya weʼehteriun, nihkanawe ama yunkitekusu naniwai taweririn.
Mamapaya ku aʼpariunwe iyahsha, ku yusparin iteriun niʼtun peʼirimarin.
¿tatamashu ku yuʼitewen imeke wayurusa, aʼna nasha saʼyatarapamare? mamapaya napurin inasuʼ nuya kankanteʼitun saʼya tarapa ku pahterin nihpunin.¿sami manapire keteʼitun samira wayu keterin nihpuniʼ.
Tatamahshu shaʼwichin, Pama paʼmaipachin paʼsarin iʼsha peʼnahte.

kema niʼpera iminkeran uʼmaran piʼi kakuanseʼ, kemasu nawaʼintu ishana amaresuʼ waʼwatari. yunkikechi iʼware nuyapiachin kankanteresu. nahpuwara nahtaʼintu ka nahtanupuchin ihpura napuru taweri kuʼ ayamaʼitun.

Nnai aʼna piʼi kankirinke kanawe tatamashunwe yaʼwerinkeʼpa, nuyahsha iʼsha, mashu uhshakeran, tananpiteke iʼsha kepainpu antiu nunshinankeʼp, inahke ninata peʼen iʼchinpiaʼa ayariuchin, pishate yuʼa inara yusparinke iʼtaʼa.
¿ketere winakasu tawerianpitareke?
Ayanan senatupihsu aʼnanteransu.

¿Ama ninakesuweʼ tataparin uʼmakasu peʼirinkeran? Tataparinsu ku nunca teweterinkenweʼ, kemarin samiraruʼsa. Ama kemarahchin kehparitatun paʼyankesuʼ peike. Kahsuʼ nihpirinwe yaʼwerawe yunkiatu. Ama paʼyankesuwe, unpuruʼ nahtaneʼ nunshake uʼmapachin.
Iyamahshu mawerarinken pihkeran.
Mamapaya shaʼwiren uʼnani a sehterin. Naʼwanin suʼwin kahpa nininsu nahpuatun ushaʼkeraʼwaya naʼnerin.
Ku ni yaʼweretasu
Ku ni yaʼweretakahsu kampuwa samira patapimare.
Ama kepakesuwe aʼnanun pantapi paʼantupike;ku interanta paʼantupiwe inauchin tuhpinanpeʼperahpun peʼpatun nani iraruʼsake.
Nimara chinuhtariuwa taʼna mukaru paʼtewihsu peʼnate.

Iʼyawe karuʼku yunki akurai tahshiramiachin tananke pakamare. Pentunterai kara iʼshana puʼpian ina irachachin imahsawatui. Puʼpian nonaterai iʼsha yunsanke chinuhtamare inaran iʼsha uʼuhkamare. Mamapaya iminenke kahpashinkeran kankunai, iyawe nuwaterawehsu.
Weʼkamaʼ payahsha, tahshiraya paʼsarawe ninanuʼwapa yamura paʼanau, naʼkun nihpaunau paʼterin, mamuwaruʼku kaʼare paʼanin.
Weʼka ichinke nuyahshakeran, iyahsha. Kema ya paʼanan atarikayu, nimara naʼkun tenawe kanpiatakahsu yamura tahshiramiachin.
Pawerechihtunwe puʼpian nuya paʼantupi nihpuni.
¿Unputa ketapun yamuramareʼ?
Kema niʼnan aʼpatewiru ninanuʼke inaran nuwateran paweretakasu, inauchin iraka iyasha nitere, kahtawatere naʼkun.
¿Ku uʼmaitunwe inaura peinenke?

Nuya nahtanke, iyawe: kema ya paʼanteranku kara panka samira, kari ketaranke aʼna siʼpi yamura kemuiruʼsamare. Paʼterinsu nuya akuke, aʼma iyahsha nunpintekehsu. ¿Unputa nahtanchihtunwe yaʼi mare? Nuya nunke, ina yunki naniterin kahtuchachin a kahpa kankantakasu.
¿Kusharu kepakariuwa iramare?

Ku yunkirawe ninakehsu nihpiruinwe sehteyarinku. Sanapi ku naniteriun nunkakahsu, nahpuatun ku manta iterawe taʼtarinsu. Waʼwasha naʼnepachina, ihpurawe chinihken. Ku kuʼwanerawe naʼkun ninatawatu ina akuterinke.

Nuyakeran nahtanaranke, wiʼnawe iʼshakeran:yuʼmenen yuʼsawatun ya maʼpatuwatan atari,¿maʼta kechihtunwe aʼnapita? Shaʼwike nuya nuʼten nininsu, aʼma kanta apikuhsu nuwanteraweke. Nuya yunkike,tahshiraya karinken iminke kahtawaranken.

¿Waʼwasha ku yuʼkapunwe kayapin aʼna panka samira maʼpatamare? mamapaya tenin ichi yaʼwerechihtunwen kahpashinkeran, samira paʼpi paʼtun niʼtun. ¿Iyahsha kahpashin kankanchihtunwe naʼkun wayu ketepi niʼtun kemuinenpitamare?
Ku pakapunawe nahpuinahchin puʼpian tawerimare.

Tata, ka ya chinuhterawe puʼpian kemahken kuhtarute aipi tananpituatanku. Piʼi chinihken piʼkaterin inaran kanuhterawe. Iʼsha uʼuihtuwe inaran kushachihtuwe puʼpian. Inaran chinihken paʼihteriuwe, ku nuwanterawe iʼwatakashsu ahke peikeran.
nimara paʼantupisu ahke
Ku kemaura kehpariteranwe ina nuya nanan yaʼweahpu, wiʼnawe; taʼaran shaʼwitainkumare inaran kahtuyaʼpinpu kahpashin kankantere.
Nani taweri pensha iʼchimiaʼawa kemuiruʼsa ni wentunkaimare, aʼpaʼawa teʼwa tahshi yaʼwerinsu inaran kahpashin a kankantaʼawa waʼwaruʼsa.
Iʼsha wahpuru ahke nininsu ninakariuwa nimara.
Waʼwasha maʼta waʼnaran kemaura weʼehsawatun? ¿Naʼwanan yuʼyuwarin iminke kehpariterinsu shiʼshi yaʼi tahshi aʼpeikamare?
¿Imupaya nuyahsha nuntarin tahshi teʼwarinsu?
Aʼma kahkesu samira anaruʼ naʼpuni akurinpu,napunin kakanterawe ku teyahtenawe kuʼsharu naʼpuni nininsu.
Ku manukariuwa ihsu ahke irake kuʼwara iʼsha nuya niʼshataraʼsuwe.

Nimara kemui sehterin tatamahshu nuʼparu ahku sehtetinkeraware. Nimara inawa yunkipi penen iʼsha pamatahpun inaran paʼyanin. Ku nuyawe niʼnawen naʼnerinsu ku chinuhtawenawe, ina yaʼwerin nani nanan paterinke. Inawa yusparin teʼina yaʼi aʼchinterinsu peʼimare inaran tanan pahkaturu.
¿Unpuwanta ka mare naʼkun sehterin, paʼanterawehsu wiʼkitahpu? Ina nahpuru iʼwaraya taʼteransu chinihken ninin nuya nanankeran puchin.
Kiyahsu weʼerai weʼenante ahkuanake inapuchin ku yun shiʼshiarinkuiwe. Inapuchin ku kañuraraewawe yunkeran iʼskaeran wentarinsu.

Iyahshanuwe kahken, kema kayapin kehpatan, karinke tanan nuhsha chinpiterawehsu ketaranke. Nihpiriunwe nuya shaʼwituku. ¿Nuwantapun Inapuchin ni kanpiakahsu ku nihpu naʼkun nahtantapun? Shaʼwike paʼtunen aʼma inshateranta ichi parehsetekehsu. Yunkiaʼawa nuya piyawi, ku kanpuara ni awepinanwe
Ama yunkikesuwe karinken kahtawainken

¿Ku kehkawe peʼpetu ina anuyahtenaʼpimahsu yaʼkunpachin aʼna ninanuʼpa? Ku, inahsu kuaʼsu naʼkun peʼpetriunwe, wiʼnahshanuwe. Inahsu nararaʼwaichin kepararin. Ahke irake kuahsu nanitapun peʼpetu keʼken kepakahsu nimantaratun uʼnaikie.
¿peʼpetu patapuna iʼsha yunsanke iratatuna chinuhtepachina?
Ina weʼka tarin nuyahshakeran, manurarin niʼtun.

Waʼwaruʼsa, nuyahshakeran ihsu nituhtu maʼpatuku, unpuinta nuya iʼsha maʼpatere. Pantaʼpi paʼankari paʼpate, ku shura ni itepariuwe inaran ku ni awekariu paʼterinsumare. Nuyahsha nanankeran nunkari inaran yaʼi niʼtapiwankana peʼteanʼ a wayuruʼsa.Inapuwate paʼantenaʼpi kanpu kiwiarinpu inaran nani semanake uʼmapun. Nuyahsha nanan paʼane waruʼsare naʼkun naʼkun, wiʼnashanawe.
¿Tanapichiʼi iʼsha pamachiʼin naʼkun ku ahpiramarahchin ihsu iʼshana pentunchiʼi?
Iʼyahsha kema nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu uskuru ayanterinken.
¿Unpinta nahtanan kema uʼmakapun tahshi irake inaran tahshi ni uhkuirehsu kenen kunaipuchin weʼerupiterinsu?
Chinuhteke nara nukunanke kuʼwara yaʼnatininsu iʼsha pentuntaran; nuya iʼsha uʼuhsaran inaran pantararan aʼchinpeikeʼpa.
Ku ihkanterinpua ihsu paʼterinsu.

Tatamahshu shaʼwirin iyahsha nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu ya aʼnanterin saʼyatemahshu aʼyaitamare iʼshanake. Kemuinenpita tanawi nihpuni, ina uhkuirawatun kuʼyanakeran kechihtunwe. Nunentenaʼpi aʼchinin nuyahshakeran ku inshateranta kehparitariunwe tanareʼna. Waʼwaruʼsa nituhtutapuna yuʼkahsu ina paʼpi nuya. Inapuchin iʼsha keterinpuwa kushatakahsu yaʼinpuwa peike.
¿Pitenewa nunsha nani tahshiramiachin?

Inamini, waʼwaruʼsa, naniterewa yunki tahpakahsu kahpa nihpisu kanpuarehkenpuwa. Nimara kanpuahsu nani tahshi tanawanke yunkiatewa sehterewa. Nimara inawahsu niʼninenpuwa ahkekera. Tenawe yaʼwerewa yunkireʼna, nituhterewa nuhsurutakahsu ninunenpukeran ku ahsu ayariunwe.
¿Ama paʼyankesuwe niʼpatankui ni ketawatui kanarairu? kema seʼwarin ihsu kashin pantaʼpi kahtawarankuin niʼtun peʼpeke pishate peiʼipaware.
Uʼnanpachina chinihken, yaʼpirinkeran naʼnei anuterin. Mamapaya sehterin amiraʼwanenpita aʼna ninanuʼpa yaʼwepi niʼtun.

Waʼwaruʼsa, yaʼkarituku maʼpatamanma ihsu nuyahsha penen. Ninanuke ayamawatewa ina pantaʼpi paʼanekeran, aʼma kurihke irake pichiʼawahsu, nuya tahpaʼawa inaran nuʼpa yusparin iteʼawa keterinpuwa niʼtun. Peike nuyahsha ni ketaʼawa: kusgaruʼtun, inapihkeran aʼnapita. Yaʼinpuwa wentunen sahkatariuwa senaturuake, wiʼnasharuʼsa, inapuwatewa kemuiruʼsa ku tana nuwitapiuwe.
Nuyahsha nunteku ku kaʼtanpirankenwe nunshakeʼpa, iyahsha; nituhteran nani tahshi awaiterawe, nihpiriunwe nani piʼi pihpirinken ynkiranken.

Nuʼten yunkiran, amiraʼwa. Nimara kanpuahsu Sehterewa piyapi yaʼwerewa nuhtetenanke yaʼwepihsu ahke paʼnin niʼtun. Nimara inawanta yunkirinenpuwa nani samira kaʼpike. Nimara aʼna taweri kenankariwa ninanike pihta yaʼwewachin. Ihpura teranta tahpaʼawa yunkiruahsu nuyahsha keran.
Kahpashin kankanchihturiuwa puʼpian puʼpian kurika yuntunuwa nihpuni, nimara inshateranta inshateranta iminke kahtawarinpuahsu pawereihturuawe.
Shaʼwituku aʼma yunsake kehparichinsu iʼwakaware; Nani tahshiramiachin uʼmain kuʼwara tahshitaraʼsuwe.
Yusparinken iteke tatamahsunen ana taweri
¿Yunkiran tahshi iʼsha pamaterinsu? inaran kahtawaranku a chaʼekahsu paʼanterawehsu? Taʼtahrawe paʼyansawatu, nihpiriunwe imiranen a nuya kankanterinku.

Aʼma teʼwatekehsu suʼsukamare, waʼwasha. Nani tahshiramiachin iʼshake imahku inaran nituhteke peʼikamare karuʼku. Karinke aʼnutaranke unpu ayatereta teʼwa anpu iʼshake. Nuya yunki tahpake teʼtetenenke inaran aʼma sehtu a taʼteʼinkensu. Nitu ninateke inaran chinihken, aʼnataweri kemanta kepararan nunsha kemuiruʼsa kusharu aʼkararan.

Iratari pihpiwatewa, ni ketaʼawa peʼpetu kanpuwa kapini, nuwaterawehsu. Nimara Kemahsu peʼpeke takahsin kahsu peʼpei kehken. Weʼehta inaran puʼpian tuʼnaru kepaʼa nimara. A waitenaʼpi peʼpetunen tahpatarawe kuʼinke, irake waʼwina waʼwatahpiriunwe. Yaniru ira kenankariwa nimara, nihpiriunwe nuya iratarewa. Inapihkeran peike ayankariuwa ikiruwinan ninpiriunwe kahpashin kankantupinan.
Paʼantenaʼpi ku paʼanpunwe kehsha kuʼwara kurihki pichiahtaraʼsuwe, inapuchin ku ayatapunwe kanarinsu kemuinenpitake.
Tahpaʼina nimara kuʼ uʼnanyahtasu
Paweretarai nuʼtehken ina kirihkatemareʼ,
¿Keteku kiʼsha nanpirure iya?
Iyaruʼsa manuaʼawa, uʼnan kanawachinpuwa. Nuwaraʼa nahpuinahchin yunsanke inaran aʼnaya aʼnaya peʼpetu maʼin nunshake nanpekamare.
Mahshu ku nuyahsha kankanteriunwe uʼnanpachina, nimara ku inshaterantari kaʼtaniunwe yaʼwerinke inaran sehterinsuri ku ichi weʼeriunwe.
¿Ku nuyawe kanpunpatera waʼwaruʼsa ihpurinawe inaran nahtaninaku shaʼwinan shaʼwitamare?
Tatamahshu, yusparin iteke iʼsha ihkankirarinsu.
Maʼshateranta kahsawatu paʼsarawe.
Unpuwa, tatamahshu. tahshiraya tahshiramiachin paʼsarawe ninanukeʼpa nimara ichi yaʼweretapu atarikayuke, ke aʼchinanpuchin iminke.
Nahpuru ihsha inahpa ninin nahpuatun nunsha nakun nakun tenin. Nuyahshakeran mahke kusharu imiranenkeran inaran aʼma irake aʼpekehsu.
Nuyahsha kehsha akuke iminke uhkuiransu, nuya pamuke nahsharuwamiahchin yaʼnukamare,inaputawatan paʼanteruʼsa aʼnarahchin matarinen.

Wiʼnashanuwe, ihsu aʼchinawesu nahtanku kankanuwekeranchachin. Aʼma wachi pantaʼpi senarewahsu paʼan awasu. Tahpaʼawa puʼpian nunun kemuiruʼsamare inaran yamura kanpiatamare ishahsharuʼku. Inapuchin ku Ninanuwe paʼanpiriunwe, peike ku kusharu pawananiunwe. Nuyahshakeran paʼanin inaran yaʼweterin weʼehta mentahsha nuhsururawehsu.
¿Yah ni kanpiateri nuʼkiripuchin? Ka kahtu wanki paterawe inaran kema ketuku yamura inaran uskuru pensha iʼchimitamare.
Ku ni yaʼweretakahsu samira yamuramareʼ
Nimara tahshiraya ina pakapun, kusharu niʼin iramare.
yusparinken itawa pupian yaweterinpuaʼsu, inapuchin nipatewa nuyasha yawekariwa
¿Ku wiʼnan naʼwaintun ahke pateran nahpurini? ku nishawa nuyahkeran weʼihtupu ina nuninsu ku nahtanawatun.
Ama paʼsahkesu paʼankapun yamura,nimantarin ama manitekesuwe aʼpamakasu naʼkun naʼkun shiʼshi paʼankasu.

Uhshira piʼpishamiachin ninake, ama manukesu sehtatun, ahpira saʼan uʼmarin naʼkun sami maninkeran, ama teʼwakesuwe, nu ihpera iʼshananta pamawe, karuʼku kehparitaran ninariuchin, ama naʼnerahkurewe kemaura peinenke.
Ina ku shaʼwiriunwe paʼninsu nihpuni, kenuinenpitare ku kuhsharuke inaran ayareʼna ninaihtunanwe uʼmarin taweri.
¿Yaʼwerahrin nihka ihpuranwanta tatamahshu ira?
¿kanta kepai keʼsha, pantapi inapuchin yamura puʼpian mapakau yamuraʼ

Iyara, puʼpian ninawatanku, ka chinuhtawe ihseke. Paʼurunuwe shihpiruterin inaran ikuhturawe. Aʼnuarahchin manuwatewa, inaran kemaruʼku iraterawe ku chiruhpinanwe. Maneku kuʼwara iʼwararin aʼma kenankamarewe kaʼnanuʼsa tahshinanke.
Ama tanaitekesu ina waʼwasha kapaʼin niwike, umpuanta ku pawereterinwe waʼkikeran inaran kemupiruhsa nituhtapi peʼparan ina taʼpanan naʼkukeware
Inamini, inapuchin. Ahkekeran weʼpatan, kahpashin knkanterawehsu ku tihkinwawen inaran yunkirawe, nuyahshakeran, unpuhsuna naʼwanankensu ihsu tawerike.

Kiyahsu nani tahshirawachin maʼsha nuya akurai, nuwaterawehsu. Sawanahsa puʼmuakari panka kuhtaruke nimara. Kayapin kepaʼa ahke iratare mare nimara. Kahsu peʼperawe saʼyateke pahkatururuʼsa, mama kahtawakahsu nuwantuachin. Kuʼwara piʼpiahtaraʼsuwe ahpiruʼsa ihpukariuwa patakamare. Waʼkikariuwa naʼkun nimara, nihpiriunwe ayanewa ninkuanke.

¿Yunkiran nunsha nuhpatemare ni nuʼwirehsu? Kahsu tewarawe ni awemiatare tehkatuwe, Inapihkeran ni ihpure, inaran naʼweren inapunchin ninehsu. ¿Unpuwata ku nihka aʼnaruwahchin yunahterewe, amiraʼwa? Nani kahsu mahshuku ku nuʼwitechinachin kankanterawe. ¿Nuʼten nuntakahsu nahpuruchachin shaʼwitechinakahsu nahpuru iʼwaraya chachin?
¿Taʼnahke wenseʼawa ninatariuwachin?
¿Unpuruta waʼwasha tataini aʼpeirarin tananke? Nuyahshakeran kaʼtaʼin inaran aʼma naʼwainsu, nimara inare nihkapun yaʼimare.
Ahpuri, ¿Insenchita paʼsaran nahpuin ikiruwinan? Iʼsha ira ahke. ¿Ya irateran karuʼku?
Waʼwasha irake in kenanin kañaʼpi nihpunin, ku pachihtunwe inaura. Aʼmuchihtunwe, uhshiteʼihtunwe inaran paʼihtunwe awaitenapi saʼwitapun. Ushahkeran ira kepachihtunwe ahke, shihpiru nihpiriunwe.
Wankui irakeran kankipatan ikirupinan, chinuhteke panka nara nukunanke tatamahshuruʼsa inapuwipuchin, wiʼnawe, nuyahsha iʼshake.
¿Unpuruta arehse niwike maʼpaterehsu paretari?
Unpuwa, aʼshatu, aʼma nañantekehsu waʼwina nishirapikamare nunentu peike kirihka yaʼwerinsuke.
Ama peʼpekesuwe naʼkun naʼkun awanteransu;kañuyatan irake,ku interanta,kepaunawe ina peʼpetu ninisu paʼankasu.
Uʼnani shipiterin neʼmehteruʼsa.
Ku tananpiteriwen pahsarinsu nihpuni, aʼshini ku tuʼnaru nichihtunwe inaran maʼsha ya kepararinsupita ahke.
Keteke isu nunsha ina irahpamareʼ.
Aʼma weʼekesu iʼshana ni wentuni yakari, yun pehtawawike.seterawe ku ni yashuwitenewe tanake kañu yawetuachinnke
Uhshira naʼnei yaʼweterin tihkinamen. Nahsha taweri ninaʼa nahpuinahchin inaran kahpashin kankantere taʼapake kankanken nahkaranchin.

Wiʼnawe, kama kuhshaterehsu uhparan nihpuni, ku shura taʼpa ihtunkunwe. Puʼpian nuʼwichihtuwe nimara, inaran nuyahsha nunchihtenkunwen aʼnuarahchin. ¿Kemanta nuyahsha nunchihtunkuwe inaran kari aʼpayanʼihtenkenwe chinirawatu nunawekeran? Mañahtun paʼa, nani weʼehta kurahtarin. Kahpashin kankanchihtuwe kema nuyahshakeran wihteteran nihpuni. Ku nuwanterawe shaʼwetenen yahkikasu inaran yinkikehsu nani naʼwerinsumare.
¿Unputa paʼterin samiranen? Puʼpian mare kechinke kemahsu ka pirianke yaʼweran niʼtun. Kahsu nuwanterawe tuhpinan uskuru paʼankahsu, shapun inaran puʼpian asuhkaru.
ninuwi ya¿keterin pichawa unpu kanararewasunan pantapi paʼanatuwa,nahpuinahchinketawa ina aʼshatu kañaʼpi nininsu ku naniterinwe pakakasu paʼantapun.

Ku mananwen penshunehsu aʼnuterankensu inaran ku kankunanwen iminke. Chiweran iʼwakaware nimantaratun ku kushateranwen. Manuke ihpura, aʼma waʼkikehsu: Iʼwara ku nuwiranwen ayankasu wahpuru iʼsha ku ninarinkenwen.

Kema nahtananku unpu kahtawaraweta imuya paʼantupike. Kari aʼpanirawe nuyahsha shaʼwirawe paʼankamare paʼanteruʼsa nuhtetenanke. Tuhshuirawe paʼtunen ina sami nanpiru, imuyanuwe yaʼi tahshi sahkaterin nunshake sami mahkamare.
¿unpu aʼnureta nuhsuresu wiʼnapu?
Nuyahshakeran keʼsha peʼtenke, iyaruʼsha nuhshitupi peʼtenehsu. Aʼma waʼkikehsu, mamapaya ninterin paʼantamare kuʼwara kamutechin nihshahtaraʼsuwe.

Nimara mahshu aʼshimuhtunen nininsu naʼwanin ninanukeran ahke paʼpihsu sahkatu yunihkapuna. Nimara ina kuahsu tahpariunwe nuʼwipihsu, nimara aʼnaya aʼnaya yunkipihsu ira paʼtapuna. tenan ina nuya niʼkapun yunki yaʼweterinsu nuyahshakeran ni wentupike. Yaʼi ninanuke yusparin tehpi shaʼtupimare, nimara sehtu chinihken niʼin nuʼpa aʼpeirahpamare.
Ama ichi shipitekesuwe pantaʼpi nuuwanake,maniterin ni tapikasu,ku paʼantarinenkewe paʼanturuʼsa.
¿Unpua inauchin naʼniʼi naʼnera waʼwa?

Waʼwasha, taʼake kahtawake aʼshatu shiʼshi iyanarinke. Paʼantupike nuya akurawe yuʼme nuya kenankaimare. Kurihki maʼpateke aʼnuarahchin inaran aʼma yuʼkesu niwike, piyapiruʼsa paʼsapi ku paweretapunawe. Manuke, taweri patarinpu.
¿Ihsu tawerimiahchin waʼwasha naʼnekawen nimara?

¿Yunkiran, waʼwishin, iraterehsu ninanuʼpa piʼihke? Taweri yaʼweterinpu nihpuni, paʼan ihteriuwe neʼmehte pipitamare. ¿Tahpa ihteriuwawe pihtamare? Ka puʼpian tahpaʼihtuwe puʼpian nani Yuhkike. ¿Ku naʼwananwe nahpuru taweri kahtuyaʼpinpu iraterehsu?
¿Ku ihpurawe wiʼnawe kuʼwara tananke paʼshataraʼsuwe? Inahsu ku inapuriunwe; ya pihpipatera wiʼnawe nunterawe nuyahshakeran.
Nimara inaura kehpariterin, nuʼwitatun.
Ku kepakasu yamura paʼantupipaʼ
¿Insehketa wanikapu chinuhtakamare puʼpian, nani uʼnan ya anutarin nimantaratun pawantarinku naʼkun ihkankamare?
Nunentenaʼpipaya ku kunparin niʼsariunwe ahke ninanuke yaʼwerinsu? Ku, ina ku naniteriunwe pakakahsu uʼnankeran. Peʼpetunen nuyahsha tahparin, tenin teʼwaterin irah paʼtakahsu kañuri mahpachin.
Nara nukunanke puʼpian wenserarawe.
¿Peʼtenkapu taʼnanewe aʼnateran iʼshaʼpa nani yaʼihpi iʼshanaruʼsa pentuntupatu?

¿Ina sanawi shaʼwirin atarikayu yuʼsawatun iki pahkaturu maʼpatakahsu? ¿Awaitenaʼpi manutarin ina yunki ina mama nanunshari nuwantarin niʼtun ihpura? ¿Maʼshanenpita kanpiaterin kuʼwara iʼwayahtaraʼsuwe nimantaratun iʼsha pentuntarin niʼtun?
Paʼpin ku nanianterinwe yunkirinsu wiʼni piʼpiraʼwa nininsu, nahpurutaweri ku kenaninwe nuya kanka, ku ya taʼterinwe teʼwarinsu nahtarinsu ina.
Manuke, wiʼnawe, puʼpian uwinkake kurihke paʼanteruahsu, inapuwatuwa yaʼwetarinpuwa tuma inran yamura yaʼi taweri.

Tehpi iyahsha peʼinaʼpinen paʼnin iʼsha peʼnahte. Nimara aʼkayan pihpirarin nunshanenke. Nimara peʼperin tarahpa saʼyatemahshu inaran puʼpian kusharu. Ku nituhterawe kentapun naʼkun samira nimara ku nihpun ku manta kentapun nimara. Tatanuwe shaʼwirin ina ya paʼpachina shaʼ wirin win tehkapuchin nunshinan ahkete paʼnin. ¡Ma kahpashinta nahtane iʼsha! Nimara wentapun piʼi inapake piʼkatuwachin, kahpashin kankantereʼna sami kentarawatun.

¿Yunkiran nahpuru iyahsharuʼku yaʼwerawe nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu ni nuʼwirai nunshinan yunsanke nuʼpamare? Teʼwarawe kanpu tererekeran piyapiruʼsa ninanuke yaʼwepihsu nuʼpa ni ketakaihsu.¿Unpuwanta inapuchin naʼkun hihkakasu nuwantere? Inaran ni wentunpi yaʼi nuyahtakaimare. ¿ku kemahsu yunkiranwe, amiraʼwa? Nani kahsu mahshuku ku ya niʼnawe piyapiruʼsa niawerahpeihsu. Nunkakahsu ina paʼpi nuya ninan.
Kema tahshita ichinke, mahshu. Nunsha nuya aʼkurawe tahshiramiachin inaran yuntunawe kurihki, tahshiraya paʼsare ninanuʼpa iʼshaparihchi.
Nuyahsha nuntekeʼ iyaparin, weke naʼnipiaʼa.

Nimara ina kahpashin kankantapun iyahshanen ahke tananke paʼninsu yunkiatun. Tuhpirawe ni ktantapuna mihtayutupihsu aʼkayan. Tenan ina yunkirinkeran nuya kankantapun, ahke nihpiriunwe tawerihsu kahtuyaʼpimare ahketupi.
ka teʼwawirawe winawemare.

Tamahshunuwe ahke iminkeran uʼmawachin, kari kahpashinkeran nahkawiarawe.nuyakeran ninake, aʼma teʼwakesu uhsharan iratupatan. Tahpake wensenan pensha pirianke, inapuchin ina nuyahsha nahtanin inaran nanpirisu shaʼwitarinpu.
Unpuwa,mamapaya. nani tahshiʼ naʼnerawe. Naʼwanawe kemahken imira muhtuneku. Nani tahshiramiachin peraranken ku aʼpaninpirankuwe.

¿Unpuaʼwata aʼma yun kañu mahkainpumarewe? Aʼma iʼsha ninaitaʼinsu. Nuya unkutaʼawa yaʼi inaran iʼirate wihteʼawa yaʼinpuwa. Nunentu peike aʼchinterinpuwa nuyahsha waʼwaruʼsa aʼpeikamare. ¡Inapuchin ku yun shiʼshiarinpuawe!
Iʼwara peʼperai yaʼi peʼpetu peikeran iʼsha yunsankeʼpa. Kema mahke ina peʼpetu waʼwishin inaran paʼmake ushahkeran, aʼma tuʼkuitekehsu.
Ku teʼwapinawen, ninake inshateranta kahtawarinke.
kepaʼin paʼin wiʼnan inaura{
¿Kaʼtanpunku puʼpian? ¿Ku karuʼku ya chinuhteranwekuʼwara iʼwahtaraʼsuwe ahke peike?
¿ayaanwa samira ananterewasu?
Nuyahsha kankanchihturiuwa maʼsha kurihki teranta tahparewa nihpuni, Inapuchin pawerechituruawe shareimare aʼna shaʼteruaʼpa.

¿Yunkirama aʼchinaʼpirun weʼni nihkaunpua inara paʼatarin? ihsekera ku unpuruteranta nihkariwawe, ku nituhturuwawe, naʼwanariwa nirahkayaruʼsa shaʼwiterinpuasuʼ, aʼna taweri nihpera wantaun tanan weʼshintawachin ina achinikankanpirinpuawe.
Ku paweranrankuwe, nihpanawe nuyahpiachin kankanterin.
Ku nituhterawe winapinan pakawen nimara.
Wiʼmawe, nuya aʼpeike samira irake. Kankunpatan, kanpiateke kara yamurake inaran yaʼsurinsu tahpake kapamare.
Tuhpinan yamura mukaru ketuwatan, ku yaʼweihtunwen ichi yaʼweretakahsu, nuya nimara yuniʼihtuwe iyahsha shapun ya keterinkuhsu.

Awaitenaʼpi weʼnin ahke irakeran nihpuni, waʼwasha nuyahshakeran ninachihtunwe. kechihtunwe aʼyumeterinsu weyain weyain inaran shaʼwichihtunwe insehkena aʼshin yaʼwarin. kepaihtunwe nuyahshakeran, inari kahtawararin iyaʼwain waʼwatamare aʼnawarahchin.
¿Maʼmare kaʼpashi kankaterawe nuwarakeran ihsha waʼpurukeran? Paʼyataʼa karuhku:ihsu ira paʼpi ahke,nihpirinwe ihnaterawe naʼkeran iminewe.
Puʼpian ira paʼchihtunwe, manuku.

Wiʼnawe, ninateke aʼna naʼnekehsu naʼkun. Ihsu tawerimiahchin mamapaya ihkankiarin aʼna ninanukeran. Manuke, wihteke peʼi kuʼwara ihkayantusewe. Niʼpatan kahpashinkeran winararin, ina naʼkun naʼwaninke. Mañahtun kusharu nihke, ahke iratare.
Kanpitasu nihpirinwe nuya kankateramawe ku kahtawatawenawe.
Nani uʼnaninke nimantarun wira aweterinke ina inaura ni nahtanin peike. Niʼke yaʼkuana ni iʼsuarahrin inshateranta wekatun kaʼtankikamare
Nuya shaʼwituku unputa paʼterin, imuya
Nimara nuya tahpaihtunwe peʼpetunen tanankeran uʼmaraʼsewe.

Nimara iʼna uʼmakapun kuʼwara senachahtaraʼsuwe, inapuchin tatanen yunkirin nuyahshakeran. Nimara yamuatuma mahkapuma shiʼshi irahka piʼi puchin. Nimara ina yunkiri chiniru kechihtunwe iminke inaura sahkatamare, yaʼwarinke taʼtahrin nihpiriunnwe.
Ku aʼpinkahsu yaʼwepachinwe, ku ira yunihkapuwe.

Paʼa, aʼma naʼnekehsu yaʼnupi nuhpaterinmare. Nimara ihpura iʼwaraya tatamahshuri nuyahtapun. Ina nituhterin ichi chinpitakahsu. aʼma sehtekesu naʼkun, uhshiraʼwa. Manuke, ihpuku inaran pihpiaʼa nara tanpara yunihkari kuʼwara uʼnan anuchahtaraʼsuwe.

¿Nuwanteran pawereʼinensu pihta pihkeran ninanuke? Sehterawe yamura nuwanterawe niʼtun inaran puʼpian shapun, nihpiriunwe ku ihpura kurihki yaʼweterinkuwe. Ihpura niwiranku nihpuni, karinkensu yaʼi kechihtunwe pawere aʼchinaʼpimare maʼpaterawe nihpuni. ¿Inapuchin nuya niʼnan? Ku ya ichi anuʼwiterankenwen, iyahsha nihpiriunwe nahpunin yaʼ werarai kemuiruʼsake.
ninanke nuwararansu nunkeran inaran tahterawe, unpuanta nuyapiachin kankanterawe nahkun.nuten napuran ni kenanesu masha nakun paterinpuchin.
¿Aʼshini naʼwapun waʼwin paʼninsu iʼshaparihchi? Tahpaʼin nuya kankanterinsu inaran ninararawe uhsharan uʼmararinsu.
Iyaweruʼku ni nuʼwiwatera nunshamare, aʼnaramiahchin nuyahsha nunterawe nahkaranchin yaʼnupiantamare iʼshake.

¿Unpuinta, amiraʼwa? Nimara nani pantaʼpiruʼsa tunpuran kepakamare. Kehken nimara kemamare peʼpekasu pinenke. Nimara ka peʼperarawe panka nininsu yaʼwere kemahsu puʼpian nininsu peʼpeke. Uʼnan a sehterinku, inapihkeran nuʼpa shihpiru taranin. ¿Ke yunkiran awantari nunshinankeʼpa? Nimara chinihken wira awetuachin, kehparitari. Weʼka iteke mamapaya kenanpatan, shaʼwiteke ihsu taweri ayamararai naʼkun samiraruʼkui.
Tahshi uʼnaike sehtewatan, irahka nanpiwihsu shaʼwichihtunwe waʼwaruʼsa; Inawa winaihtunawe kemareʼken inaran nuyahsha a kankanchihtunenwe.
Iʼwata, ahpurimahshu. Kema nimara shaʼwiteranku kanpaiatamare nuhsha nanpiru aʼna sehtamura yamurare, ku nuya nituhterawe ina.
¿Ku nuyaranwe samira ni ketakahsu iyawarinpitareʼken? Aʼnaya aʼnaya iminke kahtawatupi, nahpuatun aʼnaya aʼnaya maʼpatupike inauranken nininsu.
Tatanuwe ku samira paʼananiunwe puʼpian mare, inapuwachin ku pawantariunwe kusharu wiʼninpita tahshi ihkankipachin.
Uʼnapachin chinihken, aʼma peʼpetu peʼpeʼawasu uʼnan naʼwekaware.
kankimawatana iminkeran, kankanewe nuya kankanterin inaran naneʼi pipirin. yusparin tenawe nikatunke nahkaranchin peike. waʼwa
Yusparin iteke iʼsha inaran ninake nuya peʼikamare.
Ahpimahshu, Yusparin tehke nanpirineʼken uʼmaran niʼtun.

Nahpuru samira ku ya paʼanpiraiwe kurihkeran; yuʼsawatui maʼpaterai yamura. Ku nuya yunkiraiwe naʼkunkeware yuʼnai. Ka, piyapiruʼsa nunenawehsu, shaʼwiterawe Inapuchin ku ahsu nuyawe. Aʼma aʼna yuʼwawasu kanpuanken ku nuya nihkaparirawe maʼsuna ketarinenpua, inapihkeran ku maʼshateranta yaʼweterinpuwawe kumuinepupita tana nahtanawi.
¿Ku ka nuwanterawe wiʼnawe?
¿un naniantereta teʼwarinsu wiʼnanpu?

¿Unpuwinta paʼnan, amiraʼwa? Nani nimara yuntunaran waʼnaruʼsa iratamare. Ku nituhterawe nunsha nanitapun naʼkun kehkenuʼsa,senterawe yankunpipachin. ¿Kema yunkiran kankunkari kuʼwara uʼnanyahtaraʼsuwe? Nunshinan ahke kehpariterin nimantaratun pawerunu kuasu irahkapuchinwe. Nimara ayankariuwa iʼsha naʼkun nanpewachin. Nuyahshakeran peʼpetu akuke, wiʼnawe, ushahkeran aʼma shipi insuwe uskuru inaran yamura.
Nimara ihpura taweri puʼpian maʼpateran.
¿Unpuanta ihpura sehtarawe?
Wiʼnawe, nahtanke irahka nanan: mamawarin naʼnerin teʼwareʼna tahshinanke. ihpura aʼyarin kahpashinkeran inaran yusparin tenin tahshi tayurake.
Ina aʼnarahchin iʼmenenpita peʼpeihtunwe, Nimara ina iʼsha wahpuru pihpirin iʼsha winkinke, nahpuatun ku ayaniunwe waʼki taweri.

¿Wiʼnapiruʼsa ku keparapiuwe anuyahtenaʼpimahsu peʼpetunen ninanuʼpa?Ku, inawahsu ku maʼteranta peʼpeyaterapunawe, wiʼnahshanuwe. Iratakahsu ahke nimantaratun uʼnankeran ku nanitapuiwe. Nunentenaʼpimahshu ninararin nuyawantakahsu.
Maniahtun pantaʼpi paʼanke kuʼwara uʼnan anuchahtaraʼsuwe, Inapihkeran ira shihpirutarin ku piyapiruʼsa ya paʼantapunenwe.
ku pentuanawe kaura, ninatawa imarehsu.
ku nituhterwawe yaʼi iwaterawe.

¿Ka naʼweihtu nimara yamura paʼanpitahchin kuʼwara ayantaraʼsuwe? Nuwanchihtuwe nuhsha waʼki taweri yaʼwekamare. ¿Kenan ihtuwe kehsha puʼpian paʼterinsu paʼantupike? paʼanteruʼsaruʼwa winaihtuwe, nuyahsha nunpi niʼtun. Ikiruwinan kahpashin kankantereʼna peike uʼmaihtuwe.

Mamapaya mañahtun pihpiʼin amiraʼwanen nihkamare iʼshakeran ayaninsu. Ku iʼwarayawe, ina kahpashin kankanterin nuya niʼpachina. Ihpuratun nuyahsha nunchiʼin. Mañahtun, ama ichi naʼwekehsu ku weʼka tuhkunawe ihsu tawerike.
Manuke, nimara ninanu uhkuntarin taweriachin. Kiyahsu nani semanake nunshake iraterai,keparai pantaʼpi inaran kehsha paʼankamare inahke.
Sehterawe ku maʼpateranwe niwirinenkehsu paʼanteranke.

Unpuwa, ahpiaʼwa. ¿Kusharu tahparan iratamare? Ku nituhterawe yaʼi yaʼkunpun kuhtarute nimara. Nimara ayankariuwa yuʼwe naniteruasu mare. Sehterawe chihturu tahshiwanin niʼtun; nimara iʼwayara uʼnanpun. ¿Ke tenan kankunkari nunshinankeʼpa kuʼwara tahshiyahtaraʼsuwe? Weʼka iteke mamaparin kamare inaran shaʼwiteke aʼma manuinsu. Nuya akuke maʼsha, ushahkeran aʼma shihpiruke anuchinsu.
Kema paʼanchihtunwe paʼantenaʼpireʼken.

Nimara nihkapun ni yaʼweretakahsu awaitenaʼpipayareʼken aʼnateran iʼsha yaʼwerinsu. Ketarawe kehsha ina ketarinku sharaiya shaʼtamare. ku nituhterawe nuwantapun nimara, nihpiriunwe tinirarawe. Inapuchin tahparawe puʼpian kurihki nuwantemiaterawe niʼtun.
Unpuwa, mamapaya. Nimara tahshiraya ichi yaʼweretapu wanuwe pishi yuʼnatamare ninanukeʼpa, unpuinta unpuruta keparanku imira matawatunku.
Nimara uʼmawatu ninanukeran nuya niʼke nuʼten shapun paʼanpatan.
¿Ku yaʼnurinwe irahka ka iraterawesu ku saʼahshatawe,ihpura nuwanterawe chinuhtakaʼwesuwai ahpira ahpira narakuteke?
Ku peʼpetu patakariuwa iʼsha yaʼkari kuʼwara pentuyantaraʼsuwe.
Iʼwaraya ihkantuachinken tananke ikiruwinan, chinuhteke tahshinanke, tatanenpu aʼchininpuchin irahka.
Nunsha nuya kankirin nituhterawe nihpuni kahpashin kankanchihtuwe, ina nuya yunkiruʼku peʼikapu pihpiʼihtuwe kuʼwara tahshiahtaraʼsuwe.

Ku aʼtari paʼankariuwawe ina saweni chiʼchirumahshumare. Kanpianamenke ku inshateranta shaʼwiriun ni tapirinsu. Kiyahsu, manureʼna, nuwanrterai ku nuya nihkapuraiwe. Kari muhsharawe ninainkumare, nihpiriunwe ku nahtetupiuwe. Ihpurasu ku aʼtarikayu yaʼweterinpuwawe nimantaratun nuya waʼna sahkatamare. Aʼnataweri aʼma manuawahsu maʼshateranta ya kanpiatewatewa.
Unpuwa, kuʼwara tananke pahshahtaraʼsunwe ku uʼsaranwe ina iʼsha neʼwei, ni aʼpeike.

Tananke chiwewate pahkaturu yunihsate nunentamare, Nahtan ihtumawe kanpita panka irake ninatamare. Inahke puʼpian chinuhchihteriuwe inaran kahpashinkeran, inaran nahkaranchinn kenantaʼihtuwawe ira ninanukeʼpa uʼmakamare.

Waʼwishinuwe, kiyahsu maʼsha puʼmurai mama ahke ya waipachina. Neʼmehte peʼsapinan kepaʼawa nimara inaran iʼsha inpihtupisu. Waʼwina suʼkdtupihsu tahpaʼaw a nimara. Suʼin nuntaʼawa kuʼwara paʼshataraʼsuwe. Inahsu kehpariterin iʼmin aʼpeikamare. Nahpuru tahshichachin uʼmakariuwa aʼ na nimara, nihpiriunwe ayanewa kahpashin kankankeran.
¿Yunkira kema umpuruta inkanewaʼ?aʼpaniarawe yaʼshinkeran:Ina wentenke chinuʼteh paʼnai ira paʼpi aʼke yaʼpi kehpariterai
Nimara inaura patakahsu nuya nihpiriunwe, mamapayahsu yunkiatun sehtarin patupi inanuʼpa niʼtun.
¿Unpuata inasuʼ peʼperi ihme paʼpi keʼken ana taweri pentuachina iʼshana tukiirumashu Nani iʼwareya ku kahtawawinun?
Ni ketaʼawa yaʼinpuwa ama kehkentamarewe, iraterewa aʼkayan keraware inaran muhtuwi ichi ikirurinpuwa.
¿Maʼshateranta tanankeran kemaran?

¿Unpu ni aʼpeiʼawata sbaʼpi kañukeran? Ku weʼeruwawe peʼtentupinan. Aʼma shihpiru tananpitaʼawasu pei yaʼkari. Nunentuleike winai tuhpinan niterinenpu kuahsu kurihki maʼparinenpuwawe inaran kirihka wiremare. ¡Inapuchin ku sapu mahsarinpuwe sahkatariuwa kahpashinkeran!
Iʼsha waʼyan aʼpeiʼ inke, iyaruʼsa. Ihsu wankuike chinuhtarawe, peʼpetunuwe keʼken nihpiriunwe, inaran manurarawe ihpuraware iʼsha keterinaku uʼuhkamare niʼtun.
¿Ninan saʼwawe naʼnerinsu kemari ihpuwatana? kema kahtawarankuhsu iminke a chaʼerinku senaterawehsu. ¿Unpu yusparin itaweta naʼkun sahkatu aʼnanterawehsu?
Mahshu saweni aʼnanan.
¿Senateransu yaʼi kemari paʼanihtunwen?

Iʼyahsha nuwaterawehsu, kema atarinuwe kepawatan inaran senateransu ya paʼantuwatanku ¿nuya kankanchihtunwe ina ni kanpiarehsu? Shaʼwituku nuyahsha unpu yamurata akutaran. Aʼma nunpintekuhsu. Akuteke paʼterinsu kahtuyaʼpi chaʼchin paweretaimare ku sehtupinanwe, Inapuchin nuyahsha yaʼwarewa iya kapini.
Tatamahshu, aʼma peʼpetaʼahsu ku chinuhtewatewe.
¿Wiʼnawe, ka kahpa nihpuni waʼyan teʼwachihtunwe? ¿Ku nuyahsha kankanchihtunwe tahshiraya piʼi weantararin nahkaranchachin iteranke nihpuni?
Unpua, kaʼi.nimara niʼsarawe ichiyaʼweretakahsu shiʼshinu yamurare. iraka niʼnepuchin ku aʼke pashatapun.
Nani tahshiramiachin tatanenpuwa weʼka itaʼawa nuyahshakeran, inaran kahpashinkeran nuntaʼawa, inawa nituhtunuʼsa yaʼwetupi niʼtun.
¿sanawi weʼka iterin waʼan kuʼwara kehsha naʼkun paʼterinsu paʼanchahtaraʼsuwe?
¿kanpuasuʼ nanianterewa niwiruasu inaʼ?
Kampuwa. ku nituterayu umpuruta uʼmaun, nimara tiʼchiwachi aʼchinan. yunkirewa tewaruwaʼsu taʼparewasuʼ ni kiwirehsu ahnurachin.
Paʼantenaʼpiruʼsa nunshinanpa kankiwi nihpuni, ina paʼanihtunwe pantaʼpinenpita aʼnarahchin inaran tahpaihtunwe kurihki aʼna yamura paʼankamare inaran maʼsha pawaninsu.
Ama aʼnukeruwe kema winaransu shaʼwitewatanken ina iʼsha nani winkinterin.

Iyahsha, yusparin itapu uhshiya imiranen. Kema kahtawararanku nihpuni, aʼchin pei suʼsuihtunwe waʼwaruʼsamare. Nahtanke winarawehsu nuyahshakeran. Aʼma yunkikehsu nuyamare chiniru niʼihtunwe ninanumare.
Weʼsarin nihkapunke iterinawe nihpuni tahpaihtuwe nuya yunki teʼtetenuke, inaran nuyahshakeran iʼsha yunsake ninaihtenkenwe.
Nitu aʼpeiruwa kurihki nihpuni, puʼpian nanichiʼihtunpuwe paʼankamare nunenan nuwanteruahsu ni nunentamare.

¿Unpuwanta waʼwasha sehterinsu puʼurin? Nimara iyaʼwaine ni nuʼwipi yaʼnupimare. Kari nahtanawe ina iyahshanen nuya nuntapu. Nimara ihpuranta yunkirahrin ahkuanake. Naʼneinen amihterawe inaran keterawe mankuwa kashin. Niʼnawe inapihkeran kahtuyaʼpi taʼantapi nahkaranchin. Nimara nahkaranchin ni nuhsuruantapi iʼwapuchin.
¿Nani kankunpatera aʼna ninanukeʼpa kahpashin kankankeran ya aʼyarawe?
Ninanunenke ihkanpatun, yaʼichachin weʼka iyarawe Nuyahshakeran inaran yusparin itarawe nuyahsha niterinawe niʼtun ahke iʼsha iraterawemare.
Yaʼihpinpua paʼanpa iʼmeʼ nuya kankankeran.

Ka niʼnawe tatanuwe tanankeran uʼmararin peʼpetupinan nihpuni, kahpashin kankanchihtuwe. nuyahsha ninateke, aʼma uʼnan teʼwatekehsu. kahtawaku yaʼkuana iʼsuaʼi ina yaʼnupachin, inapuchin aʼnarahchin yaʼkuintunwe inaran chinuhchihtunwe iraterinke.

Uʼnaike panpenuwe anutahpun, iyara ka nuhtetenake yaʼwerinsu weʼnin ku kari perahpirawe. Nimara inanta kari kahtawakahsu nuwantupiriunwe inapihkeran, inapuchin ninawe inapihkeran. Nimara iʼwaraya nituhterawe, nihpiriunwe shaʼwichinke kahtawachinen kemarinta kahtawake. Kuahsu kahtawapachinenpura nañanterewe wiʼnahshanuwe.
¿Mahshuyantatu weʼka tenin kuʼwara shapun paʼterinsu nahtanchahtaraʼsuwe?
Naniterin tahshiraya kechin nahpuichin.
¿Mamapaya nuya nuntapun waʼwasha teʼwarinsu?

Kahken wiʼnawe, nuya nahtanke Kuʼwara paʼshataraʼsuwe. Ka aʼna ninanukeran ikiruwinan kankimare nihpuni, iʼkepirianke chinuchihtuhtuwe. Aʼma naʼkun maʼsha peʼpekehsu, puʼpian pateke inapihkeranmare. Kepake nuwanteransu inaran puʼpian peikemare tahpake. Ichi manumuatawatanku, ichi nañantawenku nanan. Manuke, wahpuru iʼsha patarinku.
Kanpuahsu kuʼ tupinan panewawe kuʼ natanapuriwarawe panka iʼsharuʼsake.
Sanapi nuwanchihtuwe paʼankamare ina paʼantenaʼpimahshuri aʼnarahchin pawererin nihpuni, ku waʼkikunawe inaran ku nunpinkerawe.
¿Wiʼnaitaou unpuruhsuna tanan pentunterawe ichi waitamare, ihpurasu naʼwananwe ina ahke ira?

Kehparitawatui yunkirahrai iyahsha ninanu paterinsu. Nimara nahsha sahkatu kenanin ahke iʼshake. Paʼninsu a sehterinku, tanan paʼtenaʼpi niʼtun. ku nuya nituhteraiwe niantamare nahkaranchin, kiwirai uʼmakahsu nihpiriunwe kankanukeran.
Aʼma tehkein iʼsha uʼuhkesu ku akuraitupatanwe, waʼwishin. Ka sehtarawe piyapinuwita ku ni aʼpeipachinawe inahsu kañupun ahpiraya ahpiraya.
¿Kamutechin kankunawe nunentu peike nuhpuni kaʼtun puʼmuihtunawe waʼwinaruʼku?

Tahshiraya nimara ku tahshiramiachin pihpikarewe nunsha muhturure ni tapirin niʼtun. Ku tenentewachiunwe, iratate iʼshana pentuntamare. Nimara waʼkikapu naʼkun, nihpiriunwe kankuane. Ihpura tahshi kema chinuhteke, ahke ira niʼtun inaran ninatare uʼnan naʼwekamare.
Nuyahsha nuntawatun kahpashin kankanteke, tananpiteke sehteransu.

Ira aʼna ninanukeran paʼnesu mahshuruʼsa aʼnuarahchin ikirupi. Amiraʼwasa chinuhchin nani Iʼshanake, ayanchin mamapaya. Nuya iʼsha uʼuina. Aʼma chinihken piʼihke taʼainahsu. Uʼmaina shaʼwinawepuchin yaʼi nihpisu tananke.
Ku nuya nituhterawe, nihpiriunwe ihsu yuhkike senatakahsu nuya pihpirarin, puʼpian mare pachihtuwe saʼyate tarahpa inaran saʼaweruʼku kahpashin kankantawatu uʼurawiʼihtuwiuwe.
ku nuyahsha kankanterawehsu ku naniterawe a taʼtakahsu, mamanuwe, nahtanterawe yaʼi samira paʼanan nunshinankeʼpa ku maʼshateranta akuranwe.
Wayu ruʼsa nani taweri kaʼke.

Nunentupaya shaʼwirin ina piyawi yaʼwerin nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu inari imuhtu aʼnanin panka nara aʼnekamare. Kemuinenpita nuwantawi nara pei nihkakamare, ina ushahkeran tanankeran kemarin. Inaran nawe paʼyan ihtunwe aʼna ahke pei paʼantupiʼpa tihkikamare yaʼi. Nunentenaʼpi aʼchinin nuyahshakeran kahtawatakahsu nahpa paʼpi nuya. Waʼwaruʼsa nihsapi mahshuruʼsa sahkatupihsu inaran inawatan nituhtawi. Inawe nini nahsha pei yaʼipekeran.
Aʼma shipin neʼmehterenke kehparitekehsu uʼnaike, Inapuchin ku ni nunenaranwe. Sehterawe ku penenankensu nahtewatankura.
Wiʼnawe, kepateke ihsu samira iyahsha inaran kanpiateke yamura. Aʼma paʼankesu naʼkun, ina nuya kanpuamare yah kahtarinpuwa.
Wiʼnawe, wahpuru iʼsha waʼkirin kankikahsu, ira ahke nihsarin. Manuke, pawantarinpu naʼkun peʼpetu peʼpekamare.
Nuwanterin tu inshariteranta kaʼtankamare, ina naʼnerin aʼmin yunkiatun paʼninsu iʼwa yuhkike.
Mamapaya ira niʼsawatun sehterin. waʼwaruʼsa aʼma inaura paʼinasu ahke, tenin. Ahke ira inaran waʼwaruʼsa paʼweru ikirupi. puʼpian kusharu peʼpeina, nuwantupihchin. Uʼmaina imin nani tihkipachina.
¿Maʼnin maʼsharuʼsata peʼperuwa ya paʼpatuwara aʼna taweri?
¿Ku nuyawe yuʼsatun maʼpatakahsu niwitapiranwe?
Tanawanke ninateke, nani weʼsarin.
¿Mamawarin yaʼi kurihki kechihtunwen?
¿Yunkirahran ihpurawata irahka mamawaya pantirinpuasu? naʼkun iʼwatauwe yunkirewauchin, naʼwanewa kusharuʼ nininsu, inahsu kusharuʼ nininsu, nuya nimara paʼsamaraʼ nihpaunawe nianarewa uʼmarinsu.
Unpu awanteʼita chanchuʼi irahmashu. kanpitanta nuwantuku kahpuchin, ayahku irahtuwinan, ihnuchin kankimarewe ikiruwinan nihkunu nuya kankimarewe yunsanke.

¿Unpantaʼ ku yunkiranwe mama nunterinkensuʼ? mamasu ku nunwantupirinwe kema sehtakasuʼ. Ama kemaura sehtu yaʼwechinkensuʼ. Kahsu ninarawe ina sehteruʼ aʼna taweri pahsachiʼinken. nuyahsha nuntekeʼ, waʼwa, inapuchin nihpateraʼ ku ninupike panka sehteruʼ yaʼweterinpuwe.

Unpuwa iʼyaruʼsa, ihsu semanake ku peike kehpariterawe, paʼnawe peʼnate iʼshake paʼantamare. Ku ninararawe nuyawantakahsu, nihpiriunwe kahpashinkeran kankunawe. Ku naʼkun kusharu kenawe, taʼnanuwe chinuhtamare paʼterin nani irake chinuhteraweke.
¿Nuyahsha kankanteran ninarainke niʼtun?
¿Niʼnanku ka naniterawe paʼankamare sami ra ninanuke, nimara naniterawe pawerekahsu paʼantenaʼpi nahtaninkuhsu ku aʼpatumapinawe paʼterinsu?
Ka shura tenawe nihpuni, inapihkeran nuyahsha nunteku.
Taʼta kema iteku: Tahshinake nihpachina paʼyanan nunshake, ¿Inta a nuya kankanterinke? Yusparin iteke iʼsha waʼyan peinenke kemarinkensu?
Manuke, pake paʼanke tata shiʼshinen. Kuhtaru peʼtenke kuʼwara pihpiahtaraʼsunwe, inaputuwatan ku ni nuʼwiaramawe paʼanturuʼsareʼken irake.
Iʼyahshanuwe, ku iratariwe ku chinuhtuatewe.
Nimara inaruʼku wenseʼihtwe tanawanke, inapuwatui sehteru yaʼwerinsu paʼpinamare inkiʼihtuiwe.
Ku nañanteriuwa peʼpetu nunshake waʼwatari ninepuchin.
Uhkuirawe nunshanewe nani tahshirawasuʼ, inauchin ama pama kepataumareweʼ
Aʼma tanapitukewe sehtu kanaʼinkewe.
Aʼma sehtekehsu paʼpatan, iyahsha; tanan weʼka iteke kamare inaran nuyahsha nunteke naʼnepachin ira ahketatun.
Weʼkama, ¿Kema nuwiteran iʼshana petehte nininsu? ¿Nituhteran nuya samira yaʼwerinsu ina iʼsha pehtuike?
¿Unputa karinsu kechinken?
Ina ku yuʼnin niwike, nimara samira paʼpi pahtun inaran ku yaʼweterinku kun umpu paweretaranwe niwiteransu nuya nuya ihshkeran
Nuya nunteku, mahsu, ¿kemanta peʼiran ihsu iʼshake? ¿Ku nuya kankanteranwe nani taweri yaʼwerin puʼpian samira ihseke?
Kankunawe peike kuʼwara tahshirawasuʼ, inapuchin nuyahsha kushaterawe kemupiruʼsaruʼku.
Keteke shapun mamanen.

¿Unpu yusparin interanta iyahsha uʼnaike peipite nuyahterinkensu? Yusparin iteran nuya nanankeran kemuinenpita niʼtichinaichin. Aʼkake nuʼwihken weyai sahkatu tihkiwachin? Nuyahsha yaʼwekasu suʼsurin nuya kankankeran ayanpatera maʼsha. ¿Yunkike yaʼi tahshiramiachin ina nininsu kemamare? Aʼchinapi nahtanterin aʼchintamare ihsu waʼwaruʼsa, aʼma suʼsukaimarewe inauramare yunkiatuna.
Iyahsha nunsha nahtanterin inaran iʼshake uhparin. Waʼaneni aʼma aʼna kechinsu kuʼwara nuya nunchahtaraʼsuwe.
Kuʼ nanianterawe tahweri kuʼ sehtupinanwe.
Aʼchinapi, ¿Aʼma kanutekesu uʼnan kankirinsu ninasawatun? Ku kanuhterawe, nani tahshiramiachin ninarawe kiwiatu winrawe waʼwaruʼsaruʼku iminke.
Kemaruʼku ni nuʼwirawe nihpuni, inapihkeran nuyahsha nunchihtuwe.
Ihpuke mamawarin kañaʼpi

Iyahsharuʼsa, nahtanku weʼka iterankensu. Nimara kiyahsu puʼpian taʼtahrai mamanuwe tahshi tuku tehsarin irusawatun. Nimara pahkaturu nunen ninehsu ichi unkatapun ihpura. Nuyakeran iterai nuya taweri inaran yusparin iterai kemuiruʼsa yaʼi kankankeran chachin.
¿Waʼan kechihtunkuwe kirihka nishirinsu wiʼnawe uʼwana maʼpaterinsu?
¿Unpu pantaʼpi paʼanapun ihpuea taweri?
¿Yunitun taʼnanen tahshianta?
Nimara ina kepapun kusharu inaran samira, inshariteranta kahtawain peʼpekamare.
¿Nañanteriuwa iyahsha a chaʼirinpuahsu? Ku, panka ihpuaʼawa. Ku kehpachiunwe tanan pahkaturu, ku kañaʼpiruʼsa a nuya chihteruwa.
Ahpurimahshu, Kema yunkiran iraterehsu nahpuinahchin iʼsha yunsanke nani iʼwarapiriunwe?
Ahke ira paʼchin sahkaikeran.
Inamini, tatanen paʼninsu iʼshaparihchi yunkiaʼa. Nimara kanpuhsu yunkiahpari nani uʼnaninke iminke. Nimara inanta yunkirinpu ihpura. Kahpashin kankanchehturuwe nituhtere inanta yunkirinpu nihpuni.

Uhshiya, ku naniterawe shaʼwitakainsu iʼwaterawehsu. Ku ira kenanawe pamari imuterin niʼtun. Ku tahshi ya ayanawe, nimantaratun ku yaʼweriunwe unpu pihpikasu. Yunkirawe kemahke, ninatahrawe, uʼnan anutahrin tananke niʼtun.
¿Ihsu nananmare ihpuihtunkuwe?

¿Kema wankuru kepakawenku tahshiraya? Karinken kahtawainke pantapi paʼanke senateransu, piyapiruʼsa ya paʼankapuna nimara. Nimara tahshiramiachin pakariuwa. ¿Ihkantariuwa nuya paʼterinsu? Sehterawe yaʼi kemawatu.
¿unpu paweretaawa iraaka niwiterewasu?
Nimara atari yuʼsawatun ya maʼpateran nuʼmuhken.

¿Ihpura tahshi nahsha pihta yaʼwerin niʼtun kahpashin kankankeran nansararawe? Manuke, nani wenu nuyahpiachin, piyapiruʼsa ninatawi. Aʼma winaransu puʼukesu, nuyahshakeran nunpata paʼpi nuya kankiapi. Kuʼwara nansapihsu taʼwanchahtaraʼsuwe ka aʼyararawe pensha pirianke.¿Weʼsaran ka ruʼku nansapun u tahshiramiachin paʼsaran weʼehkapun peinenpa?
Ina yuntunin kurihki yamura puʼpian mare paʼanin niʼtun.
A nuyahtenaʼpimashu maʼsha kepawi waʼwaruʼsapitareʼ.

Wiʼnawe, nahtanke nananuwe kuʼwara wahpuru iʼshake paʼshahtaransuwe. Ka yaʼkunpatu ihsu itamare, kemuiruʼsa yaʼi kamaihutuwe nuya iʼshake. Aʼma nañantekehsu weʼehta peʼpekaman inaran pensha aʼkutamare. Ikiruwinan kankunpatewa nimantarantun tanareʼna, wenu niʼihturawe inaran sami chinpi. Manuke, waʼwasha, ichi nanpeke yuvme nani muhturu kepanaʼpi nani manutarinpu.

Wiʼnasharuʼsa, ¿Aruhse senaruwahsu kepaʼawa paʼankamare paʼantupiʼpa? Puʼpian uʼnanin nihpuni saniʼihtunwe nuya, nahpiunahchin kuhtaruke paʼankariuwa. inaran yuʼsatewa maʼpataʼawa yuʼnana inaran kanchura. Aʼma tuhpinan kurihki tihkikehsu. Puʼpian tananpitaʼawa kañupatewa nimiriu paʼankamare.

Nimara tata naʼwanin iyahsha paʼninsu waʼki guhki tananke. Nihpiriunwe ina ku naniteriunwe unkutakahsu sehtunen ina a taʼterin kañaʼpi yunki. Nimara yunkirin yuhlakasu yunki pensha pirianke, sehtu aʼma naʼkun kehkenkamarewe. Ina yuniʼin mahshuruʼsa, inawa nimara tahpawi nanan nunentamare.
Iʼwata, aʼma tuhpinan nante iratekehsu, chaʼchuruʼsa ku ichi kañutsrinkenwe
Nuya niʼihtunwe paʼantemahsu nuya pawereterin nihpuni nani sahkatupike, naʼkun senatupi kemuinenpitari.

Miʼsemahshu yusparin iterinku kahtawarawe paʼanterinke iʼshakeʼpa. Kari shaʼwiterawe nuyahsha nanankeran shaʼwirawe samira paʼankamare inaran nuyakeran piyapiruʼsa niʼnawe. Paʼantenapiruʼsa ka kiwirinaku nahpuatun yaʼi samira paʼanterinawe sahkai peʼirawehsu.

¿Unpuwanta waʼwasha naʼnerin nara nukunanke?Nimara nanu ayatatun tananke. Kari yaʼkarirawe winareʼna inaran nahtanawe maʼsuna unpurinsu. Inahsu yunkirin ku kenankahsumare. yaʼwiterawe kanpu kahtuyaʼpinpu yuniaʼa. Naputewatera inaura naʼnei ni amirin. Inaran kenanai pantaʼpiru yaʼkari inaran kahpashin kankantawatui pahshi tenai.

Wiʼnawe, kema nuyahsha nunteranku nihpuni karinken yai taʼparanken iminke niʼtun, ka nuyahpiachin kankanchihtuwe. Nimara ka ikiruatu nuʼwiterawe. Manuke inaran shaʼwituku ku wachi nuʼwiteranwe, nuyahsha kankanchihtuwe ihpuranku ihpura nihpuni. Ku nuwanterawe kema sehtakesu yaʼi taweri, nimantaratun kankanen naʼkun yunkiahrin nihsha nihsha yunkiatun ihpura.
Wiʼnawe, sahpate puʼmukari tananke aʼma kañu pahshkamarewe inaran waʼan nuʼsa nunentu peike nimiriu ketarinpuwa nani taweri puchin.
¿Ya paʼanan sami nanpiruʼ?

Aʼchinapi sanawi tenin paʼsarin panka iʼsha ninanuʼparihchin. Nimara iʼshakeʼpa nuwarapun tahshiramiachin nunsha mahkamare. Ina shaʼwirin kirihkanenpita aʼna peʼturawake puʼmurin. Ku nituhterawe nunihtaware aʼna uʼmaramara ku nihpun waʼkirarin naʼkun. Iyahsha shaʼwiterinku ina nani wentarinken nahsha shaʼwinan kentarin. ¡Kahpashin kankanterai wentapachina! Nimara nisha nihsha napihse keshirarinkui tanan nunankamare.
Aʼma kushatekehsu neʼwe imiranenkeran shihpiru yaʼnuterankeran. Sehterawe kañuransu kankan ikihteransu nihkatuwe ihsu aʼna aʼma inaukehsu.
ku ninarau kanpita kawera kahtapawa
Ina kuahsu nuniunwe, tuhpinan pahkarikeran yusparin tenin kenaninsu yuʼyushanenpita.
¿Nanitere nuntakasu nuyahpiachin nani tahshi?
Nuʼten tenansu. Kema weʼnansu a nuya kankanteranku waʼyanuwe, taʼtahrawekeran yusparin tenawe weantaran niʼtun, amiraʼwa.
Waʼwasha mamapaine ni karirin irake, nuyahsha weʼkama ichin. Iʼmenen peʼpetatun pinenkeran imarimaʼin. Uʼnanawachin, a naʼiteʼin inaran ushakeraʼwayan kepaʼin yaʼwerinpa, ku patapunawe.
Maʼsu, ku neʼwe imirake kuhshataranwe, ku kankan ikihtaranwe

Ku nañanterawe nahpuru tahshi. Ku uʼnan kankiriunwe inaran ku kankiriunwe waʼwinaʼwaya. Ku chinuhtupinawe ninaterin, mamanuwe ku aʼnutupirawe ikirurawesu. Naʼneinen amihterawe inaran iterawe awantamare puʼpian. Inpihkeran ku tapirinkuiwe ninaihsu.
¿Yunkiran unpu aʼnanankuhsu nunshanen pantaʼpi kepakamare paʼankapu? Yusparin iteranken ihpuatunke, nihpiriunwe, ¿Tananpiterin naʼkun tahtawatamare?
Iʼwata, iyahsha.Ihsu nuyawanke paʼsarewa nunshake ninanukeʼpa. Nuyahsha akurarawe peʼpetunuwe wankana inaran nihsarawe iʼsha waʼwateraipuchin.
¿Maʼmareta kurihki tahparewa? Shapunmare

Uhshira, uhsharan, aʼma naʼpikehsu kuwianake. Uʼna naʼwepun inaran piʼi pihpirarin. Ka tenawe naʼwanan aipiranke yaʼnupikahsu, aʼma wira teʼwatekehsu. Manuke, weke, shaʼwichinke aʼna shaʼwinan ninataripuchin.
Wayunke pantapi nuyapi nininsu paʼankamare inaran nahpunin nininsu tahpake kapamre, ama yaʼi seʼyunkehsu ina kuhtarutekerahchin.
Yuʼke pantaʼpi Piʼpihshamare.
¿Umpuanta ku aʼnurachin ka ihsha waʼpuruke taweriachin?Nahtanawe nuhteken:piʼpike karuku taweripachin, umpuanta ihwara ina ira ikirurawe naʼkunware paʼpinuya.
Ku patariwawe kuhsharu, ahke ira nihpiriunwe.
Ku nimara maʼsha paʼankapuwe inapihkeran nunshanake ni tapirin.
¿Peʼipatera naʼwanawe wiʼnawe?
Kari nuyahsha nunterawe nihpuni hahpashin kankanchihtuwe.
Unpuwa, iyahsharaʼwa.tahshiraya nunshake paʼsare ninanuʼpa. Taʼna kepararawe, inaran kurihki mamanuwe tahparinsu. naʼwanaranken naʼkun paʼpatu.
Wiʼnaweruʼsa, ku tananpitarewawe nuʼun inauraʼ.
Peʼpeawa nimara yaʼichachin yunsankeʼpa.

¿Ina iʼirateke iʼwe peʼsharinsu ihpura taʼtarinsu nahtanan? Manuke, ¿Nituhteran nahsha maʼsha? Naʼwanawe naʼkun ku ya pihpirawe. ¿Kemanta teʼwaran aʼma ayankamarewe? Kahpashin kankanterawe ihsu nuntatunke, Unpuanta aʼnapita tahpearan.
Puʼpian naʼkekariuwa inaran ni ihpurarewa.
¿Karinta ayantapu ihsu kahtawarinkuhsu?
Kampuwasu ku iratarewawe inaparti aʼke ina piʼkeran shaʼwiate paʼnesu kemupiruhsu.
¿ku ikihchitun nihka wiʼnan ku ya ihpurinkenwen nihpunin? ku kahsu awanchituwe ka waʼwihshinewe ku yunirinkuwe ya teʼwawachin.
Nuyahsha kankanteransu teʼteteke kepake ahke iratuwatan; pateke pensha wenu ni uʼshitereʼpa, nani tahshi inapurechin ninanuke.
Ama paweretawaru kirihkiran, yuʼawa pishate, inaran naʼpatawa kanpua nuwanterewaru.

Ama inauchin naʼnekesuwe, iya, payukeran yaʼihpi anuyahtaran, nani naʼwanan kanpua mamnenpua, ahpira uʼmarin piʼi tananan yaʼkuntaware, maniatun, naʼniʼi uhkuike, ama yaʼwechikenwe teʼwa, kiarin ninarainke ihseke.
Uʼnan pei pite awepachina, mahshu nu nuyahsha inaura kankanteriunwe sehturi yunkirinsu ku naniteriunwe patakahsu.
¿tawerianpitere, waʼwi nuyasha nuntuku tashi ku nahtanankuwe perarankusu payaneʼna?
Keterawe weʼkama, wiʼnawe Numihsha. Pihtake nunsha chinirawatun inaran muhturu tenentaʼin iʼsha pentuntakaware.
Ninake tatanen uʼmakahsu.
Yunsan imahke ayankamare.
Ku peʼpetunuwe tanankeran patapuwe.
Paʼpi ikirurawe ira weʼshimarawatu.

Unpuwa, wiʼnawe. ¿Nani ninataran maʼsha peʼpekamare? Nimara paʼanterinke saʼyate, ku nituhterawe iminke weshimamaranke. Sehterawe ayankasu inamare uʼnai tawerianpiterin nimantarin. ¿Kema tenan iratakahsu nuya pihpikapun? Nani kahsu mahshuku aʼnuarahchin ikirurawe nihpiriunwe naniterawehsu kahtawaʼinke. Nuya akuke nuʼserateruʼsa yaʼkari, aʼma chiwekuhsu nunshinan irake.
Kahken iyawe, chiniratun nunke: teʼwa nahpuru tahshi niʼsapunke, saʼan a nuya kankanterinke. kahpashinkeran yusparin iteke ina nuya nuhsururinkensu.
Inahsu nuya nuwanterin pantaʼpi senarinsu yuʼsawatun pihshate maʼpatakahsu, nimara inapuwachin nuyahsha piʼpitarin kahtuchachin.
Sehturu tahshike ku nuyawe kankanterawe.
- Kaihshanuwe paʼnin iʼsha peʼnahte nahpuatun naʼkun naʼwanawe. - taʼteke, nuyahsha kankanteke yaʼnuipunpuchin ina uʼmakaware.
¿iʼsha fahpuru ku weshatarinwe nunshinanke ahkenitun? ku,
Nani tahshiwiriunwe iratahrewa.
Nahpunikeran ni aʼpeikamare, kiyahsu pei tahparai nuyahsha inaran iʼirate. Inapuchin yun aʼpeikariuwa aʼma kañu kehkamarewe kusharuke.

Ku nuyawe shiʼshi senaruahsu puʼpiamare paʼankahsu. Ina kemapi Aʼnuterinpuwa uskuru, Yamura inaran puʼpian shapun, kiyahsu aʼnuarahchin nuwanrterai. Kahsu sehterawe, inapihkeran ku maʼshateranta ihkanterenkuiwe. Aʼma tuhpina yuʼwawasu sahkaikeran shaʼteruahsu. Imin yaʼi taweri keterinpuwa nahpuatun aʼpeiʼawa kuhtarute nininsu.
