Nimara tahpakari nahsha yuʼnana paʼankamare aʼna yuhkiʼpa.
Wiʼnawe piʼi naʼwerin ituachinawe, kahpashin kankantawatu pahshi tehsarawe, ku nituhtewirawe, nihpiriunwe sehterawe ina kañupachin tehkatu.
Waʼwasha, iʼwara nunshake nanpere kuʼchahchin tahshiramiachin. Kemanta nanpeke ihpura nuya mahke peʼpetu, aʼma tananpitekehsu anuteʼinsu iʼshake.
uʼnanpachinara tahshi ka kawera wenserahrawe yunsanke,sehterawe nuwanterawe kaʼtanaikunasu iʼchinpiawa penapuhtu nuyahsha nunkakasu.
Kuʼ nuyawe ninanku nakun paʼanasu, maʼsha nihputa pahtun niʼtun
¿Ni patere nuya ni ihpuate?

Waʼwaruʼsa taʼapi tatamahshuin nahkawikamare tanankeran uʼmararinsu. Ku inaura tananpitupiu pahkarike yaʼkunkamare. A nuya kankanchiʼina sewenin pihkeran tahshi. Paku mañahtun, kemuiruʼsa kahpashin kankantawi inaran pensha nihsawi nuyahshakeran ihpukainkemare.
Waʼwasha, naʼkun iʼsha naʼwehtaran iratuwatan; kepake kusharu inaran chinuhteke nani paʼweru ikihteranke.
Paʼanariwa pihshate nahpuin paʼterinsuchahchin.

Mamapaya, kena nunwatuatan, ka chinuhtarawe ihsu panka napike. Paʼuru ikuhtwrawe naʼkun iraterawe niʼtun. Puʼpian kehsha kaʼsarawe inaran paʼsarawe mañahtun. Ku tahshi ya kankunawe, nahpuatun paʼawa mañahtun.¿Manah?
ku ama ni ayatawasu, pentuanwa naʼpuinachin ihke.
Unpuwa, weʼenatewawen ku weʼesaranwen, ku sapukahsu nuwanteranwe
¿Ka paʼanawe uskuru pawanterinkuhsu iʼchimikamare pensha? nimara nahkaranchin iʼwaraya ninanuʼpa kankuantarawe iʼwa puchin?
- ¿Inta ina kemapi naʼwerinsu? - Ku nuya niʼnawe, aʼna mihtayutenaʼpi nimara; aʼna kehken peʼperin inaran ahke tanakeran uʼmararin yaʼnurin.
Wiʼnapi ku paʼihtun tananke ku shawipunawe, mahsu ku inshateranta nituhchitunawe unpuruhsuna uʼmararin iminenke.
- ¿Nimara ahpiwarinehken ni kenanan irake? - Nuʼten nimara, nihpiriunwe ikirurawe ku naniterawe nunkahsu tananke uʼmarahpu.
Uʼnan ku ya naʼweriunwe niʼtun mamapaya sehtarin. Inaura taʼnake wentensawatun yunkirin kushatupisu kumuinenpitare.
Ku shaʼwipunawe pantaran nahkaranchin. Iʼwara ku ira kenananwen inaran ku keparanwe peʼpetunen yanirinsu. manuke, aʼma tanan kiwikehsu. aʼma ninakehsu piʼi yaʼkunkasu, tahshi ku kenanuwe nara.
Mamanuwe, puʼpian kehparituate iʼshanake,ka ni paʼmuraihtuwe. naʼkun iratawatu unkarawe.Puʼpian chinuchihtuwe inara paʼihtuwe taʼareʼna.Manuku,pawantarinpuwa naʼkun iminke ihkankamare.
Tenawe naʼkunkeware maʼsha nunshake kepare. Nimara patariuwa aʼnahken weʼehta peike aʼma yankuminkamarewe.

Weʼkama waʼwaruʼsa. Uʼnan nimara ichi kehparitarinpuwa kanpuwara yaʼi tahshiramiachin. Sehteruwa nimara ku inshateranta weʼniunwe nihkanpuwa. Nihpiriunwe tenawe winantariuwa piʼi pihpirinsu nihkatewa.
Iyaruʼsa, piwiʼawa waʼwaruʼsa muhtunen teʼwapihsu, inaran ihpuaʼawa nuyahsha kankantaimare.
Nuya puʼmuʼina peʼpetu
¿Ku kuchituwe ni aniateran akahpakantakasumare nani tahshi naʼnerin? Ku karisu tananpichituwe inauara ku ihperrawe tahshi.
Inapitasu ina pantinchachin aʼpatantapi.
Nimara ka naʼkun naʼkun sehterawe nahpuru taweri. Nanikumarinpa ihpurawe inaran ina nararuwankana tananke ayarin.

Tatamahshu, nahpuru ku ira kenanawe uʼmakamare. Uʼnan paʼpi chinihken anuterin nahpuatun nu kenanterewe. ¿Yunkiran? Ku iʼwaraya ya uʼmarawe, tanan a chiwerinku nahpuatun iraterawe ahke nunshinankeʼpa iʼsha yaʼkari, ahke yaʼwerawekeran.
Siura, nahtan inke uskuru puʼpian mare paʼantuku, mamanuwe aʼparinku paʼankamare inaran taweriachin ayanawe peike.
Weʼkama uhshira, ihsu semanake maitariwa nunshake pakamare aʼna panka ninanuʼpa. taʼna peʼtenkare nara nukunanke inaran kusharu kenansu kapariuwa irake.
Uhshira, amihke naʼneinen, tananke paʼsare wayu yunihkari. Winararewa nahpuinahchi inaran sehtu kehpariterin ahke irake
Tatamahshu ku winariunwe nimantaratun ku aʼyariunwe uʼnanpachina, nimara wiʼninpita ku weʼniunwe nihkapun niʼtun inaran ku inshariteranta a nuya kankanteriunwe.

Nunentunpaya shaʼwirin nuyahshakeran sanawi ina yaʼwerin nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu aʼnantarin weʼehta pihtamari. Kemuinenpita naʼkun wenu nihpachina yaʼimare,ina weʼehta nuya pamurawatun kensarin. Inapihkeran inanta iʼwerechihtunawe nunterin taweri.Nunentenaʼpi tenin maʼsha ni aʼnankasu nahpa ni yuntuke kanpu kapini.Inapuchin waʼwaruʼsa nituhtapi waʼwashakeraware maʼsha ni ketakahsu nuyahshakeran inapuchin yaʼi nuya yaaʼwerapi.

Ihsu semanake tahparau manintaranta ketarinauruʼ, ku naʼkun nihpirinwe, kahtawanku manintaranta paʼantakausu waʼwahshsa nahsetewachin, yaʼihpi ihkantaun nimara, manu paʼsarawe iʼkeʼpa sami piʼpiyan paʼterinsu nuniamwatawe.
¿Nimara nuʼwiterawe inara nuyahtantarawe.
Iʼsha pamatuachin ni yuntuaʼawa, aʼma teʼwakarirawe waʼwaruʼsa aʼpeiʼawa, inaran chinihken ihpuaʼawa iyahsharuʼsa a kahpa kankantamare ninanuke yaʼwepihsu.

¿Yunkiran iyawarin nuʼkui ni nuʼwirai nahsha saweni ayarinmare? Nhpunin ni tehkarirai inahsu sehtereʼna tananke paʼnin. Kahsu tehwaterawe maʼshateranta unpukahsu ina inawera paʼnin niʼtun. ¿Unpuwanta naʼkun shurah tenewa nuʼwitewatera, amiraʼwa? Ayanpachina, ni ihpurai naʼkun inaran yaʼi nañanterai. Ku ahsu nuyahsha nanan nuyahtuwatanwe yaʼi tahshi ninuwinkeran yunkirahpun.
¿Unpuata inasuʼ ku yunirewen nara nuhteken ku pentuyataresu iʼshana pamaterinke?
¿Nuʼten naʼwanan ayamarehsu iʼsha yunsanke, iʼwanake iʼsha yaʼweapun inaran yaʼinpuwa ninaterewa kankikahsu?
Wiʼnawe, aʼma teʼnawantamarewe peʼshana nuya paʼmuaʼawa inaran paʼa nunentu peike ninanuke yaʼwerinsu aʼnuarahchin nunenkainpumare.
Tatanen tanankeran uʼmararinsu ninaʼa nahpuinahchin. Aʼma sehtekasu, iyara, kemuiruʼsamare ihsu tawerimiahchin taʼararin panka kahpashin kankantakasu.
Aʼma naniantekesu wishakasu nininusa niyuntupike tupina, kemapirawa. Kapa kakanterawe yaʼ ipi kankanukraware ku masha naniantuwachinarewe natantupi ku ikayanterasuʼ

¿Unpurinta iyaʼwanuwe ku ya yaʼnupiriunwe? Nimara peʼtawaterinsu tahshi kañurin. Kari nahtanawe karuʼku ya iratupachin iʼshakeʼpa. Nimara iʼshari puʼpian a kahpa kankanterin. Naʼneinen amihterawe werunke. Inapihkeran niʼnawe kahpashin kankatawatun taʼarin iʼsha yunsankeʼpa. Tenawe nañanterin sehterinsu winarahpatun.

Imuya, nuyahshakeran nunsha peʼpeke mañahtun. Pentuntariuwa kahtu iʼsha nuyahpi pankeichin kuʼwara panka iʼsha pentuhchahtaraʼsuwe. Aʼma patekehsu peʼpetu, yuhsemare. Kankuanewa ninanuʼpa kuʼwara kamutechin nihshataraʼsuwe yaʼi paʼankamare. Manuke nani piʼi inapararin.
Nimara piyapiruʼsa paʼntupike ku ya paʼanterinawe wayuruʼsa naʼkunkeware kayarin niʼtun, ku nuyawe yaʼnuriunwe.
Nuya kankankeran tahparai puʼpian pantaʼpi paʼanaisu ninanu pihtamare, inaran yaʼsurinsu ni ketariuwa tahshiramaichin peʼperuamare.

Nimara kema nahtanan aʼna nunke muhturu tihkimarainsu iʼshana pentuntahpun. Iachin naʼwepatan, nahtan ihtenkunwe kepainkumare. Ku nituhterawe inshateranta weʼsarinsu, inapuchin nuya iratariuwa. Piʼi inahpa nihpachin chinuhtariuwa.
Weʼka iteke weʼpisupita inaran a nuya kankanteke ihsu nanamare.
¿Unpuwanta ku ihpura pawereteruwawe niwike uhkuiruwahsu paʼantupike?
Nimara ihpura chinkanake tuma paʼpi paʼtun.

Tunputeke weʼehtaruʼsa inaran iwe yanehken peʼpeʼawa. Aʼma nañantaʼawasu paʼkaturu ikihtumare, waʼwaruʼsa. Muhturu puʼmuawa inaran aʼnarahchin paʼawa iʼshaparihchi.Sehterawe ahke niʼtun inaran tahshi aʼnarahchin ihkanin.Iʼwatuwatewa, ku nanitariuwa mama kahtawakahsu.
¿Kema shaʼwichihtunkuwe kahpashin nanan pihpirinsu?

Aʼna paʼantenaʼpi mahshu kuwanteriun yuʼnana kanpiatakahsu kanpuwa kayapinenpuare. Kiahsu muhsharai, inahsu kurihki nuwanterin. Ku naniteraiwe kanpiatakahsu nahpuatun tuhpinan uʼmarai ikiruwinan. Karinke nani shaʼwiterankema aʼma tuhpinankeran ahke iratamarewe. Aʼ ma nahteawasu piyapiruʼsa nahsha nuwitaruake, ku aʼna taweri nuʼten nunpiuwe nahpuatun taweri chiniarewa.
Unpua, ninaranken uʼnanpachin.
¿Unpua, mama, kemantaʼ teʼwa maninken tahshi niʼniraruʼsa nuʼwitupachina?
Tashi ku naʼnerawe kanchura tahkuiwachina, ku kateranta naʼnerawe, iyaraʼwa, yunkirawe irahka tatamahshu shaʼwiterinpuaru ku maʼtaranta yaʼwerinwe airanke.
Wahpuru kankunin nani tahshiruʼpuraware.
Paʼsarawe yaʼkari ninanuʼpa, wiʼnawe. Ira uʼnaankeran shihpirutrin niʼtun yunkiahrawe. Ninaku uʼmarawehsu nuyaʼshakeran aʼma nuʼwitapunawe.
Kaʼpa ira, ku inkanawe ninanuwapaʼ.
¿Yuʼme kema peʼpeihtunwe?
Nuyahshakeran Weʼka iterama. Peʼpetunuwe kehken niʼtun paterawe yunsanke, pankamiachin niʼ uhkuirawe, inaran manuantarawe, aʼna waʼwasha paʼpi kañuterin niʼtun.
¿Nuwanteran shiʼshi pantaʼpimare?
Mama ku kurihki yaʼi tahparariunwe inaura; yaʼi waʼwinpitare ni kechihtunawe ku inshateranta nañantunawe.
Senteranke ku kemaura nihsarawen. Nahkaranchachin tawerikahsu ninarawe kemaruʼku inaran niʼsaran kahpashin kankanteransu wehsuatarin pantaʼpiru yankupuchin uʼnan pihkeran.

Iyahsha, iwehtuku peʼpetu mañahtun. Nani nunsha ninararin pentuntariuwa kahtu iʼsha pankamahsu. Peʼpetu aʼpeike, aʼma shipitekehsu. Pihtate mañahtun aʼnateranpa ihkankamare. Taweri kanararinpu pawananin naʼkun iratakahsu.
¿Iʼsha yah uʼurawe iratewatera ahke? ¿ku chinhterawe inanshira perarinsu nahtanpatera tanake?
¿Ni kanpiakahsu nini nuʼtehken? Kara samira aʼna yamuramare, yah kehpariterepuchin, ¿Nuʼten tenan karuʼku?

¿Unpuwanta tatamahshu sehtarin nahpuru iʼwaraya? Nimara inshateranta yunkirin ku yaʼwerinsu. Kari nahtanawe maʼsuna yunkiatun inapuahrin. Shaʼwiterinku tataine mihtayutupihsu. Shaʼwiterawe ina yunki paʼpi nuya, ku sehturu. Niʼmawe puʼpian niʼterin. Nimara tihkirin winareʼna inaran aʼna shaʼwitantarinku paʼpi nuya
¿Nani semanake samira ni kanpiarawe kemaruʼku? Nuwanterawe nuya yunkikasu nuʼtehken, inapuchin kahtuyaʼpinpu kahpashin kankantare.
Ku kankuntariwawe intaranta kahtawawachinupuawe.
Uʼnan ku ya ichi peʼipachinkenwe, kahpashin kankatawatun wenseke tawinan peike; yusparin itapun chinuhteransu inaran ninaihtunwe taweri nuyahtakasu.
Nimara ku aʼnarahchin kankumarawe unshinanpa.

Wiʼnasharuʼsha,¿samira ihpura taweri paʼankariuwa? Naʼkun peʼipatewa, iyahsha puʼpian kepataʼawa. Ketawatewa maʼpaʼawa kehsha weʼehtamare. Aʼma yaʼi tuhpinan yuʼkehsu, nimantaratun aʼma apirakuhsu. Tanapihsupitare ni ketaʼawa inaran tahpaʼawa kapuamarenta.
Nimara nahpuru na,ʼnekawe, nihpiriunwe sehterawe iʼ sha niʼsawatu. Iyaʼsha peʼiraihsu ahke paʼnin ku uʼmariunwe.
Yunkeran ihpura nuya yaʼwerewa, ku sapu yaʼwechihtunpuwawe;

Iyahshanuwe, muhshainken iminke ayantake karuʼku. Kema kaʼtanpatankun, aʼnarahchin tihkiaruwa shaʼteruahsu aʼchinpeike. Naniteran nuhpuni tahshiramiachin weʼihtunwe. Aʼma iʼwataʼawasu, uʼnan naniterin tapikahsu sahkatunenpuwa ninuwasu.
Taʼpain kanarinsu aʼchintaweri.
Uʼnan ahke irake mamapaya aʼpayanin nihpuni, waʼwashari a naʼihchihtunwe. inaran keparin aʼna yaniruʼpa inahke imiranen a wenukaterin. kaʼtanin inaran nuyahsha nunterin.
Yusparinken itawa ni ketawa ina,inaran ni ketawa,piʼshate kiʼsha inara ku interantakehpariterinwe kahpainauchin mama aʼchinterinpuasu.
Inshateranta peike kañupachina, ni yuntunʼawa inapirianke, aʼma teʼwataʼawasu, inaran ihpuaʼawa nuyahsha kankantamare inapuchin aʼnarahchin nuyahtarin.
- Iyashanuwe nuhsururawehsu paʼnin ahke ninanuʼpa. ¿Nahkaranchin niantapu? - inamini, aʼma sehtekesu, kaʼtananinken nuhsururinkensu.
¿Tahshiraya ihpura nuya kankantapu?
¿Ahpi, paʼsaran peʼikapun ahke? ¿pentuntaran iʼshana ku nihpun iranate tananparihchin? shaʼwituku mañahtun, nani tahshitarawe.
¿Maʼmareta yuntuneʼ? nuwantari niʼtun.

¿Ihpura nunentenaʼpimahsu ku kankuaninwe ahke ninanuʼpa? Ku, ina ku paʼsariunwe uʼnan ku naʼweriunwe niʼtun inaran iranta paʼpi nahpunin. peʼpetunenta ku puʼmuteriunwe, nahpuatun aʼnataweri nuyahsha ninake, ahpiaʼwanu nuhsururawehsu.
Ku nuwanterawe ni yaʼwerentakasu pantapinuʼ
Nimara tahshi ayachihtuwe, tanawanke suʼin yunkirin paʼninsu inaran ku ayamarinsu.

Mamanuwe puʼpian wensepate nunshake, ka chinirupi yaʼwechitunkuwe. Ikirurawe maitahpatu. Tuʼnaru kahsawatu inaran paʼa petehte iʼsha parihchi. Ya kankunawe kuʼwara tahshiyataraʼsu, nahpuatun chinihken paʼsarawe.
Nañanterin peʼpetunu peike.
peʼpeʼina nun kuʼwara kansarin.
Iminkeran taweriachin uʼmain kuʼwara tahshitaraʼsuwe inaran chinuhteʼin kemuiruʼsare peike.

¡Ninanuwe nuhsururawehsu, nahtanku sehturu nanankeran nunawesu! Aʼma iminke nihterinsupita yuʼkusu; nahtantuku nuya paʼtun. Paʼpatama paʼantapuma chinihken kankankeran nunku. Ka nuyahshakeran paweretarawe inaran iraterawe kanpita nuhtetenanke, teʼwarawe wiʼnawepita tana nahtanpachin.
Nuya pake, iyaʼwa. Iʼsha paʼmaiwachin, maitare ninanuʼpa kankumakaware. Nunshake taʼna peʼtenanawe inaran weʼehsarawe yunkipuchin yaʼnupirehsu yunsanke.
Ina ahke ira ichi ikirurinpuwa naʼkun.
Waʼwin paʼpachina, aʼshini naʼwanin inaran yunkirin niantakahsu.

¿Amiraʼwa ku ichi yaʼwereriunwe atarikayu panka samire iʼshakeran? Mamapaya shaʼwirin winareʼna, samira naʼkun paʼterin niʼtun inaran atarikayu puʼpian paʼterin. ¿Nuʼten ichi yaʼwerepihsu nuya yaʼnurin kahtuyaʼpimare?
Kemaura uʼnan ahkuana nahtanpatan, naniteran saʼan nuyahshaken nuʼihtunwe; ina ihpuihtunwe inaran ninachihtumawe, kahpashinkeran ninachihtumawe uʼnan nawekasu piʼiruteke.

Pihpipatan yunihkapunku, nimara kahtu iʼsha pentuntapun. Aʼma iʼsha kiwikehsu, aʼnataweri nanperin. Ikirurawe niʼpatanku, ninapunku puʼpian chinutahsu. Ku nituhterawe kankunkahsu taweriachin, nihpiriunwe imahsaranken uhsharan.
Ama tananpitawarewe peen uruhchiwe nani tashirin, inauchin mini, ku nuya kankantupiwe, teʼwarai nihpaunawe yunkiwirawiwe mamanewe nani ya kankirarin.

Tata ¿unpu ni pahtumatarita kanaresu senatereke? nuya nahtanke, waʼwa: yaʼihpichachin paʼane pantaʼpi nahpurini, tahpaiteriwe kusharumare, inahkeran ni kechiteriwawe yaʼihpinpua, ama iʼkikerewe ku yunkiapunawe, yamutewa sahkatawa inaran kahtawaʼwa mamanenpua kanpua naniterewasu.

Kahtawaʼi nimara naʼkun iyara ka nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu, ina aʼpeirinku yaʼwan keterahpunku. Nimara inanta ninarahrin inapuchin nihkakahsu. Yunkirawe ina nuneninku nuyahshakera ku maʼteranta nahtanpunkurawe. Penen kechinken ama ninakehsu kañukahsu nuhsurukamare piyapi kema nuhtetenake yaʼwerinsu.
Uʼmawatu ikiruwinan maʼsha paʼanasu kemepewita ketarawe

¿Maʼta ikihterin sanapiraʼwa samira amirinsu? Nimara naʼwanin yuʼin paninanmahshu. Kari nahtanawe yunkimara inare unpu yaʼwetupihsu. Yunkirin inari peʼperinsu. Naʼnerin, inapihkeran winantarin. Nimara ina yunkirinsuri a nuya kankanterin naʼkun. Nimara tihkirai aʼyarawatui pensha pirianke.
Aʼma naʼnekesu, iyahsha kanta naʼnei pihpitupirinkuwe. Ku ahsu sahkayawe kemuiruʼsa paʼsarawe itakahsu ahke paʼsawatera.Tanantapui paʼsarai. Ihpuinke aʼma nañatamarewe.
Ama winakeruwe kunʼpurunta,nituhtewiranwenta nuya nanan ihpura taweri.

Ahke wayumare iratuwate, mamapaya ku nuya kankanteriunwe. Waʼwaruʼsa kusharunen kepaina yuʼme ke, tenin. Iratakahsu ahke paʼweru ikihtere. Puʼpian chinuhchina inaran pantaina uhsharan ku naʼtun manuwinanwen.
Yaʼihpimare nimara ihkantaunn, nihpaunawe tahparawe, paʼanakasumare pihshate, manewesu kehparitarin kanuhtenaʼpi nuwanteri nuya kushatamre, nahpuatun manuarawe.
Paʼantenaʼpi nuyahsha nunchin inaran nunshanen maʼpain, yunsanke aʼnarahchin tahshirin niʼtun.

Iyahsharuʼsa, tahshita. Nimara kiyahsu ku nuya chinuhtereiwe, aʼshatu kañurinsu yunkiatui peʼnate iʼshake paʼninsu. Nimara nuya nuntekariuwa amanuteruamare inaran nuyahtakasu yunkiaʼa. Nuyahshakeran yusparin itwkariuwa kemuiruʼsa sehterinsu inaran iterai nuyahsha chinuhtamare ihpura tahshi.
Kema shaʼwituku unpuisuna nihkawasu, ka nunsarawe paʼanturuʼsaruku, ¿nahterama yuʼi pantaʼpi neʼmehtemare? nuwantuwachinataʼ, piʼpiyan kepaʼwa nimara, yukirawe yaʼkaria paʼaterewaʼpa

Tata, ¿Unpu tahpakariwata kanaruwahsu? paʼanpatewa kahwi senaruwahsu, aʼma manutatun tihkikehsu. Kurihke nuya tahpaʼawa. Ni ketaʼawa nuwanteruwahchin inaran tahpaʼawa nahsha panpemare. Yaʼinpuwa aʼpeiyawa naʼkun sahkaturuwahsu yunkiatewa.
Pakaʼsui nahkeranchachin uʼnantarin.
Naniterin mamapaya iminkeran uʼmakahsu ihpura. Niʼpatewa kahpashin kankantarewa nimara ihpikariuwa naʼkun naʼwanewa niʼtun.
Maniahtuh waʼwa nani wahprurumahshu ya patarinpu, iratamareru paʼpi ahke, ama kanuhtekesuwe paʼa tewenchinu imahta.

Kema nimara, puntunchintuwe tahshiraware iʼshananteʼ, yunkintuwe insupitata nani paʼpi, tahpaitun nimara kema yunkinenkeʼpa ira nunwantupisu, nahtaʼintunpu nimara, tawarisu kepaterinpua nuya kankanterewasuʼ.

Tananke kenanin aʼna piyapi tanankamayu ikiruatun wensarin nihpuni, waʼwashari ira puʼpianaʼwa aʼnuchihtuwen. Iʼsha puʼpian kechehtunwe inaran ushahkeran nunchihtunwe. Ahke peinen nihpiriunwe, inaran kaʼtaihtunwe nuyahshakeran, piʼirutenuwe.
Ninataʼawa yaʼinpuwa iʼwaraya wiʼsahpiriunwe.

Aʼma teʼwakesu waʼwaruʼsa tuhpimare, ahpiaʼwa. Irateke ka pirianke iʼsha yunsankeʼpa inaran nituhteke aʼma nitu teʼwakamarewe. karinken aʼchintaranke chinihken iʼshapuchin tarankamare aʼma taʼtamarewe. Nuyahsha petete nuhteteke nuya yunki keran inaran aʼma pinenkeran nuhtetekehsu sehtukeran. karuʼku weke, tahshiraya naʼkun samira mahsarewe mamanen mare.
Uʼshira aʼma ahkete naʼnekehsu. Ninaʼa sehtu naʼwechinke uʼnaike piʼi pihpirinpichin inaran kahpashin kankanteke.
Uhkuike weʼehta nuʼun muhtupa nihsarinsu, inarin atawaitarin nuʼun, nuhkurawarriwa puntuaʼsuwa, kahken wiʼnawe.
Manuterawe uʼmakasu nani chihturuʼ tahshinantupachina, uʼnansuʼ aʼnarumarahchin kankirin niʼtun.
Ama paweretawaru kurihki ihperasu, ketawa shiʼshi, inran ya,mura, inaurahrawauchin.
Ahpi, nahtaiken kemaʼtun pawereteke, naʼkun paʼanpatera waʼanen puʼpian mare keterinpu.

Ina nimara kahpashin kankantarin wiʼnin paninan uʼmawachin ahke ninanukeran. Nimara iminke iʼwarinsu yunkiʼihtunawe, nahpuinahchin kehsha shaʼpisu yunkiʼihtunawe. Tenan ina yunkiransu chinitapun sehterinsu aʼkayan nusha kahpananteke.

Maʼpaku nuyahshakeran weʼka iterankensu, mamapaya nuwanterawesu. Nimara nani tahshi Kemanta irininsu nahtanan ka puchin, teʼwa ichi yaʼkuninku. Mamanuwe aʼpeirinkuhsu yunki tahparawe. Nahpuatun nuwanterawe aʼpinsu akutainukuhsu yaʼweraweke.
¿Unpu itaʼwata naʼkun nuwanteruawasu? Ketaʼawa kahpashin kankanteruawasu. Ku ina kahtawarinpuwa peʼike nihpuni, uʼmaihterewa sehtepinan inaran naʼnepinan ninanukeʼpa
Nimara shaʼwirawe kehsha paʼankamare nuya paʼtunke, aʼnahken paʼantunuʼsa yunkipi nanku paʼterin.

¿kehsha yuʼsawatunwe maʼpachihtunwen samira paʼantupike? Kari kaʼtaintenkunwe yuʼme aʼpeikamare. ku nituhterawe nuya maʼsha ya ketamarinenpuwe. Nimara aʼna taweri ninatari. Sehterawe ku maʼshateranta keparirawe ayanewa.

Wiʼnawe, ¿maʼta kepare paʼankari tahshiraya paʼpate? Kepaihteriuwe kehsha atarikayure. ¿Ina kurihkike yuntun ihteriuwe maʼshateranta? Ka uwinkaihtuwe puʼpian nimiriumare waipachina uʼuhkaimare. ¿Kema kahtawaihtunkuwe kurihki pichikamare ka Amiraʼwa irahka kahtawarawepuchin.
kiwike inaran ninake nuya senatu.
¿Unpuwanta nihka naʼkun tatamahshu waʼkirin uhmakamare irake? Paʼyanawehsu a manuterinku, ¿Taʼake nahkawike uhsharantehrimarin nihpura
¿Nahpuatun inasuʼ achinterin wawinpita chinuʼtamare iʼshanarusake irá napunin nipachina?
¿ku yaʼweretakasu pantapi ana samimare?
Iʼwata, weke inaran yuʼke nuaya kankanteransu kahpashinkeran.
Nimara iyamahsu yunkiʼin tahpakasu kurihki nuʼten nuwantamiatamare, uskuru inaran yamura naʼkun paʼtepi ninanuke.
Chinihken uʼnananpachin, ¿ku chinuhteʼihtun aʼna nara kutekeʼ?
Yaʼwepisu nimara ku nuwantupiwe maʼsharuʼsa paʼakaisu peike nuwanteresu, tahpaʼawa uskuru paʼankawa, yamuraʼ inakeran naʼkeun nuwanterinsu peipaʼ.
Iʼkeran paʼnawe nuyahsha kankankeran
Taʼake, nuyahsha akuke pantaʼpi yuʼmeke. Kemahken tatamahshu nani semanake ya paʼanin ina tenin shaʼpiwitun aʼnarahchin paʼane.
Iyahsha kuahsu paʼniunwe ku yusparin itewachinawe aʼna mamapaya.
Nani tahshi nunshinanke paʼmapateraʼ, aʼsunawe nunsha yawentawateraʼ.
Ina ni nuʼwiwachinara yuʼwine,inaran ni nuntantawi nuyahsha
Nuya niʼnai yaʼinkui paweretechinamare aʼma naʼkun pawere ketamarewe, inapuchin nihpatui kahpashin kankantereʼna uʼmarai neʼmehte inaran nuʼmuhken paʼanaihsu kemarai.

Nahpuru tahshi ku ayaterawe, peike tanawantahrin niʼtun paʼyanawe. Kahtawarawe mamanuwe uhsharan ni uhkuikamare. Ku maʼsha teranta iterawe naʼi uʼmawachina, tuhpinan imira sehketerawe. Ninarawe waʼwina nuyahsha kankiʼin, inaran kankiʼin.

Manuke, aʼma naʼnekhsu naʼkun inanshiramare. Tananke yanpumara inahke kahpashin kankantarin aʼshin kenanpachin. Aʼnataweri naʼwerinsu kenansare. Aʼma sehtekesu, uhshiraʼwa inapuchin nanpirinsu. Paʼa mañahtun peike tanarawe nahpuinahchin kushataʼa.

Yaʼi tahshiramiachin iratariuwa inaran iʼsha yaʼnurinsu, muhshaihturiuwawe nuyahkeran ninakainpumare. Kiyahsu naʼpi aipi chinuhterai inaran kahspahin kankantereʼna yuni ihtreriuwawe ira nahkaranchin tatamahshu nunentunaʼpi nuwitepihsu.
Nuyakeran ni keterai paʼanteraisu, Yaʼi iyaruʼsa peʼpewi pantaʼpinun inaran yaʼinkui ikirurai ahke iratatui.

Aʼna taweri iyahsha nuhsururansu paʼnin, kuʼwara imiranen aʼpeyahtaraʼsuwe aʼna nanan keterawe. Nuyahshakera tananke pakeʼ inaran yusparin iteke insuna kusharu keterinkensu irake. Aʼma kemaura tahshi iratekehsu, iʼsha ya pentuntuwatan yunihke interanta kaʼtainken. Kahsu sehtarawe yunkiatu kema niʼnankuhsu, inaran kahpashin kankanterawe suʼsuraransu nihkatuwe. Nuyahshakera uʼmake inaran nuya nanan kemake mamanen mare.
Nimara inake ikiruran,¿chinuhtaʼa puʼpian?

Nimara ina aʼna taweri uʼmakapun iʼshaparihchin, inapuchin tatanen yunkirin nuyahshakeran. Tenan samira puʼmurarin iʼwa wiʼni nininpuchin. nimara ina nuya yunkiterinsu ichi taʼtapun sehterinsu ina paʼninkeraware aʼna ruʼteʼpa.

Ku nuyahsha kankanterawe waʼwatakahsu waʼkipachina. Pei tanawantahrin niʼtun naʼkun yunkirawe. Ku tanapiterawe nimantaratun ku imiranen aʼperawe ina nanun. Ninarawe nuyahsha waʼwatamare, inaran naʼnerin nahtanpatera mamapaya chinihken ihpurawe.

Nimara aʼshin inaran tatain yunkipi wiʼnin aʼnataweri uʼmararinsu.Nimara uʼmakapun sahkatunen tihkipachin ahke. Nimara ina yunki yuʼninsu kahtawaihtunwe sehtu kepakamare, waʼwatapuna iminke winapihsu yunkiatuna.
Iʼwa paʼne ninanu parihchi, ¿Unpuwanta ku inapuchin paʼanuwe?
Aʼma patekehsu sehtu niʼterankeran; nani iʼwaraya iʼsha niʼke inaran iyahsharuʼsa yunkike inawa kuhsharuke ninarinensu.
Tahshita, ahiaʼwa, teʼwara tahshi kankiwachina, weke kahke pinenkeʼpa, karinke ninaranke taʼnaʼpa, ku nihpu kahtunpure winanri piʼpiyan teʼwarehsu teʼwa kankanesu pihpirin.
Wiʼnapi ku nañanteriunwe nuʼpanin patakahsu, nimara ina yunkichinachin ninuwinen ku awanteriunwe inaran ku ahke iratechinachin kankanterin.
Yuni ihtunwe tumapuʼpian paʼterinsu.
Unpuwa, waʼwaruʼsa. Uʼnanpachin kanpuara nihsarewe ku iminke paʼsarewawe. Sewenmare sehterewa. Yusparin iterai nuʼwihken weyai weyai mare inaran tahshiraya weʼka itarawe nuyakeran.
Nimara nuhkanunta shaʼwi ihtuwe paʼankamare, nihpiriunwe nahpuru tahshiramiachin nañanterawe yuʼmeke puʼmukamare kuʼwara pihpiataʼsuwe.

Iyahsha paʼantenapi, nuyahteke nunsha mañahtun. Naʼkun iʼsha pentuntariuwa inaran ira ahke ninin. Niʼke peʼpetu yanihken niʼin inaran nuya tunpupinan. Pihtaʼawa yaʼinpuwa kankunkamare mañahtun paʼantupiʼpa. Manuku yuhsemare, naʼkun Pawantarinpuawu.

Nimara ku nuyahsha niʼnawe piyapi ka nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu paira nukiterinsu nuyahtepirinkuwe, Ina yaʼi taweri sahkaterin ku mahsha teranta nahtaninkuwe, tuhpinan winaireʼna. Nimara pantaʼpi ininukeran kepachi. Shaʼwichinken amiraʼwa yusparin tenehsu nine nuyahshakeran ihpureʼna, kuahsu tuhpinan nunewe.
Ama naniantekeruwe tanpanante kentamasu.

¿A waitenaʼpi shaʼwirin ina yuʼme paʼterinsu yuʼsawatun ya maʼpaterin saweni nani a sahkatupihsu? ¿Kemapi manusarin tananke pakamare niʼtun aʼnuarahchin nuwanterin? Aʼnuarahchin unkutapi ina yunkipihsu, uʼmakamare aʼnuarahchin ina sanapi kayurunkeʼpa?
¿Unpu yusparin itaʼwata iyahsha? Chinihken ihpuaʼawa. Ku ina kahtawarinpuwa nihpuni, yaʼinpuwa naʼnaihturawe kañuatewa peʼke.

Maniahtun paʼawa, tatamahshu, ku nimara yunkimaraun nahpuin kanarinenun, naʼwanan nihpera niʼninen tananke paʼninun, nihkanawe unmantaun, ama tahshi teʼwakesuwe, karin kaʼtanaranke chinuhtakamamaware, inauchin ku kemauraun niʼsaraun.
Ina waʼwasha ku ahsu peʼnate iʼshake paʼsariunwe ku inpita ihpupachinawe, nimara ahke pakakahsu kuahsu aʼnaruamiahchin wentarariunwe.
¿Nani payatarawe niʼtun nimara, ku nihpun ihsu shihpiru uʼnaike niʼtun ichi ikirurinku aʼnarahchin?
¿Iyahsha ka nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu kechiʼi saʼyahte?

Iyahsha, nahtanke mañahtun:kemuinenpu uʼmararin iʼshaparihchi. Waʼwaruʼsa ichi wentunatun shaʼwiteke kahpashin kankanchina. Niʼpachina yaʼi winakapuna. Shiʼshi nihke ihpura, aʼma iʼwatekehsu. Ina naʼwaninpu inaran kehkapun nuya yaʼwetakasu Kanpuwa ninanuke.

Ira paʼnesu peʼikari ahke inaran ikirure. Waʼwaruʼsa aʼma wentunenkeran ni aʼpeʼinasu, mamapaya tenin sehtereʼna. Kehshakeran kusharu nihpisu peʼpeina. Piʼi inahpa nihpachina chinuhchina. Nahpuinahchin uʼmaina kuʼwara tahshirarin.

Nuya tahshi yaʼwechiken, shiaʼwa, ku keterinkuwe teʼwa nisha nisha tananke perahsarinupita, pen yaʼkarike, inahke ninaranke yaʼwitakainsumare irahka nihpisupita, inapuchi nihpachi wirari kuʼwara tashiaʼteraʼsuwe.
Ku inaruʼkuwe, ku nanitarawe yaʼwakausu kawera sehtau naʼwantau.
Tahshitaʼ, aʼna taweri sehteruʼ pahsatarinken.
Nuya nuwanterawe, wiʼnawe: iʼsha pirianke nuya yaʼweran niʼnanken. yaʼwerawe kahpashinkeran niʼninaku peineku niʼtun.

Weku, wiʼnahsharuʼsa, nuyahshakeran nahtanku ihsu nunawehsu. Pantaʼpi paʼanpate, piʼiruʼte neʼpeawa kuʼwara peʼpechahtaraʼsuwe. Ya uʼnanpachin, aʼpetaʼawa nunen aʼma ni taíkamarewe irake. Aʼma pihpikuhsu manuwinan nimantaratun teʼwapinawen,
Taʼnanen peʼpeihtunwe, manuke.
Ku kawerauwe, Yusparinken kema.
¿Unpuruta kankunpuwaʼ panka iʼshaʼpaʼ?
Nahtantake nahkaranchin mamawarin unputa kurihki nahkaranchin maʼpatantarin atarimare, mana kemanta inapuchin paʼankamere ku kuhchahchin naʼkun ku nihpu kuʼchahchin puʼpihshawe.
Weʼka, wiʼnawe, ku irake chinuhtewatewe ku ahkerarewe

Nimara ina kemapi kahpashin kankanchihtunwe wiʼnin nanan aʼparin inshaterantake ninpuni. Nituchihtunwe ina ku nañanteriunwe ina ahke yaʼwerinsu. Ina yunkisawatun nuya kankanchihtunwe, nani taweririnke iʼsha yunsanpirianke yunkirin naʼwaninsu.
Yusparinken iterewa nanpiarewa nihtun, ina kaʼpa kankanterin ninupi
¿Ketapunku kemahken imira iʼshja teʼnaruʼsa pentuntakamareʼ kuʼwara yunupiʼirara?
Naʼwanewa maitakahsu nunshake iʼwapuchin.
Aʼma makewe werun ku nuwituwatawen ninunenamare. Nuwitumaninku setaran nipatera ku natawantakurawe, shaʼarusa nininensa nineninusaʼ.

Kahken wiʼnawe, nahtanke ihsu mamanen peneninkensu. Ka iraterawe yaʼkari ninanukeʼpa nihpuni, kepaihtuwe iʼsha inpi aʼma kañukamarewe. Aʼma tehkein iʼsha uʼuhkesu ku akuraitupatanwe. Peʼpeke kuhtarute iʼwaraya teʼnawantahpiriunwe. Naʼkun ikirupatu, nara nukunanke wenseapun chiniru mantakamare. Manuaʼawa, ahke ira nimantaratun wahpuru iʼsha ninatarin.
¿Tenan ku maʼteranta nahtanawe nuhsurukamare waʼwawe? Ku nuʼtenwe; iminkeran ihkankimapachin, ihpuarawe inaran shaʼwitarawe karuʼku sahkatamare nani taweri
Senateransu paʼanpatan, nuyahshakeran kurihki ni ketuku ina yaʼi sahkateramahsu iminke.

Unpuwa, ahpiaʼwa sanawi. Nani puʼmutumaranke iratamare, nahpumara. Sehterawe kemaura weʼehtaruʼsa peʼperaran niʼtun, kehken nimantarin. ¿Kema yunkiran nunsha tahshiramiachin kankiarin nunshinanke? Nimara uʼnan ichi kehparitantarinpu nahkaranchin. Nimantaratun naʼkun chihturuterin, nuyamare ninatariuwa yunsanke. Weʼka iteke mamapaya kankunpatan, iteke nuya nihsarawe, tuhpinan ikirurawe. Nuyahsha maʼshanen akuke, ushahkeran, iʼsha chiniratun nunsha Unirin.
Keparai naʼkun kehsha inaran pihshate sami, ahke iraterai niʼtun inaran tanankenta ahke kankunkahsu nunshinan yaʼkari.
Nuya ni imuteke sewen nihpachin.
¿Kusharu inaran paʼantapunku nimara?
¿A nuyahtunaʼpi nuya kankanterin Waʼwasha nunentu pahkaturuke a nuyahterin niʼtun?
Irahkapuchin Kanarahran ihpurawantaʼ.
Ku teʼwawirawe kaʼtankaʼwasu.
Nuwanteran karuʼku; ni nihkakasu nani taweri puchin nuya kankantamare. kankiransu a nuya kankanterinku, yaʼpiranuwe shipirin kahpashin kankanterawe niʼtun.
Maʼsu, aʼma tananpitekehsu nahtanteransu nimiriu nunentu peike, unpuinteranta
Iʼsha uʼusarawe kuʼwara paʼshahtaraʼsuwe.
Inawara nuhsha ni kechinaʼ.
Ku kahpashin ya kankanterawe tuhpinan nananmare.
¿Winawi inapita nani ya pakawenachin?
Unpuwa, uhshiya. Tahshiraya tahshiramiachin nunshake paʼsare nananukehpa. Keparare naʼkun pantaʼpi inaran kehsha. Uʼmarare aʼnuarahchin, nani naʼwananke nihpiriunwe.
Paʼpatan aʼma nañantekehsu nuyahsha kankantakahsu kemuireʼken; wiʼnanpita nani tahshi ihpuke, ka ihpuarawe nahsha waʼwatarin puchin.
¿ku naniterewe ichi sehtakasu?
Kemasu ku chinuhteraun kahtawarankuisu.
¿Aʼshatu ku ichi yaʼwereriunwe atarinen sharaya maʼpatamare? Mamapaya shaʼwirin ina kahpashinkeran niʼihtunwe, sharaya puʼpian paʼterinsu naʼkun nihterin. ¿Aʼna sanapi nuya nuwanchihtunwe shaʼtamare?

¡Manuku, waʼwaruʼsa! Peʼpeawa niʼmehteruʼsa inaran pahkaturuʼsa nunshakeʼpa. Aʼna mamaya iʼsha petehte yaʼwerinsu ya wairarin ku ihkantariwawe tawereachin. muhturu puʼmuawa ihpura, aʼma naʼkun nintaʼawasu naʼkun. Teʼwarawe waʼwina waʼwatakahsu kuʼwara kankunyahtaraʼsuwe.
Ku iʼirateʼpa ya panewewe tahshinantahrin niʼtun, ku katarenta ya pihpirau, yunkirau ke rupahteran, nihkanawe ku paterankewe piʼpishateranta.

Kanpatura aʼna ninanuaʼwake, nuyahkeran nuʼun apaʼteterau, ninarau ihsu pei waʼanen perainku, inapisu nuʼkiwisu, uhshahkeran yaʼkuanawe, nuʼtuntarawe tatamashuruʼsa inran ketarau sami pishate, ihsu nunasu ka kankanewe nuyahpiachin.
¿Iyahsha ku yuhkapunwen samiranen puʼpian tuʼnarumare? Mamapaya tenin ina ichi yaʼwerechihtunwe nuyahshakeran, tuʼnaru ku paʼteriunwen niʼtun. ¿nuʼten ni ichi ayaʼereʼihtunawe kahtuyaʼpikeran?
Nimara ku nunsha ihkanteriunwe.
Nani tahshi manu uʼmarawe, ama irake shipiruke tuʼkuitamarewe.
Aʼnanku peʼtenkamare maʼsha ihpura, iyahsha kahwi peʼtenkamare inaran nituhtamare unpuhsuna paʼterinsu. Manuke, nani paʼantunaʼpi kankirarin tahshiramiachin.

Wiʼnashaneweruʼsa nuyanterawehsu, maʼpatuku ihsu mamapaya nananen. Kuʼwara ninanukeʼpa pihpiahtaraʼsunwe, nuya pichiʼawa nununuʼsa inaran nuyahshakeran peʼpetu tunpuaʼawa.Kanpuarachachin nununen peʼten awa, aʼma tananpitaʼawasu aʼnapita nunpichinpuasu peʼtenpike. Inapuwatewa ku inshateranta iwararinpuawe wayuruʼsa iminke manuwahsu. Nuyahshakeran peʼtenuahsu aʼpeirinpuwa senateruachin unkaruahsu.
Nuyakeran nahtaihtenkuwe iratamare kiyareʼken, maʼsu iʼsha pentuntate ayapatui, ninaihteriuwawe tawerikahsu. Inapihkeran, Kahpashin chinuhtupinan, nuʼten ira kenan ihteriuwawe peikeʼpa ayankamare.
Kepake nihtunuʼsa iminke senarehsu. maamaparin nani tahshiramiachin paʼanin piyapiruʼsa nuwantupi nahsha nishihterehsu.
Iʼwaterewa yaʼipinpuwa. ku tewa yaʼweterinkuwe ihpura. naʼwanawe iyawe tananke paʼninsu ku ihpuranta uʼmayahtarinwe. nunihpirawe, ku ya kenanaweʼ.

Nahtanku weʼka itarankesu, iyaruʼsa. Sehterai amiraʼwa naʼnerimiaterin ihpura tahshiramiachin. Tanan waʼyani shuntamara. Nuyahshakeran weʼkama iterai inaran nahtanai yuhse yunkikamare waʼwaruʼsa kañupachin.

Kehparataʼawa yunkiruahsu pihpikamare Kuʼwara piʼi pihpiahtaraʼsuwe. Kahtawini iʼsha pentuntariuwa pantaʼpi peʼpepinan paʼankamare. Ahke ira ninin, nihpiriunwe nuya nuwanrterai ahpirai ahpira aʼyarawatui. Ninaʼawa iʼsha yaʼnatuninpa nanphinanchin ihkankamare, iyahsharuʼsa.
Ikihtupi ku inshateranta mahshuruʼsa ya uwanpiuwe, ku inapuchin kañu tuʼshitekaimare uwanpachinawe chinirunenpita ku awantapiuwe kañu sewenke.
¿Maʼta itariuwata iyahsha nuneninpuahsu iminke? Yusparin iteʼawa. ku ina nihpuni, naʼneʼihteriuwa tananke senatu aayatatewa.
Taweriachin puʼmuchin iʼwatantawachin, waʼanen nimara yunkirin aʼnarahchin pihpikahsu nimantaratun iʼsha wahpuru ku chinpiriunwe iʼsha yunsanke.
Uʼnanaʼse kemaura kehparituatan iʼshake, tatamahshureʼken nuʼihtunwe;ina a nuya kankanchihtwnkunwe inaran ninachihtumawe Iwan naʼwekahsu.
¿Wekapun wahpuru iʼsha uʼnanahpachin Inapuchin?

Ke nahkaranchin iyaʼwa aweantapatan, ka sehtarawe inaran ina naʼneihtunwe naʼkun. Nimara kanpita nuyahshakeran ni niyahtatuma ni nunchihtumawe kuʼwara weʼehshataraʼsuma. ¿Ku ya ihpuranwe? Mañahtun nihke, wiʼnawe, nani iʼwararin. Ka kahpashin kankanchihtuwe nahkaranchin yaʼnupiantarama nihpuni. Ku nuwanterawe mamapaya sehtakesu yunkiatun kanpita ya niawerama niʼtun. Pake, imira keteke kuʼwara ka nanparin tahkuichaʼtarasuwe.

Unpuanta waʼwasha taʼtahrin iyahshari nunsha aʼnanpachina? ¿Ku niʼnanwe ina kemapi kemuinmare sehterin? Paʼpi ni penenin yusparin tehkamare nuyakeran. ¿Kuahsu nahpuniunwe kahtawakahsu inaran inshateranta nuyahsha nunin?
Ka nahpunin kankanterawe wankui paʼsaruaʼpa, naʼkunkuare inuteʼ, mahchinawe iʼsha inaran kusharuʼ, yuhsumare.
Kaʼpa nunsha, ku inkanewawe aʼnateranpa.
Weʼkama, iyaruʼsa. Kuwachi tewaruwawe yaʼipinpua nahpurupuchin. Kahken iya paʼnin ahke nihpunawe ku uʼmayahtarinwe. Naʼwanawe nani kawerahchin tananke paʼpateraʼ.
Nimara samira ketapunku yamuramare.
Naʼnemarewa mamawayanenpuwamare,nahkuwanawe yusparinken iterewa nuwiterewamare,amiʼawa.

¿Yunkirawe imuya shawitakamare nuya peʼtein ya paʼanpachin? Kari iterawe aʼma puʼpian mare samira paʼan ihsunwe, nihpiriunwe inahsu manurarin. ¿Ku shaʼwiterawe tu? Nimara manurarin niʼtun ku nuya nahtaniunwe tahshiramiachin.
Peʼpetu peʼpekariuwa ahke ihkankaware.

ama pahmakesu taweri yunsanke inaran iʼsha pahpuruke ku inake nihniwen. ku naniteranwe ayankasu nunshinanke ku wiʼsharanwe iraʼ. manuke ama waniakesuʼ. ama nanianteruʼ ihwara chiweransu ku inshateranta ninapunkewe ishanake

Tananke iratewatewa, peʼpetu ni ketaʼawa yaʼinpuwa. Kemahsu nimara keparan puchuwiteke iʼsha, waʼwishin. Nimara kahsu peʼperawe saʼyate tarahpa aʼyaitamare inaran weʼehtaruʼsa. Inaran puʼpian wenu tahparewa iratamare. Ku nuyawe nahtanawe paʼma iʼsha pentuntariuwa nimara, nihpiriunwe tiniaʼawa ushahkeran. Inran uʼmamtaʼawa aʼyapinan, ya inauruwa puchin nuya maʼsha pihpipachina

Waʼwasha, taʼake kahtawake samira ahpimahshu kuʼwara piʼi piʼkatarin.Paʼantupike weʼka teneeʼ inaran sami nanpiru aʼnure.Aʼma niwikehsu nuwiteransu, inapihkeran nañantewi paaweretakaihsu. Manuke, samira ni tapirarin.

¿Tenan ina ya kanpiatapun ina kehsha peʼpetunen nininsu ina sami nanpirureʼ? ¿Ina nahsha waʼwaterinsu waʼwina aʼshin nuwantarin aʼnuarahchin ahsu, ku waʼkipunawe naʼkun? ¿Pihpirarin yunihkapun peʼinaʼpi kuʼwara tahshiyahtaraʼsuwe ininenke?

Ira ninanuʼpamare ahke inaran ikirure. Mamapaya tenin waʼwaruʼsa kepawi kusharu aʼna peʼpetuke. Piʼi piʼkatuwachin kehsha kapawena. Panka nara nukunake chinuhchina. tehkein iʼsha uʼuina. Aʼma manuinahsu nanpekaimare.
¿Tenan anuyahtunaʼpi nuya kankanterin kañapi nahkaranchin inaura kuhshatupachina?
Paʼantupisupa ku paʼanewawe kaʼpa ihpurataweri.
Niʼnawe yaʼichachin saminuwe paʼanawe, nihpiriunwe ku nuya nituhterawe unpuhsu pawere keterinauhsu pankamare.
Iminke paʼpatera ku nuyarinkuwe ahke pakakahsu, ira ahke niʼtun nimantaratun aʼnuarahchin kanuhterawe.
Winapi ku natearinwe naʼkun maʼsha paʼanpike, unpuanta niwipiʼsu ku ayapunwe ku aʼna taweriteranta ku kenanpunwe inshateranta paʼantakasu shaʼpun kuʼ sharure
Wiʼnawe, nunshake tahshiramiachin paʼsarawe. Puʼpian peʼpetu kepararwe, inara. Uʼnan iʼwapachin, inahke kehparitarawe ninatahpu.

Ku amirawe ninaterawehsu nahpuru taweri, ku taweri tihkipiriunwe, aʼshin ku wiyu teniunwe, tuhpinan pahkarike nihsarinku. Ku puʼmurawe sahkaimiachin niʼtun. Ninarawe yaʼi nuyahsha pihpikamare, pihpiwachina, naʼneiri mentahterin.
¿Kuʼwara paʼshahtapu, weke shaʼwiate paʼnesu nitekeʼ ihsu mamapaya paʼpi manutepaya?
¿Nimara Mahshuya kahpashin kankanterin senterinsu nuya nahtantatun?
Maʼpatuku weʼka itaramahsu. Yunkipatewa yuhki tahshinanke, teʼwantarewa iʼwapuchin, nihpiriunwe ni yuntunuwa ni kaʼtankamare tawerikaware.
Yuʼme kehken nininsu aʼma pataʼawasu.
Kema ku nanianteranwe nuhsuruteransu kunpuna.
Ku awanteranwe waʼwaruʼsa ku ni uwantepiuwe taweriachin niʼtun, ku inapuchin ni uwantupachinawe ku kañu chinitapiuwe tanake.
¿Yunkiran nuninsu tahshiramiachin? Ihpurasu taʼtahpi peike. ¿Ku ikihteranwen ninanuke paʼninmare? Ihsu tawerimiahchin shaʼwituku, ¿Naʼwanan kahpuchin? Nuya kankanterawe kema ka ruʼku nihsaran niʼtun.

Amiraʼwa, tahshita. Uʼnan wiraitupinan weʼeranke aʼpeinwachinke, naniteran perainkuhsu. Ninachihturuwe peianake, nihsha nihsha nunchihtunkenwe teʼwa pakamare, inaran winaihturiuwe kuʼwara wira taʼchahtaraʼsuwe.
Kaʼtawaku pentuin, kahsu ikirurawe

¿Unpuanta kirihka ku wiremaranwe nunentu peike? Wiremaʼawa aʼnuarahchin nunenainpumare. Ku tahpanuwa nahtantakahsu. Nuyahshakeran paʼpatewa, nunentenaʼpi shaʼwiterinpuwa unpu ni aʼpeikamare Inapuchin ku kañurarewawe ninanuke.

Ahpimahshu nuyahshakeran nunchina iminkeran uʼmapachin. Aʼma inaura tananpitekuhsu ihsu chinihken piʼihke. Iʼsha keteke inaran a nuya kankanteke ira ahkemare. Pake mañahtun, kemuiruʼsa ya niʼninke inaran kahpashin kankantawi kemareʼken nihpachina.
Weʼkama, payahsha, shapun nahkerachachin paʼtun niantamaraʼ, nihpuanawe paʼansarawe, mamawaya yunkirawatu irahka inaruʼkui paʼanteraisu.
Sanawi, kema waʼwan nahsha nahsiterin niʼtun teʼwaran. Nahtan ihke nuya aʼpeike inaran nuyahshakeran nunteke nani tahshi.
Ninanuke yaʼwewisupita yunki akupi ahke iratakahsu inaran ikiruwinan, nihpiriunwe nahpuinahchin iʼsha pentuntapi wahpuru iʼshake ahke ninanu parihchi.
Nimara iyawe nuya nunterawe iʼwaraya kankirinsu.
Aʼchinapi, ¿Aʼma ninakesu uʼmakaisu tananke paʼpisu? ku, ayaterawe nahterawehsu, nahpuatun naʼkaawirawe kahpashinkeran winareʼna?
Weʼkama, waʼwasha. Sehterawe kaimare ahke paʼnin niʼtun.Kahpashin kankanteke, waʼwishin, yunkike nuyahpiachin winarinsu inaran nihsaran ina yunkiransu kankanenke nuyahpiachin nahtanan.
¿Peinenke uʼmapun nani sehkere pirahpachin? Tahshi aʼnuarahchin anuterin tananke. ¿Yunkiaran pinehsu kepararan aʼma ivpakamaruwe? Ira ahke, wiʼnawe. ¿Unpuanta nani iʼwaraya paʼnan peʼikapun?
Tata ku ichi nanpariunwe naʼkun samira paʼtunen, maʼsu ku nuwanteriunwe wiʼninpita tanan nahtankaimare tahshiramiachin.
¿Keteke atari pantaʼpimare?
Ina weʼka tenin manureʼna inaran puʼpian paʼanin.
Nimara tata nuya yunkirin yuntunkasu, shapun tumare paʼpi paʼtun kemuiruʼsa ku kurihki yaʼwetupiuwe.
Yaʼi yunsan iʼsha kepachi nimara.
¿Kema ayanke peinenke iratupinan, piʼi nirapu naranake yaʼkuninsu irake?
¿unpuinta nisaran,nanpiresu,nuyasha nuntuku kemaraichin pateramare tashinanke?

Kepaʼawa mañahtun neʼmehtemahshu, waʼwina nemehtenenpita inaran kuhseraʼwaruʼsa. Yaʼinpuwa nanpeʼawa nunshake aʼma taweri chiniaʼwasu. teʼwarawe uʼnan irake mahpachinpuwa. Manuku, waʼwaruʼsa ihpura iʼwaraya mama iminenpa ihkaʼawa.
Ku nuya nituhterawe Unpuanta Unpuanta ina yunkirawehsu tahparawe. Aʼna iyayamahshu paʼnin aʼkayan kahsu wenseahrawe kehpariterawe niʼtun, taʼtahrawe, ira niʼsahrawe.
Paʼpinsu ku ya aʼnurinwe teʼwarinsu, nihpaunawe ku ya puʼturawe inanke yunkirawe wiʼnin peʼperawesu iminke.
Mahshuya ku piʼpiayan aʼpaterinwe sahkatunen.
Nihke,wiʼnawe, nani senaturuwake iminke tahpake puʼpian kurihke, inapihkeran nuwantare paʼankahsu yuʼnana inaran saʼyatemahshu.

Nimara nahpunin niterawe iyara ka nuhtetenake yaʼwerinsu sami keshipirinkuwe tanaraweʼsu. Ina kankirin winapinan, nihpiriunwe kahsu tuhpinan niʼnawe. Nahpuatun ihpura yunkiahrawe taweri inaputerinkuhsu. Shaʼwichinken, wiʼnashanuwe, ku ahsu nuyawe kuhsharu maʼpatakahsu tuhpinan ku yusparin tene maʼsha maʼpatuwatera, inapuchin nihpatan ku ahsu nuhsururinenpu.

Ka iyaruʼsa niʼnawe tunpunanke kankipihsu nihpuni, kahpashin kankantatui pahshi teʼihtuwe. Ninanke ku teʼwapinanwe shipirama uʼnanke nihpiriunwe. mañahtun perahku nunshinan yaʼkaripatan, inapuchin tananpichihtuwe maʼsha inaran taʼareʼna paʼmaihtuwe unshitamare.
Naniterin wiʼnanpu tahshiraya tahshiramiachin kankikahsu. Ku kahpashin kankantariuwa ku niʼpatewawe nimantaratun a nuya kankantariuwa nimantaratun kañurin yaʼi taweri.

r el calor del fogón. Volveremos a vernos pronto con una sonrisa. Weʼkama waʼwaruʼsa. Kepawatan nimara kiyara yahwahpui peike, ku iyawawen. Puʼpian sehtekariuwa. Nihpiriunwe kahpashin kankantarai pensha wenukaterimare. Ni nikantari nahkaranchin.

¿Kaniaʼpi kemuwinenpita ku weʼpiuwe ahke ninanukeran? Ku, inawahsu chinihken uʼnanpachina ku nanitupiuwe iʼsha pentuntakaihsu. Nunentenaʼpimahshuri iterin ku ihpura kankiapiuwe chinuhtuku, nimara iratakahsu ku nuyawe waʼwaruʼsamare.
Naʼwanai nahpuru irateraisu uhsharan iʼshaparihchi.
¿Maʼta tehkapu tatanuwe ikiruwina uʼmapachi mihtayuterinkeran? ¿Nuyahsha a nuyakankantarewe kankanen kusharu ketawatu inamare ninawesu?
¿Unpuinta tawerianpiteran, paya, nuya weʼeran ku teʼwaranweʼ?
¿Ayatapun ku nahtanpatanpu penen nanan?

Ku maʼshateranta nituhtuwatewawe ahke iminke, kahpashinkeran nahtaihturiuwawe ira yunsake ninainpumare. Inahke chinuhchihteriuwe kahtuyaʼpinpu, nanan shʼwi ihteriuwawe inaran ku sahkaikeranwe ira kenan ihteriuwawe uʼmarehsu ninanuke.
Nunentu peike tuhpinan nunentawi.

Unpuanta waʼwasha ku weʼka iteriunwe iyahsha inari panpe peimare ketepiriunwe? Paʼpin nahtanterin chini nanankeran. ¿Ku teʼwariunwe inaura kehparitamare ku kahtawapinawen tahshiraya? Inahsu kuahsu yusparin nitu teniunwe nimantaratun ku imara nitu maniunwe.
¿Nani piʼihke senaterawehsu aʼnaʼin?
Ihsu uʼnanke ku nuyahsha yuʼme nunshake puʼmukariuwe
- Tatanuwe samira paʼansawatun ahke paʼnin. ¿Uʼmapun? - Inamini, wiʼnawe, aʼma sehtekehsu, kahpashin kankanteke ina uʼmakaware.
Irakeran ikirupinan kankunpatu, taʼnake chinuhtarawe, inaran weʼka itarawe yaʼi pei pitemare shaʼwipihsu.
Sanapi, nahtaike nuya nunteke waʼwasha ahpiraya ahpiraya uhchinanpachinke. Nimara kañaritahpun amirin, inapihkeran naʼkunkeware nuwanterin.

Aʼma manukehsu naʼnepatan, ihshiya, nimara mamawarin ku kañuriunwe. Nimara tanan nunen a nuyahterinpu. Aʼma teʼwakesu, karinke kaʼtainke. Manuke, paʼa iʼsha teʼnai yuniaʼa ninataripuchin ihpura tahshi.
Ninake muhturu, ama iratekesuʼ.
¿Niʼtunaʼpi weʼkama tenin kuʼwara paʼterinsu niʼshataraʼsuwe?
¿yunkiawa niwiteruasu iʼwa?
Nuya nuwanterewa pihpikasu nunshinakeʼpa aʼkayan.
Ku paʼsarewawe ku kusharu ni ketewatewa kanpuwa kapini.
Nuya nuwanterawe kemaruʼku, aʼshatu. Ayanansu a nuya kankanterinku, nimara kehparitapu nuya tahpakamare teʼtetunuke.
¿Yah niʼnawe nuyahsha winarinsu?
¿Ku nituterawe chiwekasu tananke?
Nahtainke, sanapi, aʼma ya waipatan teʼwakesu. Puʼpian ikihpun nimara, inapihkeran waʼwan nirerawatun winararan.
Yunkiaʼawa nimara ahke paʼnuwasu.

Iyaruʼsapitaruʼku yunkirai iʼshana pentuntakahsu maipihsu kahtawatamare. Tahshirayamiachin keraware iraterai waʼna sahkatamare peʼpepinan. Ku inshateranta tananke kehparitamarewe irake ninatarai. Nahpuinahchin yaʼonkui kankunai inaran sahkatu kañariterai kahpashinkeran.
- ¿Unpuwanta naʼkun tatamahsu naʼwanawe? - Aʼna ninanuʼpa paʼnin. - Ninateke, yunkike nuhsururinkensu inara kahpashikeran ninake uʼmararinsu.
Weʼkama, ku nahpuinsahchi naniterawe winaukasuʼ mamawaya, unpuatuntaʼ ahke paʼnan, nani tahshiriamiachin yunkiranke, nihpaunawe ku nunansu nahtauweʼ.
¿Naʼneihtunwe pei awiranke nahtanan iratupihsu nihpuni? ¿Ku nuyawe niʼihtunwe yunkiatun tatamahshunen nitu aʼparin nahpunin teʼwa yaʼwerinsu?
Ninaʼawa tanawankeran muhturu ahkekeran weʼsarinsu

Tahshiraya ku ahkete yuʼnamen ikihtaranwe. Aʼma sehtekesu, mama ketarinke nimiriu nunen pahkaturukeran. Inaran nahkaranchin taʼantari iminke. Manuke inaran chinuhteke mañahtun inapuchin aʼnarahchin nuyahtaran inaran ayantari peʼikamare iʼshakeʼpa.

Ku naniterewa aʼna yuʼmera kehsha yuʼsatuwa uskuru shipin naʼpatakahsu. Ina kemapi nunpiterenpu ina maʼsha maʼpatereke kiyahsu ku nuya nihkapuraiwe kiwirai. Ya shaʼwiterama aʼma manukuhsu, nihpiriunwe ku nahterinawe. Ihpura ku yaʼweterinpu makena pensha iʼchinpikamare nimantaratun ku yaʼweriunwe maʼshateranta kapamare. Aʼna taweri aʼma maʼsha nuwantaʼawahsu ku nuya nihkariurawe.
¿Nimara ninakariuwa wahpuru iʼsha ihseke?

¿Nuya penenawe ahpiaʼwanuwe kuʼwara pantaʼpi paʼantaraʼsuwe nunshanake? Shaʼwiterawe piyapiruʼsa naʼwepihsu aʼma puʼpian mare paʼantamaruwe. ¿Ku saʼwiterawe nuya niʼkamare peʼteninsu? Aʼna peiʼpa paʼnawe taʼareʼna inaran ku nituhterawe unpu paʼaninsuta.
Iyaruʼsa ni awepachinara, ina ninaterin inapihkeran kahpashinkeran nuntantare.
¿Nahpuinanhchin yuntunkari? Inamini yamuramare.

Tahshiraya pentuntare naʼkun iʼshana, inapuchin ikiruapun. kanpuʼtun kankunpate, chinhtari puʼpian. Iʼsha paʼmaterin nimara nanitere ninatakahsu. ku imara ihkankariuwe kuʼwara tahshiahtaraʼsuwe, nihpiriunwe iratari uhsharan aʼma tuʼkuitamarewe.
¿Teʼwaihtunwe kemaura iʼirate pentuntakahsu tahshi ku mamawan nihpuni? Karinken nanparinke kaʼtaihtunkenwe, ¿Ku teʼwa ayachihtunwe, wiʼnawe?

¿Ku yunkiranwe mamapayake piʼi ninapachina? Mamapasuʼ nani taweri nuyawantakasuʼ nunwantupirinwe. Ama sehtekesuʼ yunkiatun. Ku kanta nuwanterawe kemarahchin kehparitakasuʼ. Ninaʼawaʼ yaʼipinpuwa nuyawan taranpachin, waʼwa.
Nimara kawera nuʼwiterawe tuhpinan.
¿Ya aʼnanawe shaʼyahte?
Wiʼnawe, ketuku nuyhsha kankanterehsu nahtankensu.
¿Unpu wayuiʼta pantaʼpi kayantarinsu kuwara ninanuraʼwake kepamaʼsuwe?
¿Pensha wenukaterinsu naʼwa ihtunwe tahshi sewen nihpuni? Shaʼwituku mañahtun, ¿nuya kankanchihtunwe aʼpininsu ihkankiarin nihpuni?
Maʼpatuku nuyahsha nunawehsu, iraruʼsa. Wankui irake kehpariterawe peʼpetunuwe kehkentatu ikiruanterawe niʼtun, inaran paʼsarawe kañaʼpi nunenkawe.

Mañahtun kusharuruʼsa inaran iwe a naʼpeʼawa nunshake. Aʼma tahshi ninaʼawasu, waʼwaruʼsa. Nahsitakahsu kañaritarin unpuru taweriteranta. peʼpeawa wiya neʼmehte inaran iʼsha. Teʼwarawe kankunkamare ina siura peinenkeʼpa taweriachin.

¿Waʼwasha ku naniteriunwe yusparin itakasu iyahsha iyahshanenpita aʼpeiterinsu panka uʼnanpachina? Paʼpin nahtanterin nuyakeran. ¿Teʼwarin mahshuruʼsare nunkamare? Yusparin tehkakasu nuya ahsu inaran Inapuchin ku inshateranta tananke kehparitapunwe.
Waʼwasha, aʼma sehtakesu iyawarin tananke paʼpachin. Yunkike uʼmantarin inaran inapita nahkaranchin winararewa ihsha yaʼkari, niʼsaran.
¿Kema tenan ahke pakatun yinkirinpuwa? Manuke, nuʼten shaʼwituku. Paʼninkeraware, imin inaura nahtanin. ¿Ku naʼwananwe ku inare kushatewatewe? Nuya kankanterawe uʼmararin iʼshaparihchi itupachinkura.
Kahpashin nanankeran mama shaʼwirin peʼinaʼpi samira yuʼsawatun maʼpaterin shiʼshi. kahtuyaʼpi kahpashin kankantupi ni ketuimare inapuchin.
Aʼma tanapitekewe karirusa, tananusa yaweterin nakun kuwirusa. Apayananku ku nuyasha amiwatanawe nushana sapuʼ naninke tahshi.

Nmara tahpapu puʼpiyan kururihki yaʼweterinkusu aʼana waihsirun kankiantawachin,Nuwantantapu paʼankamare piʼshiru inaran shapunketamare ina mama,ihkantapunku nihka,nihkapunawe puʼpiyan puʼpiyan ni wentunapu pawererinawesu,inauchin chasunihpatu perahkapunawe tahshi.
Naʼkun naʼwanainke nanan peʼtawaraiuchin, ku nituhteriawe uʼmautaun niamara, nihpaunawe ni yunkiranke nahkerachachin nikenantaimare ninanuʼnpuake.
Iʼyara, aʼma sehtekwhsu naʼkun. Ihpura tahshi pensha pirianke uruntaʼa inaran kahpashin kankatereʼsu yaʼwereke mentararin uʼnaike iʼsha mentarin puchin.
¿Unpuwanta nani tahshiramiachin iʼsha pentuntuatera iyahsha iminenkeʼpa kankunkamare nuyahsha kankanterawe?

Iyahsha nuntewatera, nuyahsha kankantereʼna nunterawe. Nuya nahtanke: nuyahsha saʼkateke inaran yusparinken iteke insuna aʼchinterinkensu ahke nuʼpake.Aʼma tuhpinankeran kuhshatekehsu inaran taweri yaʼwerahkesu, sahkatuwatan kemuinenpita kahpashin kankantapi kemamare. ka yunkirawe peike weʼnansu nihkapunku inaran sehterawe paʼnan niʼtun. Kahpashinkeran ayanke mana shaʼwituku maʼsuna niʼnansu.
¿Tena ina nuya nahterin yaʼwerinsu pantaʼpi ya paʼantun?
Ku nuyawe yaʼwerarau kawera yuʼyuwe chininkeran.
Pentuanwa aʼna ihshanaʼpa nahkun, iʼhi?
Ka nuyahshakeran weʼka itarawe ninanunenke nunshanuwe nunshian yunsake nihpachin, iʼsha yusparin itarawe nuyahsha keninku niʼtun.

Ku paʼnawe pihkeran aʼkayan nihsapun. Ku maʼshateranta iriniunwe, yaʼi tanawanke iʼshara awipiranke. Naʼi uʼmarin nuya pihpirin niʼpatera. Ka ninaterawe nihpiriunwe, ku shaʼwipurawe teʼwarawehsu, ina kemuinenpita aʼma wiʼnin ayatamaruwe.
Nitu yuntunuwa kurihki nihpuni, yuntun ihteriuwa wiʼnanpu kañuwachin a nunentamare inaran pawerechituruawe ninanuʼpa pakamare.

¿Aʼma wiʼseaʼawasu kuʼwara kusharu kaʼshahtaraʼsuwe? Inahsu kuahsu nuyawe. Kanpuahsu wiʼserarewa aʼma kañukamarewe. Aʼma patekehsu kusharu iʼsuatupinan, shunaruʼsa ichi kañurinpuwa. Inapuchin kemuiruʼsa aʼpeiyaruwa inaran ku sehtaruawe.
Ku ni patariwawe, imaʼwa nateʼn.

Panka iʼshanaʼpa kankunpate, nimara ninatari puʼpian iʼsha paʼmaikamare. Ku niyuhterawe ihpura pentunkari nimara. Paʼpi anpu, yunsanke chinuhtare inaran tahsiraya pantare. Kema ku manuranwen, tananke aʼchinterienpu ninatamare.
Tenan yuʼnanamare pawereteran wayuruʼsake.

pero llegamos juntos, querido papá. Ka tatanuruʼku yunkirai iratakahsu nahsha iminkeʼpa. Kara iʼsha puʼpian pamaterinsu pentunterai. Imira ni matupinan ninaterai aʼma aʼnutamarewe. Tachihtunpuchin ira, nihpiriunwe ku nahpuinahchin kankunuwe, tata nuhsururawehsu.
Ketuku yamura, paweraranken.
Ku inaruʼku ni niwirawe.

Nahtanteke weʼka iterankensu, payahsha. Yaʼi tahshi kankanen rupahtupachin teʼwasawatun, nimara nuya kankanchihtunwe kaʼtananke niʼtun. Ka wenseʼihtuwe kema pirianke, nimara puʼpian winaihteriuwe teʼwa aʼpakamare.
Ku nañanchihtuwe ayankahsu iraparihchi.

Uhshipaya paninan nininsu shaʼwirin paʼsarinsu aʼshatu nihkapun aʼnateran iʼshakeʼpa. Nimara tahshiramiachin iratapun iraparihchin. Nimara waʼwina peʼpeein aʼna neʼmehteke inran keparin puʼpian wenu. Ku nuya nituhterawe uʼmapun nimara ihpura ku nihpun tahshiraya. Ina tenin ira kahpashin naʼkun inanshira nunkarurin niʼtun. Chinihken uʼnanin nihpuni weʼihtuwe. Tenin uʼmawachina iʼwaraya aʼyareʼna uʼmarin.

Wiʼnawe, ku nuʼwiterawe iteranku kema nihpuni, ka kahpashinkeran weʼihtuwe ihpura tahshi. Nimara kahtuyaʼpinpu tewere piruhtamare ni aweate. Nuyahsha ni nuntaʼa, tahshiraya aʼkayan paʼsare minkawatari niʼtun. Ka kahpashin kankanchihtuwe kema ihpuranku nihpuni ihpura. Ku nuwanterawe kankanen sehtakasu inaran aʼma waʼnakwhsu sehteru. Manuke weʼehkaman, nani tahshirarin inaran nanparin nani tahkuirarin nimantarin.
Weʼkama, iyahsha. Kema weʼmaranken paʼantapun, nihpiriunwe tihkinanpuchin ni kanpiare kayapin samira nanpirure iʼshakeran.
Ama tuhpinan pantaʼpi yuʼkehsu, nahtanteke unpuhsu paʼterinsu inaran puʼpian tahpake yamura paʼankamare inaran puʼpian shapun paʼantupike.
Ina ku shaʼwiate paʼnesu shaʼwirinwe.
manukeʼ niwentunke saʼyate tarapa ku unayantarasu aʼma kemarachin keparitamasu peike

nimara kanpitahsu nahteteʼitumu kaʼ nahtanusu ayaʼimarusu tashirupu. irininsu muhturuʼ iʼsha pahpuruke a yunkiʼitunku tatanewe, ina anataweri ninarinku yunsanke. ku nituhterewe kemanta inuchin ni nahtanan anataweri kankanenkeran.

¡Nuhsurerawehsu ninanu, nahtanku sehturu nanankeran nunsarawehsu! Paʼanku wayuruʼsa inaran sami ku tahpanapunawe. Chinituku pawereʼinema nuya paʼterinsu. Kari kaʼtanankema ku inshateranta nuʼwiarimawe, waʼyanuwekeran sehtarawe kumuinupita nyuhsha yaʼwekamare.
Uhshiya, nuyahsha nunteku ku iʼwara paʼnawemare.

Uʼmaran kuʼwara yaʼi tahshiyahtaraʼsuwe? Mamaparin nuyahshakeran ninararinke. ¿Ku sewananwe ihpura tahshi muhtuwi nuwaratuatan ¿nuya ni suʼketapun, ¿Nuʼten? Ira uʼmakasu ahke nimantaratun tuʼkuiru. Paʼsaran nani kuhshatun peʼperansu tihkiwatan?
¿Inahsu unpurinta kankukamare nuyapiachin kara ihshana pamatuwinan yaʼi taweri waʼwaruʼsare?
Ina ku shaʼwiriun nihpuni kuʼwara iʼsha pentunchahtaʼsu, paʼpina ku nuyahsha kankanchihtunawe, ninaraʼihtunawe ayaimarinsu nuya ku maʼshateranta unpunawe.
Ahke iʼshari nuyhsha kepaʼin.
Ku nunshawawen ku ayananawe.

¿Kema paʼantapunku niwike ina nuʼmuhken puʼpian paʼterinsuteranta? Sehterawe ku mahshateranta waʼwaruʼsa kapakahsu yaʼwetepiuwe tahshiraya tahshiramiachin. Ketuatanku ihpura, karinken pawerearanke aʼchin peike kurihke ketuachinawe. ¿Kiwikawenku ihpura nahkarachachin? Nituhteran kahsu nuʼ ten nunawe, ihpurasu ku maʼshateranta kurihki yaʼweterinkuwe tahparawehsu peike.

¿Ihwahchachin keraware Kahtawarawe tu aʼshatu atarike? Kari shaʼwiterawe aʼma puʼpiyan mare paʼankehsu, ina peʼtawaterin sahkaikeran niʼtun. ¿Ku penenawe aʼna paʼantunaʼpi ninakamare? Aʼnuaramiahchin paʼnawe sanawi a waikapu nahpuatun ku tihkiaware nunterawe.

Wiʼnasharuʼsa, ¿wayuruʼsa yuʼsatewa tanan nuhsha maʼpataʼawa? Inantunaʼpi naʼkun kehpachin, paʼantaʼawa pantaʼpi inaran wayuruʼsa. Aʼma ni nuʼwikuhsu ni ketamare. aʼnaya aʼnaya nahpuinahchin ketaʼawa. inapuchin ku inshateranta tanarariunwe inaran kemuiruʼsa nuyahsha wentunen yaʼweapi.
Peʼpapuna nimara iwe uʼmawachin
Aʼchinapi, ¿Aʼma ninakesu uʼmakaisu tananke paʼpisu? ku, ayaterawe nahterawehsu, nahpuatun naʼkaawirawe kahpashinkeran winareʼna?
Naʼkun iʼsha pentuntapun kuʼwara kamutechin nihsharaʼsuwe.
Weʼkama, Ahpurimahshu. Kema samira nanpiru kenan kanpiatamare uskuruke, ku nuya yunkipirawe.

¿A waitenaʼpi sanawi shaʼwirin pantaʼpi kayanterinsu yuʼsawatun yamura puʼpian ya maʼpaterin? ¿Ina sanawi aʼnuarahchin nuwantarin ayamakamare ina sanawi waʼwa ikihterin su yaʼwerinpa? ¿Yaʼwarin taweri yaʼimare kuʼwara tahshahtaraʼsuwe?
Ina suʼin naʼwanpachin, nuʼwiterinsu nañanterin inaran nuyahsha nunterin.
¿Unpuanta sehteran? Kaiwarinta sahkaterin peʼirawatun, nahpuatun inanta maʼpaterin pantaʼpi nunshinankeʼpa kanpaiterehsu.
Nimara ninanukeran uʼmawatewa nanitere iyaruʼsa shaʼwitakasu paʼanterehsu.
Kepararai kirihkateʼ ku paʼterinsuʼ.
Manurarawe, aʼpiaʼwa waʼwaterin iterinawe nihpuni yaʼi taweri winaihtuwe, yunkiahrawe niʼkunkamare ihsu tawerike.

¿Yunkiran iʼwa tahshiramiachin maipike ni aʼwere? Kahsu nahpunin kankanterawe piyapiruʼsa wankana shura tenawe niʼtun. ¿Unpuanta nihka inapuchin nuʼwitu mahpachinpura ku ahsu taʼteruwe, amiraʼwa? Inapihkeran yaʼinkui kushaterai inaran nanan nuyahterai nuyahsha ni nuntamare. Ka naʼwanawe inaruʼku winaraihsu sahkatunanke. ¿Ku nahkaranchin taweri nuyahsha iʼwantariunwe? Tewaterawe nuʼwitakahsu, piyapiruʼsa ichi kañuterepuchin nitere niʼtun.
¿ku yunitun nihka kahpa akankantamare wiʼnan kañurin tananke nihpunin? ku kahsu chinuhchituwe wiʼnawe nuya nihkakaware naʼkeranchachin.
Ninanuʼpa paʼpatera, kemahken tatamahshu maiterin yaʼi tahshiramiachin. Kehken naʼkunkeware tahshi aʼyuterehsu inaran nunshanake tahpake.
Nuyahshakeran ninateke, aʼma teʼwakehsu.
Ina nuyahshakeran weʼka tenin inaran shaʼwirin piyapiruʼsa yaʼwerinsu nuhtetenanke ya paʼantupi, inapihkeran nuhsha chinpiterinsu yuʼsawatun maʼpaterin kashinuʼsa.
Ku tananke chiwerewe.
Naʼneapu yunkiwatu nimara.
Ku naniantarawe nunansu, naʼweperinkuta naʼkun piʼi ahke kahruʼku.
¿Kenan naʼkun kurihki? Inamini, samiraneʼtun paʼanarawe. Inapihkeran uskuru paʼanarawe, yamura inara puʼpian kehsha paʼantupike.
Iratupi ahke piʼpiyan piʼyan kankuntakaiwaare.
Weʼkama iyaruʼ,¿kemanta paʼna iʼhshanake? kanuhteran niʼnaen,¿piʼpihshaterante chinuhteke kuʼwara irataʼsuwe?

Ahpiaʼwa kankipachin ahkekeran, pei nanankeran mentahtupi. Aʼma tananpitekuhsu wensaʼinsu kuʼwianake. Nuyahshakera aʼkaʼina inaran nuyahsha nunchiʼina. Mañahtun, yaʼichichin ya niʼpi nuyahsha nahkaranchin.
Peʼinaʼpiruʼsa nuwantupi wahpuru iʼsha pama pentuntakahsu, iratakahsu ikirure nihpiriunwe, kankunapi kahpashin kankankeran ahke nininpa.
¿Yaʼi paʼanan nuwanteransu? Yaʼi puchin. Pawanin uskuru inaran kanchura, yaʼweraweke tahshinantahrin niʼtun.
¿Pei yaʼkari puʼu perarin nihpuni paʼyan ihtunwe? Shaʼwituku, ¿Ku yunki ihtunwe aʼchinterankensu ku rupahtamarewe tahshi?

Nima tatamahshu yunkirin amiraʼwanenpita iʼsha yunsan taʼatupihsu.Ina ayamapun pantaʼpi suʼsupachin shaʼninsu. Nimara ina yunkirinsuri kahpashin a kankanchihtunwe, ahkuwehsu sehtererinsu naʼkunpuchin ninin kahpanante peike pirianke.
Ku nañantarawe nuyahsha winaransu.
¿Ka nuwanchihtuwe kahtawatamare sahkatu ninanuke, inapuchin yaʼi tataruʼsa shaʼwitupi nihpuni?
¿Unpuwanta uʼnanpachina paʼpi kankanterawe wensekahsu inaran waʼwaruʼsa ichi waʼwaterawehsu ina irateraweke?
Sami nanpiru tahsi manansu manuke nunshinanpa kepamaʼa, inaputuwate piyapiruʼsa aʼnarahchin paʼantarinenpu kuʼwara kamutechin nihshataraʼsuwe.
Nimara ihpura pantaʼpinen ya paʼanteranku.
¿Kemanta nahtanan ira ahketerehsu uʼnanpachina inaran aʼnasu nani ikirurin inaura iratahpatun?
Ku tahparawe irahkai naʼnei ninanunuke.
Aʼchinapi, ¿Unpuruta uʼmararin kaihshanuwe ahke paʼninsu? Ninateke,waʼwishin, ina uʼmararin, inaran yunkiransu iminke yaʼnupiransu nuyahsha tahpake.
anataweri unanpachinchinihken, yunkiaran ninanunen,winaransu ayanan anarachin, ama nanekesu
Kiyahshu nani nahpunin nahtanpatera nunentu pei niʼnai. Inahke aʼchinterinenpu ni aʼpeikamare tewe kañuhkeran inapuchin yaʼi piʼi nuya yaʼwere.
Peʼtenkeʼ aʼna winta kuʼwara niaʼweretara.
Nunentunaʼpi ku niwike werun ya yuʼninwe.
Tahshita,amiraʼwa nuwanterawehsu. Kema nahtewatan tahshinanke niʼnansu, shaʼwichihtunkuwe. Ku teʼwaranmare winaihtuwe, tuhpinan waniwaʼihtukenwe teʼwa naʼwehtainkemare.
¿Unpu uʼwanata maʼpachihtuiwe kara wiʼnawekeran paʼnai uwantapike nihpuni?

Kema yunkiran tatanuwe kahtawarawehsu kañurahpun. Kari aʼpanirawe nuʼten, paʼanterawe samiranen yaʼi taweri. Ninawe kanpianamen aʼna tanan paʼteruʼku: ina kenin tanan nuhsha yaʼwere kari keterawe sami yamurake seʼmupinan tatanunke.
¡A kahpa kankantaʼawa! Ihpura yaʼi pantaʼpi paʼane nihpuni, paʼan ihteriuwawe yamura inaran tuma kahpashinkeran kemuiruʼsamare.
Tatanuwe, nahtan inke ayankamare ninanuke nahpuinahchin, paʼanehsu kehken inaran nunsha waʼanen pawerare.
Ayamaʼin yunsankeʼpa.

Peʼpeawa neʼmehte paʼmupinan inaran panka iʼsha inpi puʼmupihsu. Aʼma nunenuʼsa pataʼawahsu peike, waʼwaruʼsa. Pihtaʼawa nunsha iʼshake inaran muhturu a tenentaʼawa. Yunkirawe ina siura kankan yunkiahrin napuatun kankuaʼawa kuʼwara iʼwayahtaraʼsuwe.
Aʼshin aʼchinin nuʼwitere pihkeran nuyahsha nuntantare.
Aʼma paʼmawaru nunshinanpa kanpurachin, iʼra ahke ku nihtikinanwanwe panin.
Peʼpapun nimara sami nani tahshiramiachin.
Ku ni yaʼweretakahsu yamura kishamare.
¿Ina yunkirin iyahshanen payarinsu nani tahshiramiachin?
Paʼantupike paʼanpi ihpura yamura.

Nahpuru ku nuyawe kankanterawe ninatahpu. Mamanuwe ku manuriunwe nahpuatun tanawanterinsu naʼkun a yunkirinku. Ku imiranen aʼperawe puʼpian teranta. Ihpurawe inaran iterawe aʼma taʼtehsu. Yaʼi kankanenkeran yunkirawe nuyahsha ina waʼwina waʼwatakahsu.
Nahtainken te,waransu nuyahsha ni nunteke,Sanapi. Nimara kañariterinke kema waʼkiapun, inaran nituhtapun nuwantakahsu ihsu waʼwasha ya waʼwatarinsu.
Nuyahshakeran samira peʼpekari, nuwanterawesu, kehken nininsu. Ninanukeʼpa ya keparewa nunshake nani piʼi yaʼnunawachina.
- ¿Kahtawainken iʼwe peʼpekamare? - Inapuke nihpai, peʼpetuparin kehken nihpiriunwe inaran ikiruran niʼnanken naʼtun irateran niʼtun.
Sanapiraʼwa waʼwasha ku maʼpatupunwe puʼpian yuʼinkeran, tatain ku nuwanteriunwe ina sehtakasu.
¿Inapihkeran naʼnekawen kahpashin kankanterankeran?
Paʼanchihtunwe puʼpian paweretamare.
Weʼkama, aʼma kaʼkehsu ina wayu ni tapirinsu, Inapuchin ku kañuraranwe.
Ku tananpiteramawe iwe kawera peʼpekasuwe.
Taʼnake chinuhtariuwa tahshiwachin.
Weʼkama, ahpuri. Kema nimara nuwantapun kanpiatakahsu samira nanpiru aʼna pahkanana uskuru, nihpiriunwe ku yunkirawe nunehsu.
, ninaku iʼshana yunsaʼpa yaʼkunke nuanaʼpa kemaura.
¿Unpu pentuʼinta kawerahchin ihsu iʼshanaruʼsa kuʼwara kankuanawe kemahken peike?

¿Nuwanteran ka pawerechi uskurumare inaran shapun aʼna semanakeʼpa? iratarawe yunkireʼna ku yuntunawe maʼsha nuwanterawehsu paʼankamare. niwike tetuwatanku, kari tu tewetarankunwe, kemaruʼku ninawepuchin.¿Ninapunku ninantaikuhsu taweri? nituhtera yaʼweraike kiyahsu naʼkunkui nimara aʼna taweri kanarawehsu aʼchinaʼpimare ku ihkanterinkuiwe.
Ku inshateranta pantaʼpi niwirawe.
Ku naʼkun peʼpetun peʼpekasu iʼsha ku wara naʼwehchataraʼsuwe inaran ahke tananke.
Kahpashin kankanchihturiuwa puʼpian kurihki yuntunuwa nihpuni, inapuwatewa nunentenaʼpi pawerarewa, napuru chahsu ku aʼnantariuwa.

¿Ku yusparin itapunwe iyahsha tata iminke kahtawarinsu? Waʼwasha ku teʼwariunwe nunkamare. ¿Nuya tenan Iyahsha inaura sahkatakahsu yaʼi taweri iminke? Tatanen tenin yusparin tehkakasu kuahsu paʼteriunwe.

Wiʼnawe, ku keparankunwe iʼshakepa niʼtun nuʼwiranku, la sehteransu niʼnawe. Kanta nuʼwichihtuwe paterinawe nihpuni. Nihpiriunwe nuyahsha nuaʼan inaran nuyahtaʼa mañahtun, nani ya tahshirarin. Ka kahpashin kankanchihtuwe kema imira keteranku nihpuni. ¿Ya ninan ihpura? Manuke, mamanen ninararinpu kusharu nihsawatun ku nuwanterawe ina sehtekasu kanpumare.
Ku ka ichi yaʼwerehchihtuwe samiranuwe yamurake puʼpian paʼterin nihpuni, kemuiruʼsa nuyantupi kushatakaisu nimantaratun ku puʼpianteranta ihkanterinkuwe.
Naʼwanan uhshiya ahke paʼninsu. Nihkari nitihkinan piʼikeʼpa iʼsha winkintupachin. Aʼma sehtekehsu, nimara inanta nishihtarinpuwa. Ninatariuchin yaʼnupiaʼawa aʼma sehtakamatrewe.

Kema Nahtaunku nimara unpatutaʼ muhturu tahkuiwachina tahshiruʼpurawachina chinpiraweʼ, ku nituhchitunwe kemahsu peʼi tahshinan ninan nahpuriniʼ, ku yunkintuwe iʼwaraya yaʼihpinpua ninaruwasu nuya kankankeran.

Wiʼnawe, ke naʼnewatan ku kashin paʼanterankunwe niʼtun, ke sehteʼihtuwe. Ku nimara nituhteranwen ku ihpura yaʼweterinku niʼtun. Nihpiriunwe nuyahsha nunteku, inaran karinken ketatanken ninanuʼpa paʼmawate. Manuke, uhshiwarin ninarahrinken awipiranke. Ka kahpashin kankanchihtuwe kema nahkaranchin tewaranku nihpuni. Ku nuwanterawe kema sehtakesu nimantaratun nuʼwitekesu yaʼi taweri karuʼku. Apiniku inaran paʼa peiʼpa.

Nimara piyapi ka nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu nirahrinku kari yusparinken itakahsu sharaya tuhpinan keterinku niʼtun. kahsu shaʼnawe iminuke suʼsurin nuyahpiachin, nihpiriunwe nañanterawe yusparin itakahsu. Nahpuatun nahpunin kankanterawe nani kenanpatera. Shaʼwichinken,amiraʼwa, nuhsurutereʼsu niwikepuchin inanta kehkenin anta, nihpiriunwe ku ahsu niʼnuwe.
Nimara anuyahtunaʼpi inaura nahtanin, nuya nanani a kahpashin kankantewiriunwe?
¿Unpuwanta naʼkun naʼwanawe wiʼnawe?
Shiʼshimare kurihki keterinensu nuya pichike, iʼwara tewetatun puʼpisha kurihke kemaran peike.
¿Kenanapun ina ira nihka imahkapun?

Nituhteran irahka puʼpian asuhkaru puʼpian paʼterin? Ihpura paʼne paʼankari nihpuni, ¿nahpuinahchin pawerechihteriuwe ku nihpun naʼkumiachin mahpaihtenenpuwe? Kari paʼantenaʼpipaya nuyahshakeran nahtanku ihtuwe. ¿Ke paʼanchihtunkuwe, waʼwishin mamanuwe irahka nininpuchin?

¿Mamapaya ku a ichi yaʼwereriunwe samiranen pantaʼpike aʼna sanawiri nahtanin nihpuni? Ina nuya nuwanchihtunwe, pantaʼpi puʼpian paʼterin niʼtun inaran sami nanpiru naʼkun paʼterin. Inapuchin kahtu kemuiruʼsa nuya kushachihtunawe kahpashinkeran ihpura iʼwaraya, ¿Ku waʼwaruʼsa nahteranwen?
Iʼwatereʼ, sehteruʼ maninken ihpura.
Pantaʼpi inaran samira kurihki yuntunuwa nihpuni, tahpaihturuawe kusharu pawanin taweri kapakamare.
Ku waʼwasha aʼnarahchi ayamamariunwe nihpuni, nimara ahke ira niʼtiun; Nahpuatun pakamare shaʼwichihtunwe tatamahshuruʼsa ninanuke yaʼpihsu.
¿Paʼantunaʼpi nuyahshakeran weʼka tenin ninanuke samira paʼankamare?
Ku puʼpian niniunwe ina nanan, nuwanterawehsu; ku yunkiraawe niʼnankensu kahpashin kankanteransu ina peʼtawa waʼwatapun.
¿Inasuʼ unan ninarin nawekasu iʼshana ya pamaterin niʼtun?
Nunentunaʼpi weʼka tenin inaran yunkirin paʼterinsu.
Uʼnanin niʼtun sehtuwatan, saʼwipun shaʼwinan inaran kahpashin kankantantararan.

Nituhteran kema unpu yusparin itereta yaʼweran nuhtetenanke iyahsha yaʼwerinsu kahtawarinkensu yunihkamare waʼwasha tananke ayarinsu? Yusparin iteran sehturu nanankeran ninanu nuhtetenanke. ¿Aʼnuterin nanpiru nuhsha ikiruwinan wentapachina? Nahpuru tahshi yunkiransu kankanke kehpariterin. ¿Winanpita aʼchinteke nuyahsha nihkakamare? Aʼchinapi nahtanterin ihsu nituhtamare, nuyahsha ni kahtawakamare aʼma pawantainpumare wentunen yaʼweruake.
Tahshiramiachin pihpipate, peʼpetu nuya akuakariuwa yunsanke kuʼwara piʼi pihpiahtaraʼsuwe. Nuyarin iyaʼwaʼsaruʼku iratakahsu ihsu paʼnaike.
¿Ka nanitawe nimara ninu tananke yaʼwerinsu yuʼsawatu maʼpatamer aʼna pahkaturu ku suʼsurinsu pei yaʼkari, ku nunpintarinawe keʼninsu?
Kankirawe kusharu huniwatereʼna wiʼnawe mare
Weʼkama. Ku ihpura nuyahsha kankanterawe, iyaruʼ. Naʼwanawe penutun aʼchinaʼpi chimininsuʼ. Kuwachi aʼchintapunkuʼ, inaran kuwachi nahtanawe tewarinsuʼ penshake wensepachina.
Peʼtenkeʼ ina nuhsha tehparansuʼ.
- ¿Keparin maʼshateranta niʼnan? - Aʼna yuʼme keʼken nimara, ku nuya nituhterawe; naʼwerin aʼnarahchin nimantaratun ku ihkanterawe niʼnawesu.
Aʼpatawa piʼishamiachi ihsu paʼterinsu.
kemarachin unanke ni natapatan, pipiaran samitamare kareku, pahawe.
Ninatakahsu uhsharan inaran nuya nanan ninaʼawa. Iʼyawarin niʼpatan nuya uʼmarinsu peʼirinkeran kahpashin kankantantaran
Nimara ichi yaʼwerekari samira yamurareʼ.
Inamini, uʼmarin nuya kemareʼna.

Ka shahterawesu sharaya iʼnateran, ka puʼpian nuʼwichihtuwe. Inaran yunkirawe puʼpian chewerawe inaran nuya nunchihtenkunwen. ¿Ku ya kahtawarankuwe nahkaranchin aʼna nahshakeran shantamare Tahshiraya? Paʼa mañahtun waʼnaruʼsa tahpaʼawa nani uʼnan anuterarin niʼtun. Ka kahpashin kankanchihtuwe kema nuyahshakeran iminke irateran nihpuni. Ku nuwanterawe mamanen sehtakasu kema sharuʼsa shaʼninsu iʼnateran niʼtun. Pake wiʼnawe kuʼwara yaʼi shipirarin.
Uʼmain iratawatun iʼshaparihchin aʼpininsu yaweaʼse; nani tahshirinke, ira wewepiru taranin inaran sahkaimiachin.
Ku ihpura niwiterawehsu paweretarawe.
Aʼnaruahchin aʼna taweri uʼmarawe kuʼwara uʼnan anutupachin, ku nuwanteraweʼ shipin maitakasuʼ.
Paʼanan atarinenpita inaran nuwanteke puhpisha mahpateransu, kiya wawawichin ninepuchin, iratere nuya kankantuwinan
Ku uʼmaruwawe ahke nuʼpanenpuaʼpa, nuhsureraʼma.

Weʼkama kemuiruʼsa. Kiyahsu sehtarai, uʼnan ku meʼtariunwe, waʼwaruʼsa waʼkiwi ira pentuntaimare. Tahshikawen nimara. Nuyakeran weʼka iterawe inaran kiwurawe nahkaranchin kahpashin kankantantararai yaʼkuanin niʼpatui.
¿Tenan ku nuyahsha nunteranwen teweterinkensu sahkatunanke? Ku tahparawe nuʼwiterawehsu; ninarawe nuyahtakahsu, nihpiriunwe uhsraran tewarare.

Ku nuwanterawe kema pakakahsu iyahsha. Ku nuyarinkuwe pakakahsu, teʼwarawe kawera ninanuke kehparitakahsu. Ku yaʼweranwe iʼshake yaʼnuipatera nimantaratun iminke paʼpatera. Chinihken ihpuku, aʼma nañantekuhsu.

Kema nanan saʼwiteranku niʼtun kahpashinkeran kehsha shaʼsarawe ihpura? Manuke, wiraitarin tawerianpiterin tanan niʼtun.Aʼma nañantekehsu mamaparin a suʼsurinkensu, ahkekeran naʼwanan naʼkun niʼtun. Ka nunenan tihkirawatu patarawe kuʼwara uʼnan anuchahtaraʼsuwe. ¿Weʼsaran kahtawapunku ihpura u paʼsaran kemui shaʼwitapun?
Iʼsha yaʼi taweri anutuachina, naniteran paʼtakasu pensha pirianke; nuyahsha a kankanchihtuwe yunkiatun tahshiraya paʼsaran tananke mihtayutapun.
Yunkirewa iratakahsu ninanukeʼpa nunshake.
Aʼnawita tanan irake pihtawachinkura, aʼnuarahchin nuyahsha nuntarawe nahkaranchin nahshakeran winantamare.
Tahpaʼawa yamura paʼankamare.

Aʼma naʼnekeru naʼkun, wiʼnawe.tahshiraya paʼsarawe kemauruʼku iʼshakepa inaran shaʼyate uhtaʼan. niʼsaran samira nirinsu inaran sehteransu puʼpian puʼpian paʼtarinke. Ninateke maʼsu uʼnanpihkeran piʼi aʼpiantarin. Naʼnei uhkuike inara kaʼtanku, karinke aʼchintaranke uhsharan maitan nuʼserateke.

Ina kahpashin kankantarin ahpiaʼwain ayanpachin ninanuʼpa yaʼwekamare. Kahtuyaʼpi nunsha mukaru paʼpichihtunawe, irahka nihpipuchin. Nimara ina yunkiri kaʼtan ihtunwe kañaʼpi ninaraʼsuwe, iʼshake nuhterahrin ahpiaʼwain naʼwaninsu.
¿Ka sehtaihtuwe nu niʼnawe nihpuni?
Manuke kahtawake iyahsha paʼanterinke. Pantaʼpi inaran wayuruʼsa peʼtenke, ina aʼnarahchin pʼanin naʼkun piyapiruʼsa yaʼwepachina.
Wiʼnawe, kusharu imuteke aʼma kankan kañu mahkakaimpumarewe. Inapuchin shunari ku seʼwariunwe inaran ku inshateranta kañuriunwe peike.
¿Sami nanpiru paʼankariuwa? Inamini, tahpakariuwa.
Nimara iʼsha pamatawen ihpura. Nani tahshiramiachin pihpire, waʼkipate ku ihkanteriuwa nimara uʼmakamare kuʼwara tahshiahtaraʼsuwe.
Ku sehturewawe nahpuru iʼwaraya; yunkirawe nahpuru nuya paʼanterehsu kankan yaʼsuterinpu kahtuyaʼpinpu, uhshira.
Imin ira paʼpi ahke inaran ikirure. Mamapaya shaʼwiren aminpita ku tanareʼna pakamarewe. Nuya kushachina kuʼwara pahshahtaraʼsuwe. Wankui irake chinuhchina. Ayaʼina peʼpeatuna kepapihsu nuyahsha.
¿Ku uhmarinwe ina chiwewachin?
Nani mahshuterawe ku naniterawe maitakahsu.

Ka nunshinanke paʼantewatu inaran niʼkapu iyawe kankirinsu, kahpashin kankantakasu mentahchihtunkuwe. Nuyahshakeran ahpimahshu ninaihtuwe tanankeran uʼmararin niʼtun, aʼma teʼwatekehsu iʼwatuawanta. Kari nahkapiapu ihpukamare inaran kusharu puʼpian akuchihtuwe.
Ku iʼshake nuwarayahtarasuwa, chinuhtariwapuchin paʼawa maʼshateranta kaʼmiataʼawa, iratakahsu ahke niʼtun nimantarantun ikirurarewa naʼkun.
Niʼke, wiʼnawe iʼsha mentairinsu tiʼyataʼa aʼma chinihken yunkeran sapukamarewe. Yaʼichachin nuʼpa tahpararai ninanuke sahkatu yaʼwepachin.
¿Ku kah puchin nuya kankanteranwen nunshinankeʼpa ihkanpatera inaran yaʼi waʼwaruʼsa ninatapi nuyahshakeran?
Ahpiaʼwa, kahtawake tatamahshu iwe paʼankapun paʼninsu wankuru. Wentunen nuya tunpuke inaran paʼtunen shaʼwike ku teʼwapinanwe.
Weʼkama, wiʼnawi. Yuhsemare, niʼnawe muhturu nunshare kuʼwara ninanuʼpa paʼshahtaraʼsuwe, nimara iratakahsu ahke inaran iʼsha winkin.
Yunkiaʼwa mamanpayanenpua, niketawa kapuwa kiʼshanenpua inaran yamurare maʼsharuʼsa paʼanpiʼpa.
Shaʼwiteku, ama naʼnekesu kemaurahchin ihseke.

Inapake nahtaninkuwe nuyahsha nunawesu, iyaruʼsa. Samiruʼsa kepake paʼantupiʼpa ku nuwantupiu puʼpian kurihki sankai sahkatupi niʼtun. Nuʼten nininsu nahtantuku. Kari aʼpeirarawe yaʼi kumuiruʼsa, waʼyanuwe sehterin niʼnawe ku nuya pawerewachinpura.
¿Yusparin iterawe ina kahtawarinkumare?
Wiʼnawe, shaʼwituku uʼmararansu.
¿Ya nañantewiruawe iyahsha nininsu? Ku, kahpashin kankantakahsu ketaʼawa. ku weʼniunwe kahtawatapun, ku nanituruawe iʼwe peʼpekahsu.
Ka mare ina iʼsha yunsa nuyahsha nukuraʼihtunwe, nimara ina iʼsha wahpuru tahshi ayanin, nahpuatun ku kepatupiuwe mahsha keparinsu paʼankamare.
Ahpurimahshu, Ku iʼwa aʼnanankuwe tuma ku maʼsha paʼankunawe? Nuyakeran nahtan inke inuantake nahkaranchin, sehterawehsu ku naʼwehterinkuwe.
Ina kehpariterin pensha pirianke uʼnananin niʼtun. Sehtu kankanen inaran ikiru imiranenkeran amirin naʼneinen
Aʼchinapi, ¿Nahkaranchin iyahsha niantapu iʼshakeran?Nuya mini, waʼwasha. Nuyahshakeran wʼka iteke ayankamare inaran winarama nara nukunanke.
Uʼnan tananke ichi sehtewachinken, aʼyaihtunwe nuyahsha;Inapuchin nuyahsha kankanchihtuwe inaran ninaihtunwe piʼi winareʼna.
¡Ama paʼankesuwe ina uskuruʼ paʼpi paʼtunʼ
Wiʼnanpuwa nuntawatewa inaran kepaʼawa naʼkun maʼsha, peʼikari ahke paʼpatera iratupinan uʼmare ikiruwinan.
Aʼchinapi, ¿Aʼma yunkikehsu wiʼnapiruʼsa uʼmarawihsu ninanukeran? Ku yunkirawe; nuyahshakeran ninarawe inaran nahkawirawe kahpashinkeran winareʼna.
Ku paʼananwe piʼpihshamare iya.
¿Ku tahpananwe paʼantakahsu ku niwiteransu paweretunawe?

Waʼwashari aʼna piyapi iratenaʼpi chiwesawatun paʼsarinsu uʼnaike kenanin nihpuni, perahsawatun inaran aʼmupichihtunwe. Aʼshin yaʼwerinpa kepaihtunwe inaran penke a yanichihtunwe neʼmehtenen. Ichihtunwe kehpariteke ira nuyahpiachin nihkaware pake nahkaranchin.
¿Mama paʼsaran panka iʼsha pentuntaran ihpura? ¿manuraran nunsha ninasarinken niʼtun? shaʼwituku mañahtun inaran ayanke iʼwaraya.
Nuyahkeran nuntaraewa yaʼihpima, kanpuasu yaʼweterinpua iraʼ tahshinan, nihpanawe kahpa kankankeran yunkiwiruwawe nanparin iʼchinpiatuwa ira imarewa peʼipamareʼ.
Mamapaya tenin uʼnan kenin sehteru teʼteteke. Waʼwaruʼsa iʼirateke yaʼnupiwihsu naʼwanawe.
¿Kayumare ketuku pantaʼpiruʼsa?
Inamini, uʼarawe ikirupinan.
tashiterewa, iyaruʼsa. kanpuʼasu yaweterinpua tashi iwan nararuʼsa nakunterin,yunkiʼawa irahka tatamashurusa shawiterinpuʼasu

¿Uhshewe shaʼwitakahsu wayunenpita uhsharan paʼankamare? Kari shaʼwiterawe aʼma puʼpian mare paʼankamaruwe, paʼantenaʼpimahshu weʼpiriunwe manureʼna. ¿Ku penenawe nahtantakahsu paʼtunen? Ina tahshiramiachin perarinawe manuhtun pakamare inaran teʼwayarawe inura patatu.

Tatamahshu napurin paʼpi nuya kahtawakahsu kemuiruʼsa. Nahpuatun, aʼshin kañaʼpi nihsapun kari saminen paʼanterawe irake. Nuyahshakeran aʼnaya aʼnaya piyapiruʼsa nunterawe inaran keterawe paʼanterawehsu nuyahshakeran, ku insuteranta nunpinterawe.
¡Weʼkama! Aʼpeiʼawa kanaruwahsu.
Ku pantapiruʼku kehparitarawe.
Inta yuʼnin saweninen ku nuya yunkiapunawe kehpariterin ku maʼke sahkatenachinwe iminke. Aʼnawita aʼma inapuchin niʼinasu nuya tahpaʼina inuaranken.
Ku ihkanewawe ikiruwinan ku wensepatewawe puʼpian iʼsha yunsanke.
Ahpi, ka iʼsha uʼuihtuwe ihseke tananpiteranku nihpuni. Naʼkun ikirurawe inaran yamururawe. Puʼpian chinuhtewate inaran taʼaparin iraparihchi. Maneku nani iʼwatarewe pawantarinpua naʼkun.
Ihpuke chinihken wiʼnanʼpita
- ¿Shaʼwiterinke intuwa paʼninsu? ka tenawe shaʼwirin aʼna ahke ninanu, puʼpian nunin nihpiriunwe ikirurin niʼtun nimantaratun iʼsha chinimahshuke maiterin.
Shapunen aʼnanku ihpura, inapuwatu kurihki yuntunanawe inaran ku tihkirawe paʼantupike. Inapihkeran ayananawe, ishahsha aʼma apiratukuhsu.
Naʼkunkeware kurihki nihpaterawe

Aʼma teʼwatekehsu iyahsha weʼka itamare ahkekeran weʼninsu, Ka kahpashin kankanchihtuwe niʼnawe paʼanteraweke yaʼkunin nihpuni. uhsharan ninake iʼshake inaran puʼpian iʼsha keteke, inaputupatan nuya kankantarin.
kapuwasu ayarewa,nihpirinwe sehtu keterinpuwa uhshakeran.
Unpua, uʼnanpachin paʼsarawe nihkapunken.
Wiʼnawe, aʼma nañantekehsu yuʼme. Samira kanpiateke yamurake mañahtun inaran taweriachin uʼmake, mamawarin ninasarinpu kuhsinakamare.

Manuke, amiraʼwaya, wihtetarawepuchin nahtanku. Aʼnataweri kehsha yuʼsawatun maʼpateke maʼsha nuya nininsu, ama maʼpatekehsu maʼsha ku makeh paʼterinsu.Ku maʼsha maʼpachataraʼsu nuya nahtanteke unpusuna paʼterin. A ma tahpankehsu maʼsha pankamiachin nahtantamare, inapuwatan paʼanteransu uhsharan suʼsurarin. Ihpura taʼake, niʼkunke piyawi yaʼwere nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu kuʼwara iminke paʼshataraʼsuwe.
Weʼkama iterawe, amiraʼwa. Nuyahshakeran taʼnanuwe aʼkurawe nuyahsha kankanteke, muhtururi ichi paʼtanin nunsha ninanu pentuntahpari.
Uʼnankeran ku aʼnarumarahchin uʼmararewe.
¿Unpukariweta nuya piyapi iyahsha mare? Ihpuaʼawa inaran kusharu ketaʼawa. Ku ina imiranen nihpachin, ku utekariuwa nahsha pei panpenen.

Iyahsha nahterihsu, kema panka weʼehta ketuwatanku, karinke ketaranke yamura inaran sami pihshate. Ituku ihpura:¿nuya niʼnan ina yunkirehsu ku nihpun naʼkun Nuwanteran? Aʼma taʼtekehsu. Yunkiaʼawa nuʼten nanan. Maʼsu tahshiraya wiʼnawepita kuhshatawi ihpura tehsaruwahsu.

Aʼshatu shaʼwirin suʼwin ahke paʼsarin sahkatawen nimara. Nimara paʼsarin imuhtu kepararin iratuwinan aʼnateranpa. Taʼna peʼperin tenin inaran kusharu waʼki taweri mare. Ku nituhterawe ihsu semanake uʼmamara ku nihpun aʼna semanakeʼpa. Ina kahpashinkeran shaʼwirarin uʼmararinsu. ¡Ma nuyata uʼmapachina kurihki kemarin sami paʼankamare! Nimara uʼmakapun uruntereʼna tanan kanura parihchin.

Aʼna sanawi ka yaʼwerawe nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu kenanin naʼnarin irake nihpuni, waʼwashari nuyahsha ushihkeraʼwaya nunchihtunwe. Nahtain mahsuna ikihterinsu inaran taʼatun yuniʼin awaitenaʼpi. Nuyahshakeran imira matawatun kepain sanuwanaʼpa.
¿Peʼtentapunku kahken taʼna pensha yaʼkari iʼshana pentuntupatu?

Naʼkun yunkinpirawe iya paʼpi ahke paʼnin ni nununtapu kañurinun, nihkapunawe nununtunaʼpiruʼsari kahtawapun, nihpaunawe ku nuya niʼnawawe, naʼwanainken nahpuinsahchin niʼnewake, minaransu pawanterinkui, yuhsu muhsharai nuya wentakasumare.

Weʼkama wiʼnashauwe sanawi. ¿Nani peʼperan yuʼme keʼsha yaʼwerinsu? Nimara yaʼwerin naʼkunkeware aʼna piyapimare. Ku nituhterawe Nuwantapun pihpikasu nimara, chihturu tahshiwanin uʼnankapun nimara. Sehterawe naʼkun nunshinan ira yunkiatuwe, yaʼi tuʼkuiru. ¿Kema nahteran awantari? Nuʼten nimara iʼsha kañaritapun, nimara peike ayankariuwa ninatamare. Ni aʼpeike, wiʼnawe sanawi, suʼyan weʼka iteke. Shaʼwituku nani tihkipatan tunputeransu peʼpetu.
¿Unpu maʼsha yuʼsatewa maʼpatariuwata ku inshateranta pantapi maʼpapirinpuwawe?
Tawerianpitereʼ, sehtahmaran yaʼweatun kemaura.
¿Kema aʼchintuke kurihke pichikasu, aʼshatu? inauchin nihpatan karinke kahtawararinke, aʼnapitanta nihka paweranwene, yunkirawe ku kanariwe paʼanteresu.
ku nuya niʼniunwe iyaruʼsa ku nuya nahtantepiuwe nupihsu nunentu peike, Ku nahtanpiuwe niʼtun ku nituhtepiuwe aʼpeikamare peʼtawa.
Muhshaihtuwe taʼtamare nanan nahtantamare.
Aʼma ñanantekehsu nuyahsha keʼketeransu, nuhsururankehsu, kankirin yunkirawesu nahpuru nuya senaterehsu kahtuyaʼpinpu.
Aʼnahken pantaʼpi yuʼsawatun yamura maʼpateke inaran sami nanpiru, ama tuhpinan kurihkirahchin kemakehsu yaʼwereke kusharu pawananin niʼtun.

Wiʼnapi tananke paʼpachina waʼki yuhkimare, sehterai maʼshateranta unpurin tehkatui. Nimara nuya nihsarin, ku naniteraiwe nituhtakasu. Naʼwanai sahkatu ninanuke, yah kahtawaterin niʼtun. Tahparai kiwiraihsu iraterinsu nahtankaimare irake.
Aʼnanku uskuruʼ, tahshiraya niʼsaran.
Ku kepaʼihtuwe naʼkun yamura ichi yaʼweretamare, maʼsu ku make kamairawe yaʼi; shapun nahtanchihtuwe waʼwaruʼsa neʼmehtenen peʼsakamare.
Yaʼipinpuwa wiʼserewa ya kushatuwateiraʼ, ku aʼnaramarahchin kaniuʼihturewa, napurin sanihtariapaya ninunene peike nunkatun.
weʼkama, weke paʼyanke iʼwahpuchin iminke nuya kankanteresupuchin.
Nuya nihpera kuʼsharutun paankawe inapikeran paʼananawe shapun
Ku nanianterewawe maʼta naʼkun ihshanarusa ni patupi kanpuwa peike nunshinanpa aʼke.
Tahsiramiachin yuʼnin nihpuni kayapin, paʼantenaʼpimahshuri nuya pawere kechihtunwe, kuʼwara aʼnapita paʼatenaʼpiruʼsa kankimahtaraʼsuna.
Sehtupiru kemuiruʼsa ku aʼtantepiuwe kusharu shunari seʼwachinachin, maʼsu ku inapuchin aʼpeipachinawe kañu ku pei patariunwe.
manuke, ku unayantarasu niʼkumaran mamapayanan nisaran winanen unkaperachin
¡paʼa nuwanterawehsu, nunshanake nanpeaʼa! Nani iʼwaraya ninanukeparihchi iratari, nahpuatun uhsharan maitaʼa kuʼwara iʼwararin.

¿Ma naʼpuruchahchinta niʼnawe mamanuwe pantaʼpi aʼpaterinsu? Ku kahsu ya paʼanpirawe puʼpian mare, paʼantenaʼpi muhsharinku puʼpian ketamare. ¿Ku suʼyawe nahtanʼihtuwe penen ketainkumare? Nahpuru taweri manureʼna pakatu ku nahtanawe nahpuatun teʼwarawe ka tewerawekeran.
Ninateke, waʼwasha, aʼma yuʼkesu yaʼi samira. Pahtuma kanpiateke yamuramare. Aʼnapita senaterewa pihkeran paʼankariuwa.
Iʼyawe, ¿uskuru aʼnanpunku? Ku yaʼweterinkuwe. Niʼke wankuru paʼantupiʼpa puʼpian mare paʼanpi. Paʼa kanpu inara naʼwekariuchin maʼshateranta paʼankari tahshi kapamare
Ku maʼasha kepariwe kanpure iya.
Nuya tunputeku peʼpetu, waʼwaruʼsa, aʼma iratereke shipikamarewe. Kepaʼawa pahkaturu, niʼmehteruʼsa inaran panka weʼehta. Iʼchimike muhturu aʼma waʼkiapunawe.
Ku chinuhtariuwa wankui irake ku maʼsha nuya tahpawatewawe.
Iyahsha ku ahsu mamapayanen nañanteriunwe paʼpi nuhsururin niʼtun.

Aʼna mahsu shaʼwirin amiraʼwain nunsha aʼnaninnaʼna iyahsha iʼsha pentuntamare. Kemapi ya peʼirin aʼna iʼsha ahteranpa, inari nuyahshakeran kechehtunwe. Inapihkeran iyahshari sami nanpiru keterin kahtawarinmare.Nunentenaʼpi winarin inaran tenin inapuchin nuyahsha nanpiri. Yaʼipi maʼsha ni ketuwatama ku ihshateranta tana nahtaniunwe yaʼweramake, yaʼi ni nuhsuruarama.
Nani uʼnanpachina kawera wenserahrawe peineweke,kaʼtanku kanta puʼpiyanteranta nunteku kanta kawera yaʼwerahrawe,awinaku kanta naniantakaʼsumare sehtu.

Waʼwaruʼsa, kahtawaku nunen pahkaturu peʼpeʼi inaran wiri nehmehteʼsa. Teʼwarawe kankunkamare kuʼwara uʼnan anuchahtaraʼsuwe. Weʼerehsu ichi nanpeʼawa nuhshake inaran a tenenteke muhturu. Aʼma waʼkiawasu, mamanenpuwa paʼyaneʼna ninararinpuwa iʼsha winkin niʼtun.

Wiʼnawe, nuyahshakeran nahtanku ihsu penin waʼwateramahsu niʼnawe niʼtun. Ihkankipachin pantaʼpi senakahsu, kepaʼawa kayapin ninanukeʼpa. Nuyahshakeran paʼan awa, ku manupinanwe, inaran aʼna wintana peʼten awa paʼantenaʼpisa nuhtetenanke. Inapuwatewa imiranenpuwa nuyahsha kehparitarin inaran nininenpuwa piyapiruʼsa kankanenenke nuyahsha kehparitarin.
Mamanen kahpashin kankanterin paʼantenaʼpi puʼpian mare paʼterinsu paʼanin niʼtun, nahpuatun ina atarikayu yuʼsawatun yamura puʼpian maʼpaterin.
¿Ama paʼmakusuʼ peike ninatahpatamaʼ? Ku, kemupiruʼsasu kanuhtupiwe; ihsuʼ aʼchinaʼpi niʼsarin iʼsha inaran yunkirin nahpuruʼ piʼiruʼsasuʼ ku ayuntumarinwe?
¿ku taʼaitunwe kahpaitatun wiʼnan ku kankirinwe taweriachin iminken nihpunin? ku nanichintunwe weʼehkamare ku nuya nituhtapunawe.
Paʼantenaʼpimahshu taʼna paterin peʼtenpinan iʼsha yunsanke, nimara iʼsha wahpuru waʼkirin pakakahsu niʼtun ina ku wachi naniteriunwe yaʼwerin ninanuke ayankahsu.
Ku tanaiterawe seʼtu kanainkusu.
Kankimarai paʼpi chiruʼterawe paʼanterawekeran,nahkuanawe nuya kankanewekeran uʼmarawe ni ketawa ina kanarawesukanpuwa kapini,ina iminke nahpuinaʼchin sahkaterewasu.

Weke ihseke, wiʼnashanuwe, ku naniterawe. Samira paʼanpatan, ya yuʼnan niwike, maʼsha paʼanchinachin nihpiriunwe inapihkeran. Ama naʼkun aʼpatumakehsu inapikeran kahpa nihpachin naʼnetan.
