Nuya aʼnike wentunen inaran insuna paʼanterinkesu yaʼpira nuya niteke. Pake nuyahsha, paʼpi piʼi nihsarin, nuhshanen tapirarin.
Nimara nahpuru taweri shaʼwirawe atari ya paʼanawehsu, nimara ku inshateranta yaʼweteriunwe kurihke pawerinkumare.
tatamahshu aʼna taweri nuʼwiterin puʼpihsha,inarannuya kankantumantarin winantarin.

Nahpuru iʼwaraya ku nuya aʼniruawe kanpiatakahsu yuʼnewa tarahpa weʼehta nuhkuantemahsu maʼpatamare. Kiyahsu yunkirai kamaiyarai,nihpiriunwe iʼsha piʼpikunin. Kari shaʼwiterankema nuya niʼku, ninpiriunwe kanpita kuya niʼnamawe. Ihpurasu ku aniterewa peʼikahsu nimantaratun ku mahshateranta aʼyutechinachinwe. Ku nuwanterewawe maʼsha ni tapitemaʼshu ahkekeran nuyahsha yaʼnurin niʼtun; ina aʼchinterinpuwa nahpunin ninuwahsu.
Iyahsha, ¿Ku nunsha aʼnanankuwe iʼwara nahtanpunke nuyahshakeran? Paʼtun akuteransu ihkanterinku, nihpiriunwe kankanuwe yunkirahrin ihpura.

¿Sanawi ku a ichi yaʼwereriunwe weʼehta mukaru puʼpian shiʼshike? Mamapaya shawirin ina niʼihtunwe winareʼna, shiʼshi naʼkun paʼterin niʼtun. ¿Aʼna mamapaya nuwantapun ihsu a ichi yaʼweretakahsu kahpashinkeran iminke?
Nimara ina yunirin a nuya kankantamare inapihkeran.

Iyahsha paʼantunaʼpi, nanpeke ihpura inaran wenseke wankanachin. Pentuntariuwa naʼkun iʼsha pamaterinsu tahshi uʼnanin niʼtun. Niʼke peʼpetunen iʼshake anutuachin. Yaʼinpua maitaʼawa nuhserateke kankunkamare aʼnuarahchin nunshinankeʼpa. Manuku, taweri kanararinpua ihpura tahshiramiachin.
¿Nimara ku taʼterawe tahshinanke manurawatera tanan irake?
¿Tata, tenan ahpimahshu niwike ketapunku puʼpian yamura?
¿Kahsuʼ nanpewateraʼ panka iʼsha uhpuruke? yunkikuʼu anataweri nuyaʼshakeran: ninusuʼ kuhsharu, unpuanta irahke tahna maninku tewarawe ku nuyawe panawe nihtun.
Mañahtun imuhtunen aʼnankui ihpura, iminanai kuʼwara uʼnan anuchahtaraʼsuwe. Nuya aʼpeike, ihpura iʼwaraya ayantaranken nuya paʼmupinan.

Iʼwata, kemuiruʼsa. Tenan kiyahsu ku nuyahsha nihsaraiwe, iyawe ahke iminkeʼpa paʼnin ku shaʼwirenwe. Nuyahshakeran nuntekariuwa nañantuwachin. Nuyahsha nahtantuku weʼka itarankesu, ninararawe nuyahsha kankantamare yaʼichachin nahkaranchin ni wentunpatewa.
Niaʼweretareʼ ina pishateʼ shapunmareʼ, waʼwi
Nuyahtekeʼ muhturu, naʼkun pawanin.
Ku uʼmararinwe taweriachin, paʼsaran iteke.
ka ninuwinwe ku pamarinwe kahpa kankantirinsu
Kepararawe maʼshateranta peike.
Chinuhteke iʼshapirianke waʼwatapun nuwiteransu; Ninupinen kanuhtuwachin, tananpiteke ihsu iʼsha a yunkin inken insunkenta.
Paʼantupike unpuin paʼnan? Nuya. Samira paʼanawe inaran inake paʼanterawehsuke paʼanawe ihsu semanake nuwantupihsu kemuiruʼsa.
Nimara nahpuru taweri keparawe naʼkunkeware pantaʼpi paʼantupike, ku nituhterawe insuna yaʼi paʼanterinku kuʼwara iʼwayahtaraʼsuwe.
Aʼnanteran shiʼshi senaransu.

Wiʼnasharuʼsa, ¿Nanpiun senaruwahsu paʼanpatewa maʼta paʼankariuwa? Nuya paʼantewatewa, tahpaʼawa panka nunsha paʼankamare. Aʼma tuhpinan ku makehsu paʼterinsumare tihkikuhsu. Kanpiataʼawa weʼehtaruʼsa inaran saweniruʼsa. Yaʼinpuwa sahkataʼawa inaran nuyahshakeran ni ketaʼawa nuʼpa keterinpuahsu.

¿Kahpa kankatamare ina nanan nahtanterawe niʼtun peʼirarawe yahshin kapamare? Manuke, iʼsha pankeitarin ina tananke uʼnanin niʼtun. Aʼpeiteke tahshi maituwatan, ku uʼmawatanwe mamaparin sehtarin kemamare.Ka yuʼnana nuyahtapu kema nunsha nuya akuraʼsunwe. ¿Kaʼtankapunku ihpura u ninataran nuya tawerikahsu?
Iʼwata,¿kema uʼmaran iʼshakeran? ku sehteranwen kemaura iratakahsu nani tahshirawiriunwe?
¿Umpu pentunawe ka ihke iʼwara? naʼtanke nuyashakeran:Napeke karuhku ihsha waʼpuruke tahshire, mamareta nate ina ira piʼpitaun paʼpi ahke samira.
Ina ya paʼanin yuʼme paʼterinsu inaran mampayari aʼna weʼehta paya ketawatun maʼparin; nanun mama yusparin tenin ina kemuinere ni ketatun niʼtun.
Nuyahshakeran uhsharan ninaterin, wahpuru iʼshahsu nani tahshiramiachin paʼnin nihpiriunwe paʼantenaʼpihsu aʼna taweri ayamarin.
Pahsarawe tananke puʼpian tawerimare, amiraʼwa. Uʼnan puʼpian aʼpayaninku, nihpiriunwe nuya pihpirarawe. Nani uʼmarawatu ninaku kusharu nihsawatun.
Karinken nunchintenkewe nunteranku nuhpunin
¿Ka nunshake pentunihtuwe mañahtun kankunkamare ni wentunapi uʼwantaimare niʼtu?
¿Yunkiran unpuruta yuʼmenuwe peʼperan nunshinankeʼpa? Nahpuru taweri tuhpinan ihpuranke.¿Unpu yusparin ichinkenta yaʼi ina paʼantakahsu kahtawarankuhsumare?
Iʼwaterewa, kurihki nihka nanihtaupua, naputerinawe asukare paʼterin, iʼwariu panewesu paʼanin piʼpianaʼ ku yunkianawe.
Kuʼwara wahpuru iʼsake nanpeyahtaraʼsuwe chinuhtarawe.
Ni nuʼwiruwa pihkeran yuniruwa nuyahsha kankantamare yaʼinpuwa.
Shaʼ wiate paʼnesu tatamashu uhmantarawe.
Yunkikeayankasu kuʼwara tahshirarin.
Nuya nimara iminke kepakahsu, inahke waʼwin puʼpian nañanterin paterinsu tanawanke.

¿Unpuwanta inshateranta ku peʼiriunwe kanpuaruʼkunpuwa ihpura ina paʼnin? Manuke, aʼpaniteke, ¿Kemanta yuniran ninankeran? Teʼwaterawe nunsha kahpanante. ¿Tenan uʼmapun taweriachin? Yusparin itaranke kaʼtanpatanku ina uʼmakaware.
Yunkirai yaʼinkui pawere nunshake keparinakuimare, nimara ayamaihtuiwe kuʼwara uʼnan anuchahtaraʼsuwe.
Kankirawe ikiruwina inaran teʼwareʼna

Nimara ku kahsu yusparinke ni tu tenawe iyara nunsha aʼnaninkuhsu. Ina winareʼna keterinku, ku maʼteranta nahtanpunkurawe. Kahsu nimara tuhpinan waniahrawe sewenawepuchin, inauchin inapurawemare ihpuranta yunkiahrawe. Penen kechinken inshaternta imaira ketuwachinken, aʼpanike nuyahshakeran aʼma taʼtahkesu.
Ku maʼpaterawe kurihke nuyahsha.

Nimara tahshiraya tahshiramiachin iyawe paʼsarin. Tenin ya paʼnin nunshinankeʼpa nunsha ninakamare. Nimara peʼperarin peʼpetunen pantaʼpire inaran puʼpian sami tenawe uʼmararin kahtu tawerikeran, nihpiriunwe ku nuya nituhterawe. Mamanu napurin ina ya shaʼwirin intuahsuna ya paʼpachina. ¡Kahpashin kankanterin intuahsuna ya paʼpachina! Maʼshateranta yahshin nininsu keshimararainku uʼmawachin.

¿Ka paʼan ihtuwe yamura inaran kiruhsin ihsu semanake ka yaʼwerawe ninanuke? Nimantarawatu nuwanterawe uskuru kuhsinakamare. ¿Nanichihtunketu kurihki yuntunawehsu wayuruʼsa paʼantu? Yaʼsuwachin, kentaʼihtuwe kashinuʼsa kamare. Inapuchin nihpuni kahpashin kankantereʼna chinuhchihtuwe naʼkun sahkaterawekeran.

Yaʼihpima ichikemaʼ, wiʼnaupita yaʼihpima teʼwawatama yaʼihpima taʼtuke tahshiruʼpurawaru, nuya nitun yuriramau nahpurini, karinkema kechitumawe nuya nanan, ninaiʼtumawe yaʼihpinpua taweri wenimarinkeʼpamare.
¿Kahpashin kankanterawe ahpimahshu peʼirinkeran uʼmawachin? ¿Inta nihka wekapun wensekamare ihpura tahshi inapitaruʼkui?
Kema ku paʼyateranwe kema waʼwan niʼsawirinkunta ahchirin aʼchinpeikeran.
Nima a nuya kankanteruwa inaran winaruwa nahkaranchin.
¿Nimara nunentunaʼpi kahpashin kankanterin ku wachi iʼsha pamateriunwe niʼtun ahkete?
Kehshanen paʼain paʼantupike.
¿Ni ketariwa nimara pantaʼpi kanpuwa kapini?

¿Aʼma uʼwawasu nuyai iʼsha? Inahsu ku nuyawe, kankan ichi ikihterinpu. Kiyahsu ichi inpiterai aʼma kañukamarewe. Aʼma aʼmuru iʼsha yaʼkari tiʼyatawahsu. Nunentu peike nunkahsu yaʼwewachin, paʼawa kahpashin kankankeran nituhtamare aʼma kañukamarewe kemuiruʼsakeran.
¿Ihkapun kusharu yaʼimare paʼpihsu iʼsha peʼnate?
Ketuku puʼpian yamura ihpura, uhshiya, mamanuwe sami anpirarin ku naniterawe paʼantupiʼpa pakakahsu ahke niʼtun
Ayamawatan ninanuʼpa iʼmereke pantahpi mentashaʼ, yunkirawe kanta, aʼna taweri nuya kankantuwinan uʼmarawe, pehpewinan yaʼi ishanake irake.

Tahshiraya nimara ku kenanpunwe ira yaniru iʼkeparihchi paʼnesu. Petete uʼnanin, iʼsha chinhken uʼmararin naniteran ninatakahsu. Ku nituhterawe unpuruta pentune, paʼsawi naʼkun. ke ma kepararan pitana pahkekamare aʼma naʼpiraruke anutamarewe.
¿Unpuata pentunterin inasuʼ nakun iʼshanarusa ku chinutuwinawen nimantarin kankimarin tawereyachin akitamare samira?

Iyaruʼsa ruʼku yunkirai nahpuinahchin iʼsha pentuntakahsu, ku ni aʼpepinanwe. Irataʼawa uhsharan ira tuʼkuiru taranin uʼnanin niʼtun. Nani iratsruake ni ninaʼawa ku inshateranta aʼnutamarewe. Inapuchin iratarewa kahpashin kankankeran ahpimahshu peinenkeʼpa.
Aʼma waʼkiahsu, nuhsururawehsu, nuʼserate aipiteke. nani iʼwarayake iratari nunshake ninanukeʼpa inaran kahpashin mentahterinku iʼsha paʼirahrihsu nihkatu.
Ni nunterai paʼankamare ina paʼantinaʼpiruʼku, nahpuatun ihsu sahkatamare kenaisu aipatumarai paʼterinsu.
Uhshiya, uhkuike naʼnei. Tahshiraya peʼikare paʼsare iʼkeʼpa inaran winantare nahkaranchin. Nuya yaʼwetakasu kahtaninpuwa taweri sahkaipuchinke nininke.
¿Unpuwanta ku maʼshateranta iterankuwe kurihki ya ketapirankenwe kuhtaru peʼperan niʼtun? Tuhpinan ihpuranku, inaran taʼteran.
Tahshi ku nanitrawe weʼehkakasu tahshinan teʼwatatu, inurimini, kanta inurau, iyaraʼwa ku nuya kankanterinwe, paʼa tewenchinu kahtunpure weʼah.
- ¿Insechinta niʼnan naʼwerin? - Ku nuya niʼnawe, tenawe paʼsarin ahke iʼshaparihchi, kepararin aʼna kehken peʼpepinan.
¿Inkarinta a nuyakankantawen waʼwin naʼnepachin? Aʼshini ninaʼin nuyahshakeran inaran nuyahsha nunchin kahpashin kankantamare.
Ina mahshu weʼka tehsawatun yaʼimare paweretarin.
Kema ku ayatewiranwe ina nuhsuruteransu irahka
Aʼma pawankehsu tuhpinan nunentapike, waʼwasha. Kahsu kankan ikihterawe aʼpeipihsu ku nunentu maʼpatapiuwe niʼtun.
Ku nuyawe niʼnawe, ku mamapaya kahtawaranwen kehsha paʼankamare niʼtun.
Kema ku pawanawe nuwantewateran.
¿Uʼuhkeʼ nimiriu yaʼihpi taweri?
¿ku naniterewe ihpukasu naʼkun naʼkun wiʼnanpu?

Kari iyahsha shaʼwiterawe ya paʼpachin nuyahsha nananen tahpaʼin inaran sahkatunen. Aʼma nihsarawe tehkesu ku ya nihpataun, inaran yusparin iteke piyapiruʼsa tananke kahtawarinensu. Kahpashin kankanterawe nani iʼwaraya peʼirehsu kahtuyaʼpinpu yunkiatu. Sehteyaranke paʼnamare, nimara kahpashin keran pahsaran aʼna ira yunihkapun. Nihpiruinwe uʼmantake aʼma nañantukuihsu.
Unpuwa iyaruʼsa, yuniaʼawa nuya kanakamare.
¿Kemuiruʼsa kankikapuna kahpashinkeran weʼka itamare iyaruʼsa yaʼwere nuhtetenanke yaʼwepihsu?
Aʼma paʼinsu ku manta tehkapunawe.
Mahshuya nuwanterawehsu, Shaʼwituku: Nahpuru tahshi teʼwatun rupahteran nara nukunanke. Aʼma ihpura sehtekesu, kahpashinkankanteke inaran yusparin tehke nuya uʼmaran niʼtun?
Puʼpian nihka nanerewa, inakera winarewa nakerachachin ishapuchin

Unpuwa yaʼima, iʼwara ku nuya nunterankenwe manurawatu. Ku ninararawe iʼyawe wahpuru iʼshake nanpekamare. Inawe nihpiriunwe iratarawe yuʼme paʼansawatu. Ku tahshi sewenanawe tahshi muhturu pirianke taʼna peʼtenawe niʼtun.
Wahpurumashu keninkui iʼwarayaraware.
Iʼsha pentunchin ihsutaweriamiachin.
¿Ku weʼka tuhpiuwe inawaʼtun kuʼwara paʼterinsu yunkiahtaraʼsuwe?
Nimara mama inaran mamapaya yunkipi ku tihkikamarewe yaʼi. yunkipi tahpakaisu nimiriu paʼankamare inshateranta kañiupachin mare.
unanpachina kemarachin nihpatana,weke peinuke, manuamaran
Nikamara ku sehturu nininwe ihpura yukiahrawepuchin. Anki taʼparawe ina nuʼserateke maitaʼse uhsharan, ahkeraʼse iʼshaparihchi.
Ina teʼwa ku ayankimarinwe way.

Aʼma kawera iminke patekuhsu iyahsha, ku ni awerewe ihpura. Nu yuyarinkuwe nuʼten pakakhsu. Aʼma atari ni taʼatakahsu nahkaranchin. Teʼwarawe taʼtahran niʼtun, nihpiriunwe ihpuinke aʼma nañantamarewe.

¿Niʼtunapi piyapiruʼsa ihkankiapiuwe ihpura tahsi ninanuke? Ku, inawahsu tahshinanke maitapi nuʼserateke, iraya. Uʼnan ku naʼwariunwe aʼnuawarahchin nimantaratun panka pamatarin iʼsha.Anuyahtenaʼpimahshuri penen keterin nuyahtuwachin pakaimare.

Uhshiruʼsa nuyahshakeran nahkapiwi aʼshinatanananketan uʼmarinsu. Aʼma tananpitekuhsu yuʼme kehken peʼperaʼinsu. Nuyahsha nunchina inaran ikirurinsu nuyahsha machiʼina. Maneku, ina kahpashin kankanterin waʼwinpita nihsatun ninarahpisu yaʼkuanake.
¿Ihsu aʼshatu ahke pahsarinsu tihkiwachin? Yunsanke ninararawe inaran kahpashin keran yuʼmenenpita kahtawarawe
Ina iyahsha ku ahsu ninanunenke ayamariunwe, nahpuatun ina sehtarin.
Ama kunpununta nunchatakeruwe imin nuya nuya nuyahtepachin kiʼsharunenke ihsu piʼike.
¿Ku tanapiteranku nuyahsha nuntamare niwentunake nuʼwirinkuhsu? Ku tananpiterawe nuyahsha nuntakahsu; nituhtapun ihpura, nahpatun inawaruʼku winarai.
Ku aʼnuterinawe nihpuni, ku paʼihtuwe.
Mañanhtun weke, sami nanpiru akuke mihsake. Iyawe nani tahshiramiachin kenin inaran kiyari paʼanai kuʼwara ni kapiahtaraʼsuwe.
Ku uhshiwe niwirinkusu naʼparawe.
¿Yunkike ihperawanta irahka yamura ketaranu naʼkunkera?
¿Aʼtanteʼ pratuke kusharuʼ?
Ama tewatukusu, weke niʼkiku
¿Ka nianiterawe mahshu paʼantenaʼpi nuyahshakeran yai paʼantakahsu, nuʼwitapun nimara kari kehsha paʼterinsu puʼpian aʼpatumake ituwatu?
keteke aʼna ihpuinan tatanen
Ku iʼsha pentuntariuwa tahshi nani ya kankunanewa peiʼpa nihpiriunwe.

Nuya, waʼwaruʼsa nimara naʼnekariwa puʼpian mamapaya yunkiatewa. Nimara kanpuahsu tahparewa yunkiruahsu maʼsha paʼ terinpuchin. Tenawe ina ihseke nihsarin tanan iwantarinke, kahtankui. Paʼnansu naʼwanai, nimantaratun yaʼkariterin nuhsururankuihsu kiya.
Nanitaweri nunenanen uʼuhke.
Ku tananpichihtuwe naʼwanawehsu waʼwawe aʼpeiterinkuhsu.
Nimara imuya uʼmararin ahke ninanukeran.Kahpashin kankanteruwa kenansawatuwa nimara ihpikariuwa waʼki taweri naʼwanewa niʼtun.
Nuyahshakeran taʼna akuihtunwe iʼsha yunsanke, nimara paʼantenaʼpi manu ayanin ku wara nunsha ku pihpiataʼsu.
¿Tahshiramiachin paʼpatera, ku wanirawe kehsha kapamare wankui irake chiniru yaʼwetamare?
¿Nahkaranchin anantaku nunshanen?
Ihpera tahshi nuya aʼsunke nuʼun, nuyara weʼehkakamare, tahshiraya tawerianpitawatuwe winariwa yaihpinpua kanpua ninanuaʼwake yaʼwerewasu ku manukeranwe.
Wekamaʼ. kuʼtun nahsha paʼanawe, paʼatun paʼatupiriwen, iʼwa mamanewe keterinkupuchin.
Nimara peʼtawaraʼwasa pihkeran aʼmichiteriuwawe. Ka aʼpeihtuwe atari kaipaya kahtawataʼse peʼpetu, uhsharan inaran nuyahshakeran.
Waʼwaruʼsa peʼpeʼawa iʼshakeʼpa.
Ku nahtanawe puʼu ihsu maʼsuke, ¿nuʼten? ku uhshiraʼwa, inamare ku yunkiterau,ahchin tahshi weʼerawe nuyahpiachin nuya kankakeran kemaruʼku.

Tata, ¿unpu unputa nihka ni ketariwa aʼnaya aʼnaya? naʼkun kanarewa nihpuni, nuyahshakeran ni pahtumachihturuawe. Neʼmehte waʼwaruʼsamareʼtun paʼanihteruawe. wiʼnaweruʼsa, aʼma kurihkimare ni awekuhsu. Yunkiaʼawa yaʼi kemuiruʼsamare inaran puʼpian tahpaʼawa inshateranta kañupachin nunentamare.

Aʼmiraʼwaruʼsa tananke paʼpachinara, mamapaya naʼkun sehterin. Uhsharan irachin, tenin ina. Ayanʼina kuʼwara tahshirarin. Ahke ira inaran ikirure paʼweru. Pantaʼpi aʼniwi kepaʼina. Chinuhteʼina kehken ni nahtanpachinara wenukakeran.
- Naʼwanawe uhshiwe kirihkatapun paʼninsu. ¿Wekapun? - Nuʼten, waʼwasha, kahpashin kankanteke, ina naʼkun nuhsururinke.
¿Ina winarin teʼwatun tahshi?

Unpuwa, Ku shaʼwiterawe kemuruʼsa manu paʼsarawehsu. Wahpuru iʼsha naʼwerin ku tananpiterawe patainkusu. Kahpashin kankanterawe yaʼi wayuruʼsa paʼanawe niʼtun. Ku amirawe iraterawehsu, yaʼi tahshi taʼnahke nuyahsha weʼerawe nuya ni suʼpinpina.
Yaʼweterinku aʼna nuya nanan waʼwashamare ina nahpuni nisarinsu, taʼarin irake ku chinuhtaunau, paʼpi teʼwaunau inran nuyahkeran pahkariterin.
Kemahsu uwinkaran aʼna pahtun wiʼnanpitamare inaran aʼna nanpiru kusharumare paʼpanpisu ninanuke.
Paʼawa kepaʼawa aʼnarahchin paʼantinunpuamare.
Ka nimara paʼantapu uhsharan inaran kahpashinkeran, nuya nuya paʼantenaʼpi puʼpian aʼpatumarin inaran yaʼinpuwa kahpashin kehpariteruwa.
Unpua, maʼshu. nanitere keʼshanu ni ichiyaʼwerekahsu ana yunaʼnamare ninanukeʼ,yunkirawe panuke iyawe ku yawepiriwen.
¿Unpuanta nani ya aʼananawe saʼyahte?
¿Ku wiʼnawe Nuwanterawe tenama? Ku, ina nanan ku nuʼtenwe; ku tananpiterawe aʼnuterawehsu unpuhsuna nuwaterawehsu inaran yusparin iterawe kaʼtaninkumare
Uʼnanpachina chinihken, nunsha patarawe nunshinanke inaran manurarawe iratamare.
Nimara shapun paʼpi paʼtun, ihpura paʼankari nuwanterehchin.
¿Nimara ku chinuhterawe iʼsha yaʼkari nani irateraweke aʼna peike waʼwasha maʼpatamare?
Sanapiruʼsa yunki akupi iratakahsu ahke, tanan pentuntakahsu nihpiriunwe kepararin kahspashin kankankeran ahke iminenkeʼpa.
Iʼchinpike ina muhturu nunshakeran.
Ku ichi yaʼwerechihtuwe samira puʼpian mare, maʼsu paʼntupike paʼpi paʼtun niʼtun inaran wiʼnawepita nuwantupi kurihki maʼshanenmare.
- ¿Weʼka iteran pentuntahpun? - nihkawe nimara, nihpiriun ku nuya yunkirawe; weʼnawe ikiruwinan nihpiriun kahsu peinuʼpa ya kankumarawe.

Aʼna taweri iyahsha nuhsururansu paʼnin, kuʼwara imiranen aʼpeyahtaraʼsuwe aʼna nanan keterawe. Nuyahshakera tananke pakeʼ inaran yusparin iteke insuna kusharu keterinkensu irake. Aʼma kemaura tahshi iratekehsu, iʼsha ya pentuntuwatan yunihke interanta kaʼtainken. Kahsu sehtarawe yunkiatu kema niʼnankuhsu, inaran kahpashin kankanterawe suʼsuraransu nihkatuwe. Nuyahshakera uʼmake inaran nuya nanan kemake mamanen mare
Nuya iyahsha,¿Nañanteran saweni aʼnanankuhsu nahpuru taweri? Ihpura naniteran nihkakahsu, teʼwarawehsu iminke suʼsurin.
Waʼwasha sehterin iyahshari aʼshin kepawachina nunentu peike? Paʼpini iterin yusparin tehkakasu. ¿Ku niʼnanwe ina piyapi sahkatu weshirin kahtawatamare?¿Keʼma tenan Iyahsha inaura wenseatun sehtarin?
ku nuwanteraiwe ni yaʼweretakahsu kampua samira.
¿Inta ka shaʼwichihtuwe kumuiruʼsa nithtamare uwa maʼpaterawehsu nunentu peike?

Mamapaya, nahpuru tahshiramiachin ku yunkirawe nunterankuhsu. Naʼkun naʼkun paʼnawe inaran ku naniterawe kuʼwara uʼnan anuchahtaraʼsuwe. Ku nahtanawe inairaruʼsa perarinsu imahkamare. Yaʼi ahke ninin inaran nihshamiachin, inaran kemahsa yunkiaranke tahshinanke.
Iʼwa puchin, iminenmare shaʼwiran.

¿Kawera tahsiraya tahshiyachin paʼihtu tu paʼantapu? Samira tahpakamare yamura maʼpachihtuwe inaran puʼpihsha tuma. ¿Kurihki nanichihtunku tu yaʼi paʼankamare? Wayu kepaihtuwe waʼwaruʼsa ketamare. ¡paʼpinuya iratere ninanuparihchi!
¿Ihpua ira ihpura paʼpi aʼkeʼ?

¿Yunkiran nahpuru kemahken ahpireʼke ni nuʼwirai sami yuʼkamare? Waʼki tawerichachin ku ni nunterayuwe.¿Ku kemanta nuwanawen maʼsuna pawantarinpuhsu? Kahsu naʼwanawe kahtuyaʼpinpu paʼnehsu peʼikari. Inapihkeran peinenʼpa pakaware nuyahsha nuntamare. ¿Unpuanta ku iʼwahchacin ninuwe, a miraʼwa? Ina ku nuneʼsu tapirinpuwa yaʼinpuwachachin. Nihpirunwe inapihkeran yaʼinpuwachachin kuhshatantarewa.
¿Peike uʼmaran ikiruwinan?
Nuʼwituruwa, nihpiriunwe nani nañanteruwa.
Naʼkun kehken ihtunwe muhturu tenentupinan. Nimara kanpuwa kapini peʼpetu ni kechihteriuwawe aʼma nunshanake ikirukamarewe.
Nuyakeran nunteke, sehtuwina nihpirinwe, ihpurasu nanan irahkauchin sahkatariwa nuyahkeran.

¿Irataran kemawera tahshinanke tanankeran uʼmawatan? Iratakahsu ahke inaran nuhsha kehsaransu kehken nimara. ¿Ku inshateranta kaʼtaninkunwe ihpura? Nuʼten shaʼwiteranken, amiraʼwa: unpuaranta nararuwankana chiwewatan?
Iyahsha, yusparinken ichinken. Kema waʼkipatan, waʼwasha aʼchinterwesu naʼnahpun ku tunapunawe. Nuwanteke ihsu nanan. Aʼma nañantekehsu kahtawarankuhsu waʼwasha a tunateran tahshi nani paʼyanpirawe.
Nimara wekapun wiʼnanpu nahsha waʼwaterinsu kehkapun. Niʼpate kahpashin kankantare inaran ihpukari naʼkun naʼwanewa niʼtun.

Waʼwa,¿Maʼninta ketaʼawa ninanunenpua kanpua shiʼshirenunpuake? nuya senaterewa nahpurini, kepaʼitriwawe aʼana sahkura iʼkeʼpa. ayaʼwerechiteriwawe aʼnahke maʼsure, yamura inaran shapun. ama paʼankesuwe yaʼihpichachin, tahpake yaʼpirin aʼna pihpike wentarinke shantakamare.
Tahshiraya paʼsarawe iyawe kañaʼpi nihkapu.Peʼpetunu nani yaʼkuanake akurawe.kema ninaku peʼtawaruʼsa aʼpeituku, ¿Nuya?
Nimara amiaʼwaruʼsa weʼsapi nihkawenenpun ihsu semanake. Kahpashin kankantarewa niʼpatewa inran a nuya kankantarewa sehtahpachina uʼnaike.
Wiʼnawe, nuya nahtanke: Nahpuru tahshi teʼwarahpun, tatamahsu penshapirianke a nuya kankanterinke. Yusparin iteke ihpura ina nuya nanan.
¿Wiʼnawe iʼsha peʼpeihtunwe?
Iʼyawe, ihsu iʼwarayake kuya aʼpeinankunwe. Ku nueiterawe ira uʼnani tapirin iʼnaransu. Ku naniterawe ayankasu. Tata yunkirawe, ku ahsu awariunwe, inaran sehterawe ahkekeran nuninsu nahtanawe niʼtun.
Niʼke, wiʼnawe, nani sami ya paʼantuwachinen inshateranta, tahpake kurihke paʼankaman kirihka aʼchinpei yaʼkunkaman.
Ama pihpikesuwe nani iʼwaraya anutarin, kasu maʼni maʼshamareterante iʼsha puntuchituwe tahshi, paʼawa chasu ninaʼwa nuya taweri.

Mahshuya uʼmapachin yaʼkari ninanukeran, Nuyahshakeran nahkapiʼina. Aʼma inaura tananpitiʼinahsu kuʼwiana tahshinanke. Amiraʼwain taʼain niʼkuʼin nuyahshakeran. Ihsu taweri, yaiʼi kemuinenpita kahpashin kankantawi peike nuya kankimarin niʼtun.
Ku nuyarinkuwe aʼkayan tatamahshuruʼku pihpikasu, ira ahke niʼtun inaran ya weʼerawe nimantaratun kanuhterawe.
Kepake ihsu panka samira inara nahtanteke nuya yamura. Aʼma paʼankesu naʼkun, inapuchin nuya kurihki maʼpatare inaran kanpiatahpari nani semanake.
Unpuwa, ahpimahshu. Ihsu tawerimiahchin Maitarewa nunshake ahke ninanuʼpa kankunkaware. Kema keparan taʼna mukaru ka tahparawe puʼpian kusharu mamapaya nininsu.
Wiʼnapi tatamahshuin ku chiweteriun nihpuni, ku kechihtunwe irahka nananuʼsa yaʼwerinsu kahtanpihsu ahke.
¿Tahshita, ina weʼehkapun nuya?

Uhshiwe shaʼwirin tatanen paʼnin ahke tananke. Nimara nuyawantuachin pihpirarin. Ina shaʼwirin ina tatanen irahpa peʼperin inaran keparin kehsha kapakamare. Ku nituhterawe uʼmaramara ku nihpun waʼkirarin. Nimara ninkuan taware. Kari ya tewarawe shaʼwipachina ayareʼ na nunin. Tenin nuyarin iratakahsu ushahkeran nararuʼsa niʼkamare. Nimantaratun nuhsha keʼihtunwe yaʼi mare.
Ku taʼtarewawe ihseke, nihpiriunwe yunkirawe unpuhsu chinuhterehsu ihseke.
Piʼpian aʼpatumake pihshateʼ paʼterinsuʼ.
Wiʼnawe, nahtanke nuya aʼchinawehsu: kankanenke teʼwaran tahshi tananke. Kahpashin kankanteke ihpura inaran yusparin iteke kankirin aʼpininsu.
¿Waʼwaruʼsa winakapuna teʼwatuna?
Irake kenannanken nihpura, kahtapaʼihtenkeun iwe peʼshakasuʼ
Paʼterinsu nuya niʼin kuʼwara paʼayantaraʼsuwe.
Wiʼnawe, weʼenante peʼtentatun weʼehke ni aʼpeikaman panka sapukeran inaran waʼan nuʼsa ku nuneninpuwe nunentu peike paʼpatera.

¿Ka paʼihtuwetu waʼwasha aʼshin nunterawe pihkeran? Pihshirun nuyahpiachin paʼan ihtuwe inaran puʼpian yamura kusharumare. ¿Yaʼwechihtunku tu taweri kankimakamare ama tahshitamarewe? Nuyarinku uhsharan iratamare, paʼantupihsu nihkawepuchin.

¿Waʼwasha teʼwaterin iyahsha yaʼkarikahsu aʼshin iwe kahtawarin peʼperinsun? Paʼpi nahtanterin nuya hihpachin. ¿Kuahsu nuyawe inaura pakamare inaran yusparin tehkamare? Nuya iyahsha nininsu nuwanterawe nuya nanan nuntakahsu, tenin paʼpin nuyakeran.
Tahshi nihpachin uruntaʼawa aʼna tawinan peike, Teʼwa aʼpawatuwa kemuinenpuwa nuyahshakera chinuhtawi ina peianake.
Iʼsha pamatupachina nahpurawatun naʼkun uʼnanpachina, kahken saʼawe sehterin. Ihpukeʼ, nuntekeʼ ama inaurahchin nahpuruʼ patekesu peikeran. ihpuke wenuka keteke ama inuarachin pahtekesuʼ ina taweri.

¿Ina shaʼwirin tanan waru Yu ʼsawatun maʼpatamare sami chinpi? ¿Ina mihtayutenaʼ pi nuyanterin aʼnuarahchin inanta manurarin uʼmakamare niʼtun? ¿Nuwantapuna nimara ina ni kanpiakaimare kuʼwara kemuinenpita sehteyahtaraʼsuwe?

Iyahsha ka nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu shaʼwirin inpita paʼpi tanantapuna. Nimara nanpewi muhtuwike kaʼnan naʼarinpa. Teʼpi peʼpewi namuruʼsa inaran aʼna niʼnira shintenmahshu. Nimara ipi kemararin u nihpun tuhpinan uʼmapun. Inawa shaʼwepi uʼmararinsu winareʼna. ¡Ma ya pakatunada tahshiramiachin paʼpi! Nimara uʼmakapuna tahshiwachin, ikiruwinan nihpiriunwe kahpashin kankantereʼ na maʼsha tehpalisu kemapuna.
¡Unpuwa! sami kepaʼawa paʼantupipa.
Niʼnawe nahpuru taweri paweririnawe aʼna yamurake inaran arehse, ku yunkirawe nuya aʼna ketemarinawe.
Iʼwatereke, ku kenanuwawe ira nuhteken.
¿Ku nañanteranwe nuyahsha nuntakahsu kemuinen teweterinkensu? ku nañanterawe; ninarahrawe nuyahsha yaʼwekamare, nahpuatun nuyahsha inaran kahpashin yaʼwerawe.
notes: Spanish edited by translator before translating (similarity 0.97)

text: Nuwanteran ihpura, kari kaʼtaintunkenwe iʼkeʼpaʼ.

¿Anuyahtenaʼpimahsu ku ihkankiariunwe waʼwasha nunenkamare aʼna ninanukeran? Ku, ina ku naniteriunwe ahke tanan pentuntakahsu nimantaratun uʼnanta yaʼkaritirarin. Shaʼwirin nuyahshakeran ku ihpura ihkankuaniunwe, nihpiriunwe nararaʼwenen aʼpararin aʼna piyapi nuwiterinke.

Unpuwa, waʼwaruʼsa. Yaʼi taweri uʼnanpachin kanpuwara wensekariuwa inaran amiareʼwa peike. Nimara imin shipirin mare sehtariuwa. nihpiriunwe kahpashin kankantarewa nuya chaʼeruamare inaran kahpashinkeran tahshiraya ni niantaruwa.
Nuyahsha nihke, ahke irataran.
unan anutuchina, ichimiaran pehen anarachin inaran ninaran kankunarasu nuya kankantuwina
Wiʼnawe, yaʼi taweri iʼshakeran peʼirawatu sami nanpiru mahsawatu kentawatu, kema puʼpian tahpake inshateranta kañuwachin peike.

Nimara wiʼnapi naʼwanin sanapi paʼninsu ahke kumuinenpitare. Nimara ina ku nanitapunwe tananpitakahsu sehtu nimantaratun sahkatunen iminke. Nimara ina nuya niʼkapun yunki nuyahshakeran nuya taweri ku tahpapunawe nuʼwitu kankanke. Ina yusparin teʼin, inari aʼchinterin winakahsu piʼi tananke anutuachina.

e o regresarás corriendo a tu casa lejana? ¿Sehteransumare nunenanken iʼwapuchin winantamare? Manuke, nani iʼwaraya paʼsarin narakeparihchi. Aʼpeike tahpawatan sehturu paya yaʼweterinkehsu, inapihkeran naʼwanan taweri nuyahsha yaʼweransu. Muhtuparin kunaike piwirarawe pensha yaʼkari. ¿Ihpura tahshi kehparitaran karuʼku u taʼareʼna ayamararan ahke peinenkehpa
Ku nuyarinku tatanuwe ninakamare ahke irake, nimara amirawe inaran ku aʼnuarahchin kankiriunwe yunihkapunku.

¿Nuyahsha ahpiraʼwa kahtawarawe tu pantaʼpi nunshinanpa paʼanpun? kari penenawe aʼma puʼpian mare paʼankamarewe, naʼkun niminenkeran iraterin niʼtun. ¿Ku shaʼwiʼihtuwe kuʼwara paʼantenaʼpiruʼsa kankiahtaraʼsu? Nimara nahpunin ninawe inapuchin.
¿Naʼnerantu wiʼnan nahsha waʼwatahpun?
¿Ku nahtaintun maʼninteranta wiʼnan ku kushaterinwe nihpunin yaʼi taweri? ku kahsu nanichitewe nihkakaʼwesu inauchin tanareʼnen wiʼnawe ku maʼninteranta keterawe.

Nunentenaʼpipaya shaʼwirin nuyahshakeran mamapaya aʼnanarin pimun shapunen aʼna sanawi ina nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu kañapi niʼtun. Sanawi nu naniteriunwe pakakahsu paʼantupiʼpa, inari puʼpian aʼpatarin aʼna waʼwashake. Inapihkeran sanapi nuyahtuwachin naʼkun paʼananin. Nunentenaʼpi tenin kahtawatakahsu ina nahpa nuya yaʼnure. Waʼwaruʼsa niʼpi inaran nituhtapi nuya yaʼwekamare. Inapuchin nuyahsha yaʼwekauna iʼsha yaʼkari.
Tahshiraya paʼsarawe petete iʼshaparihchin, amiraʼwa. Puʼpian maʼsha keparawe kuhtaruteke. Waʼkipatu, tehsaran uʼnani yaʼkupirin irake niʼtun tehsaran.
Kiyahsu mainuʼsa werun uʼurai aʼma kañukamarewe. Nuya nani tahshiramiachin nihkakasu aʼma sapukamarewe nuyanke weʼninsu.
¿Kuʼwara shaʼwitaranken shaʼwiate paʼnesuʼ, pentuntapu naʼkun iʼshanaruʼsa nanteʼ ikihtupirawe?

Iʼyawe, aʼma waʼkikehsu:tatamahshu yaʼnupachin iya aʼpawike, nuyahshakeran nahkawike. Niʼsaran kahpashin kankantarin niʼpachinpu. Manuke, wihteke iʼirate ihpura. Ina shaʼwirarin winareʼna shaʼwinan iʼshakeran pihpirinsu. Naʼkun naʼwaninpu inaran weʼsarin nuya yunki keran kankakeʼpa.

Manuke aʼma naʼnekehsu naʼkun. paʼsare nimara mamapayataʼpa pantaʼpi aʼnira kapari. nimara ina puʼpian a nuya kankantarinke. Aʼma sehtekesu tuhpimare, nani naʼwerarin. Paʼa mañahtun kuʼwara uʼnananin, inapuchin irake yaʼnupiare.
Kuʼ amirawe nanei, uhsharan.
¿tawerianpitereʼ kaʼisha, kemanta waʼwanpita tewatupi wira tahshi?
Kahpashin kankanchihturiuwa yuntunuwa naʼkun kurihki yamura inaran tuma paʼankamare nihpuni, ihsu piʼihke puʼpian senateruahsu paʼmarin
Nimara nuyahshakeran mamanuwe nunchihtuwe, naʼkun naʼwanin waʼwasha iʼsha peʼnate paʼninsu nahpuatun ku nuyawe kankanteriunwe.
Nahtanpu,sanapi, nuyahsha niʼin waʼwin naʼsha waʼwaterinsu. Nimara winapun nireipachin inaran nyuhsha nahtanpun kanpitari keteramahsupuchin.
¿Tahpake nuya yunki ina iyahsha ni payarinsureʼken?
Nuyahshaheran weʼka iterawe, ahpiaʼwa. Nuyahshakeran kusharu peʼperawe nimantaratun ku iʼsha nañanterawe, yaʼi tahshiramiachin maiteruwa ninanuʼpa ihkankamare.
Tahshita iyahsha, Tahshi yunkipate waʼwaterehsu, Tahshi teʼware,
¿Wekapun uhshiwe panka iʼshakeran pihtamare? Ihpukapu kahpashin kankankeran inaran nañatarawe senterawehsu inamare yaʼi taweri puchin.
ku yunirawe nuyahpiachin aʼnawitanke, paʼpinsu manurin tananke yunkipirinwe wiʼninin ninasarin peiʼpa.
Manuaʼa, nimara tahshiramiachin pihpikari. Paʼmarare yunsankeʼpa, nunshake nanperare inaran nuʼtehken maitare ninanukeʼpa kuʼwara piʼi ʼkirarin.
- Ahpimahsu paʼnin mihtayutapun inaran ku uʼmariunwe iʼwara. - Aʼma teʼwakehsu, yuhse yunkike inamare inaran sehteransu kankanenke tahpake.
¿Uhsharan ninakapun waʼwatakahsu?
Ku nuyahsha kankunkariuwa panka iʼsha ku pentuntuatewa nuyahshakeran.
Uʼuhke iʼsha teʼnai inaran chinuhteke, wiʼnawe; ya kankunpatan chinihken ninanukeʼpa, nahtanke mahshuruʼsa peneninkensu.

Kema nuʼwitatun saweni puʼuteranku nihpuni, Nimara puʼpian nuʼwichihtuwe. Inapihkeran nuyahsha nunchitenku, kemahsu wiʼnainke kari nuwanteranken. ¿Ku aʼnuarahchin yuʼihtunwe? Niʼke nani paʼsarawe tananke nimantaratun iʼwatarawe. Ka kahpashin kankanchihtuwe Kema kahtawaranku yunkirawe nihpuni. Ku nuwanterawe mamanen sehtakasu naʼkun waʼkiraran nihpuni. Manuke, wiʼnawe aʼma yaʼnupikesu kahken waʼnanupitareʼken, yuhsemare.
¿Wiʼseke nani yakushatupatan?
¿Kahpashin ninuwe kankanchihtunwe niʼnanke nihpuni?

nimara kema, ayamaranke iʼwareya irake, yunkiʼintun nunpisuʼ irahka. kahsuʼ nimara teʼwa, sehtu nahtaʼintu tashinanke nuwaremareke tanankeran. nimara sehteʼitu kahpuchin, ana taweri iratereke chinehken.
Weʼkamaʼ, ahpimahshu. Ku tewa yaʼweterinkuwe. tata paʼnin iʼsha peʼnateʼ ku wentayatarinwe. Naʼwanawe kaurahchin nimiriu nihpateraʼ.
Yuʼawa ihsu pihshate kiʼshamare.
¿Kañurahpu yunkiran samira keshinkumare, ku naniterawe pakatu paʼankamare? yusparin iyahsha; ina ninawehsu a nuya kankanterin yaʼi kemuinupita.
Ku kanpuarahchinwe puntutariwawe naʼkun iʼshanaturuʼsa, iyaruʼsa.
Kehsha yuʼsawatun nahsha uskuru maʼpateran.
Weʼkama, ku kemaura uʼuhkapunwe, nahtantaran kahtawainensu waʼyantupatan.
Ku kuruhkereʼken paʼananwe shapun.
Kechin inauran yaʼihpiken.
Yaʼinpuwa wiʼnapuwa aʼpeiʼawa iʼshake paʼmawachina, inaran mahshuruʼsa ihpuku nuyahsha kankantaimare yaʼi taweri.

Nani ya paʼpachina iyahsha, kari nanan keterawe kuʼwara paʼshataraʼsuwe. Nuyahsha sahkateke inaran yusparin iteke insuna naʼikamare keterinkensu uʼnanpachina. Aʼma nañantekehsu kusharu tahshiramiachin nihkamare chinirupi yaʼwetainkemare tananke. Kahpashin kankanterawe ihsu yaʼi piʼi ni ketere nuhsuru. Ihpura sehterewa nihpiruinwe, nimara kahpashin kankantatun uʼmararan. Nuyahsha pake inaran ni aʼpeike.

¿Unpu ni aʼpeiawata a kankan kañu mahkainpumarewe? Aʼma tehkein iʼsha ku inpitariwara uʼwawasu. Ku nahpunin kankantewatewawe, peike ninaʼawa, paʼa nunentu peike. Inahke nuyahshakeran nunensarinen nimantaratun ku kurihki maʼparinenwe. ¡Inapuchin ku kañurarewawe!
Ni nunterai kemuiruʼku ni ketamare paʼanteraihsu peiʼpa kankumapatui, nani iʼwatarai niʼtun nimantaratun iʼsha pentuntarai manureʼna.
Ku ihsu tawerimiahchin maʼpatuwatanwe, ina niwirinensu ku ketarinenwe, ahpaiʼwa.

Aʼma paʼyankehsu wiraitarimare, Iyaʼwa. Naʼwekapun aʼnarahchin inaran piʼpiaʼa yawaʼta nihkamare. Aʼma sehtekehsu, ka kemaruʼku nihsarawe akuanake. Uʼnan anuterinsu pei aipiteke nahtankariuchin ni ihpuaʼa.
Ninake iʼwakasu iʼsha pirianke.
Yunkirai aʼnarahchin pawerekahsu paʼantunaʼpi, manurarai niʼtun inaran uʼmakamare kuʼ wara kamutechin nihshataraʼsuwe.
Ku wanirarawewawe peʼpetu kehken niʼtun.
Unpuwa, iyahsha, sapuwatan aʼma tehkeike amakehsu, ¿nuya?
Nihke iʼwararinsu inaran ayanke.
Ku manintaranta teninwe ayataʼsu, nihpaunawe ina nuya nininsu ku tananpiterinwe, teʼwaruʼna ayatatun nihsapirinwe.

¿Nituhteran kema unpu nuhsururawehsu iyahsha nunenterinsu tanan pahkaturuke? Ya nunteran nuyahshakeran, ku manupinanwe. ¿Sami nanpiru kepateke inaura iʼshakeran wentapachin? Nuyahsha ninehsu suʼsurin puʼpiankeran ninanu yaʼwereke.¿Ayanteke yaʼi taweri yusparin tenansu wiʼnanpita nuhtetechinachin? Aʼchinapi nahtanterin nituhtamare niʼkamare nuyahshakeran kahtawakahsu maʼpayupihsu taweri sahkaikeran.
¿Ihketa akurawe taʼna paʼterawesu?keshiku, yuʼsemare, nuyasha kankantamare naʼpuatun taʼshi paʼneweke naʼnekankanawe weʼerawe ku yunkirawe nuyasha
Wenseintaretewa ku tawereyahtasuwe nunsha peʼpeaʼwa, mahsu ikiruarewa chineike maitarewa niʼtun inaran ninanuʼpa iratakahsu ahke.

Yah iraterawe petete iʼshaparihchi kankunkamare kemuinupita ninanunenpa. Iratereke naʼweter aʼna puʼpian iʼshana nunshaya puʼpisha naʼwerinsu. Yaʼtetewatera mahshuruʼsa pahkari ninarinaku. Nahpauatun neʼpeterawe inaran shaʼwirawe samira paʼankamare ayanpinan, nahterarawe tatanuwe nunterinkuhsu.
kemuwinen nuʼwitu kankan yaʼwetewachina,inara nuyahsa kankantunatarin

¿Unpuwanta teʼwa maninku nani taʼna kahpanante niʼnauke? Shaʼwituku, ¿Kemarinta naʼwanan? Nuya kankanterawe Weʼsaran nihkapunku niʼtun, iyawe. ¿Nituhteran Unpuruta uʼmararan ninanuke? Manuke, kema nananen nuwanterawe, ku awantwrawe naʼkun ihsu taʼtawasu.
¿Ku kahpashin kankanteraun ihpurankusumare amiaʼwa?
¿Ina unpusu yunkirin waʼwishinen? Winarinsu naʼwaʼin, tahpain nuya kankanterinsu inara ninaʼin nani tahshi yuhkike.
Kema yuʼke kanaransu paʼantatun pantaʼpi nuyahshakeran, waʼwaruʼsa yinkirawatun peike yaʼwewisu
Aʼma paʼyankehsu, nuwantarawehsu, nuʼtehken nuʼserate maʼa. Yah pentuntere iʼsha ninanukeʼpa, samira yumeke nininsu kehken nihpiriunwe.
¿Ihsu semanake ku kumuiruʼsa weʼsapiuwe ihsu yaʼkare ninanuke? Nanitawe a nuyakankantamare kankanuwe nahkaranchin nahtantamare nuninsu yaʼwerauke.

¿Yunkiran mamanuwe teninsu paʼantakahsu kuahsu ni awekamarewe? Ihpura paʼne nihpuni, nahtanke ihtuwe ¿nuyahshakeran paʼantenaʼpi nuʼten paʼterinsu? Ka paʼan ihtuwe kanchura inaran puʼpian arehse, ¿Nahteteran, waʼwasha, aʼnataweri ayantarawe iratantamare nuyahsha?
Ku taʼna nañantakahsu, nimantaratun panka weʼehta ku kenuawe
Uʼnan anutepachina tatanuwe yunkirawe. A nuya kankantuwe, iyawe, pensha pirianke wensaʼa inaran nuan ʼan uʼnan naʼwekahse.
Tatanuwe, nuyahsha nunteku ku ninarankenmare.

Nahtanku weʼka iterankensu nuya kankankeran, paninan nahterawehsu. Nuʼten mare kema Nituhteran tahshi teʼwarehsu suʼsurin tananke iratupihsu nahtanpatera. Yunkirawe tatanuwe nanpirinsu. Nimara ninararawe aʼpinkasu, ihsu nanunsha mama kenanin nuya yaʼwetakasu.

Nunentunpaya shaʼwirin sanapi aʼnanin atari aʼna yaʼwerin nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu atariaʼwaruʼsa yaʼwetaimare. kemani nuwantuachin naʼkun atari pehtawakahsu, inari kechehtunwe kahtu tuhpinan. Inapihkeran ina shʼshi yuniwachiʼihtunwe nuya aʼkakamare. Nunetunaʼpi tenin inapuwatuwa naʼkun kusharu yaʼwetarinpuwa yaʼi taweri. Waʼwaruʼsa nuyahpiachin atariraʼwasa niʼihtunawe.
Wiʼnawe, tahshiraya pentuntaran kara iʼshana iminkeʼpa ihkankamare;kuʼwara paʼshataraʼsuwe chinuhteke puʼpian, aʼma tananke iratekehsu manupinan.
¿kahtankasu wiʼnanpu nihka teʼwawachinara?
Ahke peike uʼmawatan, kepake nuyahsha kankanteransu kemamare; aʼpeike yah inauranpuchin, ka mamaruʼsa waishirun aʼpeirawepuchin aʼpeike.
¿Nahkaranchin niantarawe tuhpirawe?

Maniahchin, ahpiaʼwa, kahtawake mamanen paʼain samura, nuhka, nuya pichike kurihke ayanansu, ama tuhpinan yuʼkesuwe, piyapi nuwitupirankunta, inapihkeran inapitasu naniantapuna, maniahtu pake paʼantuku kuʼwara iʼwararin.
¿Manu iratapun irake?
Nahteke irahkamahshuruʼsa iranen: Ikiruwatan, wenseke irakai naʼpike inaran chinuhteke, inaran yunkike inpitata naʼwepi kuʼwara ke paʼshahtaraʼsunwe.
Pantaʼpi nuya paʼtunke paʼanewa nihpuni, yuntun ihteriuwa puʼpian teranta kurihki iʼsha pamatuwachin kuahsu naniterewa pakakahsu.
Pawerinunpua ihsu sharuʼsariamareʼ.

Nahtanke penenankensu, wiʼnawe nuwanterawesu, taweri manutarinpu. Ahke inuteʼpa paʼmapatu, yusparin itariuwa insuna weʼekasu ketuachinpuwa. Aʼma chiruhkesu ikiruwinan weʼpiranwe iraterankeran. Nuʼserate peʼpeke inaran yankuransu, ina raʼ. Wahpuru iʼshanake tahshi ihkantupachinpuwa, iʼchimarawe waʼwishin nanparin. Taʼake, wiʼnawe, mañahtun pihpiaʼa kuʼwara pamachahtaraʼsuwe.

Nunentunaʼpimahsu tenin ina aʼnanarin saweni iyahsha ina yaʼwerinsu nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu ketarin iminen nihsankamare.Wiʼnawi ku maʼshateranta yaʼweteriun nihpuni, inari kechehtunwe ku yunkiahsu. Inapihkeran ina iyahshari ketarin pantaʼpi ina aʼnanpimare. Inapuchin yaʼihpichachin nuyahsha yaʼwerawi. Tatamahshuri aʼchinterin waʼwaruʼsa ni ketakahsu maʼsha ina paʼpi nuya. Kahpashin kankantere inshateranta kahtawachinpura ku nihpu iyahsha nuhsururinpuhsu.
Weʼka, iyahsharuʼsa. ku tewarawe iyahsha ihseke yaʼweapun. Naʼwanawe naʼkun pahkauru nunentirinsu nihkatuwe kahpashin kankanterawe ihpura.
¿Yusparin iterin kuʼwara paʼshahtaraʼsuwe?
Puʼpian tahpaʼawa nanpirumare.

¡Nahtanku, piyapirʼsa ka winaikeran yaʼwepihsu! Kankanuwe sehturi mentahterin. Paʼantupipa kankuwatama, yunkiku paʼterinsu kuʼwara yuʼme akuyahtaraʼsuwe. Aʼma peʼnate niʼtukuhsu. Kari paʼpuyararame sahkatukeran inaran pawerarawe insuna sahkatu kahtawarinkuhsu.
Tuhpinan uwantupi, wiʼnashanuwe.
Nimara ku shaʼwiterawe yaʼi yunkirawehsu. Tuhpinan ihpurawe chinihken kuʼwara tanan pentuhchahtaraʼsuwe iminke paʼsareparihchi.

Waʼwasha, nahtanku nuya nanan nunterankensu. Kawera iraterawe ina iʼshaparihchi nihpuni, nahtaʼintunwe iʼsha waʼyan Kaʼtankainkumare. Aʼma nanpekehsu wahpuru iʼshake ku nuya mahtupinanawe. Nuyahshakeran nuʼserate peʼpeke aʼma aʼpekehsu. Wankui irake ikirurawe nahtanpatu chinuhtarawe yunsan nuyahshake. Mañahtun paʼa, naʼni piʼi inahpa.

Sehterai uhshipaya ku ninanukeran ayamariunwen niʼtun. Sahkatuke kehparitumara, ku nituhteraiwe. iminke naʼwanai, irahka kiyaruʼkui aʼyarin niʼtun. Nimara uʼmakapun iʼsha winkintuachin, nihpiriunwe ku inshateranta shaʼwiterinkuiwe.
Nahtanke weʼka iterankensu, aʼshatu, inaran yusparin iteke shaʼwiterinkensu uʼmakamare.
¿Nimara ku nuyawe tahshiramiachin iʼsha pentuntuatera inaran kankunawe tatanutaʼpa nuntamare?
Ina ku shaʼwiate paʼnesu kenanaunawe ira,
Nimara teʼwa paʼnin nuyahsha ni nuntahpari.
kanpua aʼnea aʼnea naʼpatariwa piʼpiyan.

¿Kema niwike aʼnaintunkuwe asuhkaru ihsu semanake mare? Sehterawe waʼwaruʼsa ku kashin uʼuhkapunawe peike. Ninawatanku panka samariataweri wari, karinke pawereʼihtenkunwe aʼchinanaʼpinku niʼtun. ¿Tahparumiachin nahtantakahsu, puʼpian pawantarinpuwa ku maʼshateranta puʼpian paʼterinsu yaʼweriunwe.

Iyawe tanankeran, nahtainke:ka saweni mukaru ketawatenken nunsha ya maʼparanke nihpuni, ¿Unputa Nuwanteran kechinke? Nunka ku teʼwapinanwe. Inaran nuʼten nininsu nahtanteke. Aʼma manutukuhsu manurawe niʼtun. Ihsu yunki kahpa niʼin, tahshiramiachin iʼshapuchin.

¿Unpu yusparin itapunta iyahsha iminke ya kahtawarinkensu? Weʼka ichi ihtuntu nuyahshakeran nani tahshirawachin. ¿Puʼpian wenu uʼshitapin inaura Peinenke kankupachin? Inapuchin waʼwaruʼsa aʼchintariuwa aʼma nañantamaruwe kahtawatakahsu. ¿Tahparan yunki imiranen irake amiransu? Aʼchinapi ihsu nahtanterin aʼma nañantamaruwe nanpiruasu nuyahsha ayankamare nuya nanankeran.

Nuya chinuhteke ahpimashu. Kaʼnanuʼsa tananke yaʼwerinsu teʼwateran aʼkayan nihpuni, shaʼwichihtunkuwe. kari nahpuinahchin ninaihtuwe yaʼkuanake inaran a nuya kankanchihtuwe, inari nuyhsha kankan a nuyahchihtunwe.
Unpuwa, manuaʼawa samira paʼankamare.
Nimara uʼnan aʼpeinenpuwa iʼsha yunsanke.
Nimara teʼwa nahtane inaran nuyahsha ni nuntantare.
Ni nunterai maʼsuna paʼankamare pawaninsu, nahpuatun taweriachin pantaʼpi kemarai, inaran shapun inaran yuʼnana pawanin niʼtun.
Ku nahtantarawe niwike shapun chimkana mamapayanke, maʼmareta iniran ku paweretaranwe ni kemupirusanta keʼparitaran taʼpanan ihsu ninanuke.
Paʼsarawe unpu tawerimareteranta kunpanuwe yaʼwerinpa.Puʼmuterawehsu pakamare puʼpiraʼwaya tarantarin. Ninaku nuyahshakeran, taweri nuyahtupachin.
Wiʼnawe, iʼsha winkin nimara inaran waʼkiruwa naʼkun. Peʼpeke peʼpetunen nimara ahke ira ninararinpu.
¿pentunchintunwe nihka ihsu iʼsha ku teʼwatapunawe?
Chinuru yaʼwetarinku inaran nunshake a nanperarawe.
Panka iʼsha pentuntuwatan, nuʼteken nara yunihke pahkekaman. Aʼma iyaʼwa imiranen aʼpekehsu,nuya aʼpeike.
Ku paʼyanawe puʼpianteranta wiʼnan nuyahterin nahtantatu; ku nituhteranwe unpu nuya kankateraweta ina nanan nahtantatu, iyawe.
¿Pahtarewa ihshana nahpurupi inta?

Ku tanapiterawe yunkirawehsu tahshirayamiachin teʼnawanke aʼpetupi yaʼkari. Wiʼnapi ku ya kuhshateriunwe inaran ku ya nuniunwe. Ku inaura tananpiterawe tanawanke. Ninarahrin waʼwina nuyahsha ihkankasu. Waʼwatupachina, ihpurawe chinihken inaran ku maʼshateranta nunawe.
¿Yunkirawe ina nahpuru iʼwaraya iʼshake?
¿Yuʼke kema nuya kankanteransu, iya?
Nuniawa ira inkakmare peʼipa.
Waʼan nuʼsa nuya kankantupi iʼsha pentuntakasu ahke nimantaratun sahkaimiachin, nimantaratun pakakahsu ahke nunshinankeʼpa ichi kaʼpa kankantapi waʼwaruʼsa.
Ku aʼchinpei ira nuyarinkuwe, ahke niʼtun anarahchin kanuhterawe ina iʼsha pentutamare iyaʼwaruʼku
Weʼka taʼawa kuʼwara paʼanchataraʼsuwe.
Ku sehterawe nahpuru taweri; kema winaransu a nuya kankanterinku inaran nituhtawatu tanankeran nyua uʼmaransu.
¿Yunkiran pihpirehsu iʼwarapiriunwe ku nahtanawe yuʼme kehkeninsu? ¿Unpuwanta ihpura naʼkun kehkenterinku?
Kemuiruʼsa nuyahshakeran ni aʼpeiʼina: aʼnanterin nunshanen ku nuya ni nuntepirenawe inaran taweriri paterin. Aʼma maʼsha yuʼkuhsu ku nuya nunkapumarawe.
Irawankana ninararawe wahpuru iʼsha weʼsarinsu.

Nahtantu, wʼnaupita ihsu ruʼpake; Kankanuwe rupahterin kanpitamare.Paʼpatama paʼantapuna, yunkiku paʼterinsu kuʼwara yuʼshahtaraʼsuma maʼteranta. Aʼma unkairamahsu tuhpinan yuʼkuhsu. Ka nuyahshakeran ka paweretarawe taʼtahpatuwa tana nahtanewa.
Ka yunkirawe ku nuyawe naʼkun paweretakasu uskuru naʼkun paʼterinsu; Nimara aʼna ninanuke puʼpian paʼterin.
Kawera iminke, ku naniterawe yunkirausu suʼyawe.

Iʼyara, ku nituhterawe ayankasu nahkarachachin. Tanan yaʼihpi yaʼkuirin ku taweri yaʼnuriunwe. Ku kenanawe tatamahshu maʼsuna aʼnuterinpuahsu. Uʼnan pihtarinpuwa ahke, kankanuwe ihpuranta yunkirahrin ina teʼwa yaʼwerinsu irahka.

Iyahsha, ya nahtananke iʼwaraya weke niʼkiku nunkari. Kema shaʼwituwatanku, kari waʼwaruʼsa a tunachihtuwe nani tahshiramiachin. Yuhsemare, nahtanku sehterawehsu. Aʼma naʼni anutakahsu tananpitekesu ku anuya kankantenawe.
Peʼiwite warun teninun tahshi aʼpayaninku, ka chasu piʼpishamiachi aʼpayaninku, nihkaunawe yunkirawe kema chinehken ihpuranku niʼtun.
Ina ku kenaniwe ira tashitewachin.
Ni aʼpeike shunahkeran.

Nani nunteraweke iyahshanuwe, inachin inachin iterawe ushahkeran nanan keran. Nuya kuhshateke, aʼma ni tapikehsu ahke saʼkatuwatan. Yusparin iteke kemuinenpita nuhsururinkensu, nimara ina kahpashin ichi kankanterin piyapiruʼsa. Ka yunkirawe winaransu iminke inaran sehterewa paʼnan niʼtun. Nuyahsha nihke yaʼipikeran inaran uʼmake iʼsha winkintuwachin
Ku waʼwasha peʼpemariuwe inaran taʼnantan nahpuruchachin.
Kentaʼinan peʼpetu nunke
Uʼnan tahshiramiachin taʼtewachin, tahshiramiachin pihpikari maʼsha kepate; aʼpeiawa yamura shipiruwachin iratereke.

Wiʼnashanuwe, aʼma naʼkun waʼkikehsu. Atarikayu ya paʼanpatan aʼnapita paʼanpipuchin kemanta paʼanke, inapuwatan ku inshateranta nuʼwiarinkenwe. Ama naʼkun aʼpatekehsu piyapiruʼsa kurihke yaʼwetuachin. Ku nunpipatanwe paʼanteransu nuyahsha pihpirarin. Pake taʼareʼna, kepake yuʼme kuʼwara atariruʼsa akuyahtaraʼsuwe nimantaratu ya iʼwararin.
Uʼnanpachin kemaraura kankanteran, naniteran yunkikahsu kemuinenpita nuyahshakeran; inawa ninararinin peike, yusparin iterinen pensha yaʼkariran niʼtun.
Nuwanterawe tumamareʼtun paweretakahsu, inaran pantaʼpi peʼperawatui kemarai ninanuʼpa.

Nahtanku weʼka itaramahsu, kemuinupita. Kiyahsu ku nuya weʼwraiwe waʼwaruʼsa sapurinsu yunkiatui. Nimara shaʼwirinsu nuya nuntakariuwawe pihkeran shaʼwipiriunwe. Nuyahshakeran tahshita iterai, aʼpeiraʼawa waʼwaruʼsa penshapiriankeran peike.
¿Ina maʼpaterankeran shapun paʼanpun?
Tahpantaihtuwe ka kankiarawihsumare?
Weʼka taʼawa, inaran wayuruʼsa shaʼwiawa paʼankamare.
Paʼmapi peiʼpa uʼnayanake.
Chinuhtekeʼ, ahke pawananin.

Kiya penshunpatui nara ite nunihsawatui ikihtun nunenkamare, nahta ihtuwe nara yaʼkari ninainkumare. Kahpashin kankankeran chinuhchihteriuwawe tahshinanterinke inaran kahtuyaʼpinpu ku saʼkairanwe ira kenan ihteriuwawe naʼkunu paʼterehsu.
Iyawe nuhsururawehsu, peʼpetu ku nihkaparirawe aʼma pataʼahsu.

Ku peʼpetunen pateranwen yunsanke, ¿Nuʼten? Iʼwara inake chiweran. Aʼma yaʼnupireʼna tananke iratekehsu. Aʼma ninatekehsu karinken yuniantaʼinkensu tahshi nahkaranchin, ku niʼnawe ira nara yaʼkupirinku niʼtun.

Nimara ina kemapi kahpashin kankanchihtunwe wiʼnin ayamarin kuʼwara uʼnan anuchahtaraʼsuwe nihpuni. Nimara ina nuya nanan kemaihtunwe kemuiruʼsamare. Tenan ina yunkisawatun nani iʼwaraya nunshinanke ninatapun, niʼsawatun nunsha yaʼkariterinsu.
Nimara mamanuwe tananpitawenku witiyu puʼpian mare paʼankamare ihpura.
Aʼma paʼsarawe ikahtakuhsu, ku puʼmuterawe. Ku naʼnei awanterawe, inaura aʼnuterin. Ku karuʼku nihsaramawe peʼikamare iʼshanake. Weke ihpuku, aʼma pakehsu manuatun ina irake.
¿Maʼta umpuranta kankiwatan ikirukeran?nunanku ka ninawesu yaʼshikeran: wenkeʼ taʼna, chinuhteke inaran nañanteke ahke ira nininsu.

¿Yunkiran nahpuru tahshiramiachin ni awere imin irake? Ka yai tenawe chihken inaran teʼwarawe aʼpayananken niʼtun. ¿Unpuwanta nihka inapuchin nuʼwiterewa ikiruwatera? Inapihkeran narahsuke wenserate nuyahsha nunai. ¿Ku nuyahsha kankanteranwe nanan nuyatahpiruwe? Ku kahsu ahkete yai ya taʼparankenwe, amiraʼwa. Kanpuhsu kemuinpuwa, nahpatun ni nuhsuruʼawa, aʼma puʼpian mare ni nuʼwiawahsu.
¿Senaterawehsu nanitaweri kecheʼi?
Nuya ira kaʼtainkema, iyaruʼsa. Puʼpian chinterawe mahsu iʼsha wahpuru peʼnate ninarahrinku niʼtun inran nunenanuʼsa mañahtun kankunkamare kemuinuwe kañurin niʼtun.
¿Sehterawe ku kushatupachinawe?
Weʼkama, ku iratariuwe ku chinuhtupinawen puʼpianteranta.
Aʼshacha, paʼsaran tananke? ¿unpuruta uʼmararan? Manuke uinaran shaʼwituku, kanta ya pentunawe kanpitaruʼku.
Nuten napuran, iʼya: kemepunpita nuya kankatupi nihpachinara kema.nipatana kankimaransu nuya kankanterawe naʼnei pihpirin ihpuwatana nuyarinshakeran.
¿Ku paʼyaterawe wiʼnawe kañurimare? Ku inapuchinwe;ku tananpiterawe kañukahsu inaran nani taweri yusparin tenawe chiniru yaʼwetupinan kahpaitamare.
¿Tananpichihtunkuwe a kahpashin akankaintankemare ihpuatunke?
Ama kansatekesuʼ, ninakeʼ ihseke.

¿Maʼta paʼan ihtunwe kurihki keterinen ninanuke nihpuni? Ka paʼan ihtuwe nunen pahtaruru washirunuʼsa nunenkamare. ¿Paʼanchihtunwe imuya paʼanterinsu? Nuʼten paʼterinsu nihpachin, kahpashinkeran pawerechihtunwe. ¿Nuʼten iʼwa kiwirawe aʼnapita nihpiriunwe?

Maʼsu, iyahsha nuhsururawehsu: samiranuwe kepawatan aʼnaterankeʼpa, ¿Unpu yamurata kemapun uʼmapatan? Nahtanke kemaura chiniranmare, ku naʼkunwe. Nuya nunke ihpura, inapihkeran ku nuwanterawe nahtantakahsu. Ihsu yunki akurehsu kahtuyaʼpinpu kahpashin kankantaʼa
¿Niʼnan nuya kankanterawehsu niʼnanku yaʼweraweke niʼtun peʼperawehsu ayatahpu? ¿Unpu ayanchinkenta naʼkun nuhsuru, iyahsha nuhsururawehsu?
Nahtanteke weʼka iterankensu, imuya. kema nimara kanpiateran tuʼmai uskurure, ku yunkirawe nuʼten kehparitumara ina ni kanpiarehsu.
Iʼwara iʼsha nuyahpiachin nihpiriunwe nahpuatun aʼnuarahchin kankunuwa. Nuyahsha kankanteke, wiʼnawe, aʼma nunsha pihtakehsu ka peʼpetu tahparaʼsuwe.

Kiyahsu yunki kehpariterai iʼshana pentuntakahsu kuʼwara chinihken uʼnan anuchahtaraʼsuwe. Irataʼawa mañahtun nuʼten ira tananke paʼninsu imaʼawa. Ni ninaʼawa puʼpun iʼsha iʼsha uʼuhkamare. Kankunuwa yanihken peike inaran ni ibpupinan, iyaruʼsanuwe nuhsururawehsu.
Kahsu nuwanterawe tahshirayamiachin pakakahsu tananke, ira paʼtuwatera ikirurawe inaran ku awanterawe iratakahsu piʼihke

Iyahsha nuya tahpake peʼpetunen ihpuraranchin. Pentuntariuwa kara iʼsha kuʼwara kamutechin nihshataraʼsuwe inaran ku chinuhyamare Yaʼwetarinpuwa taweri. Nanpeke nunshake, yuhsemare, mañahtun kankuanʼ awa taweriachin nunshinanpa. Manuku, paʼantenapi ninararinpuwa.
Aʼma iʼsha pentuntekehsu pamatuwachin; ninake paʼmeiyaʼin inaran chinuhteke yunsanke mamanenreʼken.
Saʼan ketechinake nuwanterinsu pei mare kuʼwara tihkiatasunwe maʼsha paʼantun.
¿Ku sehterawe wiʼnawe kañupachina? Ku puʼpian mareteranta paterawe;ihpukaimare shaʼwiterawe inaran yusparin iterawe tanan nimiriuri ichi unkaterin

¿Unpu shaʼwitapunta kema nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu aʼchintenkemare shaʼtakasu nahsha iminke? Nuyahshakeran weʼka iteke nani naʼwerin niʼpatan. ¿Puʼpian wenu uʼshitapun sanuananke? Yunkirehsu nuya senatamare suʼsurin nuya yunkipatan. ¿Ayanteke yusparin tenansu wiʼnanpita niʼtichinaichin? Aʼchinapi nahtanterin aʼchintamare ihsu wiʼnapiruʼsa, nuya yunki yaʼwerinsu ina yaʼwere nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu aʼma ayatamaruwe ninanuke.
Ni pahtumatuhku kanaramasu kanpita kapini.

Mamanuwe kankipachin kemuiruʼsa niʼninkeran aʼna parihchikeran, kari ihpuihtuwe nuya kankankeran. Ninake ku teʼwapinanwe tahshinanke, waʼwawe. shaʼwiteke niʼpatan irake, inapuchin ku paʼantaranwe inaran pihpiihtunwe maʼpatamare.

Kema yaʼkuana iʼsuatun pateran nihpuni kuhshi yaʼkuintuwe, karinken nimara nunpinchihtenkunwe. Irapihkeran nuyahsha nunchihtenkunwen, nimara nañanteran unkutakahsu. ¿Ku nimara nuyahtariuwe kuʼwara kehsha kaʼshahtaraʼsuwe? Manuke, wiʼnawe kahtawaku peʼtawa uhkui. Ka kahpashin kankanchihtuwe kema nuyahshakeran pei aʼpeiran nihpuni. Ku nuwanterawe tatamahshu sehtakasu inaran nuʼwitakahsu karuʼku. Paʼa mañahtun, kuhshi tananke taʼararin.
Iyahsha, ¿Kema ihpuranta nunshake ninatahran iʼsha yunsanke kuʼwara tahshiahtaraʼsuwe nuyahshakeran peike ayankamare?
Ninatanse kiya inahke kemaruʼkui nihsaran. Niʼsaran mamapayanen nuyahtarin inaran kahpashin kankantantararin peike ina iminke iratantapachin
Ku shipin neʼmehte puʼmukariuwa, ku nuwantariuwa irateruwake.
Yunkiran kahtuyaʼpinpu uʼmarehsu.
Ihpura samira nanpiru kepake. Kanpiateke yamurake kuʼwara ni tapirarin. Senaterawe pihkeran yaʼwarin naʼkun maʼsha ni kanpakamare.

¿Yunkiran nahpuru niʼnirari atari keterin mare ni awere? Nihsha nihsha ni itere, inaran aʼnuwarahchin kuʼwaneare. ¿Unpuanta aʼnarahchin ya ni nuʼwiruwa, amiraʼwa? Inapihkeran maʼshamare winamiatere inaran nuyahsha nanan nuyahtere. Nani kahsukuwe mahshutarawe, ku wachi awetechinachin kankanterawe. ¿Ku kemahsu nuwanteranwe nuyahsha peike yaʼwekamare?
¿unpua, waʼwa unpuanta rupateran nani tashi natawantana maʼsha tananke perarinsuʼ

Ku ya aʼperawe imiranen, nininen perahtupirinenwe. ku nuyarawe iyahshanuwe pakakahsu ninanukeran. ku maitarewe iʼshanake nimantaratun nara nanpetarewe. Naʼnei ku ichi taʼterewe, nihpiriunwe ku nañanterankenwe.
¿Winakapun kahpashinkeran teʼwari patuwachin?
Nahtanchin sami paʼterinsu.
¿Ku paʼyanaun nihkatunku?
Ku kehparitapu chiwewatu, kahapshinkeran ayananawe.
Kema yunkimaranke piʼpiyan pawananin, waʼwa, nihkanawe paʼpi naʼkun yaʼwarin iʼsha, ku waʼkiananwe nanpeke ihsu wahpureke, yuhsemare.
¿Iyaruʼsa ninakapuna nunsha kankiarinsu nunshinanke?
Ni pahtumatuhku nahpuinsahchin.
¿Paʼanke ihsu pantaʼpi kanuwi?
¿Waʼwasha tahshiraya niʼsarin aʼshini nuhsururinsu? Inari yaʼkuanake ninaʼin inaran maʼpachin winarinsu nuyahshakeran.
Paʼantenaʼpi sehterin maʼsu piyapiruʼsa ku paʼpiuwe uwantapuna peʼtawaruʼsa, ku aʼpeiwachinawe kañuhsu ku taʼteriunwe.
Uhshiwe nuyahtatun uʼmarin nunentu peikeran nihpuni kahpashin kankantawatu naʼneihtuwe, sehterawe nihpiriunwe ihpuranta iʼsha panka pamaterin niʼtun.

Nani nunteraweke iyahshanuwe, puʼpian penen keterawe nuyahshakeran. Tahshiramiachin wenseke shaʼtamare inaran yusparin iteke uʼnan imin a shipiruterin niʼtun.Aʼma iyara kema nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsureʼken ni awekehsu, maʼsha ni ketuku nuyahsha yaʼwekamare. Kahsu kehpariterawe taweri yunkiatu yaʼnupiruahsu iʼshake wiʼnaupitaruʼku. Ni aʼpeike naʼkun inaran ayanke nuyawantuwachin.
Ku taweriachin kankiranwe piyapiruʼsa pantaʼpi paʼantamare.
Nuntarakema yaʼihpima iyaruʼsa, kanpuasu ya teʼwarewa maʼnintranta nahtanpatuawara tahshi, yunkipirewawe irahka mahshukuruʼsasu ianuchin nahtanpachinara ayatuna nuya kankantupi.
Kuʼ nuyawe ninanke kuʼ nuyasha kankatuwatanawe.
Iʼwa tahparewa shapun paʼankamare.
Ku nuya nituhterawe, ihpura yaʼi samira paʼanin nihpuni, ka kahpashin kankantawatu taʼaihtuwe paʼankapu mamanuwe naʼkun nuwanterinsu, nahterawe.
Tata, Ninanuke uʼmawatu paʼanterawekeran, nahtan inke puʼpian asuhkaru tahshiraya uʼuhkamare.
¿Maʼta unpukawenta iyahsha ku kehshamare pawerewate?
¿Ketaunku kanta nimara kamareʼ?
¿Nahtanteke nunenan waʼanuʼsataʼpa?
¿Kema tahshi uʼmapatan nuwiteran tawinan yunsanke, yunkiatu taweri sami paʼanawehsu irake?
Iʼwata, ina paʼanin aʼnarahchin.

¿Nuya ninawe amiraʼwaya penenawe kehsha kepawachina paʼantupiʼpa? Kari shaʼwiterawe nuyahsha kurihke maʼpachin, ama nunpintatunawe inshateranta. ¿Ku shaʼwiterawe aʼnapita paʼanturuʼsa ya nahkiterenenpu? Nimara kari imaʼi nunshinanpa.
Niaʼweretekeʼ isu pihshateʼ ina kiʼshareʼ.

Iyaruʼsa, chinarawatu sura tenawesu ihkain weratenen taʼpa, Aʼma puʼpian mare paʼankusu sahkai sahkateramahsu tananke. Nahtantuku paʼtunen. Ka nuya paweretarawe inaran nunsarawe kanpitamare, teʼwarawe puʼpian yaʼweterinpuhsu matuwachinenpuwa.
¿Maʼta tehkapun mamapaya waʼwasha suʼsurarin nihsawatun? Nuyahsha a yaʼweʼin inaran ninaʼin winarinsu iminke.
¿Ama inkankesu kuwara ihwayatasu?

Tahshita iyaruʼsa, ku inshateranta ninararawe napekamare wahpu iʼshake yaʼkunkamare ihpura tahshiramiachin. Kahpashin kankantawatu paʼnawe iʼsha peʼnahte kehsha paʼankapu. Ku sehterawe imin patapu, maʼsu ihsu taweriamiahchin taʼna peʼteantarawe.

Tahshita payahsha nahterehsu. Nuya kankankeranchachin weʼka itaranke. Kema yibkimaranke unpu nuninta tanan tahshi nihpachina inara aʼna mama unpu rupahterinta teʼwasawatun. Sehtureʼna nani tahshi ninarawe tawerikahsu, nimara Kemanta Inapuchin teʼwa nahtanan puwanakeran puchin.
Ku tahpaihtuwe sehterawehsu iyawe nuyahsha nunterawe nihpuni.

Ihsu weʼninke naʼkumiachin tahparawe, nuwantapu paʼnakasumare piʼshi, piʼshiruʼ ihsu nahsiterinke, ku nituhterawe yaʼsutanku nimara, nihkapunawe uhshrarn niwentapu, ihpurasu nihpirinwe manutarawe perahsarinau niʼtun.
Ku pahtumarawe kahpa suʼyawe niʼtun.
Manuke, puʼpian shapunen aʼnanku ihpura,mamanuwe ninararinku pehsainkamare nunshinanpa kuʼwara uʼnan anuchahtaraʼsuwe.

Mamapaya, ¿ninanuke paʼpate maʼtarunta paʼankari? Ka paʼan ihtuwe yamura inaran uskuru. ¿Ke paʼanchihtunwe imuya paʼanterinsu? Nuʼten paʼtun nihpachin, ku paʼan ihtuwe, nakun nahtanruachin, shaʼwichihtuwe puʼpian aʼpamatamare. ¿Nuʼten iʼwa puʼpian paʼterin?

Manuke, wiʼnashanewe, ama ichi ayantukuhsu. Aʼna peiʼpa paʼpatan, iʼme ku pachahtaraʼsuwe yunkike unpata aʼpateran ina wayuruʼsa. Aʼma aʼnawita naʼketehsu, nahtanke nahpuruchachin kurihke. Uhsharan pichihke kurihke ama maʼteranta pawantamarewe. Taʼake mañahtun, kuʼwara wenukari pantaʼpi tapiahtaraʼsuwe, mana ku interanta nuwantuachinwe paʼankasu.

Ina tatain nimara nuyahsha kankanchihtunwen wiʼnin ahkeran nanan aʼpa nishirin nihpuni. Nimara nituchihtunwe nuya yaʼwerahrin ina paʼninpa. Tenan ina puʼpian nanani a nuya kankanchihtunwe sehterinsu nani tahshi penshapirianke.
Nimara ka tenawe paʼpi paʼtun, nihpiriunwe nuya kankankeran, paʼantenaʼpi nituhtamare nimara puʼpain aʼpatumararawe.
¿Tananke paʼpatera aʼna mama nihkapu, wankui irake chinuhterawe? ¿ku wenserawe nara nukunanke iʼsha uʼuhkamare?
Ihshateranta chiniratun irupachina, kiyari kaʼtanai nunentu peikeʼpa. Inahke nimiriu maʼpatere inaran nituhterai kemuiruʼsa aʼpeikamare kañukeran.

Iʼwata iyahsharuʼsa. Kiyahsu sentarai mamapaya kañurinmare, iʼwaraware ku kushateriunwe.Tanan pahkaturuke nuya kahpashin nahtantapun nahkaranchin nimara. Nuyakeran weʼka iterai inaran yusparin iterai kaʼtaninkumare.
Ni ketaʼwa ninu uskurumare, inaran ama naniantawasuwe nani paʼpisupita.
¿Nuwanchihtunwe kema ka winarawehsu nuyahshakeran?
Niʼke insehketa iyahsha inaran paʼanteke nuyahsha. Shaʼwiteke kanpiatarewa samira yamurake, inapuchin ina maʼpatarin inaran kanpuanta maʼpatarewa.
¿Aʼnanʼawa saʼyate tarapa iyasha?
Ama ninakesuwe mahtaranta kechinewe, napurin.

Nunteranken waʼyanukeraware sehtatuwe, iʼyawe: wayuruʼsa ketawatunke waʼnaruʼsa maʼparanken nihpuni, ¿Unputa paʼterinsu akuchihtunwe? Aʼma naʼkun kurihke maʼpakuihsu, yunkire taweri tachihtun puchin nininsu. Paʼanke nuya kemapiken ninanunenke. Aʼpaniteke nuʼten nininsu, ihsu kanpiaterehsu nuyahsha niʼina yaʼ i piyapiruʼsari.

Niʼke, ahpiraʼwa, kepake pantaʼpi mamapayanke paʼankamare.Nuya peʼtenke inaran aʼma tuhpinan yuʼkesu naʼkun. Nahpuruchachin maʼpateke, aʼma niwitekehsu, piyapiruʼsa paweretawena tehʼpirinawe inapihkeran ku paweretupiuwe. Manuke, nani paʼanteruʼsa kankirawi.
Ku piʼpiyaterante wenseraiwe chinuhtakaimare.
Nani taweri tahpaʼa shapunmare.
Yuʼmenu nimara kehkenin.

Ninateke, aʼshatu, Ku ahkete sehteranwe imin ichimiteranmare. Sharairuʼsa suʼsuantarin uʼnaike. Aʼma teʼwakehsu tanawatan, ninanu kahtawaterin. Manuke, weke kuhshateke karuʼku ninataripuchin nahsha pahputerinsu.
Nunentu peike nitarinen.
¿Nani ya iraterinke paʼsaran iterawe?
Yuʼme kehken peʼperawe teʼwatu.

Ku nañanteriuwa peʼpetu nunshake waʼwatari ninepuchin. Kema ku samira kenanwen nihpuni, waʼwaruʼsanuwe tana nahtan ihtunawe yaʼi taweri. Maʼpaku winarawehsu pawerepuchin. Aʼma yunkikehsu nañantarawehsu ihsu nuya ninanukeran.

Uhshira, taʼtetake inaran uʼsaran ninake. Manuke, tahshiraya tata kankimararin tanan paʼtetinkeran. Niʼpatewa Winakariuwa kahpashin kankankeran, naʼkun naʼwanewa niʼtun. Pake mañahtun iwe yunihke, aʼma waʼkikehsu. Uʼmarinsu kahpashin a kankantarin kemuiruʼsa yamusawihsu.
Mamanen nuyahshakeran weʼka tenin inaran shaʼwirapirin paʼantenaʼpimahshu puʼpian mare yuʼsawatun ninu pantaʼpi maʼpatarin, inapu yaʼwetupi ninanuke niʼtun.
Inta ku wiʼni nuyahsha nunterinwe, nihpaunawe yunkiri wiʼni naʼnuwirinsu iminke ina ku ya ayaterinwe.
¿Unpu pentuntapunta ku nuwitapunawe ira?
¿Nituhtariuwa maʼsateranta niwike maʼpatuwate nimantaratun ku nitu pawereteruwawe?
¿Amiraʼwasa nahkaranchin peʼpeantapuna peʼpetu nunshinankeʼpa?
¿Unpuruta pawereʼtari niwiterehsu irahka?
Manuke, nimara ku kahsurina yaʼweriunwe. Nuyahtaʼa muhturu kuʼwara paʼshahtaraʼsuwe, inapuchin ku yaʼtetarewe wankui irake paʼpatewa ninanukeʼpa.
Tatamahshu, ¿Intuwata pahsaran? Pahsarawe aʼshatu taʼpa, ihsu puʼpian peʼpetu kepararawe. Ninaku peike, uʼmararawe ku wara tahshiyahtaraʼsuwe.
Aʼma maʼsha keparuwahsu paʼtaʼawasu uʼnaike chinuhtapatewa.
¿mamapaya kankiarin aʼna ninanuʼpa ku tahshichahtaraʼsuwe nunshinankera?
¿Amiaʼwarehken nuyahsha kankantawen nimara?
¿Nuya aʼpeike wiʼnawe waʼwishin?
Nimara puʼpian kurihki tahpaihtuwe irake naʼkun paʼtuwachin.
¿Unpu aʼnutariuwata iyahsha kahpashin kankanteruawasu? Ihpukasu chinihken ketaʼawa. Mana nunshanen ku aʼnanpacbonpuwe, ku pentunaruawe yunihkariuwawe pahkaturu.
Nuya nuwanterai aʼnapita ninakasu nunshinanke.
Paʼpi nahpuinahchin paʼantupike, nuyahshakeran yamura paʼankariwa aʼma shipikamarewe iʼshake.

Uhshiwe nishirapirin unpu kaʼtanawehsuta nunshinanpa. Ka peʼperawe yuʼme ina kurihki keparin. Aʼna paʼantenaʼpi mahshu naʼkunkeware ya mahpachina, kari nuyahshakeran yaʼkuntunawe shaʼwitamare samira ihpuraware nahsha a yaniterare iʼshakeran ihpura tahshiramiachin.
Ku tananpitarawa sehteyarausu wiʼnawe iʼsha paʼmawae paʼmarinsu.
Uhshipaya kuahsu mentahtariunwe saʼyanen inaʼtun; ina ninararin waʼwaruʼsaʼtun maʼpataimare.

Nimara kema ya chinuhteran Kuʼwara kara iʼshana ya pentunchahtaraʼsunwe. Ku nuya nituhterawe awanteransu yaʼi iratamare ku waniwinanwen. Paʼweru ikihtuwatan, iʼshanake ninataʼa. Inapihkeran paʼantari, inaran peike kankunkari kuʼwara tahshiahtaraʼsuwe.
Aʼma chiʼchi kañu mahkainpumarewe, wayuʼsa nuya paʼmurai nuya iʼshake. Inawe yaʼweturuwahsu ina paʼpi nuya yaʼweruwa ninanuke.
¿Tawerianpitereʼ waʼwa, ku tahshi teʼwa maninkenweʼ pensha tahkuyahpun?
Ina iʼwariaware uʼmarin ira nahpuripi niʼtun.

Nimara kanpu tahshi wenseaʼa, amiraʼwa inaran tahpaʼa yukirehsu ahpimahshu paʼninsu iʼsha peʼnahte. Nimare ina aʼnataweri ayankapun, nahpuatun kanpuwari ninakariuwa sami nanpiruke. Ka tenawe kahpashin kankanteriuwa, ihpura sehteru mahpirinpuwa teʼtetanake.
¿Tenan ka kenawatapu tuma inaran uskuru kuʼwara unkuchahtaraʼsuna, nimara uʼmakawe tuhpinan ynaran kankan nuʼwitereʼna?
Ina mama peʼpeawa taʼnahke.
Yunkirai naʼkun maʼsha paʼankasu ninanuke.

Kehparitapun tahshitantatamare nahkaranchin iminke? Inaran ikiruwinan yaʼi ahke ira paʼtapun. ¿No mahshateranta kapapun kuʼwara pahshahtaraʼsunwe? Karinke kehsha aʼniwi akutaranke. ¿Weʼsaran nuʼteken peike u paʼsaran uhshiwarin taʼpatun?
¿Yaʼwewanuʼsa yaʼi waʼwaruʼsa uwantapuna kepawi nihpuni nahpuru tawerike, unpuhruta kahsu ninachihtuwe?
¿Kankipachin nuya kankantapun nimara?
Amihke naʼneinen waʼwa

Ninateke, iyahsha, aʼma taʼakehsu iʼshakeʼpa sehtatun. Nimara mamawarin ku nuʼwirinkenwen. Tuhpinan naʼwanin iyawarin ahke paʼninsu. Aʼma teʼwatekehsu nuntapun. Manuke paʼawa nahpuinahchin inaran shaʼwitaʼa nuwanterehsu naʼkun.

¿Pakawe shaʼwitawe mamaparin nuya nanan kuʼwara tahshiyataraʼsu? Manuke, ira ni unkuturarin aʼnuarahchin. Ni aʼpeike a tahshi iratekehsu, chiwewatan naʼwantaran. Kari pahkaturu kepararawe puʼmurawatu, kemahsu kankanenkeran kepake nuyahsha kankanteransu. ¿Nimara kehchitaran taʼareʼna ninainkumare iʼ shakeʼpa?
Ku nuyahsha ninanwe, maʼsu ku insha maʼshuteranta ya ni nunentepiuwe chinihken irumare, kañuri mamaiatarin ku chiniru yaʼweterinsu.
¿ku nuya kankanteranwe kahtawaku ihsu pantaʼpi yuʼih? Yaʼihpi iyaʼwarenpitanata kapauna inaran yaʼihpi yaweramasu kehparitauna nuyahpiachin.
¿Ku nuya nituhterawe mamanuwe uʼmararinsu tanankeran aʼkayan? ¿Unpu inkiʼita ihsu paʼyan nani tahshi weʼi materinkuhsu?
Ku kurihke yuʼshatarapu.
Iratariuwa ahke tananparihchin ikirupinan.

Kankunau ninanuaʼwake paʼpi winkinke nihkanawe naniterin pamatakasu, paʼnawe nunshkeraʼ, nisha nisha inairaruʼsa perahpisu nahtantu paʼnawe, inake ninararinawe ka nuwiterawesupita nunshinake ninasarinawe, ketenau sami nuya shakeran, irahka mashukuruʼsa unpuisuna nihpisu irahka iyaruʼsa.
Ku tanawitapu teʼtetenuke nuʼwitu suʼsukahsu, nuyahsha nuntarawe ina iyaru ka yaʼwerawe nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu,, yunkiatu inaruʼku kahpashinkeran tananterehsu.
Mamapaya waʼwaruʼsa niʼnin inaran sehterin pakeimare. Puʼmupi kusharu iʼwara tahshi, tenin. Tanan paʼpi ahke inaran ikirure. Chinuhchina iʼsha taʼirinke. Ayan ina kuʼwara uʼnan anutarin chinihken.
¿Kema ayanke peike tanan iraparihchin nani iʼwarawachin ninanuke inaran inanshiraruʼsa peʼpetunenke pantarin?
Kuʼ naniantawawe tewaterewaʼsu ishanarusa.
¿Yah niwiranku samiranuwe shintenahpun inaran karinke pawereranken naʼkun sairake?

Kankunpatura aʼnan yaʼkariaʼwa ninanuaʼwake, nuʼpaʼtun iʼnatune nuyahkeran iran yusparinke itereʼ iʼshanta, ninarawe aʼna piyapi weʼin nunkamare, inahkeran sami aʼnuterau iʼshnaketran kentarauru, ihsu pihta tahparau nuyahsharan, ihsu yunkirau irahka tatamashuruʼsa nihpisu.
Kanta yuʼnana ketuku, iyahsha, paʼsarawe peʼikapu kuʼwara tahshiyataraʼsuwe. Manuke, kumuiruʼsa ninararinpuwa kusharu nihsawatuna.
¿Ama ihseraware uhmakesu taʼshi?
¿Nu nuyawe kankimaransu amiaʼwa?
Ni nunterai aʼma waʼkukamaruwe naʼkun, paʼanterai pihkeran aʼnarahchin uʼmarai yaʼweraiʼpa.
Iʼwa ninaterawe aʼyapinan, ¿Yunkiaran kema?

Tatamahsu nunentenaʼpi aʼnanin shapun kahpashinkeran sanawi yaʼwerin nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu. Ku sanapi waʼwin neʼmehtenenpita pihsatariunwe nihpuni, inari puʼpian kechehtunwe.Inapihkeran uhshiya yaʼwerin nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinu naʼkun shapun paʼanin paʼantupike inanan ayantarin. Inapu yaʼwetupi ni kahtawatuna. Nunentenaʼpiri aʼchinterin ni aʼnankasu nihpiriunwe paʼpi nuya kemuinenpuwa kahpashin kankantupi.
Naʼkun uʼnanke ku manuruwe.
Waʼwasha, weʼpachina nuhsha paʼanpuna puʼpian paʼterinsumare nunshake, kurihke tahpake arehse paʼankamare inapuwatan ku maʼshateranta pawantarinpuwe.

Ka paʼan ihtuwe nasha shapun aʼna ninanuke? Nuwanterawe wiʼsekamare sanapiruʼsa ya waiwachinara seʼwarawehsu niʼtun. Inaran kepaihtuwe aʼna piʼshina inaran neʼmehte peʼsawinan. ¿Ina tahparawehsu nuya nimara? Ayankahsu nuyahpiachin a kankanterinku.

¿Karinke nuyahshakeran atarikayu niwi ketainkumare nahtananke nihpuni niwiʼihtunkuwe? Sehterawe maʼsahateranta peʼke kepamakamare ku kurihke yaʼweterinkuwe. keteranku nihpuni ka sawatu paʼantupiʼpa paʼmararawe inara pawereʼihtenkunwe.¿Nuwanchihtunwe aʼchinaʼpiku nunterankensu nahkaranchin? unpuiteranta paweraranke ku nahpuni yaʼnuaranwe, iyawe, ina nuya nituhteran.

Aʼna ninanukeʼpa kankunpatera, mahshuruʼsatun weʼka iterawe nuya keran. Yah iraterawe tehkein iʼsha parihchi aʼma chiwekamarewe. Inahke kemuiruʼsa nuyakeran ninararinawe. Sami nanpiru keparawe inaran nuya kankankeran yuʼnawe tatamahshunuwe aʼchinterinku niʼtun.

inaran chiminpachina tatamashu achininpikeran samitakaʼsu, nahpunin nahtane peike. ku nihtutereyuʼ nanpirinen ahken yawerin nihtun. kiya nihmara yunkipirinkewe kiyarinta yunkire. winanen samihtunapi nahkun pawanin.
Mamanuwe, muhshainke yuʼme kepakamare, inapuchin kema nuyahsaha pantaʼpi paʼansaran ninanukeran kemarehsu.
Maʼsha naʼkun maʼin, ahke paʼsarin niʼtun.

¿A waitenaʼpipaya mahkira yuʼsawatun ya maʼpaterin iwe yanihken ina iyahsha yaʼweterinsu? ¿Kemapi nuwantarin inapuchin ku waʼkiapunawe, ina niʼnin taʼirarin niʼtun? ¿Tihkirin aʼnuarahchin ihsu yunki taweriachin ira paʼtakaimare kuʼwara tahshiahtaraʼsuwe?
Ama paʼyankesuwe waʼwashamare

Aʼshatu, ku nuwiterankuwe uʼmarahpu. Uʼnan yaʼkuirinku nahpuatun ahke ira ku tihkinawen niʼnawe. Ku chinirupi yaʼweterinku uʼmakamare, nihpiriunwe yunkirawe pensha aʼperansu. Nahpuru tahshi no nañatarawe, pahkarike inaran ahke ninin.
¿Niʼnan ihsu naʼniʼi paʼyaninsu?
Ayamaʼin kuʼwara iʼwararin.

¿Yunkiran nahpuru paʼsahpari ninanuke? Ihpuranta Nunsha Yaʼwetarinpuwa nihpuni, paʼmaihteriuwawe tahshiramiachin iʼshaparihchi. ¿Paʼankari shapun inaran tuma? Kari paʼanchihtunkenwen nuyahshakeran, ku nuʼwitapurawe. ¿Kema tenan paʼantenaʼpi nuʼten paʼtunen ketarinpu iʼwa puchin.?
¿Unpu aʼsuinta ihsu pantaʼpi ku nituhterewawe ira kapatariwa?
¿Nuya yaʼwetapun ina kusharu kapatun ahke ninanenpa ihkamakare?
Inkawan kuʼwara taʼshitarewa.
Ku iʼsha pentunchihturawe kuʼwara peʼpetu nuya akuyahtaʼsuwe.
¿Yusparin iterawe ina yuki ni keterai mare?
¿kankunihturuwawe kuʼwara iʼwayahtaraʼsuwe?
¿Irake ikiruran?
Nimara chinkana waʼanen ku niwike ketapunkuwe samira paʼankaware.
Iyahsha, ¿ku aʼnanankuwe yamura paʼankamare? Nimara nahkaranchin ketapunku, nahpuinahchin paʼtunen akutewatuwe aʼpeitarawe.

Nahtanke ihsu weʼka itarankensu kankanenkerachachin, Sanapi nahtepisu. Nimara tahshi nihpachina Kemanta iʼsha tahshinanke irininsu teʼwateran. Ka, nanunsha mamaku, taweri ninarawe nuyahshakeran. Yunki yaʼweterinku manuwe yuhse yunkirinsu, inaran nuya yunkirinsu ihpuranta kaʼtanarinku.
Ina nuya ni nuntewi yaʼwepi kapiniinaran kahpa kankantupi iminke ni kenantuna.
Niaʼwereteke ihsu waʼna weʼehta ina nuʼmuhkeneʼ.
Inapitasu nihpirinwe ku niwike yuʼpiwe tanan nimiriu.
Unpuarinta iʼshanaʼsa pamaterin nihpuni.
Iʼyawe peʼinaʼpi, ynkiran naʼwerinsu: sehtapirawe inaran teʼwareʼna yuhkike. Uʼteke ninupinen inaran yusparin iteke iʼsha aʼpeirinkensu.
Iʼsha aʼshin inaran kanpita keka itarankema, iyaruʼsa. Peʼpeterawehsu kehken niʼtun manurawe, nihpiriunwe ihseke puʼpian nih uʼwararai pantamare.
Sehterin kemuiruʼsa peʼsainpi iʼsha uʼupisuke, maʼsu Inapuchin ku kañu chinitepiuwe uʼnapike ihkankipachina.
Niʼnawe ina yunki ihpuranta ikihterawe. Iyahsha nuya yaʼweraihsu paʼnin tahshiramiachin, chihtururi iʼsha yaʼkutaʼse.

Iyaruʼsa, nahtanku nunsarawehsu: tahshiraya iyawe uʼmararin peʼirinkeran. Kemuiruʼsa shaʼwiteke mañahtun, aʼma waʼkikehsu. Niʼsaran yaʼinpuwa winararewa nuya nihkatewa. Naʼkun Naʼwanewa. Pake niʼke mañahtun nunshinankeʼpa nuyshskeran nahkawike, kankirinsu kahpashin a kankanterinpu kankan.

Piyapi ka nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu nimara yusparinke ichi, kahtawarinku iwe peʼpekahsu kañaʼpiku nihsaʼse. Ina nimara ninarahrin kari tewakahsu, nihpiriunwe kahsu ku tewarawe. Penen kechinke, amiaʼwa, ama nañantekehsu insuhsuna kahtawarinkehsu yusparin iteke. inaran iterin Piyapi yaʼwere nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu inahsu naʼkun kurihki puchin paʼterin.
Iyahsha yaʼwerawe nuhtetenanke yaʼweinsu uskuru aʼnanawe.
¿Tahshiraya yusparin itapu nimara?
Aʼma naʼnekehsu uhshira. Tahshiraya kahtuyaʼpinpu iʼshakeʼpa paʼmantaʼa inaran peʼikare iʼwa puchin. Aʼma sehtekehsu, tata uʼmakawen tanankeran nimara. Paʼa ihpuʼa aʼma sehtamarewe, ¿mana?

¿Unpuwanta puʼpian nuwanterawe maʼpatakahsu iyawe paʼtapi nen paʼantuwatera? Kahsu tenawe inapuchin nuya, inapihkeran yunkirawe. ¿Ku shaʼwirawe aʼna taweri ninatarawe? Inpura yunkirawe inapuchin ninawe manureʼna, nahtan ihtuwe piyapiruʼsa.
Ku iʼsha pentuntariuwa ihsu naʼkun peʼpetu peʼperawatuwa.
ku pentunawen ku naniterepawe nahpatun chiweran wakimiachin. ama nanekesuʼ, manuke iwara ku ayanawen ku nahtanawen nihtun tehkein.
Kepachinakariuwa maʼsha kehken nininsu nimara
Nuya nuwanterai paweretakahsu ina paʼtun nininsu paʼantupike, nahpuatun aʼnarahchin ayamarai peʼpetamare nunshakehpa.
Aʼnankui nunshanen, iʼsha pentuntariuwa pantaʼpi paʼankamare. Iʼwaraya kankupatuwa ninanuʼpa puʼpian paʼtarin
¿tahpapun saʼyate tarahpa aʼna peʼpetuke?
Ihpura kankuane ahke, ¿iratare nahkun?

¿Aʼma nahtankesu pawanansu iminke paʼpate? Iʼwa karuʼku ihseke sahkaterin. ¿Unpuwanta taʼtahran? Manuke, shaʼwituku, ¿Ina ya uʼmarin ninanuke? Teʼwarawe kanpuwa nañanterinpuwawe niʼtun. ¿Kema tenan ihpuranta yunkiahrinpuwa?
ku sehchituwe niʼnaken nihpuni kemaura peinenke.
Nuwanterai nunsha aʼpeikasu yaʼinkui.
Iʼwara chinimahshuke maiterewa inaran naʼkun ikirurewa. Puʼpian chinuhteke, waʼwasha, inaran kahtawaku nuwaraʼi peʼpetu nunshakeʼpa.
Ku yuʼihtuwe samira kuʼwara paʼtunen nunshahtaraʼsuwe, ku ya ichi yaʼwereterawe sahkatunuwe puʼpian yamura mare.
Nimara muhturu ni tapinkawen nahkaranchin. Tuhpinanteranta nuʼserate kepaʼa, inapuchin pakari chiniike pihtakari nihpiriunwen.

Weʼkama, ku ninararawe kusharu maʼsu wahpuru iʼsha tahshiramiachin pihpirarin niʼtun.Kahpashin paʼnawe sami chinpi paʼankapu. Ku nañanterawe kunparuʼsa nuntakahsu kuʼwara paʼshahtaraʼsuwe. Ihsu taweriamiahchin ayananawe, aʼma kamare sehtukusu, iyahsharuʼsa.
Naʼkun maʼsha kehken keparau nahpurini, nunsharaʼwa paʼpi yaʼkumin paʼitunpu, uhkuike piʼpiyan pantaʼpi, akuke aʼna uʼmareʼpa.

Iyahsha, muhshainke nishihtuku uhsharan. Kema nunshanen ya aʼnanpatanku, ka iʼsha pentuntatu paʼihtuwe waʼwasha kañaʼpi yunihkamare. Kiyanta nuya niʼkui ihsu kemuiruʼsa sehtapisu. Aʼma waʼkikesu, yuhsemare, taweri kanpuamare paʼpi nuya.
¿Ku sanapi ira nuʼtehken weʼshimaʼihtunwe?
Ku nuyarinkuwe intuwa tahshi pakamare.
Inamini, nuya yunkiran kemuinpu tehkatun. Nahpatun yaʼkarituatana kahpashin kankanterawe, inara naʼneinu pihpirin yunkiatu irahka yaʼerawehsu.
Weʼka itapu imuya. Nimara nahpuru taweri kema ya paʼanteranku, nihpiriunwe tihkikuninke nuwanteran kanpiatakahsu yuʼmenuwe wayu yaʼwerinsu.
Wiʼnawe, samira nanpiru paʼanpatan tahpake puʼpian kurihki, inapuwatan nani semanake yamura inaran uskuru paʼananewe.
¿Unpuwanta yah mapateruwa niwike nimantaratun ku nitu pawetreturuwa aʼnuarahchin?
Pichiʼin senake kanarinsu.

Tata, ¿Paʼankariuwa yaʼi iminke kanarehsu? Ku, wiʼnasharuʼsa, nuyahsha nahtanku: Nuya kurihke yuntunpate, uwinkaʼa yamuramare inaran tuma inaran aʼchin pei yaʼkunkamare. Kanpiataʼawa nahsha waʼnaruʼsamare. Ni ketaʼawa puʼpian yaʼsurinsu, nihpiriunwe yunkiaʼawa maʼsuna nuya nininsu.
Uʼnanpachina, tatamahshu ku winariunwe iʼwahpuchin; ihpurasu sehturi mentahterin ku inshateranta yaʼweriunwe nuntakahsu.
Mamanuwe, muhshainke, ihpuku ihpura.
Nuyahshakeran nanun mama shaʼwirin pantaʼpi ya paʼaninsu inaran aʼna payari kehsha keterin, kahtuyaʼpi nituhtupi unpu paʼanehsuna kemuinenpita nuhsurukamare.

Wiʼnawe, nuyahshakeran nahtanku ihsu penin waʼwateramahsu niʼnawe niʼtun. Ihkankipachin pantaʼpi senakahsu, kepaʼawa kayapin ninanukeʼpa. Nuyahshakeran paʼan awa, ku manupinanwe, inaran aʼna wintana peʼten awa paʼantenaʼpisa nuhtetenanke. Inapuwatewa imiranenpuwa nuyahsha kehparitarin inaran nininenpuwa piyapiruʼsa kankanenenke nuyahsha kehparitarin.
Chinuhteke ihseke pantaʼpi yankuterinken; imaran ku chunuhtapunawe nihpuni, ku kahpashinkeran kankuin ihtunwe piyapiruʼsa weʼka itamare.

Ihpura nahtanke, taweri taʼwanterin. Ka nuewararawe wahpuru iʼshakeran ina nunshinankeʼpa nihpuni, mahshuyarusaʼtun weʼka ichihtuwe nuyakeran. Aʼma kemaʼtun taʼakehsu, ninake mamaparin. Kankirarin ikiruwinan, ku aʼnuarahchin nuʼihtunwe inantaratun chinihken nananke. Irateke uhsharan ka pihkeran inaran tuhpinan puʼpian yuʼme peʼpeke.
Ku kahsu ahke ya iraterawe peʼikamare, ira ichi kanuhterinku niʼtun inaran tatanuwe ihkantarawe paʼsarinsu kehchitu.

¿Tatamahshu nunentenaʼpimahsu ku kankiariunwe aʼnuarahchin shiaʼwain taʼpa? Ku, inahsu ku inuara naniteriunwe ahke iratakahsu. Peʼpetunen paʼpi kehken nimantaratun paʼurunenpita ku awanteriunwe. Nimara ninaku inshariteranta kaʼtain nuyahshakeran.
Nimara ahpiaʼwa uʼmararin tanankeran. Kahpashin kankantariuwa nuya niʼpatewa inaran a nuya kankantariuwa ikiruwinan uʼmapachin ahke irakeran.
¿Unpuhsu naʼwankawe iyahsha yaʼwerawe nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu?

¿Saʼwitarawe iyaruʼsa kemanken iyawarin nani uʼmarin tanankeran? Manuke, nani uʼnan yaʼkariterin ira shihpirutantararin. Ni aʼpeike nuya kankanterankeran, inapihkeran naʼwantaran yaʼweranpa. Ka pinshi tahpatarawe kuʼwara taʼahraraʼsuwe. ¿Irawankahna ihkantapunku kub nihpun ninaranku peyanaʼpa?

Nani iyahsha ya paninke sahkaimiachin nunterawe, nihpiriunwe penen ya keterawe. Mahshuruʼsa weʼka iteke inaran yusparin tehke ihpupachinen yaʼkuana irake. Aʼma naʼkun uʼuhkesu pihtake, ni aʼpeike, inaran aʼpeike muhtuwarin. Kahsu kahpashin kankanterawe nahpuyanahchin suʼsure niʼtun iʼsha yaʼkari. Pake nuyahsha inaran uʼmake nanituwatan, ihseke ninasaranken.

Aʼnananku peʼtentenaʼpi, karinke kechitekenwe senatrausu, kemamare, ¿nahteran kema yaʼihpi paʼanari shiʼshi? ku nihpu atarireʼ ni ketariwa, ku nihkanawe inapuchi kurirau paʼanari maʼshanepu, naʼkunkeware yunkirawe.
Kankunpatan anpu iʼshakeʼpa, aʼma kemaura pentuntekehsu;perahke aʼna mahshu kahtawaʼinke pentunkamare.

Tatamahshu nunentenaʼpi shaʼwirin aʼna sanawi aʼnanin pahsanan aʼna sanawi ina yaʼwerin nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu. Inanta ya wenurin kusharu nihkakamare,inaran ina sanawiri kechihtunwe puʼpian yamura ku nihpun pantaʼpi ina kahtawaterinmare. Nunentenaʼpimahshu tenin inapuwatewa nu kusharu pawantarinpuawu peike. Waʼwaruʼsa nituhtapi maʼsha nuyahshakeran yuʼkakasu. Yaʼi ninanu Inapuchin yaʼwepi kemuinanpuchin.
- ¿Yaʼkari yaʼwerin tenan? - Nahpumara, iminen ahke paʼneʼpa tenin nahpuatun uhsharan iraterin ina kehken peʼperinkeran.
weʼkama kanaʼawa maʼshateranta kapamare.

Tahshita mamawanewe, ku teʼwaraun kemaura nihsaunawe peinenkeʼpa, ka wentaʼihtuwe aʼnarahchin, inaurawa nahpurini winaitriwawe nimara yunkiatewa irahka mashu taweriruʼsa, inauruwa nahpurini piʼpiya piʼpiyan teʼwarewasu ahkenanpitupuahwe kanpu kahtupukeran.

Ka nahtanterawe iyawe iʼshaparihchinkeran uʼmararinsu nihpuni, paʼantarawehsu tananpichihtuwe inaran nunshinake ninaihtuwe. ninake karuʼku, wiʼnawe, aʼma chini teʼwatekehsu. Niʼpate nahkawikari kahpashinkeran inaran pantaʼpi aʼnira keteihteriuwawe.
Weʼkama, mañahtun saminenpuwa paʼanwa.

¿Peʼinaʼpi ku peʼirinsu yuʼkapunwe taweri aʼna yuʼmemare? Mamapaya shaʼwirin ina kahpashinkeran yuʼnin, yuʼme puʼpian paʼterinsu waʼkirin.¿Nuwantapun sanapi ina ichi yaʼweretakahsu sahkatunen yahshin samirare?

Aʼma kehparitekehsu sehtupinan kuʼwianake, wiʼnawe. Imahku yunsankeʼpa inaran niʼke iʼsha ahkui aʼpininsu piʼike.Keparawe nunshanuwe inaran kema kahtawarankuwe saʼyate tarahpa mahkamare. Niʼsaran sehtunen puʼpiraʼwaya samirapuchin tarananin. Chinihken kankanteke inaran winake, maʼsu ka kemaruʼku iʼsha yaʼkari nihsarawe.
¿Ku ninaʼintu winan iʼshana yunsanake iʼwatapirinkunta peʼitun? Nuyaran peʼitupu ku nituhterewawe nuya uʼmakamasu.
Ama kehparitekesuwe kahpa kankanteransu kema.

Yah peʼperai peʼpeturuʼsa panka kuhtaruke, ninupiraʼwaya. Neʼmehte puʼmukari nimari, kusharu inaran peʼpetunuwe nimiriu puʼsumarewehsu. Kepaʼawa iʼsha inpi waʼwinamare nimara. Kahsu uʼkiterawe kuʼwara paʼshataraʼsuwe aʼma maʼshateranta pawankamarewe. Ira shihpiru nimara, nihpiriunwe nuya Paʼawa. Mamapaya apinuatewa pataʼawa inapihkeran aʼyarihmarewa uʼmapatewa.

Nahtanke, amiraʼwaya, manuke maniahtun piyapiruʼsa nunshinanpa weʼsapi. Aʼnataweri nahtantupi unputa paʼterinsu pantaʼpi aʼna peike. Nunpitupi paʼtuneʼ. Nuyakeran pantaʼpi paʼanke, nihpiriunwe ama tuhpinan yuʼkehsu. kanaransu puʼpian yuntunke yaamura, shapun paʼankamare. Pake maniahtun, kepake iʼme kuʼwara iʼsha wahpuru kankiahtaʼsuwe.
Ku pihpiahtaraʼsuwa peʼpeaʼwa nunsha, mahsu ira ahke pawanin niʼtun aʼna ninanuʼpa, ahke maitewatuwa ikiruarewa.
Pihpiaʼwa kuʼwara taweriaʼsuwe, teʼnawanke kanunariwa maʼsha paʼanpiʼpa, ¿ku nahteran paʼantanunpua maʼsha keparewasu? karinma nuyahsha akuchima, aʼnaruahchin paʼanpa, yunkirawe piʼpi yankunaninsu.
Nahpuru pantaʼpi kehshare kepaʼawa naʼkunkeware. Weʼehta ketuku, wiʼnawe, nuyahshakeran akuke peʼpetu pirianke
¿Maʼmapaya, ihpura paʼsaran ahpimahshutaʼpa? ¿ku kanuhteranwe naʼkun iratamare? shaʼwituku mañahtun kuʼwara piʼi pihpirarin.
Yamurarahchin ya paʼantuwatanku, ku nuwantarawe, maʼsu samira paʼtunen kenawe petete iʼshakeran.
Niʼka setarewa ipurasu, nipirinwe napuinachin nawere ipura taweri, winawe sanawi
Kankiauna nimara kuʼwara uʼnansu
Amiraʼwaini kaʼtanin paʼnin paʼantupiʼpa nihpuni, ina kepaihtunwe naʼkun pantaʼpi inaran aʼnarahchin uʼmaihtunwe kuʼwara uʼnan anuchahtaraʼsuwe.
Ku ama paʼawasu shaʼwiate paʼnesu, niʼpirinwe ihsha ku keterinpuwawe mahta manurinwe.
Mamapaya uʼnan niʼsawatun sehterin. Tenin wiraitewachina naʼwanin naʼkun kemuinenpita inaran nihkakaihsu.
¿Naʼnekariwa sehtukeran ku nihpun kahpashinkeran? Kahpashinkeran, yusparin itaʼawa iyahsha. Ku mamapaya nuneniunwe nihpuni, ina ihpura ku irachihtunwe.
Nunke,ira pentuntarama.
Nuyahshakeran nanun mama shaʼwirapirin kunparinen kehsha yuʼsawatun maʼpatarin sami, inapuchin kahtuyaʼpi waʼwina aʼkapuna ku maʼshateranta paweretepunawe.
Tawerirawahsu Kankuanawe ninanumake inahke weʼka itarawe mamaruʼsa ninarinawehsu nuyahshakeran.
Tahshita ninanu. Sehtukeran yunkikariuwa tahshi wiraiterinsu, wira teʼwatewatera yaʼinkui ni ihpurai pei ahkuanake.
Iyahsha, ¿Yunkiran aʼnanankuhsu nuʼserate? Muhshainke nuyahshakeran naʼkaranchin inuantake, teʼwarawe ku ihkananawe nunshinankeʼpa niʼtun.
¿Nimara uhsharan ihkankipun nuyahsha kankantamare?
Ku kahsurinawawen muhturu ku tenenchihtunwe.
Ku nuwanterawe kahtu samira panka yuʼsawatu maʼpatakahsu aʼnaruara yamura, inahsu ku nuyawe kemuiruʼsamare.
- Mamanuwe, iyawe paʼnin tananke naʼwanawe. - Aʼma naʼnekehsu. waʼwawe, a nuya kankanteke kankanen, uʼmantararin nunshake.
Nuʼpanenke kankunpatu, imiranuwe iwehsarawe inaran weʼka itarawe yaʼihpi, nahtantarawe niʼnawehsu keʼin nuyahsha kankantakahsu kankanke.

Iʼwata waʼwaruʼsa. Ihpura iʼwaraya uʼnanarin chinihken inaran kehparitarewa iʼsha pirianke. Nimara sehtere ku kankipimarewe. Kahpashin kankanterawe uʼnan taweriachin naʼwepachin inaran yaʼinpuwa uʼmararewa.

¿Unputa nihka aʼna yuʼmera sami keʼihtunwe keparawe ninanuke nihpuni? pawererinawe nihpuni, waʼwinaʼwaya neʼmehtenen paʼanchihtuwe inaran kahtawaʼihtuwe ichi nahsitamare. ¿Paʼpi nuya mamanuwe kechehtuwe? Kahpashin kankantawatu kechihtuwe. kahpashin kankantereʼna ira weʼshimaʼihtuwe.
Sehtu ku tananpitarinkuwe ku ina uʼmawachiunwe ninanuke.
Peʼpeawa taʼna ahke irake.
¿Ama paʼankesu pantapi ninanuwake?
¿Unpuwanta nani pateraweke kemuiruʼsa manurawe pihpikamare, Iʼhsake wanirawe paʼweru paʼmukamare inaran pantamare?
Ama imuhtuʼ paʼtun paʼankesuʼ.
Naʼkun kepararawehsu irake taʼwanterin.
Ku naniterewa nanpekasu pamahkeran, ninaʼawa winkintakahsu iʼsha
¿Intuwata uʼtenawe taʼna taʼshi?Shaʼwichinke nusha kankanteke:Nunirawe inahke narawnkana, nihpirinwe iraterawe ihwarepita nuwanterawe weʼkausu puhpian
¿kema nuʼten tuhpinan ihpuihtunkuwe?
¿Saʼyate aʼnanawehsu ya ayanterinku?

Aʼma nunen pahkaturu yuʼsatuwa maʼsha tu make paʼterinsu maʼpataʼawasu iʼwa puchin. Nahpuru yaʼipuchin yuʼnai pinshi uskuru maʼpatamare inaran puʼpian asuhkaru. Ka naʼkun sehterawe ina pinshi munuke waʼwaruʼsa nunenawe kañupachinara. Ku nuyawe kanpianamen nininwe inaran kuʼwayanare. Aʼpeiaya tanan keterinpuahsu, ku sahkaitarawe paʼankahsu.

¿Unpuanta wiʼnan ku yusparin iteriunwe piyapi yaʼwere nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu iʼyashanen nuneninsu wiana?paʼin sehterin waʼwasha nu nuyawe yunkipachinawe. ¿Tena kema iyahsha kahtawaterin ku inshariterantari niʼkamarewe? Yusparin tehkariuwa.
Insuhsuna kenanansu nuyahshakeran nunteke. Puʼpian mare chinuhtarawe peʼpetunuwe keʼken niʼtun nimantaratun taweri amanutarinku mañahchin pakamare.

Iʼshana pentuntewate, nimara ahke muhturu nahtankari peʼinaʼpiruʼsanke. Kenanpate, nahtankari niʼpachina ahkete pamatarinsu petete. Nimara iʼsha ichi naʼwekunpu, ninatari nuwanterehsu. Kema chinuhtaran naʼnateran yunsankeʼpa ihkanpatan.
Yunkirewa nanperuawasu nunshake nani tahshiramiachin.
