Nahpuru tahshiramiachin pihpiruwa kuʼwara piʼi pihpiahtaraʼsuwe. Uhchinanke iyaʼwa shaʼwiteke nani nunshake paʼsare ninanukeʼpa
Kahtawaku paʼanchi ihsu tanan wayu. Kepake mañahtun nunshinake, ahpimahshu inahke ya paʼanin nunsha uʼmapachina.
Maʼsha naʼkun taghparuwa nimara irake.
ka nuhsuruterawesu ina mare ku taʼwanterinwe.
¿Iratewatera ahke peike, wankui chinuhterawe inaran iratantarawe kuʼwara iʼwayahtaraʼsuwe.

Ku nituhteranwen weʼninsu wahpuru iʼsha perahpatenkera nahpuatun ku iʼsha pentunteranwen. Aʼma kehparitekehsu yunkiahpatunawe, manuke. Iʼwara ku ira kenananwen nahpuni niʼnan niʼtun. Aʼma ninakehsu iʼsha nanpeinsu nimantaratun yaʼshuirarin irateransu.

Ku nahteterawe ninatamare nihpiriunwe nuyamare. Pei tanawantahrin ku inshateranta nuniunwe. Ku aʼkayan yaʼinkarawe inakeran. Ninarawe Waʼwina ni uhkuikasu chinihken, ina pihkeran tu tewerawe. Uhsharan ihpurawe teʼtetenuke.
¿Wihtekeʼ iʼirateʼ ama yun yaʼwekamareweʼ?
Ina kemapi ku manta keparinwe kahpa ku paweretapunawe, nihpirinwe niwiterinsu nanperapu ihna nininenke ku tenurutapiwe ni yuntuhpike yaʼweruwasu.
unanpachina ku naniterewe samitakasu napunin kankanterawe kawerachin peiʼke. weke iyasha, nuʼan tewaʼa ninakunchin uʼnan chinihken.
¿Maʼta keparan paʼanpu? Kepararawe sami nanpiru aʼkayan uhkuirawehsu iʼke. Kurihkeke arehse paʼanarawe inaran tuma ninanukeʼpa.
Aʼma imira aʼpetukuhsu. Ku nuwanterawe taweri tihkikasu ku nituhterawe unpuruta niantainken. Ku yaʼweranwe aʼchin peike iratamare karuʼku. Teʼwarawe kawera kehparitakahsu, ku nañantarenkenwe.
Puʼpiyan nuʼwitapu inaran aʼnuarahchin nuyahsha nuntarawe, maʼsu naʼwanawe ina iyahsharuʼku paʼpi nuyahsha yaʼwereʼsu.
Ku nanianteraun kema naʼkun ya kahtawarankui.
Manuihtunwe iʼshapa nukutamare, nimara iʼsha wahpuruhsu pihpirin paʼantenapimahshu maʼsha, taʼnare nuya tahparaʼse.

Ahpimahshu napurin nimara paʼmararawe ihpura iʼwaraya nunshinankeʼpa. Nimara ya ichi nanperin panka tunpunan naʼwerinsu iʼshake. Mamapaya shaʼwiterinku ina peʼperin aʼna yuʼme mentahsha wayuruʼsa. Ku nituhterawe uʼmaramara nahpuruchachin ku nihpun kehparitapun kunparin yaʼwerinpa. ¡Ma kahpashinta iraterin! Tenin yaʼi shaʼwiʼin aʼma yunihkaimarewe. Kemararin yamura inaran uskuru peimare.
Maʼshateranta peterawe iʼsha yunsankeran.

Imuya paʼantenaʼpi, nuyahteke yuʼmenenpita kuʼwara puʼmuchahtaraʼsuwe. Pentuntariuwa naʼkun iʼshana chinihken chinimahshu ku nanituruwa chinikahsu. Nuyahshakeran nanpeke nunshake, yuhsemare. Kankuaʼawa kuʼwara iʼwayahtaraʼsuwe panka nunshinankepa. Maneku, aʼnapita nunsha nani paʼnin.

¿Unpuanta ku pawankariuwawe nunentu peike nunentapachina? Inahke aʼpeirenenpuwa aʼma kañukamarewe. Nahpuru taweri ku iminke kehparitariuwe. Kahpashin kankanteke paʼa, kirihka wirimake ninin yaʼwerinsu ninanuke inaran nuyahshakeran peike ayanmaʼa.
¿Ni ketapuna peʼpetun wiʼnaiʼsa kapini aʼnarahchin kankaimare?
Nimara ihpura yamura naʼkun paʼterin.
yunkiawa tatanenpua maʼsha ni ketawatewa anuahsu:Inapita nihpiriwen nuya nihpi maʼsha paʼanpike inapita aʼchinterinpua maʼsha ni kehtasu nuyaran.
Ku pantaʼpi niwike yuʼawe niwike paʼantupike; Nahpuruchachin yaʼi maʼpataʼawa nuyahsha uʼmakamare inaran kahpashinkeran ninanuke.
¿Weʼka iterama mahshuyaruʼsa nunpatamara shapun paʼterinsu?
Wiʼnashanewe, ikiruwiruwe ira paʼtare.
¿Uhseretere sehterinsu ichi winate?
¿Nani kankunpatera ina ninanuke wiʼnawepita kahpashinkeran taʼawi iyahshanen yunihkapuna? ¡Ina a nuya kankanterinku!
Nuya kanpuwa pahkakamare shihpiruante yaʼwerinsu pei pirianke. Inapuchin aʼpeiruwa yun nuʼsa sapu kehpisu inaran aʼpeiruwa wiʼnanpuwa.
Maʼsuruʼsa nuya kankantapuna naʼkun iranateruʼsa pentuntatuna ikiruwinan,nihpiriunwe wahpuru iʼshare akutarin iratakahsu ahke iʼshake.
¿Keshin inke samira yaniʼpi inaran kema ketuku yamura? Inapuchin ku pawantarinkuwe kusharu akutamare.

Ahpiaʼwa, wenseke mañahchin puʼmutaman. Mamaparin iminkeran uʼmapachin sahkaterin keran, nuyahshakeran ihpuke. Ina kahpashin kankantarin suʼsuransu nihkatunke. Niʼsaran unpu winarinsuta kemareʼken. Naʼkun naʼwaninke ihsu tawerike ahke ninanukeran paʼsawatun.
Niʼke, iʼsha inpi uʼuhkariuwa naʼkun wenuka nihpachin. Inapuchin ku puʼpian shinteanuwawe inaran waʼwaruʼsa yaʼi taweri yaʼnupiwiramawe ku kañuraramawe.

Nahtanku, waʼwasha, aʼma teʼwakehsu. Tahshi peʼipun piʼpiwatan, ku teʼwatarawe tahshi iʼshake. Kemanta ku teʼwaranwe, maʼsu kahsu uʼmararawe naʼkun samira kemararawe kemamare. Ninaku uʼsharan inaran chinihken kankantepinan. Yunkike nunterankensu: teʼwa paʼnin kema piyapi kiwipatan inaran iʼsha keterinpuwa kusharu.
Tatamahsu ku nituhteriunwe unpuanta uʼnanpachina ku winairi maniunwe; kankanenkeran ku kenaniunwe nuyahsha yaʼwekahsu inaura.
Nimara nahtankariuwawe muhturu kuninanke?
¿Nitu wayunkawe kawera paʼankamare kañaʼpiruʼsamare, tihkiapu tuhpinan nimara inaran kusharumare pawantapunku?

¿Unpuwa amiraʼwa? Nimara nani akuran neʼmehte yanirinsu kuhtarute. Ku nimara ihkankapunwe yaʼi mare iratamare. Sehterawe uʼnanpachin ninataʼse nunshinanke. ¿Kema tenan ihpura paʼpate ku nihpun ayamare peike? kahsu nuya nihsarawe, piʼiruʼte nahpunin niʼne. Nimara nuya peʼpekasu puʼpian inaran tananpitakahsu aʼnapita. Aʼpeike nantewarin shihpiruke, wiʼnawe inaran weʼka iteke ahpimahshu kamare.
¿kema tenan nanihtarinpu kurihki uskuru paʼankamare?
¿Unpuruta nihka mamapaya uʼmararin ninanukeran? Nunshake uʼmararin niʼpatu kahpashin kankanterawe, nimara paʼyan mentahtarinku kankanuke.
¡Weʼka! shaʼwiawa sami nanpiru paʼankamare ihpura.
Manuke, nimara ninanu uhkuntarin taweriachin. Kiyahsu nani semanake nunshake iraterai,keparai pantaʼpi inaran kehsha paʼankamare inahke.
Nimara kuhsharu nayapihsu niʼihtunawe kapakaimare, wiʼninshanen paʼninkeran paʼpi sehture manin.
Kanta naʼnarawe kema paʼpatan
Weʼkama wiʼnawepita. Uʼnan ku tanpitarinpuwawe peʼikasu iʼshake. Nimara sehteriuwa pamatarin niʼtun.Nihpiriunwe tahparewa winaruahsu inaran yusparin itekariuwa kemuiruʼsa niwentunpisu.
¿Tahpatapun nimara maʼshateranta mamanenta nimara?
¿Kema tenan ku nuyahsha kankanterawe wiʼnawe yaʼwetutu? Ku inaouchinwe; ku taweri naʼweriunwe nuwiterawehsu ina kahpashin a kankanterinku.

Ku ninaranwen iyawarin pentuninke inaran chiweran kemaura. Ku inaparihchi tananke nuwiranwen nimantaratun ku saweni keparanwen. Manuke ihpura, aʼma chinikehsu: ku iʼwara ayananwen puʼpisha shi tahshiteran.
Ku tananpitariunwe naʼwankahsu winarinsu.
Ku nuyarinkuwe ira ahke, aʼnuarahchin ikirurawe inaran ninatarawe naʼkun mamapaya peinenpa kankumakamare.
Nani pantaʼpi paʼaneke puʼpian kurihki tahpawate, naniterewa nunenan paweretakahsu inshateranta kumui kañupachina.
Ahchin iʼshanaruʼsa pentunterai, ahke nunshinansuʼ ninasarinpuaʼ.

Ka mamapayaruʼku yunkirai kemuiruʼsa nihkakamare. Ina uhsharan iraterin niʼtun nani yunsanke ninarai. Nuyahpiachin yaniru iranta inaran kañuhshin ihpura iʼwaraya paʼpi nuya. Iraterai nunsatui irahka taweri yaʼwepihsu, mamapaya nuwanterawesu.
Iʼsha, kuhsharure peʼpeawa aʼna kuhtaruteke, iʼsha winkin niʼtun, naʼkun maitariuwa inaran ira paʼtakahsu yaʼinpuwa ikirusarewa.
Saʼya tarahpamare ni aweruwa, nimara nani nuyahsha ni nuntantarai.
- Tatanuwe nuhshake paʼnin naʼwanawe. ¿Interanta uʼmarin? - Pawanin, nihpiriunwe nuya kankanteke, ihsu tawerimiahchin yankurinsu iʼshake niʼsaran.

Ama paʼyankesu, uhshiraʼwa manuke, ni uhkuike. Nimara mama ku iʼwatariunwe iminke. Teʼwa pakapun puʼpian ayapate nimara. Ka wenseʼi kemapirianke inaran ninataʼa. Aʼma naʼnekehsu, ina uʼmararin tanapachin.
Iʼwata, iyahsha tanankeran weʼninsu. Puʼpian wensarawe sanuwanke, ku naʼkun waʼkiarawe, iʼsha wahpuru nani ninasarinku niʼtun inaran nenenuʼsa ku ninarinawe.

Nimara tahshiraya kuʼ yaʼwetapunkewe kurihki nimana,nimara paʼsamarawe pahkaturu ketapuyaʼwerai kapini ninaisu,ina ketapunkusami nanpiru,nihpirinwe ku ahkete nuwantapuwe,nihkapunawe nahtapunau aʼnarahchinkuʼwara paʼsarin nunke.
¿Nuʼten paʼpi nuyahpiachin ihpurankusu?

¿Naniteran ketainkuhsu niwike arehse puʼpian mare? Sehterawe tahshiraya kemuinupita ku kuhsharu yaʼwetupiuwe niʼtun. kema ninawatanku maʼpatamare aʼchin peike, nahpuruchachin yaʼi pawereʼihtenkenwe. ¿Nihkapun kamare uhshiya? nu kahsu nuyarawe niwitakahsu, ihsu taweri ka mare tachihtunpuchin nahpatun nahtanananke kahtawainkumare.
Paʼsarawe ahke iminkeʼpa, wiʼnawe. Yunkirawe uʼnan paʼpi chinihken weʼsarin niʼtun. Nuyahsha ninateke, kuʼwara paʼshataraʼsuwe tahpatarawe pakamare.
Unpuwa yaʼipinpuwaʼ. Ku ihpura tewarawe kahken uhshipayake yunkirawe niʼtun. Paʼninsuʼ ihpura ku uʼmayahtarinwe. Nani iʼwaraya ninarawe, nihpirinwe ku irake kankimarinweʼ.
Yusparin tehsawatun inaran ninake nuyahsha iyawarin.
Kehken nininsu peʼpeʼin nani paʼnin.

Nimara muhturu ku paʼtariunwe tahshiraya, iʼsha pentuntariuwa iratewinan. Kema paʼsaran peʼpeterʼna puʼpian aʼna kanuhtamarewe. Piʼi chinihken piʼkatuwachin, sanuwanke chinuhtari. Uʼnankawen nimara, inawe nihpiriunwe paʼsare tahshiramiachin.
Pantapiruʼsa irake kepake, waʼwawe. Mamaparin nanpiru paʼanin nani paʼanterinke inaran piyapiruʼsa aʼnarahchin paʼanpi kayanterin niʼtun nimantaratun pankamahshu.
winareʼna shaʼwiawa wayu senaruahsu paʼankamare.
¿Ku samira ya kepateranwe mamapaya? Ina naʼkun kahtawarinpu inaran ketariuwa kanaruahsu ihpura.

¿Yunkiran nahpuru kemahken mamanen nuʼku ni nuʼwirai yamura pikiremare? Yai iʼwaraya ku ni nuntereiuwe. Kahsu teʼwaterawe aʼma ahkete ina nanan pankatakahsu ina naniterenpu tapikenpuʼsu. ¿Unpuanta nihka aʼnaruwahchinya nuʼwiterewa maʼsha nananmare, amiraʼwa? Tahshi niihpurai inanran yaʼi taʼtumarai. Kahsu yunkiahrawe nani naʼkupiriunwe. Kuʼwara weʼihshahtaraʼsuwe nanitere nanan nuyahtakahsu.
Ama winakewe nahtapatan mamanen nani a sanurin yaʼi nihpachin.
Tewerawe, ¿kema weʼnan ahkekeran? niʼnanke sehteransu inaran ikiruransu. ¿Maʼshateranta unpuran irake?
Ka yunkirawe nuya nimara nuyahshakeran paʼantakahsu, inapuchin paʼantenaʼpi nuya niʼninku inaran nahkaranchin puʼpian mare paʼantapunku.
Ku keparanwe pantaʼpinen ihpera taweri.
Ku puntuntariwawe ahke iʼshanaʼ.
¿Mama, ku shaʼwipunawe paʼsaran? ¿amiran uʼnan ninasahpatun? Manuke inaran shaʼwituku ira pentuntuwatan ninanukeʼpa.
Uhsharan pentunke, nuʼteken iʼnake;ninararanke kusharuruʼku aʼnateran iʼshake inaran chinuhtariuwa kuʼwara peike uʼmatayahtaraʼsuwe.

¿Unpu yusparin interanta iyahsha kema pirianke yaʼwerinsu nunsha nuyahterinkensu kuʼwara peʼyahtaraʼsunwe? Nunteran nuya kankankeran nani tahshirawachin iʼshake. ¿Keteran peʼiransu nuya yaʼnukamare? Inapuchin ku kanpuara irataruawe sahkaipuchinke. ¿Tahpake yunki sahkateransu? Aʼchinapi nahtanterin ihsu waʼwaruʼsa nihkatuna kahtawatakahsu ayankamare, inaran yusparin tenehsu ninanuke aʼma tanawitakaimarewe.
Chiniʼke ihseke iʼsha taʼterinke, puʼpian chinuhteke; ku wanikuawe irateran, kankun ihtunwe ikirupinan kemuiruʼsa peinenke.
¿Nani pentunpatera inaran nani yankunnawatera ina ninanuke kankanuwe kahspashin kankanterin naʼkun piyapi nuwiterinsu niʼsawatun?

Waʼwasha aʼna mahshuya ku naniteriunwe iratakahsure irake ni kataterin, nuyahsha iʼserin. Ushaʼkeran ira paʼtein inaran ina kanuhtuachin chinuhteʼin. Ahke pawanpiriunwe ninanunen, nihpiriunwe ku chiruatunawe kaʼtanin, ninuwi.
Nuʼwiterawe uhshiwe namuʼ upanterinku niʼtun, ni uhkuirawatu yunkiarawe kahtuyaʼpikuwui peʼirehsu, inaran nuyahsha nuntantarawe.
Sehterawe ku kahtawaranwe aʼshatu atarikayu paʼanpachina.
Weʼka iterawe nuyahshakeran, mahshuya. Nuʼten nimara nani tahshi peike tanawanke tewa ayanahnin. Tahshiramiachin ninararawe nimara, kankanuwe nituhchin chinuhtakasu ku rupatenawe
¿Penutun mahshu nuya kankanterin nunentu sanapi nuya nanan kenen ihpura niʼtun?
ku paʼyawansuwe, nuniawa ira.
¿Weʼka itapun a waitenaʼpi ihpura tahshi?
Ama awetekesuwe aʼnawita ya awewachinen, nuyahkeran nunteke ama aʼpamaesu paʼterinsu ku nituhtaunawe.
Ama unkutekeruwe uʼnanawakasu, uʼmake ka peineweke,kushatawa kaʼawa pihshate waahshin waashininaran winaʼawa nahpuinaʼchin.
Nuʼwitupirawe nihpiriun nuyahsha nuntarawe.
¡Nuyahsha niʼihtunwe tahshiramiachin paʼantupike kankune nihpuni! Pantaʼpi kepari yuʼmeke inaran paʼankariwa, inapuchin kahpashinkeran uʼmarewa peike nuya kurihki maʼpatupinan.
Aʼna nunun paʼanpatan, puʼpian yamura nahtanteke, peike ku wachi yaʼwerariunwe niʼtun.

Wiʼnawe, nahtanke nunterankensu kuʼwara pihpiahtaransuʼwe iratapun. Ka naʼkun kehken irake peʼperawe nihpuni, pinen ikiru ihtunwe inaran ku paʼihtuwai. Nahpuatun maʼsha ni ketaʼawa yaʼichachin. Kepake tuhpinan taʼna inaran weʼenante. Tahshi kankunpatewa, aʼma aʼmawita Peinenke yaʼkunkehsu ku nahtanpunawe waʼanen. Manuke, peʼpetunen mahke nani perahsarinenpu.
Uhshira, nuyahshakeran yunkike: ihpura tahshi sehteri inaran teʼware tunpunanke. yusparin taʼa kahtuyaʼpinpu, iʼsha keparinpu yaʼwereʼpa aʼyapinan.
Maʼpake nanan aʼpainan kemewenenke inaran yusparinke inteke wiʼnan yuna niʼsarinke.
Ku kankuanuwa tahshiramiachin kuʼwara iʼsha pentunchahtaraʼsuwe
¿Ka ya aʼnaninku uskuru?
Muhshaihtunkenwe nuwantamare ka winarawehsu yaʼkunkiapachinara.
Tatamahsu uʼnanpachina ku inshareteranta kusharu ni ketupiuwe, nimara kemuinenpita ku kankiriunwe inaran sehturi ku tananpiteriunwe.

¿Unpuanta waʼwishinuʼsa ku aʼpeiruawe? Inapita aʼnuarahchin kañupi. Kepaʼawa nunentu peike kañu tuʼshitekaimare. Peranininpihsu wiremaʼawa inaran ayanʼawa kahpashin kankanrawatewa. Inapuchin wiʼnanpuwa ku kañurapiuwe suʼsurapi chinihken inaran kahpashin.
Ku aʼperayuwe kehken nininsu tananke.
Mañahtun nunteke, nani ya paʼsarin.
Iyahasha nahteraihsu, ¿Aʼnanpunku saʼyate rarahpa iʼwapuchin? Teʼwarawe ku ina nihpachiunwe kemuiruʼsa ku iʼshake kuhshatapiuwe ihsu semanake.
¿Ku piʼpishateranta naʼwaintun wiʼnan aʼna parihte inauran paʼnin nahpurini? ku nuyasha nitupu ku inan naʼkun taweri niʼnawesu.
¿Wahpuru iʼsha kankiarin ihsu uʼnanke, tatamahshu?
Ku kamare maʼshateranta tahparawe.
Nimara seweitapun iʼsha, maʼteranta kepaʼa aipi. ihpuraware taweriraʼse pihpirare inaran maitari ku wanipinanwe puʼmutupiʼpa.

Manuke, wiʼnawe kepateke pahkaturu mamawarin paʼanterinpa. Shaʼwiteke maʼmareta nunwantere inaran kurihki maʼpateke. Aʼma niwike yuʼkesu ina nunen, ku pawerewachinenwe sahkatu ku yaʼwetarinkenwen. Paʼanke mañahtun inaran uʼmake kuʼwara uʼnanarin.
Kanpuasuʼ nuya yaʼweʼihteruwa iʼsha awayatewa uʼurewa nihpura, inapuchin ku kankanenpuwa ikihchiʼihturewawe.
Ku ayataranwe ihsu panka tanpananteʼ.
¿ichi winare wiʼnanpu nani taweri?
Nuya pichike pantaʼpi kuʼwara paʼanyantaraʼsuwe inara tahpake aʼna kuhtaruteke nuya paʼmupinan, inaputuatan nuyahpiachin ninanuʼpa kehkamaran.
Ama paʼantahkesu wai naʼkunkeware,ku mahshateranta kanaranwe nimantarin yaʼi sahkatu iminken ninisu ku kanarewe,tuʼpinanapuchin sahkateyare.
Nimara mamapayari pachihtunwe inaura aʼnaruyateranta, mahsu waʼwin paʼninkeran pei tanawantahrin.

Waʼwasha, ¿pantaʼpi paʼante kanarehsu tahpaihtunwe puʼpian? Ka tahparawe puʼpian kurihke pihshi inaran nawan paʼankamare. ¿Kema paʼan ihtunwe kashinuʼna ku nihpun tananpitapun? Irahka mamanuwe tahparin puʼpian kurihki. ¿Ku nuyaranwe nitutakahsu ina nininpuchin?
Nimara naʼkun piʼi naʼwerin nahpuru ni paterehsu. Yunkirawe ina iyahsha iterinku ayankasu, nimara irari ahke keparin.
Unpuatan naʼnerahranu waʼwa? tahpaterain pishatenen, ku intaranta uhsurutarinenkewe, tahshiraya yuʼawa maʼnimaretaranta kema nuwanteransu.
¿Unpuwanta iransu a sehterinku?
¿Teʼwakapun tahshi ihkankipachin?
Aʼma teʼwakehsu aʼshatu waʼkipachin nunshakeran nuwarakamare.Kari ninaihtuwe yaʼi iʼwaraya kahpashinkeran. Kehparuteke karuʼku paʼantupike inaran shaʼwiteke kenanpatan, inapuchi taʼapun ihpukamare.
¿Kema nuyaran yunkikasu iʼwaraya uʼmananke, tatawarin iraterin parihchin paʼanteransu peʼperawatun uʼmaran?
Panka uʼnan anutewachina pei aipeke, wenu aweihtunwe;waʼwanpita kechihtunwe inaran kahpashin kankanchihtuwe kaʼtanarinen niʼtun.

¿Kechihtunkuwe niwike kepakamare ihsu shapun inaran puʼpian yamura? Sehterawe aʼchinawere ku ya paweririnawe nani naʼwerarin nahkaranchin. Ninawatanku ihsu yuʼki taʼwananpa, karinken kechihtenkenwen yaʼichachin, ku maʼteranta a pawaihtuwe.¿Nuya ninan inapuchin, iyahsha? paʼantupike yunirawe puʼpian paʼterinsu, nihpiriunwe ku kurihki tahparawehsu ihkanterinkuwe.
Weʼkama, aʼchinapi. Naʼwanawe kaihshanuwe paʼninsu.Nuya kankanteke, waʼwasha, kirihkanenke nininen nishihteke,inaran yunkiransu tapake tahshiraya winakaman.
Nimara kemahsu ku awanteranwe naʼkun ira, wiʼnawe. manuke peʼpeturuʼsa peʼpeke, nani wahpuru iʼsha patarinpu.

Aʼma sehtakesu, Winashanuwe nuwanterawehsu. Aʼmihke yaʼpiranen inaran kahtawaku saʼyate tarahpa paʼteʼi tahshiraya. Sahkataran imiranenkeran, kankanen nuyahsha kankantantarin nahkaranchin. Ninateke, maʼsu nani taweri nuya maʼsha kenen kemuiruʼsamare. Kaʼtanku iʼshakeʼpa inaran niʼsaran uʼpu naʼweterinkesu sehtu nani iwan naʼwerinke.

Weke ihseke, amiaʼwa, mañahtun. Ya paʼanansu kayanpi, uwinkake nuya nininsu inaran paʼterinsu akuteke.Ama sehyunkehsu yaʼipichachin peyapiruʼsa nuya paweretaimare. Inapuwatan paʼanteransu ku interanta pinuarinkenwe. Pake mañahtun, aʼnanuna pantaʼpi pehperawatun kepake nunshinan yunsanke ninatapuchin.
Ku ina ira paʼtakasu iʼshana naʼkun pamatuwachin ihpura
¿Kahpashin kankanteran samira paʼanehsu nihkatun? Maʼpatereʼsu yuʼsawate maʼpatari puʼpian yamura inaran tuma kemuiruʼsamare, ¿Nuʼten?
Weʼkama, ina yaʼi paʼankapun ihpura.
¿Ihkantapu shaʼwiate paʼnesu kahken shiaʼwaruʼsa kuʼwara pentuntarawe iʼshana nitihkinan?
¿Ka kankunawe nihpuni winaransu niʼihtuwe?

¿Iʼsha pentuntaran ku wachi maʼshateranta nishaʼtaraʼsuwe? Inasu wewepiru, amiraʼwa. ¿Ku ninake aʼshatu nahpuinahchi paʼmakamare? Peʼpetu kepararansu paʼpi kehken.¿Maurata yunkiran pakamare sahkatamare ihpura ninanuke?

Irake kenanin nihpuni aʼna sanawi waʼwin ya yaʼwetarinsu, ushahkeraʼwayan kahtawaʼintunwe. Peinenkeʼpa kepaihtunwe, iʼsha ketawatun nuyahsha nunchihtunwe. Ahke yaʼwewiriunwe teranta, ku tananpitiʼihtunwe, waʼwihshin.
Unpuwa waʼwishinuʼsa. Uʼnanpachin kanpuara kehparitarewa tata ninatewa. Nimara sehteruwa puʼpian inamare. Nuya uʼmawachin shipiwinan kahpashin kankantarai inaran ihpuarinpuwa winarinkeran.
¿Aʼma tananpitekehsu winaransu samira ku saʼyate tarahpake anutuwachiunwe? Ku, ku tananpitarawe winarawehsu; ninararawwe nuyahshakeran tahshiraya iʼsha ketantarinpuwa naʼkun.

Ka kankunawe yaʼkari ninanukeʼpa nani ninkuanke, tehkein nuyahsha winkintahpun. Ina nunshinankeʼpa ninarawe tawerikahsu, nuya iʼsha niʼsawatu. Weʼka tenawe irahka nananke inaran peʼirawehsu yuʼnawe. Ihsu yaʼwerehsu tahparawe nuyahsha, inapuchin aʼchintarawe nahtaninawehsu.
Waʼwawe peʼperawe yaʼi irake.
¿Ahpinuwe niʼninku nihpuni ihpuihtunku?
Ku ayankariwawe kuʼwara tahshiahtaraʼsuwe.
Nuyasha nitaʼwa nisha nisha maʼsahrusa yaʼweterinpuasu, paweretawa pantaʼpike kanpua niyakawarewasu maʼsha ituwachinpua.
Paʼa winareʼna, kahken wiʼnawenupita, aʼma sehtuku ikirumare. Yah pentuntere ninanuke nunshake inaran iratewatera iʼwaraya kaʼtaninpu.
Iyamahshu, nahtainke kurihki pichihke ihpura, maʼsu ahpurimahshu ya paʼanin aruhse puʼpian mare iʼwarapuchin.

Shihpiru ira ya pentuntewatera peʼperai puʼpian peʼpetu, kankanuwe. Kehken peʼpetu patariuwa peike nimara. Kusharuʼchin kepaʼawa nimara inaran pahkaturu peʼperawehsu. Kahsu yunkirawe mama waʼwina ninapihsu aʼnateran. Uʼnankawen chinihken nimara, nihpiriunwe uhsharan paʼawa. Inaran ni nuntatewa uʼmakariuwa kuʼwara tahshiyahtaraʼsuwe.
¿ku maʼni mushateranta kechitunkewe wiʼnan paʼpi kanuhtaweraun? ku nihpera tananpichitunwewe naʼnitunpu ku nuya kankanewe.
Ku chinuhtapurirawe wankana irake kuʼwara iʼsha pentunchahtaraʼsuwe.
Ihpuraware uʼmararawe peʼirawekeran nimara nuya nanan nahtantimarawe, nihpiriunwe, paʼpi nuhsururawe, yaʼi kemuiruʼsa ihpuihtuwe, nimara.
¿Nuhsuruteke tanankeran uʼmawatan?
¿Iʼyawe, paʼsaran iʼsha peʼnahte? ¿maʼmareta naʼkun kusharu kepararan? shaʼwituku, mamanuwe shaʼwitamare.
Tenan ka keparawe naʼkun samira nanpiru paʼantupike, inapuchin nuya paʼantarawe inaran ku iterinawe naʼkun aʼpaterin.
Ku tananpitariuwa ira ayatakahsu uʼnaike kuʼwara iʼsha pentunchahtaraʼsuwe.

Iyahsha, yusparin ichihtunkenwen waʼwaruʼsa aʼchinterawesu aʼpeiteranku nihpuni puʼpianmare.Kemari aʼpeiran nihpuni, ka paihtuwe nimiriu yunihkapu. yuhsemare, anuya kankanteke aʼnahken naʼnepachin. Aʼma inaura patekehsu, waʼwishin nuʼsasu inaran paʼyankapuna kahpashin kankantuwachina.
¿Maʼta pawanin yuʼmeke? Pawanin samira kamutechin kapamare. Ninarawe paʼantupike nanpiru yaʼwerin tenawe.
Ku chinuhtariwawe peike ihkankaware.
Ina weʼka teʼihtunwe kuʼwara yamura paʼayantaʼrasuwe.
¿Tahpaihtun puʼpian yamuraʼ?

Iyawe shaʼwiterinku saʼin kahtawarawe paʼantakahsu samira iʼsha yunsanke. Ina nahpuru ikirurin inaran kahsu yuʼme pirianke wenserawe. Kankiwi naʼkun iyahsharuʼsa inaran kari panka samira aʼnuterawe nuyahshakeran.
Naniteruwa kehparitakasu taʼtepinan? Ku, iyahsha yusparin itariuwa yaʼi kankanenkeranchachin. Inapuchin ku ihpura sami kechihtenpuawe, weʼehkariuwa tanareʼna ihpura tahshi.
¿Nuya niʼihtunwe ka waʼan nunterawe nihpuni nituhtamare maurata uʼwana kañaritarin
Mamapaya ku ahsu nuwanteriunwe iyahsha sehturuʼna pakamare.
Nararaʼwanu iʼnatupi niʼtun nuʼwitupirawe, kahpashin kankankeran nuyahsha nuntarawe inaran yunkirawe inaruʼkuwi iminke nuyahsha yaʼnupirehsu.
Sanapiruʼsa ninanuke yaʼwepihsu shaʼwiteke pantaʼpiruʼsa nuyahpiachin nanpiwiahchin, inaran puʼpian paʼterin, paʼanke yaʼichachin tuhpinan ayankuntamare.

Unpuwa, nuwanterawesu. Nimara nani yaʼweterinke yaʼi puʼmuteransu iratamare. Nimara kepare naʼkun tuʼnaru naʼkun taweri mare. Nimantaratun peʼpekari sawanahsa tahshi sewen niʼtun. Sehterawe uʼnan ichi waʼkiarinpu nunshinanke niʼtun. ¿Kema maʼta tenan, pihpiaʼa aʼkayan? Imira aʼpeike sami puʼmurehsu peʼpetu kehken ichi nanperawatan. Weʼka iteke iyawarinpita, nimara inshateranta ya weʼnin, peʼpetunen puʼmuchin.
Iminke uʼnanin iterinawe nihpuni kahpashin kankanchihtuwe, sehterawe ku kankunawe chini iʼshakeran niʼtun.
Kepaʼin naʼkun maʼsha ketewisu.
Aʼma waʼkiʼinsu nunsarinkeran.
Waʼwishin, tatanen mihtayutapun paʼachin, iteke pahsaran winareʼna.Yunkike uʼmarin kusharu kemararin inara inapitaruʼkui ihpura tahshi wensarewa pensha yunsanke shaʼwikamare nanpiwihsu.
Iʼna ku paʼankanpun shapun yamurare niwiketeranta, unpuanta niwiriʼnsu ku naniantapewen kankanenke yunkiahpun ku paweretuachinwe.
Paweanawe nimara ihpera tawerin panaurumare, ku nihpun kechinau naʼtaranta kanta, kurihke ketewachinau kurihki, tahparawe paʼanakasumare nuwanteraruʼ.
Nimara tatanenpu uʼmararin tahsiruʼpu peʼirinkeran. Kahpashin kankantariuwa yaʼkaripatewa inaran shaʼwitarewa unpusu naʼwanewahsu.

Ku nuyahsha yaʼnuriunwe aʼna niʼnira mahpintunaʼpi kanpiatakahsu aʼna uskuru inaran kusharu. Kiyahsu nuwanrterai ku tanan yunkirirawe. Kahsu naʼkun sehterawe, ina niʼnirakeran ku nanitere iʼpi paʼninsu imahkamare. Aʼma ayanʼawasu yuʼkamare nuhkumarinpuahsu. Aʼnahken inapuchin nuya yaʼnurin, inapihkeran ku manta ichi yaʼweterinpu.
Iʼinare ku niawepunawe aʼna saʼyate wayuruʼsamare; aʼshini ku tanapitapunwe ku inshateranta kushatamare.
Nuya tu inawa tahpapuna kurihki aʼna peʼpetuke, maʼsharuʼsa chinkanake paʼpi paʼtun ihsu yuhkike.
Taʼteke iyaruʼ, ¿nuya nihsaran? kanpita paʼsaramaʼpa paʼpi ahke, kanpita niʼnaema kanuhterama, ¿nuwanteran kahtawakianuʼ?

Inamini, waʼwaruʼsa, naʼkun naʼwanuwa. Nimara kanpuahsu yunkirewa ina nani kusharu nayarinsu ninuwake. Ihsu yunki nimara kaʼtan ihtupuwa waʼki taweri. Nihpiriunwe tahpaʼawa yunki uʼmakamare iratupinan tanan parihchin yuʼme peʼperinkeran.
Ninanuʼpa kankunpate, kusharu kepareʼsu nanpirutahrin. Keteke puʼpian samira aʼshatu inaran tahpake aʼnapitamare.
Ina pakawen kahpashinkeran, kusharu tahpaʼin waʼwaruʼsamare.
¿Nuhsururan sami ketakasu ahpiwarin? Inapitasu nihpirirnwe kanpuarukunpua ni keteruwa iminke, nahpuatun naʼparinunpua nuya kankakeran.
¿Nahpuinachin nahtantawa nuya nana?
Shaʼwiteke paʼantenaʼpiruʼsa nunchiʼin inaran iʼsha pentunchin taweriachin, tahshipachin iʼsha suʼpuraterin.

¿Makari a sehterin uhshiyaraʼwa tahshiramiachin uʼnaike? Nimara ku naniteriunwe tataine iminke pakakahsu. Kari nahtanawe ahkuanake yaʼnupikamare karuʼku. Nimara uʼnani nahpunin a kankanterin. Aʼna shaʼwinan shaʼwiterawe tewachinachin iʼshakeran. Niʼnawe senterinsu nañanterin aʼnuarahchin. Winarai piʼi pihpikaware inaran yaʼi aʼpinin kahpashinkera
Ku peʼpekariwawe naʼkun peʼpetu kusharu nuwanterewasu kepawatewa.
Kemhsu imira ya pamura.

Iyahsha, muhshainke kahtawaku nahkaranchin. Kema nihpatan aʼchin peipite, waʼwaruʼsa shipikapuna uʼnaike. Nuyahsha niʼkui kiyanta. Ku paterawe ihsu sahkatu, yuhsemare, kahpashin kankanchihtunawe yaʼipichachin.

Uhshiya uʼmawachin paʼninsukeran, ni yuntuʼina yaʼipichachin. Aʼma nahpunin nahkawiʼinasu. Nuyahsha inaran ihpuiʼna chinihken. Maneku, aʼshin naʼnerarin kahpashin kankanterin keran nuwanterin niʼkasu mañahtun ihpura pihtake.
Unpuwa, iyahsha. Kamare weʼka iteke tatawarin ninanukeran kankipachin, inaran kuninansake nuyahsha muhturu kepake.

Kairuʼsaruʼku yunkirai tanan wayu mahkakasu iʼshana pentuntatui. Ninarai yaʼnaterin yunsankeʼpa aʼnasu pihkeran kehpariterin niʼtun,naʼkun inanshirapitare. Iraterai winatui yaʼi taweri, kairuʼsa nuhsirawehsu.

Amiraʼwanu kañurahpun, piyapi yaʼwerawe nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu paʼnin nunentunaʼpi yunihkapun. Nimara kahsu ku nituhterawe unpu yuspanrin itakahsu panka. Inahsu ninarahrin nuyahsha nuntakahsu inapihkeran inaputerawe. Penen kechinken nuʼsurutamare, tananke paʼpatan maʼsha pahsawatan nuwantaran kahtawainensu.
Ina paʼantenaʼpimahshu taʼnaʼtun maʼihtunwe, ina iʼsha wahpuru nimara paterin ku shaʼwitapunawe, inahsu nihpiriunwe kehparitatun ninatahrin.
Nuya paʼke, uhshira. Piʼi pihpiwachin, nunshake paʼawa ninanuʼpa. Peʼperarawe puʼpian peʼpetunuwe inaran yunkiarawe inuteke yaʼnupireʼsu.
unpua, tatamashu. ku winarawe irahka puchin ku yaweranwe nihtun. nawananke nahkun pahpatera teʼkeinke samihtawe kawerachin ku inshateranta nihnarinkewe peike.

Weke, waʼwashanuwe, nahtanke paʼmutarawepuchin. Paʼterinsu nuyahsha akuteke, ana naʼkun paʼchinsu inara ama puʼpian paʼchinsu, inaputatan nahkaranchin paʼantatarinen. Ama piyapiruʼsa nunpintekehsu mana aʼnataweri kemanta nuwantaran maʼsha kahtawainensu. Nuyahsha kema nihpatan maʼsha nuya yaʼwetarinke, ku nahpanawe nunpinkeranwe.Manuke, kepake kehsha nunshinankehpa kuʼwara piyapiruʼsa mentarawi.
¿Unpuwanta a nuyahsha kankanterinku winarinsu?
Tahshiraya uhshiyanuwe kankiarin aʼna ninanukeran. Kahpashin kankanterai nihkatui inaran nunshakeran pihpiwachin chinirawatui ihpurarai.

Mamapaya yah shaʼwiterin waʼwaruʼsa. Kepaina naʼkun kusharu ahke ira nihpachin. Wenuina tuʼnaru ikirupachina panen nanpetatuna. Iʼshapirianke. Panka tanan inaran pavweru aʼnuarahchin ikirure kahpuara iratewatewa.
Uʼnani nihpuni, werunke maʼsharuʼsa yunsanke ninin aʼpechihteriuwawe. Ku ihkanchiteriuwawe tahpakamare kuʼwara shipiahtaraʼsuwe yaʼi.
¿tashitere, nusururankesu,nuwanteran kepariteʼi nuyaʼapiachin a weʼeteinke.?
¿Ku kankimariwen ina ana taweri,nuyapiachin pentuachina nakun iʼshanarusa pehpetuwinan pantapi kenken iminkeran?
Ihpura nahtarewa ihshiwinuʼsa: Paʼanteruwa paʼantupike inaran puʼpian tahparewe tatamahshumare, ina aʼchinterinpuwa ni ichi yaʼweretakahsu nuya kankankeran.
¿Mahshuya kahpashin kankanterin nimara inaran yusparin tenin uʼnan anutewachina ina uʼuhpachina?
Tatanuwe nuhsururawehsu, ku weʼka tuhpatuwe ku naʼwarewe.
Aʼma sami nanpiru paʼankesu tahshiramiachin, nahpuatun ku nuya pawere keterinenkenwe.
¿Unpuwanta nani iʼwaraya, uʼmawatera mamanuwe niʼnawekeran, wankui irake wenserawe ni uhkuikamare?
Samira paʼtun nihpachina ka puʼpian paʼanterawe, inapuchin kenansarawe puʼpian paʼterinsu kemuiruʼsamare.

Wiʼnawe, kahtawake uhshiwarin atarikayu paʼankamare ku waʼkipunawe. Nuyahsha akuke nuhpuituachin. nNuʼtehken paʼterinsu shaʼwike inaran shaʼwike pawereʼinen. Aʼma niwikehsu inshateranta, muhshapirinkenwen inapihkeran aʼma ninataʼinsu.

Inamini, waʼwishinuʼsa, kanpuahsu nimara niʼnira Naʼwanewa tananke ayarinsu. Nimara aʼ nataweri uʼmapun weʼeruwi imepachin.Ka tenawe paʼawa ahke werataʼawa nuʼwiterinsu nahtankamare tahshiramiachin. Nahpuantaratun, yunkiaʼa wa iminke imarinpuahsu.

Tahshirin niʼpatera ku ina aʼperawe. Ku nuwanterawe sehterewawehsu nihkamare. Ninarawe Waʼwasha inaura nuya ni akuʼin. Naʼnepachina, ku naniterawe a tunatakahsu. Mamanuwe ikirurinsu ihpurawe inaran ku maʼsha teranta tenawe.
¿Tata, paʼsaran aʼna ninanukeʼpa ihpura? ¿ku ikiruranwen? shaʼwituku mañahtun, ka ya paʼnawe kemaruʼku nunshake.
Aʼma pakehsu nuʼwitupianwe, iyahsha, aʼma ni aweahsu ihpura. Ku ya yunkirawe sehteransu paʼpatan. Ku yaʼweranwe iʼsha peʼpepatera nimantaratun samira kaʼpatera.

Uhshiya, nahtanku nahtanankensu mañahtun: shaʼwike nani ya uʼmararin waʼwanpuwa tanankeran. Niʼpatewa yaʼi winakariuwa kahpashin kankankeran. Taʼna peʼtenteke mañahtun, aʼma chinuhtetakehsu. Naʼkun naʼwanewa inaran ihkaimarinsu kahpashin a mentahtarinpuwa yaʼweruake.
Pake ninanuʼpa iyawarinehken inaran kahtuyaʼpima paʼanku pantaʼpi inapuchin ku kehkentaramewe peʼpetapuma kahtuyaʼpina ku ikiruaramawe.
Ahpimahshunuwe, ku wensewatewe ku iratarewe.
Samira paʼan intunwe puʼpian paʼterinsu.
¿Aʼma sehtekehsu senateransu waʼkipachin suʼsukamare? Ku sehterawe; nihpiriunwe kiwirawe inaran sahkatahrawe nani taweri winareʼna.
Kanpuahsu kuʼ pentunuwawe ku nuntapuriwarawe tatamashuhkurusa nuʼpanake nipiʼsu
¿Naʼneihturawe ku iyahsha kahtawapinawen? Inamini, nuyahshakeran yusparin itaʼawa. Waʼwasha kañaʼpi nihsapun, ina iʼsha kentarin ku inshateranta nahtanpunawe.
Nuyahsha nuntarawe nuya yaʼwekamare.
Iʼwara nunsha aʼnanteran.
¿Pinshike piwiranke nihpuni, ku tahshi teʼwaihtunwe? ¿Yunkiatun tatamahshu waʼwaruʼsa nuneninsu teʼwa inkitamare ku nuyahsha weʼihtuwe?

kema nihpera, nahtanan muʼturu tahkuʼirin tashi, yunkimaʼintun mamawarin ninarinke kuhsharu wenukare. ku kasu nihtutiʼitu kema nahneʼintu nahnerupuchin ayanwatena. nimara iʼna sehteʼ yaweteʼitenkuwe teʼtetenke.
Naʼkun maʼsha nuwanterinsu maʼpachin.
Mahshu, ¡kema paʼpi ikiruran? ¿ya wenseran puʼpian tahshinanke iratamare ninanuparihchi?
Ku taʼterawe kemahken sehtu suʼsupachina.
Uskuru tumare paʼain.

¿Unputa nihka keʼne ihsu aʼnanununa kepararawehsu ninanuke? Naʼkun keʼnin, naʼkun pawereʼihtunawe inaran kanchura paʼanihtuwe tahshi mare.¿Nanichiʼihtunkutu waʼna weʼehta nahsha paʼankamare? Kawera winaʼihtuwe suʼyawe yaʼwahrin kenamarawe nihpuni peike.
Ahke iraterawehsu ichi kanuhterinku.
Yunkirai yuʼkakasu muhturuke tihkiraisu.

¿Ka paʼan ihtuwe nimiriu sanawiruʼsa kayuruʼsamare ninanuke yaʼwepihsumare? Kepaihtuwe teshira inaran piʼshiru.¿Nihpiriunwe paʼtun yaʼihpi? Yaʼsutupachinku kashinuʼsa kehsarawe waʼwaruʼsamare. Kahpashin kankanchihtunawe inaputerawe nihpuni inaran taʼaihtunawe nahkapinkumare irake.
Pentunawatun taʼna peʼteihtunwe.
Nunawemare nahpunin iʼwa nuyahtaʼa, iyahsha; nani naʼweranken iminke, nuyahshakeran yunkike inaran ku kankan sehtapunawe.
Iʼsha tahshiraya nuyahpiachin nihpuni, ina tashiramiachin paʼihtunwe inaran kepaihtunwe pantaʼpi, shiʼshi inapita kepaihtunwe ninanu nunshinankeʼpa.

Kuʼwara paʼshataraʼsuwe ni yuntunpike shaʼwikapu nuya nanan nahsha? Manuke, kahtawaku iyaruʼsa shaʼwiteʼi ni yuntunkaimare ihsu peiteke. Manurankeran aʼma winaransu ayatekehsu, piyapiruʼsa Yunkiapi kahpashinkeran shaʼwirarin tehsawi. Kaʼtun nunsarawe inaran nuya nuhsururawehsu shaʼwiterawe aʼnaya aʼnaya. ¿Weʼsaran karuʼku ihpura u kehparitaran waʼwaruʼsa nihkamare?
Nimara tahshiramiachin paʼsarin kahpashin kankanterinkeran, aʼma nañanchinsu yaʼi nuntatun patamare.
Niʼke uhshaʼwaruʼsa waʼwisinuʼsa
Ku tananpitarawe yusparin itarausu, ka piyurayan ni yakawaraisu.
Ka iʼsha pentuntarawe nunshake inaran kankunpatu weʼka itarankema nuyahsha inaran nuya yunki ketarawe yaʼi piyapiruʼsa.

Nuya nahtanku, wiʼnawe. Aʼma tahpakesu sehtu ku shaʼwipinawen. Nuntuku nahtanansu saʼyate tarahpa nuyahtaʼse iʼshake.karinken nuyahshakeran nahtanaranken inaran nuyahsha yuniaʼa nuyahsha yaʼwekamare. niʼsaran kehken teʼteteransu puʼpian nahtansaran. Tahshiraya tahshiramiachin pihpirare inaran iʼsha kahtawarinpuwa nañantakahsu puʼpian puʼpian.
¿Paʼanawe piʼpiyamare ihsu pantaʼpinuwe nanpiruʼ pishate?
Kuʼ yawetenrinpuawe ishanarusa, niʼpirinwen kuʼ inaterayuwe kuʼ ahpinaya yunkipinawe.
Nimara tihkiuninpa aʼnaruʼchin iyhahsha niʼnawe. Nunshake nanperahpun ihpurawe, nihpiriunwe ku inapuchin yunkirawe.
Nani kehsha senarawe pihkeran, tahpake puʼpian kemuinenpitamare inaran yaʼsurinsu paʼanke nuya paʼtunke
¿ku tenan yunkirawe irahka pa¿pi ya yuʼnawe pantaʼpi yamurare wiʼnawitapu?
¿Yunkiran mamanen pawanterinsu? ama paʼyankesu, inahsu nihpirinwe naʼpaterin kiya paʼanteraisu.
Ku iʼyara nuʼwikapuwe, ku weʼehshataraʼsuwe nuyahsha nuntarawe tahshiraya iminke winakamare.

ama nanianteru peʼpeteransu irake, ninainke. iwara ku kenananwe ayanesuʼ inachachin ayanapiranwe. manuke, ama chiwekeru nahkarachin. ama tashi ninahkesu: tashi kuasuʼ kenanterewe irake anarachin chiwere.
Nuyahshakeran uhsharan irateke iraparihchi; naʼkun ikiruwatan, chinuhtatun inaran yunkike iratewihsu ihsu ruʼpake nani paʼpisu.
¿Unpuwanta nani nunshake pentunpatera ya winarawe inaran kankunawe ahke kemuiruʼsa nihkamare?
¿Unpuwanta wenserawe puʼpian naranan anuterinsuke kuʼwara tanan pentunchahtaʼsuwe manuke paʼsawatera nunentapu?
¿Unpua tahpaterewawe maʼtaranta ke mamanemare?

Ketarawe pantaʼpi sami manaʼpi sami keteinkumare, aʼnaruahchi tihkiarawe, ku nahpaunawe nuʼten yunkirau, yaʼwetumarin naʼkun ihperaʼ, inaupuchin tahpararwe kurihki mamanewe nimiriu paʼantakausu, maniatun tihkiarawe peiʼpa paʼmakausu.

¡Iʼsha nahtananʼinku teʼwareʼna nunawehsu! Kepaku sami nanpiru inaran aʼma nuwantekuhsu puʼpian paweri kechinmahsu. Ina paʼantupike nuya nahtantuku. Kari peʼinaʼpiruʼsa paʼpuyararawe ihsu ninanuke, waʼyanu sehterin nunpintupachinura.
Tahshiramiachin tehkein pentuntaʼa; iʼsha pamaterin nihpuni ka ushahkeran maichihtuwe, inapuchin ninanukeʼpa nuya kankunihteriuwe.
Ku tananpinteriun wiʼni kañaʼpi nininsu, ku kenanniwe nuyahpiachin kanka inakaritaranta teʼwarinsu aʼpatupi iʼkee taʼasun.
¿Unpuanta tahshi naʼnekaun, wiʼnawe? ¿Naʼwanan mamaparin ihke paʼninsu? Yuhse yunkipatan karuʼku, ¿Ku taʼchihtunwe?
Nimara paterewa ihsanarusa, ¿nuhtepaʼ?
Nuyapeʼtenke ina pantaʼpi, iya

¿Maʼmareta kemanta manuran pakamare? Aʼma pekehsu Inapuchin, iyawe. ¿Ku niʼnanwe teʼwarawehsu? Shaʼwituku, ¿tahshi nanwanan? Peike taʼtarinsu ichi sehterinku. ¿Kema uʼmakapun unpuinteranta senatamare?
Ku yaʼweterinkuwe taweri wiʼnawe ihpukamasuwe tahshiachin, aʼnaruahchin pihpirin tananke, teʼwarin imahsarin niʼtun.
Kepaʼihtunwe samira kemuiruʼsamare.

Tahshiraya manurarawe nunshinankeʼpa pakamare. Nimara paʼanawe samira puʼpian paʼterinsu sanapi kemuinenpitamare. Yaʼwetapunku naʼkun kurihki nimara, nihpiriunwe puʼpian taharawe yaʼweterinkuhsu nimiriu paʼankamare. Manurarawe kuʼwara tahshirarin.
Tananwanke tahpake inaran ninake aʼpanitupihsu.
Nuyahkeran nuntaraewa yaʼihpima, kanpuasu yaʼweterinpua iraʼ tahshinan, nihpanawe kahpa kankankeran yunkiwiruwawe nanparin iʼchinpiatuwa ira imarewa peʼipamareʼ.
Ku niwike amarehsu ni yakawareke ku umpuruteranta keterinken, inaran ku pawararinkewe patarinke waʼanen ku maʼshateranta mareʼ peiʼ
Tenan nunshanen yuʼsawatun saʼyate tarahpa maʼpatapun.

Winkenke waʼruʼ kankirin kanpua yaʼwerewake, tahshiachinkeraware paʼnawe maituwina uhshahkeran inaran nuyahkeran iʼsha imamarau, ihtruʼpa nani ninarinawe, sami yumarawatu nuya nanan shaʼwitarawe, ihperawanta inaere nuya nihsapi.
Paʼantuku uskuruʼ naruʼpa.

Nimara payahsha nahtanin suʼin paʼmiaterin aʼnateran iʼshaparihchi. Nimara ina nani tahshirawachin iʼsha niʼnin inaran yusparin iterin waʼki piʼi yaʼwepihsu niʼtun. Nahpuware ku nuyawe ina aʼpe kushatakahsu sehtukeran, nimantaratun yaʼi nuhshanenpuwa nuwanterin aʼpeikasu. Ina yunki aʼma ayachinsuwe ku sehtatunawe nimantaratun inara tahkuichinwe.

Tahshita, uhshipaya. Nuyahshakeran weʼka iteranke. Kema nahtamaranke, kahpuchin, nani tahshi waʼwaruʼsa weʼehpachina teʼwa weʼnin. Sehtureʼna yunkirawe mamapaya aʼyareʼna teʼwa pakamare awiranke. Kahpaitatun ninatahri nimara, taʼtakasu kankirin.

Mamanuwe, ihseke puʼpian chinuhtewate, ka pahsarawe chinihken. Ikirurawe naʼkun pantaʼpi peʼperahpatu irake. Nara nukunankeʼpa wanipate,iʼsha uʼuhkapu inarapihkeran mañahtun paʼsari kuʼwara iʼwayahtaraʼsuwe.
Ku keparanwe pantaʼpi tanpanatereʼ.
Nuya iyahsha, ¿Ku kemawe aʼnanankuwe yuʼme kehsha peʼpekamare? Ihpuranta nimara naniteran, ku inawe nihpachin ku maʼshateranta paʼansarawe.
Ku nuyarinkuwe mamanuwe ninakawesu tanankeran uʼmapachin, ira ahke inaran iʼwatere uʼmakasu.

Ku iʼsha imaranwen kari shaʼwiterankenpuchin nahpuatun ku peinen kenananwen. ku nuya peʼperanwen peʼpetunen nahpatun yaʼi shipirin. Aʼma paʼyankensu ihpura, nihpiriunwe manuke: aʼma tananpitekehsu tahshitakahsu ira yunikaʼse.
ka peʼperarawe ihsu pehpetu paʼpi kehken ina nuunke,naniterin yankuminkasu;kahtawaku ni ketawa kuʼwara pihpirarewa ninanuʼwanenpuwaʼpa
Paʼterinsu nuya niʼin paʼantupike.
ku nunchatarakuhsuwe,nahpatun ku niʼnawe winaransu peike.
nani yamuanwachina piʼirute nahpunin naʼwerinsu yunkirawe. kepariteke kaʼreku, shawiteku mahteranta nuyapiachin naniantaʼa uʼnan napuinachin.
¿Tatamahshu, Kemanta teʼwaihtunwe tananke irinin nahtanin tahshi nihpuni? ¿Ku nuyahsha nahtan ihtuwe kemaruʼku kehpariterawe nihpuni taweri kaware?
¿Unpuata ihperasuwe ku keterinawe pihshate pantaʼpi nunumareʼ?
¿Kepapun sami nihka paʼantunanke?
Ahke maitarewa nunshinankeʼpa kankuntamare.
tahshita yaʼiwinkema ihse nihsaramahsu kia paʼyanai iʼsha sahterinsu tahshinanke, yushparinke yaʼweterinkui amiaʼwanuita ku ahke weʼehsahpi

Ya nahtananke nunshanen aʼnankainkumare, iʼsha pantaterin niʼtun chiweraiwe, yunsanke ninachiʼihteriuwawe nuyakeran. Inahke chinuhchiteriuwawe nuya kankankeran, nahkaranchin kenantaʼihteriuwawe ira iʼshaparihchi paʼninsu ninanuke.
¿Tenan yusparin itapu naʼkun kahtawarinkumare?
Nuyahshakeran wayuruʼsa nunshanake puʼmuke, iʼwa semanake ninanpuchin, inaputuwatan nuyahsha kepararan paʼanteranpa inaran aʼnarahchin nankitarinen.
¿Tataini naʼwanin waʼwasha peʼikapun paninsu? Tweriachin uʼmain, nuyahshakeran yuniʼin inaran winarinsu keʼin.?
¿Unpuwanta aʼna ninanukeʼpa ihkanpatera kahpashin kankanterawe ahpiraʼwasa nunshinanke yaʼnupiraʼpisu nihkatuwe?
¿Unpuanta tahshiramiachin ninanukeʼpa paʼsaran? Ihkantamare nuya paʼtun. Kaʼtun kankunpatera kuʼwara aʼnapita kankuyantaraʼse samira aʼnuarahchin iʼkiri paʼanehsu
Wiʼnawe nituhterin iyahsha pantaʼpi shaʼnin yuhkamare? Paʼpin sehterin wiʼnin ku nitu teniunwe yusparinke. ¿Nuya tenan aʼya piyapi inaura sahkatapun iminke ku yusparin itupirinawe?

Aʼma naʼkun naʼnekesu, iyara, nimara mishu uʼmapun inaura. Manuke, kaʼke maʼshateranta, nimara nuya nahtanpun. Naʼwanan kemare weʼerin niʼtun. Aʼma tahshi teʼwakehsu. kahsu niʼtahpu kehparitatu inaran nahpuinahchin ninatariuwa.
Ama kunʼpurunta sehtahkesuwe shaʼwitewachinenken,sami kankiwachin iʼshakeran.

Nuyahtarin tatamahshunen ihsu tawerimiahchin nuya nanan nahtantaran? Manuke, akuraiteke iʼsha nunenan aʼyuteransu. Nuyahtuwachin aʼma nañantekehsu nuhsururansu, aʼnahken nuyanken nihpatan kañaʼpi naʼwanai. Kari ayariʼne piwihsarawe tiʼyahten.¿Weʼsaran karuʼku ku nihpun kehparitaran pensha kaʼtankamare?
Kiniru naʼkun yaʼweterinpu nihpuni, yaʼi pantapiruʼsa peʼpeihteriuwe nunshakeʼpa. Mamanuwe inaran ka kepaihteiuwe uhsharan yunsankeʼpa.

¿Unpuwanta iʼwa kemahken mamapayanen nuʼku ni nuʼwirai iwe shipirinmare? Nuʼwitatui ku kahtuyapinkui ku weʼeraiwe. ¿Ku nihka niʼnanwe tahshiramiachin nani nuyahteraiwe inaran nuyahsha ni nuntawatui ni ihpurai? Karihsu naʼwanawe ina peike yaʼwahpiraiwe. ¿Nuʼten ihsu ruʼpake nuʼwitu ku ahsu waʼkiriunwe kanpuwamare? Teʼwaterawe chiminkahsu ku nanan nuyahteraʼsewe piyapiruʼsaruʼsa ni nuhsurawehsu.
Nimara kehshaʼtun peʼpeihteriuwawe inapihkeran kuhtarute. Yaʼi ihkankapun nimara, nihpiriunwe yaʼinpuwa tini ihturiuwawe uhsharan.
Ku yunkirawe unpuhsu pawererinawe atarikayumare; nimara puʼpian, nihpiriun kahpashin kankantereʼna uʼmarawe yaʼweraweke.
Shaʼwiterinawe nuya nimiriu nihpuni, nuyahshakeran shura teʼihtuwe, nihpiriunwe ku nituhterawe, nimara puʼpian sapurimare sehterawe.

¿Unpu yusparin itapunta iyahsha sharaya keterinkensu shaʼkamare? Nuyahshakeran weʼka iteke kenanpatan. ¿Shaʼwiteke kahtawakasu iminenke nuwantuatan? Nuyahsha yaʼwekasu yaʼwerin maʼsha ni keterekeran. ¿tahpake yunkiransu nuyahshakeran? Aʼchinapi nuwanterin aʼchintakasu ihsu wiʼnapisa, nituhtaimare maʼsha ayankaimare maʼpatupihsu.
Mañahtun ina saweni aʼnanku, iyahsha, iʼwe yahshitarawe kuʼwara kamutechin nihshataraʼsuwe ku ihpura tihkirawe. Keteke kema miwiranken, aʼma yinkikehsu.

¿Uʼmapun tanankeran iʼwe kemareʼna nani tahshi anutawiriun? Ina peʼpetunen paʼpi kehken kemamare. ¿Ku yuʼyuwarin shaʼwitaranwe kahtawainkehsu? Ahke ira taranin tahshi nihpachina. ¿Unpuruta paʼsaran tawerimiahchin kankamare, waʼwashanuwe?
Nunsha patarawe puʼpian chinuhtamare.
Kuʼwaniapi ninanuke ku inshateranta nahtanpiuwe nunentu peike kiwipihsu piyapi nuninsu, nimantaratun ku ina penen yaʼwepachiunwe piyapiruʼsa ku sapu kañu chinitawiuwe.
Maʼpatuku weʼka itarankensu. nani tahshi teʼwarai puʼu perarinsu nahtansawatui, nihpiriunwe yusparin iterawe nahsha taweri kankirinsu aʼpinpinan.
Iʼwananke iʼshayunsanke waniarawe.
Ama pihpikesuwe iʼwaraya peinenkeran,ku paʼantunaʼpiruʼsasu ninatupiwe pantapi paʼankaisumare nimanatarin kuanta paʼantupin kepachinara paʼanuhsake.
Ku naniantarewawe nunshinankeran nuʼun
Mamapaya weʼnin nihpuni, taʼnanen kepachihteriuwawe. ninamara wankuinante nunshake akuihteriuwawe chinuhtamare nuyahsha.
ku taʼchituwewe sehtarusu niʼnanken aʼna ninanuke paʼnansu.
¿Nimara ninakawe nuyahsha waʼwatakahsu?

Nahtanku nunawesu, nuya piyawi: kema ya paʼantuwatanku ina nahsha saʼyate tarahpa aʼyaiterehsu, karinke kechihtenkenwe kahtu yuʼme shiʼshi. Nihpiriunwe ituku:¿kemamare nuya niʼihtunwe kanpiatakahsu? Aʼma yunkiransu taʼchinsu. Paʼterinsu nuʼten akuteke, maʼsu iyahshakapini ku yaʼweriunwe ni nunpintakahsu.
Iʼwata, tatamahshu, naʼpaku ihsu nuteina, yuhparinke itawa iʼsha sami keterinpuamare.
Kemahsu ku keparanwe samira nanpiru nunshinankeʼpa, nahpuatun ku piyapiruʼsa yaʼweterinkenwe.
¿Kepapu taʼnanewe kanpuʼ chinuhtakamareʼ kuʼwara pentuntareʼ naʼkun iʼshanaruʼsa?
Ama tahpakeruwe winaransu,nahkuanawe winake nuya nanan yaʼwepachin.
¿Niketapun iyawarineʼken kurihki nimara?

¿Unpuanta waʼwasha nañanterin yusparin itakasu iyahsha inari aʼchintepiriunwe maitakahsu? Paʼpin inamare sehterin. ¿Yunkirin kahtawatakahsu inaura kankirin? Inahsu nininsu inaran yusparin iterin iyahshanenpita nanan yaʼwepachina ninanuke.
¿ihpura yamura nakun patarin isehke?
Iyahsha, yusparinn ituku yunirankenmare.
¿Mamanuruʼku weʼihtutu iʼshakeran?

¿Maʼta unprinta uhshawanuwe Tahshirayamiachin? Kaihshanene ni awemarai iminke. Kari nahtanawe nahkaranchin nuya ni nuntantakaimare ina kaishanene. Nimara ku inahsu nuya nahtaninkuwe. Shaʼwiterawe irahka unpu yaʼweterehsuna waʼwashatapui narinkepuchin. Niʼmawe winarinsu naʼkun. Inapihkeran kahtuyaʼpi ni ihpupi. Kahsu kahpashin kankanterawe nuʼnu narake wenserinpuchin.
Taweriachin kemuinenpupita nuntawatewa paʼawa, nimara iratakahsu ikirureʼ inaran uhsharan iratariuwa iʼshana paʼmairaʼse.
Ku kankuanuwa taweriachin chinuhtapatewa nara mukaru nukunanke.
Ahpurimahshu,¿Ku paʼanterewe nuʼten paʼterinsu atari? Nuyahshakeran nahtan inke aʼnanku kahtu, ayatewatu teʼwarawehsu suʼsurarin.
¿Niwike iyaruʼsa ketaʼawa?
Nuyahshakeran yaʼnatirinsu iʼsha pentunteke, tuʼkuiru naʼpiraruʼsa taranin. Aʼnateran iʼshakeʼpa ninake iyaruʼsa inaran chinuhteku.
Ihsu piʼihke nuya senaterawe nihpuni, ina kepaihtunwe pantaʼpi paʼankamre paʼantupiʼpa inaran paʼan ihtunwe nuya paʼtunke kemunenpita kahtawakamare.
¿Nani taweri naʼkun peʼirawe yamura kanpiatamare? Nuyarinku ina yunkirehsu, kahtuyaʼpinpu pihpiri kahpashin kankantate.

¿Kemanta naʼkun naʼwanan mamapuchin? Ina ku kushateriunwe tananke paʼninkeraware. Manuke, ¿maʼshateranta Nituhteran inanke? Ihsu taʼtarinsu tahshi ichi teʼwarinpuwa yaʼichachin. ¿Unpuwanta paʼnin ku shaʼwipunawe? Shaʼwituku mañahtun irake nahtanansu.
Weʼkama, imuya. Nuyahsha kankanteke inaran kemaʼtun nanpeke; peʼpeke kuhsharunen inaran keteke wiʼnawi iʼsha nuwiterinsu.

¿Ina nimara yuʼsawatun saminen maʼpatapun nanpiyun ina keninsu? ¿Ina awaitenaʼpi nuwantarin aʼnuarahchin ku nuʼwitapunawe manurarin niʼtun? ¿Ayanpuna yaʼwepike kuʼwara uʼnan chinihken anuchahtaraʼsuwe tananke?
Aʼma nunshakre nanpetarakehsu iyahsha. Aʼma paʼtekesu iʼsha ku nunkanawe. Ku nuyarinkuwe pakakahsu, teʼwarawe kemaruʼku yaʼnupikahsu. Aʼma nañantukuihsu ahkekeran.

Tatanuwe kawera ihseke wenserarawe puʼpian. Tahshinankeʼpa chinuhtere nihpuni, ku paʼuru ikihchituwe. Inapihkeran maneku, naʼkun tanan pawananin. Ihpura paʼpate, kankuanewa mamapaya peinenkeʼpa kuʼwara iʼwayahtaraʼsuwe.
Ku kahsu naʼkun nunshake ya ninaterawe, pakakaru iʼshawankana ahke nimantaratun ku aʼnuarahchin kankumarewe
Nimara nuyahsha nunsha aʼsuane. Pantapiʼtun yah peʼpere inapihkeran kanpuwa nanperuwa, munsha tawan tawan tuhkunin chinii iʼsha nihpachina.
Piʼpiyan nimara ihpera taweri paweranunpua?
Yaʼi ninanu nuwantupi ira ahke nininsu, nimantaratun ayankasu ina iʼsha ahkekeran kahpashin kankantapuna.
Inta ku weʼerinwe wiʼnin yunkiwachina, yunkipirinwe winarinsu ku tananpiterinwe, ku tenʼwariun kaniuwachin.
Unpuwa. yanaʼnerawe mamaparinu yunkiwateraʼ. Kuwachi kantarinwe karuʼku iminkewachi, nani iʼwaraya ku kenanaweʼ wanirinke.
ketaʼawa pihshate yanihte inaran maʼpatawa uskuru inau paweretupi inarahka tatanenpuasu.
Irahka asuhkaru ku ahkete paʼteriunwe,¿Yunkiran wiʼnawe?
Paʼpi ku nuyawe kanaterinwe wiʼnini ahke patuwachina, yunkirinsu chasu kehpariterin iʼwaraya nihpachina yunkiri inare nininsu.
ku teʼwaterewawe tanan kanpuwasu,nihpirinwe iraterewa nahpuinahchin ku maʼninteranta pahsarewawe.

Weʼka tenawe nuyahshakeran, mahshu nituhtunaʼpi. Nuʼten mare kema Nituhteran teʼwawatera tahshi niʼni aʼna mama nanunsha. Yunkirawe irahka nanan waʼyan a taʼterinsu. Inahke ninarawe tawerikahsu, teʼwarehsu ayantarin puʼpian ihsu piʼiruʼteke.

Unpuwa yaʼima, Iʼwara ku naniterawe shaʼwikahsu iratarawehsu. Wahpuru iʼsha ku ninarinkuwe puʼpihshan mare yunsanke shi kehpariterawe, pantaʼpi paʼanpatu, ku kenawe taʼna nahpunin weʼerawe, inamarehsu ku sehterawe ihpura.
Naniterin uhshiya waikahsu. Paʼawa kahtawaʼawa inaran yaʼinpuwa kahpashin kankantarewa, nimara waʼwina waʼwatuwachin ihpurarewa.
Kahpa maʼtaranta niʼnawe ishu tanpananteke.
Tata, ¿Unpu ni aʼpeiwata chiʼchi kañukeran? Niʼke, tehkeiniʼsha inpihtaʼa inaran wiʼsekariuwa kuʼwa kushachataraʼsuwe.
Ahpi ku kehparitariunwe iʼshake kanarinsure; Ahpiaʼwainpitare ni ketapuna nuyahshakeran.

Nahtanke nunawesu kuʼwara paʼshataraʼsuwe, waʼwishin. Ka manureʼna wahpuru iʼshake nanperawe nihpuni, nunte shipirinke tuʼkuichihtuwe. Nahpuatun nuya iʼnake inaran yunsanke mahteke. Aʼma iʼyaʼwa peʼpekehsu nunshakeʼpa, ka tananpituku. Ikiruwinan kankunpate, weʼehsare taweriachin ku kehtaritepinanwe. Taʼake mañahtun, nani muhturu irinin.

Ku nunterawe iyahsha kuʼwara paʼshahtaraʼsuwe, nihpiriunwe kahpashin kankanterawe. Ku ninarawe wahpuru iʼsha panka nani tahshiramiachin paʼnin niʼtun. Weʼkama yaʼima, paʼsarawe sami nanpiru paʼankapu aʼna ninanukeʼpa. Ihpura ku wachi taʼna naniterawe.

Tatanen paʼin nahkapiʼin wiʼnin uʼmararinsu peʼirinkeran. Aʼma tanawitekehsu inaura iʼsha yunsanke ninataʼinsuwe. A nuya kankantiʼin inaran nuya nanan nahsha nininsu chinuhtapuchin. Ihsu tawerimiahchin, piʼi uʼmararin kemuiruʼsa kahpashin kankantawi uʼmaran niʼtun.

Mamapaya shaʼwiren ira paʼnesu panka iʼshaparihchi naʼkun ikirure. Amiraʼwasa nuyahshakeran irachina nara ite wankana. Chinuhchina tahshiwanke. Yamuruwachina wenu uʼuina. Uʼmaina ira nuwitupiparihchi.
¿unpuanta niwiterewa anataweri ku pichipinawen?
¿Yunkiran wiʼnawe aʼpeiransu ka aʼnateran ninanukeʼpa paʼantaʼse? Nahpuru ya patantuke ihpurankensu aʼnuterinku nuya nuhsurutamare.
Iʼwata, ahpimahsu. ¿Aʼma teʼwakesu kemaura iʼsha pentuntuatan? iʼsha nanperin aʼnarahchininaran ira wewepiru taranin.
Mamaparin waʼwashatahpun,ina ruʼku paʼnei ninanuʼpa ina nunshake. Iʼsha niʼke nuyahshakeran inaran shaʼwiteke aʼna ite weʼpachin.
Ku muhturuwawen, ku aʼyaintuwe ihpura.
Waʼwishin, aʼma sehtekesu mamawarin paʼnin nunentu peiʼpa niʼtun. Kahpasinkeran ninake, ina iʼwaraya uʼmararin inaran inapita irateriuwa iminparihchi.

¿A waitenaʼpipaya shaʼwirin atarinen ketarin sanawi yaʼwerinsu ina yaʼwerin nuhtetenake inari nunen pahkaturu ketakamare? ¿Ninamara atarinen yuʼsawatun maʼpatarin ina nunen pahkaturu washirunuʼsa a nuyahtupihsu? ¿taweriachin kankuanin kuʼwara kemuiruʼsa iʼke paʼshataraʼsuwe?
Uʼnan anuterin ina inaura kankenterin wenserinke. Waʼwinpita ahke paʼninsu yunkiatun naʼnerin.
Wiʼnan shaʼwiteke aʼma tananke waʼki insu; Nani iʼwaraya uʼmain kuʼwara aʼpininsu paʼshataraʼsuwe.
Uʼnan kenanpachinke kemaura irake, uʼmananke ninanuʼpa aʼyaihtunwe;ninaʼihtuwe iyawarinpita nahkawirarinensu kahpashinkeran.
Nuwanterewa kepakasu muhturu nunshake.

¿Unpu yusparin interanta iyahsha kema pirianke yaʼwerinsu kaʼtaninkensu kemaura sehtase? Nuyahshakeran nunteke inran aʼnuteke wensenan. ¿Keteke pantaʼpi aʼniteransu penshake? Inapuchin nuyahsha yaʼwarewa kemuikapini. ¿Yunkike yaʼi taweri nuyahsha nuninsu? Aʼchinapi nahtanin ihsu nituhtamare yusparin tenehsu aʼnure yaʼi taweri, kuahsu aʼnaruahchinwe.

Wiʼnashanawe nuhsurarawehsu, nahtanku ihsu paya nuwanterimahsu kanpita weneinemapuchin. Nani paʼanteruake pantaʼpi ninanuke, tahpaʼawa puʼpian suʼsusamare ku iʼmin yaʼwetupihsumare. Aʼma yunkiaʼawasu kanpua peʼpeteruahsurahchinwe, yunkiaʼwa tanapihsumare.Senateruahsukeran ni keteʼawa nuya kankankeran, inaran nuʼpa keteapunpuwa naʼkun nihterinsu.

Nimara aʼshin tahparin panka sehtu waʼwin ahke kirihka nihkapun paʼninkeraware. Ina imara nituhtapun paʼninsu nuyamare.nuya niʼnin paʼtakasu ina yunkiapuchin, imiraruʼsa taʼtakamare yunki. Ina aʼma kañuʼinsu sehtukeran, nimara waʼwin uʼmapun iranen tiʼkipachin.
Kankuanwa kuʼwara kañaʼpi ichi iʼwachahtaraʼsuwe.
- ¿Unpuwanta naʼneran, wiʼnawe? - Mamapaya chiminin?. - Weke ihpuku, yunkike nuhsururinkensu inaran yunihke kahpashin kankantamare.
Nimara yuʼme paʼterawehsu ya paʼanterawe kaisha yaʼwerawe ahkete yaʼwerinsu, ku nahpunawe nuya nituhterawe aʼnahkenta nimara ya paʼanterinawe.
¿Inta peʼpekapun kehken weʼehta?
Nunchikema nuyahkeran, iyaruʼsa, ihsu kahpashin kankanterewawe yunkiaʼwa waʼwaterewasuʼ, yaʼwerewa, taʼarewa tahshi nunihkariwa mahshukuruʼsa yaʼwepisu, tatamahshu shaʼwitupachinpuaraʼ.
Nimara yuntunpate nanitere saʼyate tarahpa paʼankasu paʼpi nuwanterehsu.

Weʼkama, nahteraihsu iyaruʼsa. Kiyahsu sehterai, tata ku uʼmariunwe peʼirinkeran nimantaratun iʼshanta pamaterin. Inara nimara ninararin iʼsha paʼmaikasu. Weʼka iterai nuyakeran inaran muhsterai yaʼwerike kahpashin kankantamare

¿Ku sami kaʼnewe nuya piʼihpinanwe? Inahsu ku nuyawe, nanpi ichi kañurinpuwa. Kanpuahsu nuya anpiaʼawa kusharu aʼma kañukamarewe. Kankan ikihtuwatewa aʼma paʼyan awahsu, paʼawa nunentu peike inahke aʼnuarahchin nuneninpu nuyahshakeran.
¿Aʼma sehtekesu iʼwaraya, ka kankirawe paʼpi ikiruwinan, yunkiatuwe mamanuwe aʼchinterinkuhsu aʼma ayankamarewe irake?
Kanpuasuʼ kankunewa nunshinanpaʼ nani pamatawasuʼ inapuchin ku nanitereweʼ pakakasuʼ.
¿Ku niʼniwen inasuʼ anataweri piʼirute ya pentuachina, kankukamare peinenke ku unanin shipitamarewe?
Nuyahshakeran ninachihtunwe yaʼi tahshi ku weʼepinawen, ku nimara taweri yaʼkari nunsha ku ayaniunwe, inaran ku akahturiunwe inauchin nihkasu.

tTananpitewatanku kahtawakamare, ka peʼpeihtuwe nununuʼsa wankuruware. ¿kema tenan paʼankari ihpura? Nimara senaterehsu naʼkunkeware yamura inaran tuma paʼankamare. Ku nituhterawe taweriachin kankikari nimara, tatamahshu. Sehterawe kayantuachin.
Ihsu taweriahchin iyahshanen nunchin inaran peike uʼmain piʼi yaʼkunpachin, inapuchin aʼshin ku sehtariunwe.
Nimara ichi nanpeihteriuwe muhturu nuyahsha. Ka kahtawaʼihtuwe tatanuwe, kehken nihpiriunwe ku nituhterawe ihkankapui kiyara nimara.

Tahshirin nihpuni, ira ayachihturuwawe, muhshaihteriuwawe pensha pirianke ninatamare nuyakeran. Kiyahsu chinuhteihteuwiwe tawerikaware inaran kahpashin kankankeran inaran ira nahkaranchin imantaʼihteriuwawe pahkaturu mahkatewa kañaʼpi nunenkamare.

Nahtantuku weʼka iterankensu nuyahshakeran iyaruʼsa. Senteruwa tatamahshu ku sauhta taweri nuniunwe niʼtun. Nimara uhsharan inaran nuya pahkaturukeran nahkaranchin kahpashin niʼtantarin. Weʼkama iterai inaran muhshaterai kemuiruʼsa kankanenkeran nuyahtamare ihsu tawerimiahchin.
¿Unpuruta niʼsaran wiʼnan nansarinsu? Ninararawe nuyahskeran, tanankeran uʼmararinsu nuya inaran kahpashinkeran.

¿Naninitawen niwi kentainkuhsu ina kiruhsin kara unpuinteranta paweraranke ihsu taweriahchin? Senterawe ku nanparin yaʼweriun niʼtun ku naniterawe waʼwaruʼsa kirihkanen nitakahsu tahshi. Ihpura paʼantuatanku, ayantaranke paʼterinsu wankana paʼantupiʼpa paʼpatu. ¿Kiwira ihsu aʼchinapi nahkaranchin? ku waʼki ya niwirankenwe,iyahsha, nuʼtemare yusparin itaranke.
Yaʼwetuku nuhsha tahshi, kumpawaruʼsa piʼpiyan teʼwa manima peen tahkuirinsu, a kahpa kanchima ina kaʼtanarinkema, uhshakeran ninasarama, uhshahkeran nuntaʼima ina weʼehkamare.

¿Unpuwanta nihsaran, Amiraʼwa? Nimara nani yaʼweterinke peʼpekamare maʼsha iratamare, ku nituhterawe ihpura nani ya pihpimaran. Nimara uʼnan weʼpachin nunshinan ira tuʼkuirumahshu nihsarin. ¿Ku nahterankuwe paʼa puʼpian ninataʼa nihpai? Kahsu sehterawe iʼsha pamatarin niʼtun ku nuwanterawe maʼshateranta unpukahsu. Nimara tawerianpitapun aʼpetupinan, pihpiare tahshiramiachin. Ni aʼpeike, wiʼnawe, shaʼwituku nani yaʼi tahpatuatan.

Iyahsha,nahtainke nuya nuntuku pawanawemare., kema sawininen aʼnanpatanku, ka ira aʼchinpeike paʼnesu nihsan ihtuwe. Nuya nunteku ihsu aʼninapi sehtarinsu. Aʼma tananpitekehsu yuhsemare, tahshiraya waʼwaruʼsa nuya iratapi tahshiramiachin.
Ku kanpitaruʼkewe nanparawe nuʼunke.
Ihpura nimara peʼpeapuna aʼyaitena.
¿Umputa waʼkiawe ihsu iramare? Nishike kema nusha makankera:chinuhteke kemaʼtun, kaʼsu kankirawe paʼpi ikiruwe nihpirinwe nusha kankaterawe uhmarawe peike.

Weʼkama yaʼima, ku shaʼwiterawe saʼawe ahke irataramahsu. Ku ninararawe aʼna wahpuru iʼsha, manawe inaʼtun pihpisarintun. Kahpashin kankanterawe atarinuwe paʼanawe nuya paʼtunke niʼtun. Ku ikirurawe iratatu, puʼpian inaran nuyahsha taranin.
Tahshiraraya tahshiramiachin pakariuwa nunshinankeʼpa. Peʼikariuwa naʼkun inaran kanpiaterewa yamura aʼna peike. Manuke, mahke yuʼmenen.
¿Unpu kepaita pantaʼpiruʼsa ninanuwake nuyah peʼtenkamare?
Ketarainken shapun kemahken pihshatemareʼ.
¿Nimara ku aʼpayaninku wiʼnawe winarinsu? Ku naniterawe tananpitakahsu, winarinsu ku naniterinkuwe a nihsha kankanteinkuhsu pei pirianke yaʼnupipachina.
¿weʼehkapun taʼnake weʼmawatan?
Kampua tatanenpua paʼpachi aʼna ninanuʼpa, seʼterewa tehkein pamatuwachin ma;kuwana

Nimara mihtayutenaʼpi naʼwanin iyahshanen iratupihsu tananke. Nimara ina ku naniteriunwe iratakahsu sehtukeran, tanan nahtanin ikihterinsu. Nuya niʼnin tenan ina yusparin itakasu mihtayu ni ketupihsu iʼshana pirianke. Ina tahpaʼin yunki puʼpian pensha puchin, aʼma tananpichinsu sehturi tahkuichinsu.

Nimara sanawi kankanenke tahparin panka sehtu waʼwinwn paterinkeraware iʼsha peʼnahte.Nimara ina tahparin yunki aʼma sehturi ichi kañukamarewe.Ku nimara ina nuniunwe mamapayaruʼsere, inawa nituhtewi a taʼtatahsu waʼyan ikirurinsu. Ina yusparin iterin nanpirin, waʼwinsu nihpiriunwe ni uʼwararin aʼna parihchi ke.
¿Kepakeʼ waʼwasha waʼanuʼsataʼpa?
Kepake peʼpetunen, wiʼnawe;pentuntaran naʼkun iʼshanaruʼsa inaran ahke ira taransarin. Chinuhteke piʼi chinihken piʼkatuwachin.
- ¿Nunin iramare? - Inapuchin nimara, tenin ira ahke paʼnin, niʼnawe ikirureʼna nunin.
¿Pentu kema ina iʼshanaʼpa ahkemichin?
¿Nituhtapu ka nararaʼwa nunenterehsu yuʼsawatu maʼpatakahsu yamura inaran uskuru, ku nihpun paʼantenaʼpi ku nuwantapuwen maʼpainkuhsu sehkerawehsu?
Kuʼ naneransun ku nuyakankaterinkuwe.
Unpuwa, waʼwishinuʼsa. Uʼnan anutewachin sehtarewa nimara inaran kanpuarahchin tananke. Sehteruwa aʼnapita ku winapihsu nahtantuwara. Nihpiriunwe Yaʼwetarinpuwa kaʼtanainpuhsu inaran winapihsu peike.

de cruzar miramos el agua, por si está muy crecida. No sé si pasaremos hoy, pero siempre esperamos con calma. Luego regresamos remando juntos, contentos. Kiyahsu nunsha nuya yah aʼsunai peʼpetu kepawatera. Pantaʼpi nunun peʼpekaiuwa nimara inaran kehsha tuʼnapinan. Inaran keparewa saʼyate tarahpa aʼyaterehsu irake peʼikamare. Kuʼwara pentunyahtaraʼsuwe iʼsha niaʼawa, pamatahpiriunwe. Ku nituhterawe nahwekariuwa ihpura nimara, nihpiriunwe Ninataʼawa nuyahshakeran. Inapihkeran Ayankariuwa nahpuinahchin kahpashinkeran maitupinan.
Amiraʼwaya, aʼkayan pihpirrawe iʼsha peʼnateparihchi. Peʼpetunu puʼpian peʼperarawe. Kema ninateke ihseke, nani tahshi uʼnanpiriunwe.
¿Senateransu yaʼipi ketapun?
Ku naʼkun nuʼwichihtuwe, nuyahsha nuntukuwi.
¿Unpua, mama, urake nani tahshi ama waʼwaruʼsa teʼwari mahkakamaruʼ?
¿Pentuntapun tananku nahtanapunawe tahshi?
Aʼshin pakapun wahpuru iʼshake nimara, yunsanke ninachin.
Yunkiaʼa paʼpi nuya paʼterinsu kahtunpuʼ.
Iʼwa puchin, pawereteran nuhshake nimara.

¿Ku ni suʼpinkariuwawe chinihken uʼnanpachina? Inapuchin nihpatera iru kañu maninpu. Kanpua ni aʼpeiwatewa ku shipiwinan tananke pihpiwatewawe. Ku iru paʼpachinwe, ku ahkete ninakariuwawe, pakari kahpashinkeran nunentu peike inahke nunenan keterinenpu.
Nimara uʼmawatan peʼpetupinan chinuhtapun kuʼwara iʼsha pentunchahtaraʼsunwe.
Chinuhchin, ahke iraterin.

Mamapaya nituhtunaʼpi, tahshita. Nuyahshakeran weʼka itaranke. Kema Nituhteran aʼna mama nani tahshi paʼyanin waʼwinpitamare. Sehtukeran yunkirawe nuyahsha tahshi nininsu. Nimara ninatarai tawerikahsu, ihsu irahka teʼwa puʼpian puʼpian taʼtein
Nunsha aʼsunanawe chinuhtakamare.
Paʼterinsu ku nanperiun nihpuni, ku inapuchin niʼihtuwe, naʼkun iʼshakeran iraterawe sami kehken peʼperawekeran.
Pantaʼpi yuʼsawatun yamura maʼpateran.
Nunawehsu nuyahshakeran nahtanku, mahshuruʼsa. Puʼpian wanirarawe, iʼsha wahpuru nani tahshiramiachin pihpirarin niʼtun inaran peʼpetunuwe iʼsha ichi pentuntarawe niʼtun.

Nuya nuwanterawe, waʼwishin. Nimara kanpuahsu yunkiahrewa mamaparin kañuatun ni nunentawen paʼninsu. Nimara nuyahtatun uʼmarin ihsu tawerimiahchin. Ka tenawe taʼtatewa nani taweri yaʼweawa. Inaran yaʼinpua pei kaʼtan aʼwa inaran iminke ninaʼawa.
Mañahtun paʼa aʼma iʼwayahtaraʼsuwe. Nunsha pihtaʼa yunsankeran.muhturu a tenenteke inaran iʼsha imakari kankunkaware.
Nuyahsha yaʼweihturuawe kurihki puʼpian yuntunuwa nihpuni, nimara nahsha nunshamare pawerechituruawe kuʼwara mukahtaraʼsuwe.
Ku kahpa kankantewirawe ku nihkapurawe wiʼnawe.
Shaʼwituku unputa paʼterin ina shiʼshi.
- ¿Nuwiteran ira? - Peʼinaʼpi nimara, nihpiriunwe nani tahshirarin inaran ku nuya niʼnawe iʼwaraya niʼnawe niʼtun.

Waʼwishinuwe, werun suʼpianwa kusharu suʼketamare. Nimara puʼmukariuwa sami chinpi inaran puʼpian yamura. nimantaratun kuhseraʼwa kepaʼawa inaran nunentu pahkaturu. Kahsu aʼpeirawe pentunpate ku maʼshateranta shipikamarewe. ku nituhterawe mama nani waʼwin yaʼwetumara, paʼa mañahtun. tatamahsu nuntawatewa paʼawa.

¿Ayanaran iʼshakeran nani tahshi yaʼkunarin nahkaranchin? Tatanen ninararin yaʼkuanake, sehtereʼna. ¿Ku yunkiranwe ahke nunshinan nininsu? Ira ahke inaran sipirurin.¿Unpuruta nituhtaran aʼkayan pakahsu, amiraʼwa?
¿paʼanke pantaʼpi kayanpi ihpera?
Nuyahshakeran weʼka iteke mamapaya, paʼpi sehterin kuʼwara nahtayantaraʼsuwe.
Ama kehparitekeruwe kemaura,karinken nubchinken.
Ama paʼankesus puʼpiamare manunanke,inaran ku nanihterinwe paʼantamare maʼsharuʼsa nuwanterinsu wiʼnanpita, peike.
¿I kiruwatan naniteran chinuhtakahsu?
Ku pakawen kuʼwara shaʼwichahtaraʼsuwe.
¿Naniterawe kahtu samira niwike ketawansu inaran tahshiraya yamura ketuku? Inapuchin yah nini ku niawerewe.
Paʼanuwa nununen paʼantupike inaran nuyahshakeran kusharu uwinkarewa waʼwaruʼsanke kuʼwara kanpuwara ni kechahtaraʼsuwe.
¿Unpuwanta samira paʼanewa, inaran nañantere niwiterehsu paweretakahsu?

Sehtatu itaranke, iyawe:kanpuwa wayu yuʼsawatewa maʼpatewatewa yamura, ¿insunahputa aʼnuihtunwe? Aʼma naʼkun paʼterinsu akutekehsu, yunkike waʼwaruʼsa tanapihsu. Nuya kankankeran aʼpaniteke. Yunkiaʼawa aʼna ni shaʼwiterehsu nuyahsha niʼina ninanuke.
Waʼwaruʼsa, nunteku nuyahsha tatamahshu paʼsarin iʼsha peʼnahte niʼtun? Aʼma naʼnekuhsu, winaimichin chinihken niʼtuku, ina samira yaʼi kentararin kanpua mare.
Ninakeʼ, paʼpi ahke ira.
Ku chinuʼteriwen ina Nani pentuninke ihshanake peʼpewachina keʼken Nani tahshirayamiachin iminke panin.
Wʼkama, ¿Kema nituhteran unputa pawanin ihkankamare? Peinuwe ahke kehpariterin inaran uʼnatakahsu teʼwaterawe.
Aʼma pakehsu ku nihkapunkurawe, iyahsha. Ku nuyawe tatanen kepakainsu ahke iʼshake. Ku pakariuwe wayu yunihkari tananke iʼwapuchin. Panka ihpuku ihpura, aʼma taweri naʼweinsu.
Ku paʼmarinwe paʼtaerinsu nuya nimiriu.
Ku naniterewawe ayankahsu ina uʼnanke.

Wiʼnawe, nuya nahtanke sgaʼwiterankensu nuyakeran. Aʼna ninanuke kankunawe ku shaʼwipurawe nihpuni, yuni ihtuntu aʼshimuhtunen weʼka itamare. Aʼma yaʼkunkehsu tuhpinan ku nanuterawenpa. Peʼpeke maʼsha kemuiruʼsa nahkawirarinensupitamare. Ikirurawe iratatu nihpuni, inapuchachin nuya nihchihtuwe. Manuke, wiʼnawe, ihpura unpuinteranta paʼ a.
Nanituwi iyaruʼsa yuntunkaisu puʼpian puʼpian nuwantupihsu paʼankaimare paʼtuwachin.
¿Unpuatun napuin paankasu pantapi inakeran mapatakasu sami irakapuchin?
¿Penturawe ihsu ihshana paʼpi ahke?
Aʼma tanawitukuhsu nuʼwitu aʼshinchinkuhsu.

Paʼa mañahtun mamapaya, aʼma kemaura naʼnekehsu yaʼkuanake. Nimara ahpimahshu uʼmararin sahkaterinkeran ahke ninanukeran. Naʼkun naʼwanan nihpiriunwe, nimara uʼmakapun senatu nankiwachin. Aʼma teʼwakehsu, karinken ihseke nani iʼwaraya kaʼtainken ninataman.
Ayanan samurareken, uskuruʼ, inaran kayawin kaʼ yunkirawe nahpuru piʼ i ayamairusu ikirupinan nikapenawe nuya kankantuwinan ninanuʼke

Ku tanan iraparihchin ni puʼmuranwen, ¿nuʼten? manureʼna ichinken: Aʼma mukaru ira paʼtekesu. chiweran tahshi nimantaratun ku peʼpetu keparanwen. Aʼma keura pantakehsu, aʼma ninakehsu uʼnan ira yaʼkuin nahkaranchin.

Aʼma wira teʼwatekehsu, waʼwasha. Wira chinihken anutuwachin, ihpuku inaran karinke aʼpeiyaranken peʼi ahkuanake.Tahshiraya piʼiruʼte nuyahsha yaʼnuarin nahkaranchin inaran peʼikariuwa pihpiaruwa nuyahsha.Chinihken kankanteke aʼma teʼwakehsu, maʼsu teʼwa paʼsarin kahtuyaʼpinpu nihpate. Tanshike, chinuhteke inaran tahshiraya yuʼme mentahtari panka samirake.
¿Ma urataʼ kankunpuaʼ aʼna naruʼpaʼ?
Uʼnaike, tatamahshu ku inshariteranta niʼniunwe nimantaratun ku inshariteranta a nuya kankanteriunwe, nahpuatun sehturi ku naʼweteriunwe.

Nuya nahtanke, iyawe:Ahpimahshu tanankeran uʼmawachin, nuyahshakeran nahkawike. Niʼsaran unpu winarinsuta kanpu niʼsawatunpu. Ku teʼwarawe, manuke, nunshake puʼmuteke mañahtun. Ina naʼwaninpu iʼwaraware inaran weʼsarin nuyahshakeran kenankapunpuan yaʼinpuwa.
Tataine waʼwaruʼsa shaʼwichin: saʼyate tarahpa aʼnanpi iyahsha inaran ushahpi. Aʼma yuhkehsu maʼsha sahkai sahkateramahsu.

¿Ku nuyawe Waʼwasha yusparin itakasu iyahsha peʼirinsu kañaʼpiruʼsamare? Paʼpin nahtanterin wiʼnin ihsu nituhtuwachin. ¿Inta ya kehpariterin inaura ku iyahshawawen ninanuke? Inahsu ku yusparin teniunwe ayaterin piyapiruʼsa nuhsururinsu.
Tahshiraya kankunpatu, taʼna peʼtenarawe panka peike inaran weʼka itarawe mamapayaruʼsa waʼwaruʼsa aʼpeipihsu.
¿unpuanta taʼtahran kariken yusparin itahpieankenwe paʼantaerawehsu aʼpieteranku niʼtu? Kahtawarankuhsu a nuya kankanterinku ihsu semana sahkaipuchin nininke.
Waʼwaruʼsa kahtawaku kanpita iyawarinke paʼanchi, wayuntuke karinsu ayaʼnatamare, ama nuhpinan yuʼkesuwe, tuhpnakeran paʼantaran, taʼake, wenukari tapirarin.
¿Ka nimara paʼantumiatapu waʼki kepakamare neʼmehte nuwanterauhsu, ku nimara kurihki puʼpian ihkantapunku paʼmakamare irake nimara?

Kaihsharuʼsa nuhsururawehsu, nahtanku ihsu nuya nanan mamapaya waitenaʼpi nuntarimahsu. Kuʼwara pantaʼpi peʼpeyahtaraʼsuwe ninanuʼpa, nuya wayuanwa nununen senateruahsu inaran kanuwiruʼsa tananpitaʼawa kanpuamare. Aʼma tuhpinan yuʼwawasu sahkatenenpuwa: nuyahshakeran peʼten awa. Inara paʼanuakeran, paʼan awa yamuraʼtun kusharumare, ina kuahsu pawanapunwe weʼwehtanake.

Irake naʼwerarin nihpuni aʼna mama waʼwin peʼperinkeran, waʼwashari uterinsu kuhtarute kahtawaihtunwe. Nuyahsha nunchihtunwe inaran aʼnuterin ira shipirinsu uʼnankeran. Inaran iterin nuhsuruʼihtunwe kayaʼwain nuhsurinpuchin.
Ku chiwi ihtuwe tehkein imarawe nihpuni.
Ku ya nañanterankenwe, nunwanterawehsu, iʼsha winkinterin nahtantuwatera nuyahsha weʼnawe.

Manuke, wiʼnawe, kahtawake mamawarin kehsha paʼain wankuru. Nuyahsha wentunen akuke inaran paʼterinsu chinhken nahtanteke. Aʼma niwikehsu inshateranta, inapihkeran ku paweretapiuwe. Aʼnarahchin maʼpateke inaran peʼpetuke tahpake.
Nimara muhturu tenentapun ihpura, ¿Nuʼten?
Nimara nuʼwitu tehsharinpu nunshake.
Nimara ka kanpiaterawe samiranuwe uskuruke inaran yamura, inapuchin ku kurihki tihkirawe inaran yaaʼinpuwa kanararewa, tenawe.
¿Tahparawe yunki kahtawarinkuhsupita nimara?
Iyahsha, ya nahtananke nuyahsha nunteku iʼwaterawemare.
Aʼshatu, yunahsha nuntuku manu niʼnankenmare.

Aʼshatu kankipachin iʼshakeran peʼpetureʼna, yaʼi yaʼkarichiʼina. Aʼma tuhpina ku paʼyatupirinawe kankanenkeranchachin nahkawiʼinasu. A nuya kankanchiʼina inaran a chinuhchina. Manuku, kemuiruʼsa kahpashin kankantawi nihkatuna inaran tawirapitupi nuyahshakeran.

¿Unpuwanta kemahke aʼshatuparinuʼku ni nuʼwirai nunsha mare? Waʼki taweri irake ni kenanpatera ku ni nuterayuwe. Kahsu teʼwatarawe ina yunkikahsu ku wachi ni nuhsureʼsu. ¿Ku kemarinta naʼwananwe kuhsatunanke, amiraʼwa? Inapihkeran ina weʼnin, nuyahsha ni nutawatui nanan nuyahterai inaran ni ihpurai. ¿Inapihkeran nuyahsha kankanterai? Nuʼwiteresu ina nahpa nimainke sahkaterepuchin.
Inawa yuntunpi kurihke yamura paʼansawatuna.
¿Tenan ina nahtanterin nuyahshakeran shapun paʼterinsu iʼke?
Mama, nahtan inke yuhsemare aʼma pawereʼinkusu paʼantenaʼpi, ina paʼanin nuʼmuhken puʼpian mare ihpura.
¿Iʼkeran wentawatera ku wiʼnawe ihpurawe? Ku, inahsu ku nuʼtenwe; yah maʼparawe nuyakeran inaran samira keninmare yusparin iterawe.
¿Niʼnawe uʼmantararin nihpuni winaʼihtuwe?

Ka mamapaya niʼnawe nunshakeran nuwarararin nihpuni, kahpashinkeran taʼasawatu weʼka ichihtuwe.Ninake kemuiruʼsa ku manupinanwe, waʼwawe. Kahtawaku peʼpetu uhkuiʼi kankipachin, inapuchin ka puʼpian chinuhtarawe inaran samira paʼahnantapu.
¿Unpuanta ina iyahsha winarin ya pakapuchin?
Kuya waʼkirawe maniahtun kankunkamare.
Niʼku pentunarawe,ka nuwanterawe pentunkaʼwasu ihsu pentuwinan anpu,tunputeke chinihkenihsu peʼtatenaʼpi seʼterawe naʼkun.
Weʼkama, nahtanke weʼka itarankensu inaran yusparin iteke nuya nanan keshirinenpuhsu.
¿Ni pahtumatariwa yaʼihpinpua nihka?
Nunshinanke paʼmarahpun, nahtanchihtunwe unputa samira paʼterinsu kuʼwara kemanta paʼanyahtaraʼsuwe, iʼwara aʼna wentun mare puʼpian paweretupi niʼtun.
Kehshake yusparin itapu nimara.
Ku waʼwasha tuhpinan paʼihtunwe, mahsu ninanuke yaʼwewihsu kuahsu nituhtupiuwe ahke paʼninsu inaran unpuru uʼmarinsu.

¿Ina aʼna peʼpetura piʼshiru yuʼsawatun ya maʼpaterin sharaya kemuinenpita nuwanterinsu? ¿Ina sanawi yaʼwerin nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu shaʼwirin maʼsha naʼkun yaʼweterinsu ya kanpiaterin? ¿Manukeran yunkirapi ina sanawi ya wairinsu ninatarin taʼnanenke?
Mahshu ku uʼnan awanteriunwe, kemuinenpita kahpa niʼtun inaran nani iʼwaraya ku nuyahsha yaʼwekahsu naniriunwe.

¿Paʼmaran peike nani tahshirawachin? Ahke ira inaran yuʼme peʼperansu paʼpi kehken. ¿Ku teʼwaranwen Kemaura iratakahsu tananke? Tahshiraya paʼihsu nihpai, wiʼnawe, inapuwatan kankuanan kuʼwara piʼi muhtuwi yaʼkunchahtaʼsuwe.

Iyahshanuwe paʼpachina ahke ninanuke, kari nuyahsha nunterawe ku paʼshahtapunwe. Nahtanke penenankensu: yusparin tehke yaʼi tawere iminke inaran iʼshake ninehsu kahtuyaʼpinpu. Aʼma nañantekehsu piyapiruʼsa ahke paʼpatan, inaran ayanke kahpashin kankatawatun nanitupatan. Ka kahpashin kankanterawe nuwiteranke niʼtun, ihpuranta ninuwinuke sehtu mentahtarinku. Ni aʼpeike irake inaran yunkike nituhteresu.
Ama naʼnekesuwe,amihke naʼneinen
¿pitenteʼ keparuwaʼ pihshate yanihken?
Iʼsha yunsanke wensekariuwa tenan.
Ama paʼankesuwe pantapi ku yunkiapunawe,piyawiʼsa paʼantunaʼpiruʼsa ya nunpinpi naniterinenke nunpinteinenkesu ku pawereraninkewe nanirinsu.
Aʼma a nuya kankanchinsu nunpinkeran.
Iyawarin pihshate aʼnutunke.
¿Tenan samira ni ichi yaʼweretere?

Nimara piyapi ka yaʼwerawe nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu ninahpirinkuwe mairarinsu kahtawakamare, nimara ina weʼnin ka nihkapunku. Ku kahsu nuya nituhterawe ina ka maʼsuna nuwanterinsu. Ku manta tenawehsu inahsu sehterin puʼpian. Penen kechinken aʼpanitamare inshateranta kahtawarinkehsu, inaputuwatan nuyahsha kemuinpitareʼken yaʼwaran.
Waʼyani tahpain, iratarin.
ku maʼsah keparawe kañurahpatu.
Waʼwa, paʼa kankuaʼa kuʼwara tahshiruʼpurawarewe, paʼpi ahke iratari, maniatun inaran kahtawakiwe peʼpei ihsu maʼsha paʼpi kehkenmahshu.
¿Mamanuwe, ihpura paʼsaran? ¿Naniteran iʼsha pentuntkasu taweriachin? ¿Maʼmareta manuran yuʼmenen kepatun inaran maʼshanenpita?

Peʼpeawa yaʼi kuʼwara tahshiahtaraʼsuwe. kanchura kepaʼawa, neʼmehteruʼsa inaran piʼshi aʼsunkamare. Aʼma nañantaʼawasu saʼyate pahkaturu puʼmuruahsu. iʼwaraya kankuanuwa, wewepiru nihkapun mamanenpuamare inaran waʼwin. manuke, waʼwaruʼsa, tunpunanke maʼsharuʼsa a napeʼawa.
Tahshiwachin inpitare peike uʼmaina iratatuna kuʼwara tahshiahtaraʼsuwe; inapuchin ku kanpitara irataramawe.
Paʼpatan iʼsha peʼnahte, aʼma sehtekesu; yunkike nani tahshiramiachin tanan weʼka iteran irahkapuchin kanpu ninehsu.
Nuyahsha tantiaʼin kurihki iʼwara kanarinsu.
Nuya taweri yaʼwechinken, nanunsha. Nuya aʼsunke taʼna inaran kusharu yanihken tahpake, pakakahsu ninanuʼpa nunshake inahsu nuʼten.
¿Inaruʼku senaterawehsu ya ni keterai?
Waʼwi, naʼwanan kemanta pei pateresuʼ, manuhtun, ihperaʼ peʼpekariwa maʼshanenpua kuʼwara nanpeyahterasuwawe.
Inawitasu nihpirinwe nuwantupi iraitakaisu ninanuʼwapa kurihki ku iʼkikamaraiwe, yaʼihpinpua nihpatewa kurihke yaʼwetanpua peike maʼsha paʼanakaimare.

Weke, shanaraʼwa, mañahtun nuʼwihken teʼnararin. Pantaʼpinen kepawatan irake, yunkikeʼ unpuhsuna paʼterinsu kuʼwara yuʼshahtaraʼsuwe. Ama tananpitekehsu pihkeran pawereʼinenkehsu, tananpituawatan naniantapi. Inawa niʼtechinachin nuya pichike kurihki. Manuke, puʼmuke pantaʼpi kuhtaruke nani nunshinanpa pirahtupi.
Ihsu paʼterinsu nanparin ihsu semanake.

Weʼka, waʼwaruʼsa. Ihpura tahshi naʼkun uʼnanarin inaran kanpuara tahshinanke wensahpariwa. Nimara sehteruwa peʼtawaruʼsa awipiranke niʼtun. Nihpiriunwe wenukatariuwa nahpuinahchin inaran yusparin itarewa nahsha taweri tawerianpitupatewa.
waʼwishinen pakapun nimara peʼpepepachin. Nahtaninke, sanapi, aʼma teʼwakehsu, keteke shuʼshu nuyakeran.
Kema aʼchinan kanaterehsu yuʼpatera nuyahshakeran nuya ni wentun yaʼwere inaran nuya kankankeran yaʼwere peike.
Chinihken kankantaʼawa yaʼi taweri tanan paʼtupihsu mare, niaʼawa uʼmapachina ihpuaʼawa chinihken kemuinenpita kahpashin kankantaimare.
Ninanuke nuwantupi sahkaimiachin iratakahsu nimantaratun iʼsha naʼkun pentuntapi kuʼwara ahke ninanu ihkanchahtaraʼsuwe.
Inaran ina parah aʼnanku, tatanuwe kahtawarawe kehsha shaʼkamare. Inapuwate taweri Yaʼwetarinpuwa inaran tihkiaruwa kuʼwara piʼi piʼkachahtaraʼsuwe.
Mamapaya napurin iyahsha ku ahsu paʼniunwe ku yusparin tehkapunawe.
Paʼawa paʼantawa atari ni yakawarewasu.
Ku ketarankunwe yaʼi samira puʼpian yamura mare, nanitere nahtantakasu shapun ma kankankeran ni ichi yaʼweretamare.
Aʼshatu, nahtainke kema peʼpetu peʼpeke, ka tuma kepaʼi inaran samira pihshate paʼanehsu.
nimara samira ku pahrinwe
Sanapi, nahtainke nani tahshiramiachin waʼwan aʼyateke, Nimara nuwianatatunke weʼehkapun nuyahsha ihpupatan.
¿Unpanta ku ninaranweʼ yaʼihpi pantaʼpi kayantakawareʼ? Kanupisuʼ nahpunin, ku kashin taraninweʼ. Ama manu iʼshakesuʼ. Ama kemarahchin iminke kehparitekesuʼ; Ama paʼyankesuʼ, unpurusuʼ kayantarin.
Paʼantupisupaʼ ku yaʼwerinwe yamura.
Paʼawa ahke,¿pentuanwa iʼpuraichin iʼshana?
Tahpakawe nimara ina yunkirawehsu
¿Unpuanta ku ya ihpurankewe chinehken?
¿Nani naniantemranke ina yunki sehturu nininsu?
Ku nuʼteken niʼnawe nituhterinsu sehterawesu. Nahpuru tahshiramiachin saweni mukarumahsu nuyahterawe yunkirahpamare, ni ihpurai nunshinanke.
Paʼyan ketetinku nahpuru nihshamiachin ihpuranku niʼtun. Sehtapirawe, inanta Inapuchin, ninanu patumiatapun.
¿Uhshi, paʼsaran mamapayataʼpa ihpura? ¿Maʼmareta nahpuin iwiantaran manureʼna? shaʼwituwai waʼwaruʼsanta kepasawatan.

Aʼma nañantaʼawasu tuma peʼpekamare, kanchuraruʼsa inaran yani pahkatururuʼsa. Yaʼi akuaʼawa nunshake ihpura. Teʼwarawe ahke ira niʼtun nimantaratun ku kankuanuwa.Manuke,waʼwaruʼsa paʼawa kuʼwara piʼi tanan yaʼkunchahtaraʼsuwe.
Yaʼwechin nuya iʼwaraya, siura. Nuyahshakeran nunshake nanpeke inaran nuya akuke taʼna kuʼwinpa, chinuhtaman ninanuʼpa paʼnanke.
Ihpura paweraran insuna kahtawarin peʼperan senateransu iminkeran peiʼpa kemapihsu.
Waʼwasha, pantahpi senawatan paʼankamare puʼpian kurihki tahpake puchuwiteke, inapuwatan ku maʼshateranta pawantarinkenwe peʼipachinara.

Waʼwa, kepateke ihsu wenu mamanken yunke nuya yaʼpiraran, inapuchinahchin keteke yaʼipiya, yaʼihpi kurihke naʼpachinake awa tuhpinan ketekesuwe, inapihkeran ku parutupiwe ianmare mama nuʼwitantanwe, maniahtun kuʼwara maʼsha paʼanpishuke taʼwantarin.
Paʼkariwa nimara wahpuru iʼsha ihkankipachin.

Unpuwa, ku nunterawe iyahsharuʼsa kuʼwara paʼshataraʼsuwe iʼwara. Ku iʼwakasu ninararawe, pihpirawe kamutechin paʼantamare. Kahpashin kankanterawe yaʼi aʼnuarahchin paʼanawe niʼtun. Ku nañanterawe taʼna peʼtenkamare wahpuru iʼshake chinuhtamare peike uʼmakaripuchin.
Weʼkamaʼ, ku sehteranweʼ

Nunentenaʼpimahshu shaʼwirin wiʼnin aʼnanin yuʼme paʼtuwisu aʼna sanawi ina nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu. Kemapi ya peʼperin nihpuni kehsha iminke,inari nuyahshakeran nuhsurutakahsu naʼkun keterin. Inaran ina maʼpatarin wayuruʼsa kahtawaterinmare. Tatamahshu winarin inaran tenin aʼnantakahsu maʼsha ku mukanarewe yaʼwerike.Waʼwaruʼsa nituhtawi kahpashinkeran maʼsha yuʼkamare. Inapuchin nuyahsha suʼsure yaʼwere peike iʼsha pirianke.
Panka weʼehta aʼnanku, yuhsemare, nani pihta kañaritarin nimantaratun kusharu nihsarewa yaʼimare. Kahtawaku mañahtun, aʼma waʼkikehsu.

Nani kanaʼwepa aʼnatran ninanuaʼwake, ninatrau nuyahpiachin ku nanputaʼsuwe nunshinake, paʼnawe yuhki aʼpinpachina iʼkeke samiruʼsa chinuhtapi, nahpuachina uhshahkeran yaʼkunawe, uhshahkeran nuntrau mashuruʼsa inaran ketrau sami pishate, inauchin kanawe ka yaʼweraweke.
Ina nuʼwiterin ku waʼwasha nahtetepachinawe, inapihkeran nuya nuntantarin.
Nuya niʼihtunwe ina uwinkarin nuya wayuruʼsarahchin nihpuni, inapurin nihpuni naʼkun kurihki maʼpachihtunwe paʼanterintaʼpa.

Iyaruʼsa, nahtanku ihsu kankanuwe rupahterinsu. Yunkiku unpuhsuna paʼtunen aʼpatakasu kuʼwara sami paʼayantaraʼsuwe paʼantupike. Aʼma nunpinchininsu. Kari aʼpitarawe yaʼi peʼinapiruʼsa inaran nuyahsha paweretarawe nuya, waʼyanuwe sehtarin ninanuke nuya yaʼwekamare.
Paʼa mañahtun nimara piyapiruʼwa kahpa nihsapi. yah yunkirawe waʼwaruʼsa inaran muhturu a tenantari pakamare ninanukeʼpa.
Uʼmakariuwa nimara ninatariuwa iʼwa puchin?
Sanawi, muhshainke, waʼwasha naʼnepachin nuyhsha nuntarawe. Inahsu ku nituhchahtariunwe, kanpitari nituhtarama nani taweri nuyahshakeran nuwanteramahsu.
Ku natantapiwe maʼsha naʼkun pahterinu ku paweretuwinanwe, unpuanta waʼanen ku naniterinwe nahtekasu inshateranta ku inkariteranta saminen paʼantakaisu, tananke

Unpuwanta sanapiraʼwa ka yaʼwerawe nuhtetenanke yaʼwerinsu ku pihpiriunwe peinenkera? Nimara teʼwarin waʼna weʼehta uhparin tehkatun? Kari nahtanawe aʼshini nuyahsha nunterin tehkatu. Nimara teʼwarin nunkamare. Shaʼwiterawe aʼshini paʼpi nuwanterin. Niʼnawe kahpashinkera yunihsarin. Kahtuyaʼpikui ni ihpurai inaran nuyahsha kehpariterin. Ka paʼyansawatu pahshi tenawe tururu puchin.

¿Nuya shaʼwiterawe kaihsha aʼma nunshinanke nunpintakaimaruwe? Kari shaʼwiterawe nuyahsha sami kurihke maʼpatamare. ¿Nimara ku nuya shaʼwiterawe? Paʼnawe aʼna sanawi wairinsu nihkapu nahpuatun ku nuya tihkiterawe shaʼwiterawehsu.
¿samira ihpura naʼkun paʼterin?
Teʼwarawe tahshiramiachin pakatuwe.
Kema ama kahpa kankantekeruwe aʼnaruahchin,nahkuanawe ihpura ama iratekeruwe sehteruken iyawarinehken.

Tatamahshu napurin paʼsarin ahke iminenpa. Nimara ushahkeran iraterin nani mahshu niʼtun. Tenin saweni peʼperin inaran puʼpian tuʼnaru. Uʼmapun kamutechin u nihpun iʼwaraya nimara. Ina shaʼwirin kahpashinkeran panka kehsha senararin.¡Kahpashin kankanterin niʼni shaʼwipachina shaʼterinsu! Nimara kemapun aʼna yuʼme mentahsha mamanuwe ketamare.
Naʼnei ihpura aʼnuterinsu paʼsarin iwanke tahshiraya. Iminke nahpuinahchin iratare inaran inaran sahkatakahsu kahpashin nahtantantari nahshakeran.
Kemanata kansateran
Kenuhtariuwa nimara kehken peʼpetureʼkenpu.
¿Yaʼi tahshi ihseke ninatapun?

Weʼkama, wiʼnawe sanawi. Nani nimara nuya akuran peʼpetu nunshinankeʼpa pakamare. Ku nimara ihkantariuwe nunsha kuʼwara uʼnan anuchahtaraʼsuwe. ¿Maʼta kema yunkiran, ninaʼa ku nihpun pataʼa? Kahsu teʼwa keterinku iʼsha irake mahpachinpu. Nimara nuya kepakahsu kuhtarute inaran weʼehta nuya aʼtantupinan. Aʼ peiteke peʼpetuatan, aʼma pinen tapikehsu, pawantarinku naʼkun iratamare.

¿Ka, paʼan ihtuwe pantaʼpi paʼantupiʼpa yamura paʼankamare? Ina kurihki kanarawehsu kentaihtuwe uskuru inanaran puʼpiyan askaru. ¿Nuya kechihtunakuwe nuya paʼterinsu inanahpukeran? Peike uʼmaihtuwe kahpashin kankantereʼna, yuʼme mentahtawatu maʼsha kemaihtuwe, kemuwinupita ketemaihtuwe.
¿Waʼwasha, unpuanta tahshiwan nininsu teʼwachihtunwe? Inaran yunki ihtunwe nuya waʼyanuʼsa tahshi aʼpeirinpu?

Nahtanchihturuwawe nuyakeran ira aʼnutinpumare, kiyahsu chiwerai werun mahkapui paʼsapiraiwe sapumare, kahpashin kankantatui uʼmarai peike. Nihpiriunwe, puʼpian chinuhtari inaran ninakari uʼnan nuyahsha naʼwekahsu.
¿Iʼsha awaike waʼwanpitamare?
Anuyahtunaʼpi ku maʼtaranta nuwanteriwe niwike yuhakasu.
Paʼantenaʼpi mahshu, muhshainke shaʼwituku unpuhsu pawereinke yamuramare inaran shapun peike keparawe mare.

¿Ku niʼnanwe uʼnan meʼtayahtarinwe ihpurawantaʼ? Ama iminke patarakesuʼ, Tuʼkuitatun anututan. Kahsu aʼna taweri meʼtakasuʼ ninarawe, ku manurawe. Ama kemarahchin ina ira shipin paʼtekesuʼ. Tahshiraya taweri piʼisarin, Ama manukesuwe, miʼse.
¿Tahshiraya tahshiramiachin pihpiwatewa, kepararawe wiʼnawe uwantapike?
Ku kemanta yaʼweterinke kuriki paʼakamasuʼ
¿Unpuanta tenama ku wiʼnawe nuwanterawe? Ina yunkiramahsu ku nituhterawe, aʼkayan winarinsu a nuya kankanrerinku inaran ku tananpiterawe aʼpeirawehsu.
Iwan werunuʼsa anakunterin nihpainawe kahsu ku ya niʼnawe airanke, ku kahteranta niʼnawe, ku nuya kankanterawe, nihpanawe ke kuitarankun ina kamaresu nuyahpiachin.
¿ku chinuhteriwen anataweri pupiyanteranta iʼshana yunsanke,ana iʼshana mawetatun kankukamare peike?
Weʼkama, mamapaya, ama chinuhtapunawe ira pataʼa.
Pentuawan aʼmisenan nuyashakeran.

Ya muhsharanke iʼra aʼnutainku mare uʼmakamare, chiwere irake sahkatura uʼmarahpiruwe, chinuhtariwaʼtun iʼshapirianke. Inapihkeran, kahpashin, ira nahkaranchin kenantari inaran taweriachin kankunkari nimiriu nihkamare.

¿Tenan waʼwasha ku yuʼkapunwe kehsha puʼpian yamura maʼpatamare? mamapaya tenin ina ichi yaʼweretapun kahpashinkeran, yamura paʼpi paʼtun tanake. ¿Sanawi kemapianke yaʼwerinsu nuwanchihtunwe inapuchin yunki yaʼi peimare?
Ni nuntaʼawa ninanuʼpa ayankumakamare, nimara pantaʼpi paʼanwa inaran yamura ihsu semake naʼkun nuwantapi niʼtun ninanuke.

¿Kemarinta naʼwanan peʼnate iʼshaparihchi paʼsapun? Ku naniterawe weʼekasu iyawe. ¿Ku inshateranta inamare nuniunwe? Teʼwa ketetinku ihsu taʼtahresu. Shaʼwiteke mañahtun, ¿Nituhteran Unpuruta uʼmararin? Kahpashin kankanterawe maʼshateranta shaʼwituwachinkura, maʼsu ku naterawe ninatakahsu.
Iyahsha, Yunkike nahpuru tahshi ahkerinsu: wiʼra aʼpayaninpu yunsanke. yusparin tehke karuʼku, nimara tawerikahsu kenin naʼkun nuya yaʼwetakhsu ninuwike.
Paʼantenaʼpi shaʼwirin piyapiruʼsa ku ni aʼpeipiuwe kañukeran inaran ku paʼpiuwe shaʼwipike inaran aʼchinpike unpu ni aʼpeikamare kañu aʼma ni pahshitamarewe ninanuke.
Ni ketuku yaʼihpima shapun.
Ama maniantekesuwe nuya aʼnikasu sami kuʼwara paʼantaran; ku nihpun uhseretarinenke pawereninsu.
¿Ku nituhtraun pantaʼpinuwe iʼwahpuchin kanpuru inaurechin?
Ku pihpikariuwe ku aʼmuhpatuwe uʼnan yaʼi ira shipihterin niʼtun

Tata, ku nañanterawe nahpuru chiwerawehsu ahke iminke. Ku niʼnawe nara iʼtururansu intunke. Uʼnan a chiweterinku iraterawehsu. Ka naniterawe ayankamare, inaran sehturukeran yunkirawe yunirankensu yaʼi iraparihchi.
