Nunteke mamanen inran nuya akakanteke, nahpuru naʼkun naʼwaninke.
¿Nahkaranchin iyahsha uskuru ketantaʼi?
Nuyahshakeran weʼka itaranke ihsu irake. Manurawe pehpetunuwe nani tihkirarin niʼtun, nihpiriunwe chinuhtarawe puʼpian kuʼwara iʼshake paʼmayahtaraʼsuwe.
Ku mamaruʼkeweu, kenansarawe nuyahpiachin kanatarawe ihpera tahshi paʼninke.
Waʼwaruʼsa, nuyahshakeran tatamahshu ihpuku.Ninatuku, ina uʼmararin iʼshaparihchiran inaran yaʼinpuwa winararewe tahshiramiachin kayapin kapariuwachin.

¿Ku nuyawe niʼnanwe ku yaʼnupirinmare kanpuareʼkenpuwa iʼshake? Ituku, ¿Ina ayanarin pihtamare? Teʼwaterawe ahke kehparituwachin. ¿Kemanta nani iʼwaraya ninaran? Manuke, shaʼwike ninan naʼwepachin iraparihchi.
¿Kanpure ni ketaʼa sharia nanpiruʼre?
¿nihketaawa samira kanpuarachin?

Mahshu, muhshainke manuke. Tahshiraya pentuntariuwa kahtawini iʼshana sami kepate paʼankamare. Peʼpeke peʼpetunen ihpura nunsha nuya niaʼa. Aʼma nuhserate nañantekehsu. Tahshirayamiachin pihpipate, kankuane kanpuʼtun paʼantari. Manuke mañahtun.
Shaʼ wiate paʼnesu inaran uhmatarawe iraparitiʼ.
Yunkiʼina aʼna kemapi aʼnanterinsu aʼna peʼpetura sharaya inaran uʼmarin tuhpinan. Aʼma yaʼpirin pachinahsu piyapiruʼsa nañantenaʼpike.
Manuke, kahtawake aʼshatu pantaʼpi paʼantein. Nuya peʼtenke paʼanturuʼsa aʼma nuʼwichinahsu, inawa ayanpi paʼanteranke.

Ahpimahshu kankiwachina ihkeran, shaʼwiterawe samiranen paʼanterawe ina chinuhtaʼse. Yunkirai ni ketahsu aʼna siurate ruʼku aʼnateranpa yaʼwerinsu: inari yuʼnin kehsha pantaʼpire inaran kari keterawe sami chinpi ahpimahshu nininsu.
Inawa aʼnantupihsu aʼpeikapunarawe yaʼi ayatupi kanawihsu. inakeran nituhchina inaran aʼma kechinsu ku nitu maʼsha tenururinsu.
Nimara samira kehpi paʼantupikeran.
¿Payahsha niʼkapun kemuinenpita ninanuʼpa ihkamawachin?
¿Paʼa paʼantupiʼpa ihpura? Nuwanterawe uskuru paʼankamare inaran puʼpian yamura, peike ku maʼteranta yaʼweriunwe kuhsinakahsu niʼtun.
Nanun mama tenin kahpashinkeran sami nanpiru yuʼsawatun ya maʼpaterin yamura aʼna sanawi ahketerankeran keninsu?
Iʼwa tahparai nanpiru nuhsha paʼankamare.
¿Kahpashin kankanteran samira paʼanehsu nihkatun? Maʼpatereʼsu yuʼsawate maʼpatari puʼpian yamura inaran tuma kemuiruʼsamare, ¿Nuʼten?
¿Ka kusharu kepaihtuwe wiʼnawemare, uwantakahsu tahshirayaware waʼkirin nihpuni ninanu peike?
Nuwantuwirawe taʼna peʼtenkamare nara nukunanke, nihpiriunwe piyapi muhturu keparinsu ku ayaniunwe nimara ahke paʼmara.
Karuʼku weʼnan nihpura, kahtapaʼihtun aʼna sanapi yawairahrinsuʼ

Aʼma naʼkun sehtekesu, ahpiaʼwa. Yaʼwetarin ninatakahsu, maʼsu karinken aʼchintaranke yunihkamare samira iʼshana taʼtahrinkeran. Nituhteke ninatakahsu nuyahshakeran, inapuchin peʼinaʼpi ninarin samira ketetakasu.Sehtu patarinke karuʼku sahkatuwatan nani tahshiramiachin. Tahshiramiachin wenseke inaran weke, iʼsha ninararinpu teʼnashinkeran.
Sanawi nahtaʼin ihsu penen: aʼnanterin panka weʼehtanen inaran ayanin iʼshanake. aʼma maʼsha uʼurinsu pachinsu aʼnawita imirake ku aʼpeipachinawe iʼwa piʼi nininpuchin.
¿Kema paʼitun kemaruʼku aʼna ninanuraʼwake? inahke paruwenen nisenate tewechinuʼ, ka peʼpei iʼme ama kema kanuhtamarewe.
Ku nituhterawe nuya aʼna nimarawe ina senaterawehsu kepatu; nimara ayaterawe kuʼwara paʼayantaʼsu.
Ku ahke pakariwawe yuhse nuntariwarewe.

¿Unpuwanta nihka wiʼnawe ku shaʼwiterawe kurihki nuya pichikamare? Kahsu iʼwaraya manurarawe, aʼna sanawi ya wairarin niʼtun. ¿Shaʼwiterawe nihka unpumarena shiʼshi paʼankahsu? Inapihkeran nuya yunkirahrawe nuya shaʼwiterawehsu.
Ku tahshi iʼsha yaʼkarirawe teʼwatatu, ku kahtranta paʼnawe, ku kaweraihchin nuya kankanterawe, paʼawa ninaʼwa taweri niʼin.
Wʼwasha, nuya paʼtunkeran sami nanpiru ya paʼantuachinawe, kema puʼpian tahpake kirihka paʼankamen aʼchinpeike kepakamare.
Kahpa yawerinweʼ pantapi paʼantupisu
Ku paʼananwe shapun nuyahpiachin.
¿Tenan nañantapun waʼwishin wiʼni? Aʼpeiʼin, nuyahshakeran nunchin inaran aʼna tananpichinsu naʼwaninsu.

Weʼkama iyaruʼsa. Kanpuahsu sehterewa wiʼnanpuwa ku tanankeran uʼmapiuwe niʼtun. Niwiruahsu nuyahshakeran nuntariuwa inaran ninatariuwa uhsharan. Nahtanke weʼka iterankensu, kiwiaʼawa ihsu tawerimiahchin nuya peike uʼmararin
Tanankeran uʼmawatan, nanpiru nuhsha keteke mamaparin inari anpiʼin yaʼima kapamare.
¿Ka ruʼku Weʼsaran ninanuke? Inamini, paʼsarawe nahsha yuʼnana paʼankapun. Kahkensu nuhshiteterin nahpuatun ku naniterawe samira uwarakahsu nuyahshakeran.
Iyahsha kuahsu sehterinwe, yaʼwere mamapayahsu naʼkun yunkirin.
Uʼnanpachina naʼkun kawerehchin kankanterawe peike. Weke kaʼtanku aʼnarumahchin, ninuntakamareʼ nitewakamareʼ inapuchin sehteruʼ nanianchiʼi.

Weʼkama, paʼantenapi. Kuʼwara pahshahtaraʼsunwe nuya akuke maʼsha paʼankamare nunshake. Pentuntariuwa naʼkun iʼshana inaran iʼsha pamatarin. Ku peʼpetu weshirawe ku tunpukarirawe, yuhsemare. Manuku mañahtun kankuaʼawa peike kuʼwara uʼnananin. Nanpeke wai.
Paʼninsu uʼmarin paʼpi kanuhtuwina ihpera tashi.

Iyahsha, tahshiraya ayanpatan aʼchin peike yusparin itaranken. Kema nanitewatan kahtawainkusu nahkaranchin, Waʼwarusa winaihtunawe. Niʼke wiʼnawe winarinsu; kahpashin kankanchihteruwawe. Yuhsemare, aʼma kawera patekuhsu ihsu panka sahkatuke.
Tatamahshu ku pantaʼpi paʼanpunwe ku paʼterinsu nahtantapunawe, ku nuwanteriunwe kemuinenpita maʼshateranta pawantakahsu.
Ina ira kenantaʼin nahkaranchin.

Aʼma naʼnekehsu, iyaʼwa. Paʼsarawe tananke iwe yahshiteapu inaran uʼmararawe samira puʼmukapun weyain weyain.Kakiwihku inaran ninatakahsu tahpake kankanenke puʼpian. Niʼsaran tahshiraya kahpashin kankantaran ihpura puchin. Aʼma tanawitekehsu sehtu machinkensu ya yaʼnupiransu iyashareʼken iʼshake.
¿Ni keteku pantaʼpi kiʼshare?
Iʼsha a kuraiteke kuʼwara uʼuhshataraʼsuwe.
Ku nuyahkeran kushachituwe, kema paterankuweran ku nanitrau chinuhtakawausu.
Unpuwa, tatamahshu, ku nañanterawe ni nishi nininkasu tahshira ni uwantamare.
Yunsanke nunsha puʼmutupinan akuina, tenan ina paʼsarin aʼkayan.
Nuya niʼihtunwe ina yaʼi kehsha senarinsu yuntunin nihpuni inaran nunshake puʼmuihtunwe iʼsha ahketeranpa kepaihtunwe paʼankamare.

Kema shaʼwiteranken uhshiwe nahtaninku paʼantu kahtawakamare. Ka nuwanterawe ina niʼkamare inaran shaʼwirawe samira paʼantamare piyapiruʼsa nunshake yaʼkunpisu. Nuyahshakeran shaʼwiterawe peʼtenawehsu inaran pankaterinsu, yaʼipichachin nuwantupi paʼankeimare.
Aʼma maʼshateranta paʼankesu inaran kemuinen niwiterinsu ahkete suʼsurarin nani taweri.
Ninake nuya weʼnan itawenen, keʼparawe pishate yuhkakamare inaran nate naʼpatarawe, mashukuruʼsa yunkirawatu.

Kema nuwantewatan, ka wayuʼsa paʼanchihtuwe piyapiruʼsa chinutahpisu. ¿Aʼnarahchin paʼanihteriuwawe? Aʼnahken inara yaʼwerenamen atarikayu maʼpachihteriuwawe. ku nuya nituhterawe ihkantariuwa yaʼi nimara.sehterawe uʼnan irake aʼpeinpachinpuwa.
Inapita yunkipi unputa nimriu paʼtakasu.

¿Ka kepaihtuwe atarikayu peʼtenkamare inaran paʼankamare paʼantupike? Ina kurihkike nawan inaran nuya pihshi paʼan ihtuwe. ¿kamare ina yaʼwerenamen yamura maʼpachihtuwe? Nuya yunki ihtuwe shaʼwikamare ¡Kuhtarute mentahtawatu kahpashin kankantawatu uʼmaihtuwe yaʼweraweke!
Uhshinewe samira matuachinku, ku nuʼwiarawe, nuyahsha nuntarawe ku niawereʼna kushatamarewe.
Peinenke kankiʼin kuʼwara tahshitaraʼsuwe, yah nininpuchin, inaran mamapayanen kahtawaʼin pihshate aʼwintamare.
¡Paʼa kahpashinkeran! Yaʼinpipuwa pantaʼpi peʼpepatewa, kankuanuwa aʼnarahchin paʼantupike inaran kahpashinkeran paʼankeriuwa nani tahshiramiachin.
Ku taʼtahrawe kema nuyahteran nituhtuatera, wiʼnawe; kawera nihsawirawe, ina nanan nuyahsha a kankanterinku.
Kuʼwara iʼwayahtarasuwe nunshinanpa kankumarawe.
Nahtainke nunke nuya nanan karuʼku.
Unanpachina ku meʼtanawanwe, aʼyaran karuku inaran nuyapiachin kankantarewa peike.
Yamura paʼain ninanuke.
Uʼnani tatamahsu ku keteriunwe nuyahsha kankantamare; nahkunkeware, sehtu keterin ku inshareteranta yaʼweriun yaʼwerinke niʼtun.
Ku nuyawe niʼpiuwe iyaruʼsa ku wiʼnina uwantatunawe. Maʼsu ku ina ni yaʼkuiwachinawe kañu ku taʼtariunwe yaʼi iʼsha yankeapun.
Yamuwansawatun uʼnanpachina, mamapaya naʼwanin waʼwin. Inaura ni nahtanin inaran tuhpinan nahtanin iʼsha anuterinsu pei aipi.
Nuyahshakeran paʼin, tahshirayamiachin paʼnin.
¿Nunentunaʼpi kahpashin kankanterin yaʼi kemuinenpita nuya tanankeran uʼmarin niʼtun?
¿Kema sehteran iʼwaraya paʼmapachina inaran ayanan peike ina iraparichi wiʼnanpitareʼken maʼsha ni keteramahsu parihchi?
Aʼma niwiaʼawasu naʼkun iyahsha; ya paʼanpatewa nuya, maʼpataʼawa ihsuchachin inaran kuruhki taʼpaʼawa nuyahsha.
Ninanunenpa kankunpatu, nuyahshakeran taʼna peʼtenarawe inaran kemuiruʼsa weʼka itarawe nuya kankankeran nahkawirinawehsu.
Aʼma paʼinsu ku ihputunawe.
manukeʼ niwentunke saʼyate tarapa ku unayantarasu aʼma kemarachin keparitamasu peike
Nimara kuʼchahchin naʼkun puʼmuterawe pakamare.
Nuwanteransu paʼan ihtunwe ninanukeʼpa.
¿Uʼmapun paʼanteranken kurihkiʼken nimara ihpura taweri?
Ama maʼshateranta ketukusu ihsumare
Sanapi, Nahtan inken suʼyan patuachinke kemaura nuya nunteke, Nimara uʼmararin, inaran kahtuyaʼpinma waʼwasha aʼpeirarama.
Nuyahsha nunteku puʼpian nunpatewe, iyahsha; pateke ku sehtepunawe inaran ayanke iʼsha paʼmaipachin, ya uʼmaranpuchin peʼikapun.
Ku kepakariuwa taʼna pankamahshu kehken niʼtun nimantaratun iʼsha pentuntariuwa niʼtun.
¿Yunkikeʼ unpuinta nuhkumaran waʼwan?
Ina kuahsu yuʼyushanen nañanteriunwe inaran yusparin iterin kahtawarinsu.
¿Ku kahtapapunkuʼ pentuntakasuʼ ihsuʼ iʼshana kuʼwara tahshinantara,
Weʼkama, mamapaya. Nunshakeʼpa manperare inaran maitare ninanuʼpa kankumakaware. Ka peʼpetu peʼperarawe kema kepararan naʼkun kuhsinatlrehsu kahtuyaʼpinpu.
Nuya kemaruku, ahpiawa. Nani umaranke tanankeran, niʼterawehsu aʼpinin inaran taʼtarawehsu tahshiramiachin kashin puchin ninin.
Kemapi yunkiʼin maʼsuna pahsarinsu: peʼpetu aʼnanin iyahsha inaran ku ayanteriunwe. Aʼma aʼna maʼsha aʼnainsu ku nuya yunkiapunawe.

Amiaʼwanuwe, ama waniahkesu. Pantaʼpi paʼanapun kepawatan, nuya niʼke unpu pantaʼpinunta keparan. Aʼma naʼkun machinensu, uhsharan paʼankamare. Puʼpian kanawatan paʼanke tuma inaran uskuru.Pake nañahtun ira paʼteke, kuʼwara aʼna waʼwasha yaʼweretarinken inaputuachinken yaʼi inarahchin paʼantpi.
¿Tahshiraya nimara iyawe kankimare ahke iminkeran? ¿Nituhtawe kankanuwe a nuya kankantakasu iraparinchi narawankana nirepatu?
Nimara yaʼwerin a nuyahtakasu inaran a nuyahsha a kankatakasu.
Ku pantaʼpi paʼaninwe piʼpihsha paʼterinsu.
Wiʼnawe, tahshiraya paʼsarawe peʼnate ninanuʼpa. Nani puʼmuterawe. Ninake uʼmarawehsu uʼnan naʼwe pachin, aʼma yinkitekehsu kamare.
kepaʼawa pantaʼpinenpua maʼsha paʼanpiʼpa, inran niketaʼwa uskurureʼ iʼwahpuchin.
¿Keshin inke sami nanpiru iʼshakeran inaran kema yamura ketukun inaran uskuru kuhsinakamare?
¿Ka yaʼweterinku naʼkunkewari wayuruʼsa yuʼsawatu yamura maʼpatamare ninanuke, uʼmapu sehtuwinan nimara kemuinupita ku ninarinawe niʼtun?
Wenseʼa nahpuinahchin, nuwanterawehsu, puʼpian chinuhtaʼa. peʼpetu kehken nipiriunwe, nuya nahtanawe iratewatera ninanuʼpa iʼshaparihchi.
Paʼpi kanuhteran iratatunpa, waʼwina, napeke maniahtun, nahpanawe pawananin peʼpekamare penahteni nininsu kuʼwara nihpahtumachataresuwawe.
Unpua kanpita,ahpiramiachin paʼpi paʼyantarai,tahshiraya atarikayu ni ketarai kema keʼshanemare,ina nuya kahtu nuya nihkapun.
Ama naʼnekesuwe, nani yakankirareʼ.
Aʼna ninanuʼpa kankunawe kawera

¡Iyahsharuʼsa, nahtanku nuawehsu! Nuwanterankema ninanumare. Paku paʼantupiʼpa inaran nahtantuku nuyahsha paʼterinsu sahkatumare. aʼma inshateranta nunpinchinkusu uʼnan anutiwachin. Paweretarawe inaran manutarawe nuʼtehken, kankanuwe sehterin yaʼimare.

Tahshita payahsha nuwantupihsu. Weʼka ya iteranken nuyahshakeran. Nuʼten mare teʼwa tahshi nihpachina kaʼtane mama inaura ni aʼpeirinsu. Yunkirawe mahshuruʼsa ninatupihsu taweri ku teʼwapinanwe. Nimara, tahparawe ina yunki, waʼyanuwe nuya nahtanin tahshinanke.
¿Nunentun naʼpi kahpashin kankanterin ihsu piʼihke wiʼnan sanapi ninararin waʼwin niʼtun?
Aʼchinapi, ¿Aʼma ninakesu uʼmakaisu tananke paʼpisu? ku, ayaterawe nahterawehsu, nahpuatun naʼkaawirawe kahpashinkeran winareʼna?

¿Unpuwanta iyahsharaʼwa naʼnarin iʼsha yunsanke? Niʼnirane tananke ayarin nihpura. Ushahkeran yaʼkarirawe inaran imerawekeran naʼnei amihterawe. Nimara nuyahsha nunterawe, ku yunkirawe. Nahtanawe karuʼku niʼnira ya yunihpachin. Naputewatera puʼpisha winarin. Niʼmawe sehterinsu inairapuchin yanpuantun paʼnin.
Paʼan ihtunwe kehsha inaran aʼna samira.
Paʼawa yunkiaʼawa irahka paʼpisupita, ketaʼawa pahkaturu inran yamura, uskurureʼ.
Senateransu yuʼsawatun sami maʼpateran.

Tata, ¿Unpuaʼata atarimare kanarehsu? Nahtanku, wiʼnasharuʼsa: Nuya yuntunpatewa kurihki, tahpaʼawa kirihka paʼankamare. Aʼma kashin yaʼi taweri paʼankuhsu. Ni ketariuwa nuyahshakeran iyakapini inaran kahtawaʼawa mamapaya inaura yaʼwerinsu.
Nahtanteke a nuya kankanchinen, nimara nuyahtapun nimara.

Aʼma kirihka tiniranmare sehtakesu iyahsha. Nimara aʼna tinireʼpa nuya pihpitarinpuwe paʼa kahtuyaʼpinpu kirihka nuntaʼa. Nimara aʼchinapi ketantarinpu tininan. Aʼma sehtekehsu ihpura, paʼa mañahtun piruhta yaʼnupitaʼa kuʼwara tahshirarin.
Nimara ku nanitarewawe kepakahsu yuʼme mentahsha. Nimara nahkaranchin ayantarewa kehpariterinsu yunsanke kepakamare.
¿Yah kankirawe iʼwaraya wankui irake ikirurawe niʼtun? ¿ku nihpun uhsharan iraterawe niʼtun nimantaratun keparawe pahkaturu awaitamare?
Yuʼsarewa pihshate nanpiruʼ yamurareʼ inaran shapuneʼ.
Ku nanianterawe nuhsururawesu niʼnawe
¿Nimara uhshiwe waʼwin kwhsarin nahsha waʼwaterinsu? Kahpashin keran apinuarawe waʼwasha ku nuwiterawe niʼtun, ¿Ahpira ihkankiarin?
Naʼwanawe ayankamare irahkapuchin.

Mamapaya, kurihki yuntunpate, ¿ninanuke aʼna nahsha weʼehta paʼan ihteriuwawe? Ka yunihtuwe panka nininsu samira puʼmukamare. ¿Tena ketarinenpu nuʼten paʼtunke? Irahka weʼehtaruʼsa waʼkirin piʼihpi. ¿Ihpurasu ni iʼshupirin aʼnuarahchin, mamapaya?
¿Maʼta nuwanterewa? yamura inaran shapun tahpaʼawa.
Mamanen naʼwanan ninanukeʼpa paʼninsu. Nimara uʼmararin kematun maʼsharuʼsa kanpuamare. Aʼma sehtekehsu naʼkun iyaraʼwa. Yaʼkuanake ninatari inaran iʼshakeran kankintapachin chinirawate ihpukari.
Mamanuwe nuhsururawehsu, ku iʼsha uʼuhpatewe ku ira pentuntariuwe.
